### [1] [STATERA: Hidden Mass Estimation via Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Kinematics using Frozen Temporal Tubelets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00003)
*Animesh Varma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 STATERA，用冻结的 V-JEPA 视频骨干加轻量时序 tubelet mixer，从单目短视频预测不透明非对称刚体的质心热图与轨迹，并发布 HiddenMass 基准（50K MuJoCo 轨迹 + 63 段真实测试序列）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向帧级外观预训练的视觉模型难以从运动推断隐藏物理属性；在自遮挡下，表面线索与点跟踪不可靠，因此研究质心（CoM）定位这一隐藏参数估计问题。

Method: 在预训练视频骨干 V-JEPA 上做适配，主体权重冻结，仅训练轻量时序 tubelet mixer，输出逐帧 CoM 热图与轨迹；构建 HiddenMass 基准，含 50K MuJoCo 轨迹及 63 序列、具物理标定 CoM 真值的真实测试集；对比相位感知（Crescent）与相位无关（Sigma）两类监督目标。

Result: 仿真中 STATERA-50K-Sigma 将归一化 CoM 误差从 DINOv2 的 41.7% 降至 25.2%。零样本 sim-to-real 中呈现监督权衡：相位感知目标易产生双峰预测，相位无关目标易塌缩到统计安全质心。相位感知的 STATERA-50K-Crescent 是唯一持续朝真实隐藏偏移移动的方法，但存在单目向量过冲，绝对欧氏误差略高于静态几何质心，物理捕获率由 2.6% 提升至 41.0%。

Conclusion: 冻结的时序表征有助于将惯性动力学与视觉几何分离，从而更好估计隐藏物理参数；相位感知监督对真实隐藏偏移的捕捉更有效。

Abstract: Vision models pretrained for frame-level appearance often struggle to infer hidden physical properties from motion. We study center-of-mass (CoM) localization for opaque, asymmetric rigid bodies from short monocular videos, where surface cues and point tracking are unreliable under self-occlusion. We propose STATERA, which adapts a pretrained video backbone (V-JEPA) with mostly frozen weights and a lightweight temporal tubelet mixer to predict per-frame CoM heatmaps and trajectories. To support this task, we introduce the HiddenMass Benchmark, comprising 50K MuJoCo trajectories and a 63-sequence real-world test set with physically calibrated CoM ground truth. In simulation, STATERA-50K-Sigma improves normalized CoM error from 41.7% (DINOv2) to 25.2%. In zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, we observe a fundamental trade-off in supervision: phase-aware targets can induce bimodal predictions, while phase-agnostic targets can collapse toward statistically safe centroids. Nevertheless, our phase-aware STATERA-50K-Crescent is the only evaluated method that demonstrates consistent movement toward the true hidden offset. While this leads to a monocular vector overshoot artifact that marginally increases absolute Euclidean error compared to a static geometric centroid, it improves physics capture from 2.6% to 41.0%. These results suggest that frozen temporal representations can better separate inertial dynamics from visual geometry for hidden-parameter estimation.

</details>


### [2] [Emergent Object Binding Has a Finite Spatial Horizon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00006)
*Mayank Singal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文发现预训练视觉Transformer（ViT）的冻结patch嵌入中存在可解码的"IsSameObject"绑定信号，且该信号并非均匀全局，而是呈具有有限长度尺度的局部空间相干性（随距离指数衰减并趋于非零下界），这一结构性质可解释聚合准确率无法说明的多种行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究常用单一准确率数字报告ViT冻结嵌入可解码"两patch是否属于同一物体"（IsSameObject）信号，并据此认为物体绑定仅靠自监督预训练即涌现。但作者认为这一聚合指标掩盖了信号的结构，需要揭示其空间组织形式并解释聚合分数无法说明的行为。

Method: 在ADE20K与COCO数据集、DINO与CLIP等多种骨干网络上，使用三类探针（probe）从冻结patch嵌入中解码绑定信号；测量绑定概率随两patch距离变化的曲线并拟合指数衰减，提取长度尺度与floor；在控制混杂因素（如物体尺寸、遮挡）条件下，逐一剖析物体大小、同类/异类物体区分、部分-整体分组等行为；并初步比较DINOv2与DINOv3中horizon与floor的组织深度。

Result: 绑定概率随patch间距单调衰减并收敛至非零floor，可由有限长度尺度的指数函数良好描述；该衰减规律在多种物体尺寸、三类探针、ADE20K与COCO以及DINO与CLIP骨干上均成立，说明其为表示本身性质而非解码器特性。将绑定理解为有限范围的局部空间相干性，可解释聚合分数无法说明的现象：大物体上绑定减弱、同类不同物体比异类物体更难可靠分离、物体部件易与整体分组；而在控制物体尺寸后绑定不受遮挡影响。horizon与floor在DINOv2和DINOv3中出现在不同深度，作者将其作为初步（suggestive）观察报告。

Conclusion: IsSameObject信号具有局部、有限范围的相干结构，而非单一准确率所能概括；这一视角统一解释了大物体绑定减弱、同类物体分离困难、部分-整体分组等行为，并表明绑定源于自监督预训练。horizon与floor深度差异提示分层组织，但受探针层数少及模型间混杂影响，仅为初步观察，需进一步验证。

Abstract: Pretrained Vision Transformers encode whether two image patches belong to the same object. This IsSameObject signal is decodable from frozen patch embeddings at high accuracy, which suggests that object binding emerges from self-supervised pretraining alone. We show that this single accuracy number hides the structure of the signal. Binding is local: the probability that two patches of the same object are decoded as bound falls off monotonically with the distance between them and levels off at a nonzero floor, a falloff well described by an exponential with a finite length scale. This decay holds across object sizes, across three families of probe, on both ADE20K and COCO, and across DINO and CLIP backbones, which indicates that it is a property of the representation rather than of the decoder. Reading binding as local spatial coherence with a finite range accounts for a set of behaviors that the aggregate score leaves unexplained: binding weakens on large objects, separates distinct objects of the same class less reliably than objects of different classes, and groups object parts with their wholes. It is, by contrast, unaffected by occlusion once object size is controlled. We map each behavior with confounds controlled. As a preliminary observation, the horizon and its floor are organized at different depths in DINOv2 and DINOv3, which we report as suggestive given the small number of layers probed and the confound between the two models.

</details>


### [3] [Spatial Lifting for Dense Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00017)
*Mingzhi Xu,Tao Zhou,Yong Li,Yizhe Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出空间提升（SL）方法，将2D图像升维后用3D U-Net等处理，在稠密预测任务上以更低推理成本和大幅更少的参数量取得良好性能，并具备结构化输出、稠密监督与单次前向的自洽性不确定性估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稠密预测任务通常依赖2D网络，参数量大、推理成本高且不确定性估计困难，作者希望探索一种更高效、准确且可靠的建模方式。

Method: SL将标准输入（如2D图像）提升到更高维空间，再用为高维设计的网络（如3D U-Net）进行处理。该升维产生沿提升维度的内在结构化输出，从而在训练时支持稠密监督，并在测试时通过单次前向实现基于自洽性的质量与不确定性估计。

Result: 与常规方法相比，SL在基准任务上取得良好性能，同时降低推理成本并大幅减少模型参数量；其输出具有内在结构，可用于稠密监督及测试时的自洽性质量与不确定性估计。

Conclusion: 空间提升是一种简单通用的建模策略，为视觉稠密预测任务中更高效、准确、可靠的深度网络提供了有前景的方向。

Abstract: We present Spatial Lifting (SL), a novel methodology for dense prediction tasks. SL operates by lifting standard inputs, such as 2D images, into a higher-dimensional space and subsequently processing them using networks designed for that higher dimension, such as a 3D U-Net. Counterintuitively, this dimensionality lifting allows us to achieve good performance on benchmark tasks compared to conventional approaches, while reducing inference costs and \textbf{drastically lowering the number of model parameters}. The SL framework produces intrinsically structured outputs along the lifted dimension. This emergent structure facilitates dense supervision during training and enables single-forward-pass self-consistency-based quality and uncertainty estimation at test time. Spatial Lifting introduces a simple and general modeling strategy that offers a promising path toward more efficient, accurate, and reliable deep networks for dense prediction tasks in vision.

</details>


### [4] [Encoded but Disconnected: Decomposing Vision-Language Model Failures under a Patching Null](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00024)
*Genpei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在三个视觉语言模型架构上，中层表征虽编码正确答案（错误样本中68-91%），但该信号对最终预测无因果作用，残差流补丁在层级别翻转率为0%；尽管如此，错误可操作性分为三种失效模式，且可由架构先验方向预测干预响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究中层可解释性在视觉语言模型中的因果有效性：中层是否真正驱动最终预测，还是仅编码未被使用的信号。作者试图检验中层信号与最终输出之间是否存在因果断连。

Method: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B三种架构上，使用POPE基准，进行残差流补丁（residual-stream patching）实验，覆盖层级别与头级别；并对错误样本进行失效模式分类与干预实验（oracle标签下）。

Result: 错误样本中68-91%的中层编码正确答案，但层级别补丁翻转率0%（三架构均如此），头级别两个架构为0%（Qwen：0/12,600）。唯一例外是InternVL3第20层第2头（非词汇、自注意力头，p<1e-4）。错误可分为三类失效模式（Perception Failure、Encoded-but-Disconnected、Prior-Override），三架构上可学习性均超60%；架构先验方向可预测两种干预中哪一种引发类别特异性响应。

Conclusion: 中层编码的正确答案信号在视觉语言模型中普遍缺乏因果效力，构成通用负面发现；但错误模式在机制上真实可分，且可由架构先验预测干预响应，为可解释性研究提供了操作性分类框架。

Abstract: Across three vision-language model architectures (LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B), we report a universal negative finding for mid-layer interpretability. On POPE -- the benchmark common to all three -- the mid layers encode the ground-truth answer in 68-91% of errors, yet this signal is not causally active for the final prediction: residual-stream patching yields 0% non-trivial flip at the layer level on all three architectures, and on two of three at the per-head level (Qwen: 0/12,600 patched forwards). The lone exception, InternVL3 layer-20 head-2, is a non-vocab, self-attending head whose effect is localized to that specific head (p < 1e-4). Despite the null, the errors separate operationally into three failure modes -- Perception Failure, Encoded-but-Disconnected, Prior-Override -- learnable above 60% on all three architectures, and the architecture's prior direction predicts which of two interventions elicits a category-specific response. We report these mitigation effects under oracle labels as evidence the categories are mechanistically real, not as a deployable method.

</details>


### [5] [Domain generalization and synthetic data in object detection: the enabler, the probe, and the gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00030)
*Elfi I. S. Hofmeijer,Ella P. Fokkinga,Friso G. Heslinga,Klamer Schutte,Jörgen M. Karlholm*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文综述了面向目标检测的域泛化(DG)研究，从合成数据作为使能器、探针及合成-真实差距三个角度剖析其作用，指出未来需发展显式处理定位与分类的表示感知方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标检测模型在分布偏移（如天气、环境、目标外观变化）下性能退化，而面向目标检测的域泛化研究稀缺，且该任务在定位与多尺度表示上存在额外挑战；合成数据有望通过大规模生成多样样本来支持域泛化。

Method: 对面向目标检测的域泛化进行综述，从三个互补视角审视合成数据的作用：一是作为域泛化使能器（多样化与对齐策略）；二是作为探针，通过可控实验识别和理解失败模式；三是讨论合成-真实差距这一特殊域偏移形式。

Result: 梳理了合成数据在目标检测域泛化中的多重角色，识别出现有域泛化方法在目标检测上的局限性，并明确了合成-真实差距带来的挑战。

Conclusion: 当前面向目标检测的域泛化方法存在不足，未来研究需要表示感知方法，在域偏移下同时显式处理定位与分类问题。

Abstract: Object detection models often experience performance degradation when deployed under distribution shifts, caused by for example changes in weather type, operational environment, or object appearance. Domain Generalization (DG) aims to develop models that remain robust under such shifts and generalize well to unseen domains. DG research specifically focused on object detection models is scarce, although these models face additional challenges around localization and multi-scale representations. Synthetic data is a promising tool to support in DG, by enabling large-scale generation of diverse new samples. In this paper, we present an object detection-centric review of DG and examine the role of synthetic data from three complementary perspectives. First, synthetic data acts as an enabler of DG through diversification and alignment strategies that aim to improve robustness to distribution shifts. Second, it serves as a probe that enables controlled experimentation to identify and understand failure modes. Third, we discuss the synthetic-to-real gap, a particularly challenging form of domain shift that arises when models trained on synthetic imagery are deployed on real-world data. Through reviewing these perspectives, we identify limitations of current DG approaches for object detection and argue that future research requires representation-aware methods that explicitly address both localization and classification under domain shift.

</details>


### [6] [Seeing the City or Recognizing the Place? What Street-View Imagery Adds Beyond Existing Urban Data in VLM Urban Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00031)
*Kaizhen Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文比较街景图像预测与既有城市数据的增量价值，发现图像优势取决于视觉可辨识度与本地数据覆盖情况。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 街景图像越来越多地用于推断城市属性，但仅凭预测精度无法揭示一张照片在同等位置既有数据之外究竟提供了多少额外信息。

Method: 在同一城市单元上，用图像、任务上下文、邻近观测和公开记录对来自五个公共资源、三个视觉语言模型的七项属性进行评估；通过替换图像和引入冲突记录来检验模型对信息来源的依赖。

Result: 既有城市数据在道路损坏、路缘坡道和房价上达到或超过纯图像模型，邻近官方统计在人口上接近最佳图像结果；图像在建筑类型、建筑功能和低层楼层数上更具信息量。楼层数方面，图像优势随与最近有标注建筑距离每翻倍增加5.7个百分点，而对屋檐常出画的高层建筑则下降；模型常跟随冲突记录；OpenFACADES楼层标注基于OpenStreetMap楼层值生成，其高度相关误差模式与纯图像复现相反。

Conclusion: 街景图像的价值取决于视觉可辨识度与本地数据覆盖；将图像与既有城市数据比较，可指导图像采集并厘清派生城市地图的数据来源。

Abstract: Street-view imagery is increasingly used to infer urban attributes, but predictive accuracy alone does not reveal how much a photograph contributes beyond data already available for the same place. We compare image-based predictions with existing urban data across seven attributes from five public resources and three VLMs. The same urban units are evaluated using images, task context, nearby observations, and public records, while image replacements and conflicting records test source reliance. Existing urban data matched or exceeded image-only models for road damage, curb ramps, and house price, while neighbouring official statistics nearly matched the best image result for population. Images were more informative for building type, building function, and low-rise floor count. For floor count, image advantage increased by 5.7 percentage points per doubling of distance to the nearest labelled building and declined for tall buildings whose rooflines often fell outside the frame. Models frequently followed conflicting records. OpenFACADES floor annotations were generated with OpenStreetMap floor values and showed the opposite height-dependent error pattern from image-only reruns. Street-view image value therefore depends on visual legibility and local data coverage. Comparing images with existing urban data can guide image collection and clarify the provenance of derived urban maps.

</details>


### [7] [DSSR-3D: Decoupled Reasoning for View-Dependent Referring in 3D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00040)
*Thanh-Khoi Nguyen,Thien-Phuc Tran,Minh-Triet Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的推理期框架DSSR-3D，在连续3D高斯场上实现视角相关的指代分割，并构建ViewRef-GS基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于3D高斯泼溅的指代场将语言特征嵌入全局视角不变空间，无法处理依赖相机位姿的观察者中心空间关系（如"在……左边"）。

Method: 将任务形式化为两个接口：位姿不变的语义定位与位姿条件下的空间推理，任意满足约束的函数对均可构成有效实例；具体以温度锐化softmax定位机制与基于投影的方向打分函数实现，并通过轻量免训练步骤融合；无需重训练底层语义场，也不依赖边界框等离散几何代理。

Result: 在ViewRef-GS及增强版Ref-LERF上与现有3DGS指代方法相比取得一致提升，且不依赖基础语义场之外的额外训练；两接口可零样本迁移至结构不同的语义场而无需适配。

Conclusion: 视角相关指代分割可在推理阶段以模块化、免训练方式实现，为连续3D高斯场上的视角依赖空间定位提供了通用框架与评测基准。

Abstract: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting have enabled open-vocabulary and referring segmentation by distilling semantic knowledge from 2D foundation models into 3D representations. However, existing referring fields embed language features in a globally view-invariant space, making them fundamentally unable to resolve observer-centric spatial relations (e.g., "to the left of") that depend on camera pose. We propose DSSR-3D, an inference-time framework for view-dependent referring segmentation on continuous 3D Gaussian fields, formalized as two interfaces - pose-invariant semantic localization and pose-conditioned spatial reasoning - such that any pair of functions satisfying these constraints yields a valid instantiation, requiring no retraining of the underlying semantic field and no reliance on discrete geometric proxies such as bounding boxes. We instantiate the two interfaces with a temperature-sharpened softmax localization mechanism and a projection-based directional scoring function, fused via a lightweight, training-free step, and show they transfer zero-shot to structurally distinct semantic fields without adaptation. We further propose ViewRef-GS, a benchmark isolating view-dependent segmentation on 3D Gaussian fields, evaluated jointly with an augmented Ref-LERF to provide a comprehensive testbed for viewpoint-dependent spatial grounding. Experiments show consistent gains over existing 3DGS-based referring methods, with no additional training beyond the base semantic field

</details>


### [8] [Reachability Is Not Generalization: Understanding Verb--Noun Decomposition in Assembly Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00064)
*Changyi Li,Yu Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统分析了动词-名词分解在装配动作识别中的组合泛化能力，发现其仅能部分突破原子分类器的性能上限，性能受训练数据共现结构、词汇不对称与组件纠缠制约。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 装配动作具有组合性（操作+零件/工具），部署中常遇到熟悉组件的新组合。原子动作分类器对所有未见组合赋予零概率，而主流解决方案——动词-名词分解——虽被广泛采用，其组合偏移下的泛化机制仍缺乏系统理解。

Method: 在三个装配数据集（MECCANO、HAViD、IMPACT）上对动词-名词分解进行系统性分析，考察其相对原子分类器上限的泛化表现，并识别原始支持度、词汇不对称、组件纠缠等误差来源。

Result: 分解虽突破了原子上限，但泛化仅部分超越。未见组合性能与训练数据共现结构强相关，增益多来自密集支持区域的插值而非无约束重组。失败集中在词汇量较大的组件上，IMPACT的动词主导词汇将瓶颈从名词反转为动词。共享编码器训练引入组件纠缠，依赖共现模式，在调和平均上比独立重组最多低6.0倍。

Conclusion: 分解在实践中只能实现部分组合泛化。通过识别原始支持度、词汇不对称与组件纠缠这三个相互关联的误差来源，本文提供了一个可移植的诊断框架，用于超越聚合准确率地研究组合识别。

Abstract: Assembly actions are compositional: they combine a manipulation with a part or tool. In deployment, systems routinely encounter novel combinations of familiar components, yet an atomic action classifier assigns every unseen combination exactly zero probability by construction. The prevailing solution is verb--noun decomposition, which predicts components separately and recombines them to reach unseen actions. While widely adopted, how decomposition generalizes under compositional shift remains poorly understood. We present a systematic analysis of verb--noun decomposition across three assembly datasets (MECCANO, HAViD, and IMPACT). Although decomposition escapes the atomic ceiling, its generalization extends only partially beyond it. Unseen-composition performance remains strongly tied to the co-occurrence structure of the training data, indicating that much of the observed gain arises from interpolation within densely supported regions of the compositional space rather than from unconstrained recombination. Across datasets, failures consistently concentrate on the larger-vocabulary component, and IMPACT's verb-heavy vocabulary reverses the bottleneck from nouns to verbs. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态模型判断者已大规模用于监督训练数据筛选、输出选择与奖励建模，信任其前提是确认它确实使用了视觉证据。现有做法是用反事实探针检验视觉接地（编辑图像使答案翻转、保持推理轨迹不变，看判断是否跟随），但这类探针本身的有效性从未被审视。作者因此质疑：这种视觉接地的反事实探针是否真的测量了它声称测量的东西。

Method: 将探针形式化为"判断接地分数"（Verdict Grounding Score）。核心论证：判断只对"到达判断者决策相关读取"的编辑作出反应，故分数被编辑的可感知程度所上界；若编辑并未使属性更易读取，误差是单侧的——分数只能让判断者显得比实际更不接地。随后在给定假设下证明，这一缺失量不仅可被界住，还可由同一审计协议已收集的三个量识别出来，使虚警率可被直接测量。实验上审计九个判断者，并以未编辑图像上的检测探针作为上界检验。

Result: 在主要判断者池中，预测的排序严格成立；典型判断者只对约一半"其属性本可分辨"的编辑作出反应。施加保守拒绝阈值后，若干单元被直接判定为虚警，最明显的一例是：一个几乎每次都能检测出注入错误的判断者，其接地分数却显示它仿佛完全未使用图像。可见分数与实际接地能力严重脱节。

Conclusion: 图像侧的反事实分数绝不应单独报告。未编辑图像上的检测探针可为该分数提供上界、认证其虚警，且几乎不增加额外成本。审计协议应同时报告二者，以避免因单侧偏差而误弃可用的监督模型。

Abstract: Model judges now supervise multimodal systems at scale, filtering training data, selecting outputs, and supplying the reward that shapes multimodal reasoning models. Trusting one means first checking that it uses its evidence, and that check is itself worth scrutinizing, so we ask whether a counterfactual probe of visual grounding measures what it claims to. The probe edits the image so the ground truth flips, holds the reasoning trace fixed, and asks whether the verdict follows. We formalize it as the Verdict Grounding Score and show it cannot be read the way such scores are read. A verdict responds only to an edit that reaches the judge's decision-relevant reading, so the score is capped by how perceptible the edit is, and unless editing makes the attribute easier to read, the error is one-sided: the score can only make a judge look less grounded than it is. The practical failure is therefore a false alarm, an auditor discarding a usable overseer. Under assumptions we state, we show this missing quantity is not merely bounded but identified from three quantities the same audit protocol already collects, which makes the false-alarm rate directly measurable rather than merely a concern. Auditing nine judges, we find the predicted ordering holds strictly across our entire primary pool, and the typical judge there acts on only about half of the edits whose attribute it can otherwise resolve. Applying a conservative rejection threshold certifies several cells as false alarms outright, the clearest being a judge that detects the injected error essentially every time while still scoring as if it had not used the image at all. The rule that follows is that an image-side counterfactual score should never be reported alone: a detection probe on the unedited image upper-bounds it, certifies its false alarms, and costs nothing extra to run.

</details>

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for video understanding and caption generation, but their performance may decline in specialized medical imaging domains such as echocardiography. The target is constructed by converting structured video annotations into qualitative attributes, generating a fixed-format reference caption, and mapping it into the language-model embedding space. The correction is modeled using a sparse variational Gaussian Process with inducing points, natural-parameter variational updates, and a block-wise linear kernel, while the original VideoChat2 components remain frozen.The method is evaluated using representation-level, caption-level, content-oriented, and execution-time metrics by comparing the original VideoChat2 with VideoChat2 + GPEC under identical input and reference conditions. Results show improved caption similarity and content alignment after applying the proposed correction. Furthermore, GPEC adds less than 0.05 s of inference-time overhead per video in the evaluated setting. These findings indicate that GPEC can improve caption generation in specialized medical video domains with minimal computational cost, without requiring end-to-end fine-tuning of the pretrained multimodal backbone.

*Hongbo Zhang,Zihao Yang,Liuyang Song,Daqian Yang,Haoyang Yao,Yan Wen,Zhengtao Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出将视觉token压缩从"选择/剪枝"范式转向变换编码"变速率"范式：保留全部token，依据每个token的率失真曲线，在固定比特预算下做精确整数率失真优化分配码率。压缩过程不依赖文本，因此同一压缩表示可服务任意查询。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉token压缩几乎被完全定义为选择问题（保留/丢弃token），最佳准则依赖语言模型对token的注意力，使排序成为所提问题的函数。这在单轮基准上不可见，但在压缩表示被写入一次、多次读取（如多轮对话缓存、设备-服务器传输）时具有决定性影响——注意力排序只对调优时的那个问题有效。

Method: 采用变换编码工具库的另一半：保留每个token，改变其码率。变换码给出每个token实测的失真-率曲线，通过在这些曲线上做精确整数率失真优化，把固定比特预算分配到各token。整个流程不引入文本，因此一次压缩表示可服务任意查询。

Result: 在相同比特预算下，于两个数据集、两种模型容量上，该方法比均匀码率编码、闭式注水法和按失真排序剪枝更好地保持模型输出分布与答案；在与剪枝方法调优时相同的目标问题上，匹配注意力排序剪枝；当压缩图像需要回答同一图像的另一个问题时，超过注意力排序剪枝。

Conclusion: 视觉token压缩应被视为率分配问题而非token选择问题。基于率失真优化的变速率编码在同等预算下更优，且因不依赖文本而具备查询无关性，更适合缓存的多次读取与传输场景。

Abstract: Visual-token compression for vision--language models is posed almost entirely as a selection problem: decide which tokens to keep and discard the rest. The criteria that work best rank tokens by the attention the language model pays them, which makes the ranking a function of the question being asked. That is invisible in a single-turn benchmark and decisive whenever a compressed representation is written once and read many times, as when it is cached across the turns of a conversation or transmitted between a device and a server. We take the other half of the classical transform-coding toolkit instead: keep every token and vary its rate. A transform code exposes each token's measured distortion--rate curve, and a fixed bit budget is distributed across tokens by exact integer rate--distortion optimisation on those curves. No text enters the pipeline, so one compressed representation serves any query. At equal bit budgets, on two datasets and two capacities, it preserves the model's output distribution and its answers better than uniform-rate coding, the closed-form water-fill and distortion-ranked pruning. It matches attention-ranked pruning on the question pruning was tuned for, and overtakes it once the compressed image must answer a different question about the same image.

</details>

Abstract: Crowdsourced imagery provides timely, fine-grained, street-level observations for disaster mapping, complementing conventional remote sensing imagery (RSI) during emergency response.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Collaborative perception enables connected agents to share complementary observations for 3D object detection, extending sensing range and mitigating occlusion. Under asynchronous communication, however, cooperative features arrive with temporal delay. Existing prediction-based methods compensate for these features mainly from the transmitting agent's own history, leaving residual misalignment with the ego agent's current observation; subsequent fusion also often overlooks spatial variations in alignment quality. We propose EgoRefine, an ego-referenced predictive alignment and reliability-aware fusion framework for asynchronous collaborative perception. Its Ego-referenced Predictive Alignment module uses the current ego feature to guide cooperative trajectory-field prediction and refines the sampling offsets along an ego-referenced trajectory direction. Its Trajectory-conditioned Reliability-aware Fusion module treats the trajectory discrepancy between the ego and cooperative streams and the directional refinement magnitude as alignment cues, using them to condition the relation between aligned features and adaptively reweight the two streams before convolutional fusion. Experiments on V2V4Real and DAIR-V2X-Seq show that EgoRefine outperforms TraF-Align by 1.6 and 2.9 points on average in AP@0.5 and AP@0.7, respectively. </details>


### [21] [LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00333)
*Jaeyun Shin,Hangeol Chang,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LEGO-OPD 通过将语言专家的先验与视觉专家的似然因子化组合为单一教师分布，并引入自适应校准控制视觉监督强度，在多模态与纯文本推理任务上超越单/多教师 OPD 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态 on-policy 蒸馏（OPD）希望在学习视觉定位的同时保留语言模型强大的推理能力。现有多教师方法（LLM + VLM）虽能提供互补监督，但直接使用 VLM 的完整预测分布会将其视觉定位信号与自身语言先验纠缠，导致定位信息无法独立迁移；而增强视觉监督强度虽可提升感知，却可能过度强调视觉证据、损害语言推理。核心问题是如何解耦并独立控制这两种信号的权衡。

Result: 在 Qwen3 模型上的实验表明，LEGO-OPD 在多模态与纯文本推理任务上均持续优于所评估的单教师与多教师 OPD 基线，并在提升初始学生视觉感知的同时保持纯文本推理能力。

Conclusion: 通过因子化的先验-似然组合与自适应校准，LEGO-OPD 有效缓解了视觉监督与语言推理之间的权衡，为多模态 OPD 提供了一种可独立控制语言与视觉信号的有效方案。

Abstract: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) aims to improve visual grounding while preserving the strong reasoning capabilities of language models. Recent multi-teacher approaches combine LLM and VLM teachers to provide complementary supervision. However, directly using a VLM's full predictive distribution entangles its visual grounding signal with its own language prior, preventing the grounding information from being transferred independently. Conversely, increasing the strength of visual supervision can improve perception but may overemphasize visual evidence and degrade language reasoning. To address this trade-off, we introduce LEGO-OPD, which selectively composes factors from a Language Expert and a Grounding expert into One teacher distribution for multimodal OPD. Under a generalized Bayesian formulation, the language expert provides a prior over candidate tokens, while the grounding expert contributes a visual likelihood that updates this prior, rather than transferring its complete predictive distribution. This factorized composition allows language reasoning and visual grounding to be controlled independently. We further introduce adaptive calibration to determine how strongly the visual likelihood should update the language prior at each decoding prefix. Specifically, LEGO-OPD uses the grounding expert's image-induced prediction shift as a prefix-dependent reference, preventing both insufficient and excessive visual supervision. Experiments with Qwen3 models show that LEGO-OPD consistently outperforms the evaluated single- and multi-teacher OPD baselines on both multimodal and text-only reasoning tasks. Moreover, it improves the initial student's visual perception while preserving text-only reasoning.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机数据处理的SNN虽具能效优势，但其OOD检测仍具挑战；现有方法依赖目标检测SNN中不可用的模型输出或计算组件，且不适合低算力部署，因此需要一种低成本、内部可用的分布偏移信号。

Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient approach to processing event-camera data, yet out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging in this setting. Existing OOD detection methods often depend on model outputs or computational components that are unavailable in object detection SNNs or are poorly suited to low-compute deployment. To that effect, we show that the subthreshold membrane potential \(V_{\mathrm{mem}}(t)\) provides a useful internal signal for detecting distribution shifts. Simple per-channel statistics derived from these membrane dynamics enable OOD detection. To evaluate this approach, we introduce Gen1-C, an event-camera corruption benchmark developed upon the Prophesee Gen1 automotive detection dataset, containing six sensor-motivated histogram-level stress tests at five severity levels. We further propose the Multi-Descriptor Deviation (MDD), a corruption-blind method that operates on membrane-potential statistics. At the highest corruption severity, MDD achieves an AUROC of more than 0.88 on five of the six corruptions using only a bounded 64-frame observation window. Notably, the remaining corruption is also the one that has the smallest effect on the underlying detector. These results show that the temporal membrane-potential dynamics can provide an effective and low-cost signal for OOD detection in SNN-based event perception.

</details>

Motivation: 基础模型在大规模数据上预训练后对医学影像任务具有强迁移性，但其隐表征如何编码临床相关信息仍不清楚，这在安全攸关领域是亟待解决的开放问题；现有黑盒分类器缺乏可解释性，难以说明模型依据哪些图像结构做出判断，也难以对合成医学图像给出细粒度、可读的评估。

Conclusion: 该框架为理解基础模型如何组织临床相关结构提供了透明、按深度分层的视角，同时给出所提取规则的实际下游用途。

Abstract: Foundation models pretrained on large-scale datasets demonstrate strong transferability to medical imaging tasks. However, understanding how their latent representations encode clinically relevant information remains an open challenge in safety-critical domains. Class-specific prototypes are learned by clustering in the feature space, yielding compact visual patterns. Patch features are then expressed as prototype similarities and classified by fuzzy rules with linguistic IF-THEN conditions that are human readable. The framework is applied across the final two blocks of ViT-S/16 backbones pretrained on ImageNet-1K and GastroNet-5M, and benchmarked against k-nearest neighbours, kernel SVM, and linear probing under identical frozen features, on wireless capsule endoscopy classification, gastrointestinal endoscopy classification, and colonic polyp segmentation. The experimental analysis shows that the proposed method, without backbone fine-tuning, reaches accuracy comparable to these black-box classifiers, and that domain-specific pretraining yields features that are both discriminative and symbolically compressible. Because the resulting rules are extracted from real data and expressed in interpretable terms, they are further used as an instrument to investigate synthetic medical images, providing a human-readable account of which real prototypes and rules a generator reproduces or fails to reproduce, localising where a synthetic image departs from real tissue rather than summarising it with a single score.   <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 各层污染均严重：主语料库官方测试集中28.8%的图像在自身训练集中存在近乎相同的孪生样本；第二个语料库22.3%的测试图像字节级完全相同；95.5%可追溯测试图像与训练集共享患者；不含解剖信息的文件头特征以0.959平衡准确率区分肿瘤与非肿瘤，与微调ResNet骨干网相当。关键意外结果：去除所有已识别泄漏测试图像后，平衡准确率基本不变。

Abstract: Automated classification of brain tumors from MRI is a heavily published application of deep learning in medical imaging, with reported accuracies on public benchmarks routinely exceeding 98%. However, accuracy does not capture a critical dimension of benchmark quality: dataset integrity, defined as the independence of test from training data at the image, patient, and acquisition-source levels. We introduce a three-layer contamination framework comprising duplicate, patient, and source-label leakage to assess the public corpora on which this literature rests. We audit the three most widely used corpora against a chest-radiograph negative control and quantify each layer's effect on measured performance across nine architectures and three evaluation conditions. Contamination is severe at every layer: 28.8% of the dominant corpus's official test split has a near-twin in its own training split, a second corpus leaks 22.3% of its test images byte-identically, 95.5% of traceable test images share a patient with training, and file-header features containing no anatomy separate tumor from no-tumor at 0.959 balanced accuracy, at parity with fine-tuned ResNet backbones. The unexpected result is that removing every identified leaked test image leaves balanced accuracy essentially unchanged: stable performance after deduplication does not establish benchmark integrity. Our findings establish dataset integrity as a distinct, measurable axis of benchmark quality that a stable leaderboard cannot certify. For biomedical research, reported accuracy on these corpora alone does not establish that a model has learned to recognize tumors rather than exploit dataset-specific cues.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人体运动、环境接触与交互力遵循共同物理规律，但现有方法将视觉姿态重建与接触/力估计分离，限制了联合推理，且阶段间误差会传播。

Abstract: Human motion, environmental contacts, and interaction forces are governed by common physical laws, yet existing approaches typically separate visual pose reconstruction from contact and force estimation. This separation limits joint reasoning and can propagate errors between stages. We introduce PACT, an end-to-end model that jointly learns to estimate human pose, contacts and contact forces from monocular video. Our approach augments a human reconstruction foundation model with learnable contact-force tokens and a temporal transformer that integrates visual features with world-space motion. Joint prediction heads refine human poses and estimate contacts and forces, while physics-based supervision encourages consistency between the reconstructed motion and interaction forces. To address the scarcity of force annotations, we develop a data annotation pipeline that combines contact labeling with physics-based motion and force optimization, producing training supervision from synthetic and real-world videos. We also introduce a real-world climbing benchmark ForceWall with climbing videos and corresponding ground-truth contact forces obtained from the force sensors. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art contact and force estimation, outperforming staged reconstruction approaches and generalizing to interactions beyond the training distribution. These results support end-to-end joint learning as an effective approach to recovering human motion and physical interactions from video.

</details>

Abstract: Representation alignment (REPA) accelerates diffusion transformer training, but its alignment targets are almost exclusively semantic encoders such as DINOv2 and CLIP. Recent analysis points to spatial structure, not global semantics, as the carrier of the alignment effect, yet dense-prediction foundation models trained to predict that structure remain overlooked as REPA targets. In pixel-space diffusion, SAM2, Depth Anything v2, and Metric3D v2 each outperform the DINOv2-only GenEval baseline, with the two geometric teachers leading the segmentation teacher. A flat sum of all four teachers, however, lands below the best single geometric teacher, as semantic and geometric gradients compete for one denoiser projection. We introduce PixelDense, which routes DINOv2 and SAM2 through a semantic projection stream, routes Depth Anything v2 and Metric3D v2 through a geometric projection stream, and adds a weight-space orthogonality penalty that keeps the two streams in disjoint subspaces. All four teachers are frozen during training and dropped at inference. In partial-noise reconstruction, independent panoptic, depth, and surface-normal probes show up to 53.1% PQ gain and 36.0% depth AbsRel reduction at $τ=0.5$ across COCO and Flickr30K. From random initialization, PixelDense also reaches the baseline's peak GenEval 1.23x faster. ### [27] [Memorizon: Training World Models Beyond Their Context Window](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00544)
*Tingting Liao,Xuezhi Liang,Hao Li,Guangyi Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Memorizon 将长跨度监督与长序列注意力解耦：样本可覆盖任意长跨度但只在最后 k 个 chunk 上计分，各计分 chunk 通过相机共视检索 top-K latent 组成容量受限于 kK 的共享 bank，从而在接近常数成本下实现跨重复访问的场景一致性建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式世界模型需要在重复访问同一地点时保持一致渲染，但直接监督此类"重访"要求训练样本同时包含两次访问，跨度常达数分钟；对全跨度做稠密注意力会带来二次复杂度，使长跨度监督代价高昂。核心矛盾在于：监督需要长跨度，注意力并不需要。

Method: Memorizon 打破上述耦合。训练样本可覆盖任意长度跨度，但仅在其最后 k 个 chunk 上计算损失；对这些计分 chunk，不再对其之前的历史做 tokenize，而是让每个计分 chunk 依据相机共视关系各自检索 top-K latent，所有请求的并集构成一个共享 bank。bank 规模上界为 kK，因此无论跨度多长，序列长度保持有界；当跨度取最短时，该方案退化为常规训练。消融实验中，将 bank 从另一 episode 填充，用以检验模型是否真正使用了检索到的内容。

Result: 引入 bank 仅使单步成本增加一次，此后更长的跨度代价很小：跨度从 100 s 增至 400 s 仅增加 12% 的单步耗时。相比滑动窗口基线，检索在所有划分上都提升了重访一致性；当跨度长到足以覆盖每次返回的首次访问时，一致性再提升 24%–30%，但图像质量有一定损失；超过该跨度后继续加长不再有增益。用其他 episode 填充 bank 会使重访相关性下降 83%，表明模型确实依赖检索到的内容。

Conclusion: 长跨度监督与长序列注意力可以解耦：借助按相机共视的 top-K latent 检索与有界共享 bank，Memorizon 以近常数成本实现长跨度重访监督，显著提升流式世界模型的重访一致性，同时揭示存在最优跨度阈值，超过后收益饱和。项目主页：https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon

Abstract: Streaming world models should render a place consistently across repeated visits. Directly supervising such revisits requires training samples that capture both visits, often spanning minutes. Yet dense attention over the full span incurs quadratic costs, making long-span supervision expensive. Memorizon breaks this coupling: long spans are needed for supervision, but not for attention, since the two visits can share a forward pass without including every intervening frame. A training sample covers a span of any length but is scored only on its last $k$ chunks. Instead of tokenizing the history before them, each scored chunk retrieves its own top-$K$ latents by camera co-visibility, and the union of these requests forms a shared bank. The bank is bounded by $kK$, so the sequence stays bounded however long the span; at the shortest span the recipe is exactly conventional training. Adding the bank raises the cost of a step once; beyond that, a longer span costs little, and going from 100 to 400 s adds 12% to the step time. Against a sliding-window baseline, retrieval raises revisit consistency on every split, and a span long enough to reach the first visit of each return adds a further 24% to 30%, at some cost in image quality; beyond that span, more length no longer helps. Filling the bank from another episode lowers revisit correlation by 83%, so the model uses what it retrieves. Project page: https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon

</details>

*Xinge Peng,Yiting Lu,Tianwu Zhi,Wen Wen,Jianzhao Liu,Xin Li,Zhibo Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 PhysVista 基准，通过"感知—推理—判断"闭环认知框架评估视觉语言模型的物理智能，实验揭示模型在物理推理与合理性判断上存在显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型虽展现较强的多模态推理能力，但其是否真正把握真实世界动态背后的物理一致性仍不明确；已有评测范式存在碎片化问题，偏重孤立的认知阶段，忽视感知、推理与物理判断之间的内在协同，缺乏整体视角，难以诊断模型能否可靠评估生成模型的物理真实性。

Method: 提出 PhysVista 基准，借鉴人类"看—思—评"过程构建闭环认知框架：联合评估物理状态感知、物理动态推理与物理合理性判断；进一步区分事件级推理与尺度级推理以实现细粒度分析；同时纳入真实世界视频与 AI 生成视频，覆盖多样领域与新兴生成场景。

Result: 在多种视觉语言模型上的大量实验显示，模型在物理推理与合理性判断方面存在明显局限，视觉识别能力与真实物理理解之间存在持续差距。

Conclusion: 研究指出当前模型在物理基础理解上的不足，为构建更具物理根基的多模态智能提供了原则性设计方向。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, yet whether they truly capture the physical consistency underlying real-world dynamics remains unclear. Existing benchmark paradigms often suffer from fragmented evaluation, focusing on isolated cognitive stages while overlooking the inherent synergy between perception, reasoning, and physical judgment. The lack of a holistic perspective limits the ability to diagnose whether VLMs can reliably evaluate the physical authenticity of emerging generative models. To address these issues, we introduce PhysVista, a benchmark designed to evaluate physical intelligence in VLMs through a closed cognitive loop framework inspired by the human seeing-reasoning-assessment process. PhysVista restores this loop by jointly evaluating physical state perception, physical dynamics reasoning, and physical plausibility assessment. It further distinguishes event-level reasoning and scale-level reasoning to enable fine-grained analysis of physical understanding. In addition, PhysVista incorporates both real-world and AI-generated videos, allowing evaluation across diverse domains and emerging generative scenarios. Extensive experiments across a diverse set of VLMs reveal substantial limitations in physical reasoning and plausibility assessment, highlighting a persistent gap between visual recognition and genuine physical understanding, and pointing toward more principled designs for physically grounded multimodal intelligence.

</details>


### [29] [FORTE: Adaptive Scoring and Exact Keyframe Selection for Long-Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00573)
*Haifeng Huang,Biyin Xu,Chunsheng Xin,Yang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FORTE是一个免训练框架，通过自适应相关性打分与全局关键帧优化两阶段，实现查询感知的长视频关键帧选择，在四个长视频问答基准上取得最高平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于打分的关键帧选择方法在固定的均匀采样候选池中搜索，导致池外证据永远无法被选中；在有限打分预算下，如何自适应地把评估分配给有潜力的帧、同时探索覆盖不足的时间区域是关键挑战。

Method: FORTE分两阶段：1）自适应相关性打分：从稀疏均匀观测出发，用高效高斯过程相关性预测器估计未打分帧的相关性，利用时间局部性与近似带状核结构，将核心计算复杂度从三次降为关于帧数的线性（固定带宽下）；打分阶段以预测相关性与时间覆盖度的平衡来选择下一个待打分帧。2）全局关键帧优化：最大化同时刻画实测相关性与时间覆盖度的目标函数，利用对数覆盖结构推导出精确算法，在固定最终帧预算下以关于候选池规模的线性时间选出最优子集。

Result: 在四个长视频问答基准上，FORTE在所有测试的打分预算下均取得所比较选择器中最高的观测平均准确率；进一步实验表明其对不同相关性打分器和下游MLLM均保持一致的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过将打分预算自适应分配与全局优化结合，FORTE在免训练条件下有效突破了固定候选池的限制，实现了高效且稳健的长视频关键帧选择。

Abstract: Query-aware keyframe selection enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to process long videos using only a small set of question-relevant frames. Existing score-based methods, however, typically search within a fixed, uniformly sampled candidate pool, preventing evidence outside this pool from ever being selected. Given a limited relevance-scoring budget, the key challenge is to allocate evaluations adaptively to promising frames while continuing to explore underrepresented temporal regions. We introduce FORTE, a training-free framework that addresses this challenge through two stages: adaptive relevance scoring and global keyframe optimization. Starting from sparse, uniformly distributed observations, our efficient Gaussian-process relevance predictor estimates relevance for unscored frames, exploiting temporal locality and the approximately banded kernel structure to reduce the core computation from cubic to linear time in the number of frames for fixed bandwidth. To overcome this, we propose to model human cropping preference as a multi-peaked, continuous, and sharp field over the crop space. We introduce the Continuous Preference Field (CPF), which recovers a dense preference landscape from discrete annotations through (1) peak clustering, (2) off-lattice refinement, (3) negative shaping, and (4) field assembly.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Representation alignment has become an effective way to accelerate diffusion training, but its benefits do not transfer reliably to pixel-space clean-image prediction. Gradient diagnostics further show reduced minibatch gradient variance, while ablations demonstrate that the gains cannot be explained by time reweighting alone. These results show that prediction-space supervision provides a simple and principled alternative to representation alignment for pixel-space generative models.

Abstract: Flow matching (FM) learns generative transport by fitting continuous-time motion from a simple source distribution to the data distribution. First, we find that accuracy and validity diverge: the highest-accuracy configuration can produce wrong conclusions. Second, modality value is not guaranteed: text alone can yield strong performance, indicating that adding modalities can add cost without adding signal. Finally, we find that cost can be decoupled from video length when annotating short-form videos: a single $2\times8$ image grid built via simple shot-transition detection approaches full-video understanding ($κ$ within~.05), at $\sim 15\%$ of the token cost. Abstract: Video generation has rapidly progressed from short, low-quality clips to high-resolution, long-duration sequences with complex spatiotemporal dynamics. Despite strong generative priors learned through large-scale pretraining, pretrained video models often fail to reliably follow human intent, maintain temporal coherence, or satisfy physical and safety constraints. Compared with image and text generation, alignment in video generation presents unique challenges, including error accumulation over time, motion-appearance coupling, multi-objective trade-offs, and limited supervision for temporal properties. Beyond methodological advances, we review commonly used datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation practices, and discuss open challenges such as scalable reward design, long-horizon temporal consistency, stability-expressiveness trade-offs, and safety-aware generation. Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as powerful candidates for universal vision backbones, with representative architectures including autoregressive (AR) models and diffusion transformers (DiTs). Ultimately, GeoSim provides an interpretability lens for probing latent transferability in low-level vision and diagnosing model limitations in task- or model-specific scenarios.

</details>

*Thiru Thillai Nadarasar Bahavan,Yu Xia,Sachith Seneviratne,Saman Halgamuge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出即插即用的 SmoothOperator（SmoothOP），依据样本在嵌入空间中的"突出度"自适应设置标签平滑系数，改进开集识别中的球面表示学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开集识别（OSR）的核心难点在于训练时无法建模未知类的无界分布，容易将未知样本误判为已知类。近期工作转而塑形特征空间，使已知类紧致且分离良好，球面表示学习方法在此取得显著成效。其中标签平滑被认为是成功的关键驱动因素之一，但它对所有训练样本施加相同系数，忽略了各样本当前嵌入质量的差异。

Result: 在 Semantic Shift Benchmark 上，SmoothOP 增强后的变体在不同数据集、不同语义偏移程度以及不同 OSR 后处理器的设置下总体优于其基础目标，在 AUROC、OSCR 和闭集准确率上提升最高达 4.7%。

Conclusion: 标签平滑在 OSR 球面表示学习中应被理解为样本级的对齐调控而非统一的全局超参数；通过嵌入空间信号 prominence 自适应调节平滑系数，可在几乎不增加训练成本的前提下，稳定提升开集识别性能并具备良好的通用性。

Abstract: Open Set Recognition (OSR) aims to enable models to accurately classify known classes while rejecting samples from unseen classes. A key challenge in OSR lies in the inability to model the unbounded distribution of unknown classes during training, often leading to the misclassification of samples from these classes. Rather than modeling unknowns, recent work shapes the feature space so that known classes are compact and well separated, and spherical representation learning methods have achieved strong results this way. Label smoothing has been identified as one of the key drivers of this success, yet it applies the same coefficient to every training sample, regardless of how well each sample is already embedded. We show that the spherical representation learning objectives used in OSR share a single alignment--uniformity structure in which labels enter only through the alignment term. Label smoothing therefore acts as an alignment dial, and a fixed coefficient sets this dial to the same value for every sample. We propose a plug-in, SmoothOperator (SmoothOP), which sets the smoothing coefficient of each sample from its \textbf{prominence}, an embedding-space signal measuring how clearly the sample's own class stands out against its strongest competing class. Our method integrates into four existing spherical representation learning methods at minimal training overhead. SmoothOP assigns strong smoothing to samples with high prominence, which reduces their alignment and relaxes their pull. On the Semantic Shift Benchmark, SmoothOP-augmented variants generally outperform their base objectives across datasets, degrees of semantic shift, and OSR post-processors, with gains of up to 4.7\% in AUROC, OSCR, and closed-set accuracy.

</details>

*Cigdem Kokenoz,Amir Salarpour,Alkim Domeke,Christopher Salas,Pedram MohajerAnsari,Long Cheng,Mert D. Pesé,Bing Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Lang3DSeg 首次将点变换器（point transformer）作为主干，用于室外 LiDAR 的无标注开放词汇 3D 语义分割；通过类别优先级的掩码合成与深度分布首次间隙截断来修正 2D-to-3D 投影的深度歧义，在 nuScenes 验证集和 SemanticKITTI 上取得了已发表无标注方法中的最高 mIoU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D 语义感知对自主导航安全至关重要，但监督式 LiDAR 分割受限于封闭类别体系和逐点人工标注的高成本。开放词汇方法通过将 2D 视觉-语言模型的输出投影到 LiDAR 并蒸馏进 3D 网络来规避标注成本，然而现有方法几乎都依赖基于体素的稀疏卷积，点变换器则仅局限于室内密集、有界的环境，尚未用于室外 LiDAR。

Result: 在 nuScenes 验证集上达到 52.8% mIoU，在 SemanticKITTI 上达到 41.4%，在两个基准上均为已发表无标注方法中的最高值。

Conclusion: Lang3DSeg 证明点变换器可作为室外 LiDAR 开放词汇分割的有效主干，且无需几何预训练；每次 3D 语义分割仅基于单帧 LiDAR 扫描，推理时可实时运行且无需调用视觉-语言模型。

Abstract: Accurate 3D semantic perception is critical for safe autonomous navigation. However, supervised LiDAR segmentation remains tied to closed taxonomies and to the cost of point-wise manual annotation. Open-vocabulary methods avoid that cost by projecting the output of 2D vision-language models onto LiDAR and distilling it into a 3D network. These methods rely almost exclusively on voxel-based sparse convolutions, and point transformers have so far been limited to indoor environments, where 3D data is dense and bounded. We present Lang3DSeg, which establishes a point transformer as the backbone for annotation-free open-vocabulary segmentation of outdoor 3D LiDAR, and is trained from scratch without geometric pre-training. We therefore composite masks using an explicit class-priority rule and truncate each projected instance at the first gap in its depth distribution, correcting the projection error directly rather than averaging it over registered sequences. Lang3DSeg achieves 52.8% mIoU on nuScenes validation and 41.4% on SemanticKITTI, the highest among published annotation-free methods on both benchmarks. Every 3D semantic segmentation is on a single LiDAR sweep, and inference operates in real-time without running vision-language models.

</details>

*Chensheng Peng,Wenhao Ding,Ran Tian,Zewei Zhou,Jef Packer,Maximilian Igl,Peter Karkus,Yan Wang,Masayoshi Tomizuka,Boris Ivanovic,Marco Pavone,Yuxiao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 CtrlWAM，通过在模拟器中执行扰动动作并配对其加噪视觉结果，替代传统同时加噪动作与视频的训练范式，并用"扭曲的"视频-动作噪声调度匹配两者去噪需求，实现更可控的世界动作模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的世界动作模型（WAM）训练同时对记录动作与视频加噪，导致不匹配：被扰动的动作意味着反事实的未来视觉，而被加噪的视频仍绑定于真实（GT）录像。尤其在低噪声区间，加噪后的未来帧仍清晰可见场景几何甚至动态行为，使模型难以从"错误动作"中学到正确的因果关系。

Method: 提出 CtrlWAM：1）在模拟器中执行被扰动的动作，并将其与相应加噪的视觉后果配对，用于联合 WAM 学习，使动作与视觉在因果上保持一致；2）针对视频与动作不同的去噪需求，设计"扭曲的（warped）视频-动作噪声调度"，使视觉布局在动作预测演化过程中保持响应性；3）将动作接口从仅限自身（ego-only）控制扩展到可变数量的智能体流，使统一模型能表示多个智能体的预测或指令未来。

Result: 驾驶实验中，动作预测更准确，生成视频与动作一致性更高，对给定指令的遵循更好；机器人实验中，运动保真度与可控性更强。匹配对照实验支持"偏离路径渲染"对指令跟随与操作保真度的收益。项目页：https://ctrl-wam.github.io/

Conclusion: 通过用模拟器中扰动动作对应的加噪视觉结果替换传统同时加噪范式，并配合扭曲噪声调度与多智能体动作接口，CtrlWAM 提升了动作预测精度、视频-动作一致性、指令跟随能力及机器人操控保真度，推动世界动作模型向更可控方向发展。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) jointly predict actions (intent) and visual future (foresight). Standard training adds noise to recorded actions and video simultaneously, but such training paradigms introduce a mismatch: perturbed actions imply counterfactual future visual, while the noised video remains tied to the GT recording. In low-noise regime, the scene geometry and even the dynamic behavior remain clearly visible from the noisy future frames despite the added noise. We present CtrlWAM, which executes perturbed actions in a simulator and pairs them with their noised visual consequences for joint WAM learning. To accommodate the different denoising requirements of video and actions, we introduce warped video--action noise schedules that aim to keep visual layout responsive as action predictions evolve. We further extend the action interface from ego-only control to a variable number of agent streams, allowing a unified model to represent predicted or commanded futures for multiple agents. Driving experiments show more accurate action forecasts, closer agreement between generated video and actions, and better following of supplied commands; robotics experiments show stronger motion fidelity and controllability. Matched controls support the benefit of off-path renders for command following and manipulation fidelity. Together, these findings contribute to a more controllable world action model. Project page: https://ctrl-wam.github.io/

</details>

*Ozge Mercanoglu Sincan,Anton Pelykh,Edward Fish,Harry Walsh,JianHe Low,Karahan Sahin,Oline Ranum,Sobhan Asasi,Steven Emery,Richard Bowden*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手语机器翻译虽已从孤立手语识别发展到端到端系统，但数据资源有限、评价指标难以衡量语言质量、手语同时性/多层性/三维结构难以建模等问题依然存在，且伦理与社区参与议题常被忽视，因此需要一篇兼顾技术挑战与利益相关者视角的综述。

Method: 采用综述方法：分析手语的计算独特性（语言学特性），梳理识别、翻译与生成系统的演进脉络，剖析持续存在的技术挑战，并从数据治理、社区参与与合理使用角度讨论伦理考量，融合计算机视觉、手语语言学与聋人研究等跨学科视角。

Result: 手语机器翻译在姿态估计、Transformer 架构与大规模数据集采集推动下取得显著进展；但相较口语资源数据仍匮乏，评价指标不足以刻画输出的语言学质量，模型需应对手语的共时性、多层性与三维性。

Conclusion: 手语机器翻译的持续进步需要计算机视觉、手语语言学与聋人研究等领域长期协作，并与聋人社区共同推进，以在技术发展与伦理、社区利益之间取得平衡。

Abstract: Sign language machine translation has progressed substantially over the past decade, evolving from isolated sign recognition to end-to-end translation systems. Advances in pose estimation, transformer architectures, and large-scale dataset collection have driven progress, yet challenges remain. Datasets are limited compared to spoken-language resources; evaluation metrics inadequately capture the linguistic quality of output; and models must capture the simultaneous, multi-layered, and three-dimensional structure of sign languages. This manuscript provides a comprehensive review that seeks to balance technical challenges with stakeholder considerations. We examine the linguistic properties that make sign languages computationally unique, trace the evolution of recognition, translation, and production systems, and analyze ongoing technical challenges. Crucially, we address ethical considerations around data governance, community involvement, and appropriate use. Drawing on interdisciplinary perspectives spanning computer vision, sign language linguistics, and deaf studies, our analysis emphasizes that continued progress requires sustained collaboration across these fields and with deaf communities.

</details>


### [51] [EyeTAG: Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00922)
*Jungmin Lee,Niamat Ullah,Yoseob Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EyeTAG，一种以显式一阶视线轨迹为先验的因果多帧视线估计框架，通过差分近期预测得到平移不变的运动令牌并反馈给模型，降低抖动与扫视偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然头眼运动下的视线估计应用广泛，但单帧方法逐帧独立预测导致输出抖动；多帧方法虽能缓解抖动，却将运动隐含地学在表观特征中，视线轨迹从未成为显式变量，因而仍存在系统性扫视偏差。

Method: EyeTAG以显式一阶视线先验为核心：每一步对自身近期预测做差分，得到紧凑的运动学令牌并反馈；由于差分在视线空间中具有平移不变性，该令牌携带与受试者无关的运动而非个人视线偏移。人脸流与眼部流提供视觉证据，经交叉注意力融合，并由因果Transformer解码器输出。

Result: 在Gaze360上平均角度误差降低约1.0°；在EVE上与最强基线相当（2.56° vs. 2.58°）。模型内消融（固定编码器与其余结构，仅改变视线历史）表明，是差分形式而非单纯的时间上下文消除了即使使用绝对视线历史先验仍存在的系统性扫视偏差。

Conclusion: 将视线轨迹显式建模为可微分的运动学令牌，可在保持架构简洁的同时有效抑制抖动与扫视偏差，验证了差分先验相较绝对历史先验的优越性。

Abstract: Gaze estimation under natural head-eye motion underpins applications from driver monitoring to human-computer interaction. Single-frame methods predict each frame independently, so consecutive outputs fluctuate as jitter. Multi-frame methods reduce this, but they learn motion implicitly inside appearance features, so the gaze trajectory is never an explicit variable. We propose EyeTAG (Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation), a causal multi-frame framework built around an explicit first-order gaze prior: at each step it differentiates its own recent predictions and feeds the resulting trajectory back as a compact kinematic token. Because differencing is translation-invariant in gaze space, this token carries subject-invariant motion rather than personal gaze offsets. Face and eye streams supply visual evidence, fused by cross-attention and a causal Transformer decoder. EyeTAG reduces the mean angular error by about 1.0$^\circ$ on Gaze360 and performs on par with the strongest baseline on EVE (2.56$^\circ$ vs. 2.58$^\circ$). Within-model ablations, which keep the encoder and the rest of the architecture fixed and vary only the gaze history, show that the differential formulation, rather than temporal context alone, removes the systematic saccade bias that persists even with an absolute gaze-history prior. Our code is available at https://github.com/peter8366/EyeTAG.

### [52] [Joint Branch-Space Transform Coding for Diffusion Activation Quantization with Classifier-Free Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00930)
*Mingrun Jiang,Yuejia Liu,Zishan Shao,Ting Jiang,Qinsi Wang,Hancheng Ye,Yixiao Wang,Rui-Feng Wang,Kangning Cui,Yixuan Chen,Fan Yang,Xiang Cheng,Hai Li,Yiran Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出分支空间变换编码（GCBT），通过旋转匹配的CFG分支来利用跨激活结构，在等速率量化噪声代理下具有闭式逐层解，可即插即用地提升扩散模型PTQ保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型后训练量化虽已利用时间步、特征和层结构，甚至引入CFG结构，但激活量化仍在条件与无条件坐标上独立进行，未利用跨激活（跨分支）结构。作者发现匹配的CFG激活构成强相关的二维源，在固定比特预算下，分支编码基的选择会显著影响量化保真度。

Method: 提出分支空间变换编码：用离线推导的2x2正交矩阵旋转匹配的CFG分支，对模型参数与量化流程改动极小。进一步推导GCBT（Guidance-Correlation Branch Transform），联合考虑CFG引导方向与跨分支二阶矩；在等速率量化噪声代理下给出闭式逐层解，无需梯度优化或角度搜索。

Result: 将GCBT叠加在现有扩散PTQ方法上，在大多数评估比较中获得统计显著的保真度提升，且无统计显著退化，同时不改变底层宿主量化流程。

Abstract: Post-training quantization for diffusion models increasingly exploits timestep, feature, and layer structure. While recent work has begun incorporating CFG structure into diffusion quantization, activation quantization still operates independently across conditional and unconditional coordinates, leaving cross-activation structure unexploited. We show that matched CFG activations form a strongly correlated two-dimensional source and that, under a fixed bit budget, the choice of branch coding basis materially affects quantization fidelity. Motivated by this observation, we introduce branch-space transform coding, which rotates matched CFG branches via an offline derived 2x2 orthogonal matrix, requiring minimal modifications to model parameters or the quantization pipeline. We further derive the Guidance-Correlation Branch Transform (GCBT), which jointly incorporates the CFG guidance direction and cross-branch second moments. Under an equal-rate quantization-noise surrogate, GCBT admits a closed-form per-layer solution without gradient optimization or angle search. Applied on top of existing diffusion PTQ methods, GCBT yields statistically significant fidelity gains in most evaluated comparisons with no statistically significant degradation, while leaving the underlying host quantization pipeline unchanged.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重标注语料已成为文生图（T2I）训练标配，VLM 替代稀疏 alt-text 生成密集描述。但语料分布由标注策略、标注器与源语料共同决定（记为 D_{π,V_c,C}），基于长度相关代理的审计会遗漏标注语体伪影，而下游 T2I 基准又将语料与训练选择纠缠，导致该分布难以在语料尺度上审计。

Result: 在四组跨语料配对中，所发布版本在两种 Judge 下均使每标注支持 CBU 提升 +3.39 至 +6.36；在 CC12M 上，框架揭示出在两种 Judge 与四个预算下一致的长文本-密集文本前沿。

Conclusion: 框架可有效审计重标注监督分布，揭示跨语料与跨预算的一致规律。作者发布经审计的多源重标注语料（约 4.9 亿条）及审计工件包。

Abstract: Recaptioned image-text corpora are now standard for text-to-image (T2I) training, with vision--language model (VLM) captioners replacing sparse alt-text by dense descriptions. A recaptioned corpus is a supervision distribution induced by a documented captioning policy ($π$), captioner ($V_c$), and source corpus ($C$). Length-correlated proxies miss caption-register artifacts and downstream T2I benchmarks entangle the corpus with training choices, so this distribution is hard to audit at corpus scale. We introduce a reusable matched-budget audit framework for recaptioned supervision distributions $D_{π,V_c,C}$: at a fixed text budget of $B = 64$ it reports a five-axis profile spanning prompt-side coverage, image-conditioned faithfulness, and caption-surface health, with claimed controllable basic units (CBU) as the common claim unit. We instantiate the framework on seven paired comparisons over five public source corpora. Across the four cross-corpus pairs, the released surface raises supported CBU per caption by $+3.39$ to $+6.36$ under both Qwen and Gemma Judges, and on CC12M the same framework exposes a long-vs-dense frontier that is consistent across both judges and four budgets. </details>


### [54] [Two Clocks in Diffusion MLLMs: When Answers Stabilize Before Rationales Unfold](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00953)
*Keuntae Kim,Yong Suk Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究区分了掩码扩散多模态大模型(MLLM)中"答案候选的回顾性稳定"与"token承诺"两个时间时钟,并考察它们相对于推理链生成过程的关系。通过三个VQA基准实验,揭示了答案在推理链几乎未生成时即已稳定,且证据覆盖度是提示词效果差异的主要成分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散MLLM中,答案候选可能在推理链(rationale)尚未展开时就已稳定,这带来了一个概念混淆:日志中记录的候选答案的回顾性稳定(retrospective stabilization)并不等于模型真正做出了token承诺(token commitment)。作者希望厘清这两种"时钟"相对于推理链生成的时间关系,从而更准确地理解模型何时"确定"答案、何时"完成"推理。

Method: 在三个视觉问答基准上分析掩码扩散MLLM(如LaViDa、Nemotron)。定义并区分回顾性稳定与token承诺两个时间读数,统计稳定时刻推理链画布(rationale-side canvas)未书写的比例;在V*Bench上改变块长度(128→8),观察该比例、答案覆盖度与可观察窗口的变化;在EOS启用提示下比较直接指令对准确率的影响;采用对称分解将变化分解为覆盖度(coverage)与条件准确率(conditional accuracy)两部分;并通过匹配画布的图像消融实验测量视觉敏感度。

Result: 在单块、EOS抑制的LaViDa运行中,稳定时刻有89.4%-98.1%的推理链画布尚未书写。在V*Bench上,块长度从128降至8使该比例从89.4%变为1.7%,同时改变答案覆盖度与可观察窗口。在EOS启用提示下,直接指令使Nemotron在M3CoT和ScienceQA上整体准确率分别提升15.0和19.5个百分点,但使LaViDa/V*Bench准确率下降11.0个百分点。对称分解显示,各变化中绝对量较大的成分归属于覆盖度而非条件准确率。匹配画布图像消融实验分离了答案稳定与视觉敏感度两个时间读数。

Conclusion: 这些测量将答案稳定、推理链展开与视觉敏感度三者区分开来,并确认覆盖度是提示词效果差异中更大的成分。研究表明,区分回顾性稳定与token承诺对于正确解读掩码扩散MLLM的推理时序至关重要。

Abstract: An answer candidate in a masked diffusion MLLM can stabilize while its rationale is still unfolding. On V*Bench, reducing block length from 128 to 8 changes this fraction from 89.4% to 1.7%, together with answer coverage and the eligible observation window. Under EOS-enabled prompting, direct instructions improve Nemotron's overall accuracy by 15.0 and 19.5 percentage points on M3CoT and ScienceQA, but reduce LaViDa/V*Bench accuracy by 11.0 points. A symmetric decomposition associates the larger absolute component of each change with coverage rather than conditional accuracy. Matched-canvas image ablations measure visual sensitivity alongside answer stabilization, separating the two temporal readouts. Together, these measurements distinguish answer stabilization, rationale unfolding, and visual sensitivity, and identify coverage as the larger component of the prompting differences.

</details>


### [55] [Video-Index: A Curated Meta-Benchmark for Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00960)
*Enxin Song,Yinuo Xu,Shusheng Yang,Wenhao Chai,Jiatao Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出"攻击金字塔"（五级捷径攻击）审计115个视频基准，发现大量基准可被无帧或打乱帧攻击逼近满分，并构建防捷径的Video-Index基准（840项）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频基准应奖励其声称衡量的能力，但模型可利用答案选项、问题文本或部分视觉证据等捷径作弊，导致评测结果失真，因此需要系统化审计并构建抗捷径的基准。

Method: 提出攻击金字塔——五级捷径攻击，对每个条目的访问权限递增；用它审计115个视频基准，并对505,518个问答对筛出审计池。采用智能体将评测请求转为规范，配合带红队门控的确定性选择器组装可复现基准。

Result: 35个基准上"从未看帧"的攻击者可达全视频准确率；51个含时序探针的基准中，打乱帧仍保留中位数96%的全视频准确率；63个基准中近重复问题至少占一半。发布Video-Index：四个能力组各210个最难验证项，共840项、76个来源。同一固定输入下Claude Opus 5领先所有开源模型超37个百分点，智能体工具再增约20个百分点。

Conclusion: 现有视频基准普遍存在严重捷径漏洞，多数条目可由非视觉或非时序信息解答；Video-Index提供了抗捷径、可复现的评测集，但所有系统在效率与准确率上仍有提升空间。

Abstract: A video benchmark should reward the capability it claims to measure, yet models can exploit answer options, question text, or partial visual evidence. We introduce the attack pyramid, five levels of shortcut attacks with increasing access to each item, and audit 115 video benchmarks with it. On 35 benchmarks, attackers that never see a frame approach full-video accuracy. On 51 benchmarks with temporal probes, shuffled frames keep a median 96% of full-video accuracy. Near-duplicate questions make up at least half the items in 63 benchmarks. We screen 505,518 question-answer pairs from 112 of them into an audited pool. Agents turn evaluation requests into specifications, and a deterministic selector with a red-team gate composes reproducible benchmarks. We release Video-Index, the 210 hardest verified items under these attacks in each of four capability groups, 840 items from 76 sources. With the same fixed input, Claude Opus 5 outscores every open-source model by over 37 percentage points, and agent tools add about 20 more, yet all systems leave room to improve efficiency and accuracy. </details>


### [56] [RelationVGGT: Visual Geometry Transformers for 3D Spatial Relation Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00970)
*Minsu Kim,Jaesung Choe,Jiwoo Lee,Yu-Chiang Frank Wang,Seon Joo Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出前馈、无需位姿的多视角"3D空间关系分割"新任务与RelationVGGT框架，并基于ScanNet++构建自动标注流程。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D重建已从逐场景优化转向前馈推理，语义场景理解随之演进，但现有方法仍局限于物体中心感知，忽视了物体间的空间关系。

Conclusion: 将语义场景理解从物体中心扩展至空间关系层面的前馈多视角分割是可行且具扩展性的，为3D空间关系理解提供了新任务、方法与数据基础。

Abstract: Recent advances in 3D reconstruction have progressed from per-scene optimization to feed-forward inference, and semantic scene understanding has followed suit -- yet existing methods remain confined to object-centric perception, neglecting spatial relations between objects. We formulate 3D spatial relation segmentation in a feed-forward, pose-free multi-view setting: given a visually specified subject and a relational text query, the model segments the target across views without receiving its category name. To this end, we propose RelationVGGT, a novel feed-forward framework that integrates semantic features from a visual foundation model with geometry-aware representations from a 3D geometry foundation model and leverages a relation transformer for subject-conditioned, cross-view relation prediction -- requiring neither per-scene optimization nor known camera poses. We additionally provide a fully automated annotation pipeline built on ScanNet++ with VLMs and LLMs, enabling scalable training data generation for this new task.

</details>


### [57] [Concept Driven Domain Adaptation: Finding an Abstract Needle in a Haystack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00973)
*Haiming Zhao,Tai Wang,Kun Zhang,Xicheng Peng,Zhiyang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究"概念到示例的视频检索"（concept-to-example video retrieval），即教师用抽象科学概念查询纪录片片段而非描述画面内容。作者提出概念驱动域适应（CDDA）三阶段框架，将概念作为中间语义锚点，通过文本概念几何构建、冻结视觉编码器下的概念几何迁移、以及稀疏视觉概念监督下的联合适应，缩小文本-概念与视觉-概念的角度差距。在自建初中物理检索基准上，CDDA 在概念检索上优于 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B 等基线，同时保持具体图文匹配能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学教师检索纪录片片段时，往往查询的是想讲授的抽象概念，而非屏幕上可见的事件。现有基于语言的视频片段检索方法假设查询描述可观测事件，无法满足教学场景中"用具体视觉现象例证抽象科学原理"的需求。这一"抽象需求-稀疏证据"的鸿沟（abstract-needle-in-a-haystack）是本文要解决的问题。

Method: 提出 Concept-Driven Domain Adaptation（CDDA）三阶段框架，用于将双塔视觉-语言模型适配到概念级检索，把概念视为中间语义锚点：（1）用教科书与教师手册中的"示例-概念"对结构化文本嵌入空间；（2）在冻结视觉编码器的条件下，将概念感知几何迁移到纪录片视觉空间；（3）用稀疏视觉概念监督联合适应双编码器。几何上，这种分阶段对齐减小了文本-概念与视觉-概念的角度差距，在促进概念级适应的同时保留预训练模型的具体图像描述对齐。

Result: 在自建的初中物理检索基准上，CDDA 在教学导向的概念检索任务上优于多个竞争性多模态基线（包括 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B），并在适应后保持了具体的图文匹配性能。

Conclusion: 概念可作为连接抽象教学需求与具体视觉证据的中间语义锚点；通过分阶段几何对齐，可有效缓解抽象概念与稀疏纪录片视觉之间的鸿沟，为教育场景下的概念级视频检索提供可行方案。

Abstract: Science teachers frequently search for documentary excerpts not by describing what appears on screen, but by querying the abstract concepts they intend to teach. This use case exposes a limitation of existing language-based video moment retrieval methods, which typically assume that queries describe observable events, whereas instructional search requires retrieving concrete visual phenomena that instantiate an underlying scientific principle. We study this setting as concept-to-example video retrieval, an abstract-needle-in-a-haystack problem where compact curriculum concepts must be grounded in temporally sparse documentary evidence. To bridge this abstraction gap, we propose Concept-Driven Domain Adaptation (CDDA), a three-stage framework for adapting two-tower vision-language models to concept-level retrieval. CDDA treats concepts as intermediate semantic anchors: it first structures the textual embedding space with textbook and teacher-handbook example-concept pairs, then transfers this concept-aware geometry to documentary visuals under a frozen visual encoder, and finally jointly adapts both encoders with sparse visual concept supervision. From a geometric perspective, this staged alignment reduces text-concept and vision-concept angular gaps, thereby encouraging concept-level adaptation while preserving the pretrained model's concrete image description alignment. On a curated middle-school physics retrieval benchmark, CDDA achieves stronger pedagogically oriented concept retrieval than several competitive multimodal baselines, including Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B, while maintaining concrete image-text matching after adaptation.

</details>


### [58] [VIEScore2: Unified Image Evaluation with Spatially Grounded Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00994)
*Xianda Du,Max Ku,Weiming Ren,Zhi Rui Tam,Chunlin Ren,Ping Nie,Min-Hung Chen,Wenhu Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 VIEScore2，一种统一图像生成与编辑评测器，将图像表示为 N×N 网格，单次前向同时预测质量分数与缺陷位置，并通过 GRPO 强化定位能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成图像评测器通常仅输出标量质量分，无法指出支撑该评分的图像区域，缺乏空间可解释性与可验证性。

Conclusion: 文本原生网格表示与可验证后训练目标使统一评测器在质量打分与缺陷定位上同时优于通用 VLM 与专用空间评测器，并具备跨数据集泛化性与可解释输出。

Abstract: Existing synthetic image evaluators typically provide only a scalar quality score and do not identify the image regions that support it. We introduce VIEScore2, a unified evaluator for image generation and editing tasks with optional conditioning images. VIEScore2 represents an image as an N x N grid and jointly predicts quality scores and defect locations in a single model pass. Its text-native grid representation provides a common interface for heterogeneous spatial supervision and enables directly verifiable post-training objectives. We train on 38K examples spanning score-only, localization-only, and joint supervision across generation and editing tasks. Starting from supervised fine-tuning, we further apply GRPO to improve defect localization using rewards that combine cell-level Dice overlap, score accuracy, and output-format validity. A parameter-free parser converts the structured predictions into readable explanations. On the primary suite, VIEScore2 achieves an overall-score SRCC of 0.601, compared with 0.491 for Gemini-3-Flash, the strongest zero-shot general-purpose VLM baseline under matched inputs. For defect localization, VIEScore2 outperforms both general-purpose VLMs and specialized spatial evaluators on three of six benchmarks in per-image grid IoU and ranks among the top three on five, including datasets beyond its training sources.

</details>


### [59] [Watch Your Speech: Text-aware Video-to-Speech Synthesis with Textual Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01012)
*Gunwoo Lee,Yoori Oh,Yoseob Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出WYS框架，将文本条件作为显式语言线索引入视频到语音合成，缓解一对多映射问题并取得SOTA性能。

  <summary>Details</summary>
