TL;DR: AgSpec是一个面向编码智能体的检索式推测解码框架，通过补充会话/工作区/全局三层语料并采用离线标定加在线自适应的草稿长度策略，显著提升生成吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检索式推测解码适合编码智能体反复复现代码、日志和历史尝试的场景，但现有方法在智能体流水线中存在三点不足：可复用文本缺失于语料库或存储格式与智能体输出格式不一致；草稿长度固定，未考虑接受长度在不同智能体间差异大且随轮次漂移的问题。

Method: AgSpec为现有检索引擎补足语料与草稿长度策略：从会话、工作区、全局三类语料检索，保留当前会话轨迹并以智能体输出格式索引已打开文件；用离线标定的上限约束各智能体的草稿长度，并依据验证反馈在线自适应调整长度。

Result: 在两个仓库级多智能体编码基准上，AgSpec在多数评测设置中优于五种检索式草稿器和EAGLE-3，batch size 1时生成吞吐量较自回归解码最高提升4.37倍，batch size 16时最高提升4.76倍。

Conclusion: AgSpec在无仓库或无多智能体流水线的基准上同样有效，表明其收益可泛化至更广泛的编码智能体场景。

Abstract: Retrieval-based speculative decoding (SD) drafts tokens by copying continuations from existing text, which suits coding agents that repeatedly reproduce code, logs, and earlier attempts. Yet existing methods fall short in agent pipelines: much of the reusable text is missing from their corpora or stored in a form that differs from what the agent emits, and their draft lengths ignore that accept length varies across agents and drifts over turns. We present AgSpec, a framework that supplies the corpus and draft-length policies that existing retrieval engines lack in coding-agent pipelines. AgSpec retrieves from session, workspace, and global corpora, retaining the ongoing session trajectory and indexing opened files in the agent's emission format. It bounds each agent's draft length with an offline-profiled cap and adapts the length online from verification feedback. On two repository-level multi-agent coding benchmarks, AgSpec outperforms five retrieval-based drafters and EAGLE-3 in most evaluated settings, raising generation throughput over autoregressive decoding up to 4.37$\times$ at batch size 1 and 4.76$\times$ at batch size 16. AgSpec also remains effective on benchmarks without a repository or a multi-agent pipeline, showing that its gains generalize to coding agents broadly.

</details>


### [235] [Madeleine: Learning Involuntary Recall for Conversational Memory from Simulated Lives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01118)
*Zhiyun Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Madeleine，将"联想"视为可学习的相关性（记忆在人类生活展开方式下的点互信息），通过离线 LLM 生活模拟生成的线索-触发对，训练查询编码器在冻结的相似度之上学习残差联想；在线阶段不调用 LLM，仅替换查询编码器即可接入任意向量记忆系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期对话助手需要在恰当时刻回忆恰当记忆，但最重要的记忆往往与用户当前话语并不相似。现有系统依赖 LLM 在写入或读取阶段进行推理来恢复此类关联，代价是每个记忆库上百至上千次 LLM 调用，以及每次查询高达数千个上下文 token，成本过高。

Method: 核心洞察：联想是一种可学习的相关性，即记忆在人类生活展开方式下的点互信息。Madeleine 学习摊销式联想（amortized association）：离线阶段，由 LLM 生活模拟器生成模拟人生，其中的线索-触发对用于教导查询编码器，在冻结的相似度之上学习残差联想；在线阶段不调用任何 LLM，可插入任意向量记忆系统，且仅需替换查询编码器。

Result: 在 LoCoMo-Plus 的官方协议下：(I) 接入 HyperMem 时达到 66.6，为该协议下所有评测系统中的最高分；(II) 单独使用时达到 HyperMem 发布版本的分数水平（52.4 对 52.9），且零 LLM 调用、答案上下文约为其 1/21；(III) 将 T-Mem 提升 26.2 分，在两个系统中均显著优于相同的未训练骨干，并在 4B 骨干上保持普通问答性能不变。

Conclusion: 联想能力可以被离线学习并以摊销方式部署，从而在完全消除在线 LLM 调用、大幅压缩上下文开销的同时，达到甚至超越依赖 LLM 推理的现有记忆系统。

Abstract: A long-term conversational assistant must recall the right memory at the right moment, yet the memory that matters most is often not similar to what the user says now. Current systems recover such associations by letting an LLM reason at write or read time, at a cost of hundreds to over a thousand LLM calls per memory bank and up to several thousand context tokens per query. We argue that association is a learnable relevance: the pointwise mutual information of memories under how human lives unfold. We introduce Madeleine, which learns amortized association: offline, an LLM life simulator writes simulated lives, whose cue-trigger pairs teach a query encoder a residual association on top of frozen similarity; online, it calls no LLM and plugs into any vector memory by replacing only the query encoder. On LoCoMo-Plus under the official protocol, Madeleine (I) reaches 66.6 when plugged into HyperMem, the highest among all systems evaluated under this protocol; (II) used alone, reaches the score of HyperMem as released (52.4 vs. 52.9) with zero LLM calls and about 1/21 of its answer context; and (III) lifts T-Mem by 26.2 points, significantly outperforms the same untrained backbone inside both systems, and leaves ordinary QA intact on the 4B backbone.

</details>


### [236] [Counting and Min-Cost Encoding for Tokenization in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01127)
*Shuming Shi,Xiang Zhang,Hao Yu,Wenbo Fei,Changjian Wang,Zhan Wang,Guoqing Pang,Guangye Yu,Quan Lu,Ning Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 CNF 分词器训练方法与 MCE 文本编码算法，通过全局最小化分词成本提升 token 效率，压缩率优于 BPE，下游性能相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流 LLM 依赖分词器将文本编码为 token 序列，相同文本在不同分词器下长度差异显著；固定模型架构下，更短的 token 序列意味着更低的推理时间，因此需要提升 token 效率。

Method: 提出 CNF（Counting and Filtering）分词器训练方法与 MCE（Min-Cost Encoding）编码算法。MCE 定义文本片段上的代价函数，通过全局最小化整体分词代价确定最优切分；CNF 先通过直接统计有效子串构建原始词表，再用 MCE 切分训练语料，并基于实际 token 使用情况进行过滤，得到最终词表。MCE 不依赖 BPE 的 merge list 或 UnigramLM 的 token 概率。

Result: 在 6 类文本、2 组词表规模下，CNF-MCE 压缩率均优于所评估的 BPE 分词器。250K 词表下，英文网页文本压缩率相比 o200k_base 与 qwen250k 分别提升 26% 和 30%；词表扩展至 1M 时，token 效率提升超 60%，词表利用率由 52.9% 升至 96.9%。从零训练的 1.8B 与 8B 模型在 11 个基准上平均性能与 BPE 分词器模型相当。

Conclusion: CNF-MCE 能显著提升 token 效率，同时保持有竞争力的下游性能，并可适用于 BPE、UnigramLM、CNF 等多种词表构建方式。

Abstract: Mainstream large language models rely on a tokenizer to encode text into a token sequence. Different tokenizers may yield token sequences of substantially different lengths for the same text. With a fixed model architecture, shorter token sequences correspond to lower inference time. We propose a tokenizer training approach named Counting and Filtering (CNF) and a text encoding algorithm called Min-Cost Encoding (MCE). MCE defines a cost function over a text segment, and determines the best segmentation by globally minimizing the overall segmentation cost. CNF builds a raw vocabulary by directly counting valid substrings, and then constructs the final vocabulary through a filtering step based on actual token usage when segmenting the training corpus with MCE. The CNF-MCE conbination offers several advantages over BPE, including higher token efficiency, greater scalability, and lower dependency. Across six text categories and two vocabulary-size groups, CNF-MCE consistently achieves better compression than the evaluated BPE tokenizers. With a 250K vocabulary, CNF-MCE increases compression rate by 26% and 30% on English web text over the o200k_base and qwen250k tokenizers. Experiments scaling the vocabulary to 1M entries on English web text demonstrate sustained improvements over BPE, with a token efficiency improvement of over 60% and vocabulary utilization rising from 52.9% to 96.9%. The MCE algorithm does not depend on a merge list (as in BPE) or token probability (as in UnigramLM), making it applicable to a wide range of vocabularies, including those built from BPE, UnigramLM, CNF, and others. Language models trained from scratch at the 1.8B and 8B scales achieve comparable average performance to models using the BPE tokenizers across 11 benchmarks. These results demonstrate that CNF-MCE can improve token efficiency significantly while maintaining competitive downstream performance.

</details>


### [237] [BanglaDial-Abuse: A Corpus-Grounded Dataset for Regional Dialect Identification in Abusive Bangla Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01150)
*Hasin Almas Sifat*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出 BanglaDial-Abuse，一个用于孟加拉语区域方言识别的平衡孟加拉文脚本数据集，包含 1000 句、四类方言各 250 句，采用语料基础的合成方法构建，任务为四类方言识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 孟加拉语自然语言处理在非正式、非标准文本中面临区域语言变异的重要挑战，尤其缺乏针对辱骂性文本的方言资源。

Method: 采用语料基础的合成构建流程，在保留敌意或辱骂语义的前提下，引入代词、所有格、动词形态、否定、疑问结构、后置词、词汇及孟加拉文拼写规范等方面的区域变异，构建含标准孟加拉语、Chattagram、Sylhet、Barishal 四类各 250 句的平衡数据集。

Result: 描述性分析显示四类句长分布大体相近，但词汇空间部分区分；成对 Jaccard 词汇相似度为 0.37 至 0.56。数据集公开于 Zenodo，采用 CC BY 4.0 许可。

Conclusion: 该数据集面向四类区域方言识别而非二分类辱骂文本检测，当前版本定位为研究与原型验证语料，尚非经母语者验证的黄金标准语言资源。

Abstract: Regional linguistic variation remains an important challenge for Bangla natural language processing, particularly in informal and non-standard text. This paper introduces BanglaDial-Abuse, a balanced Bengali-script dataset developed for regional dialect identification in abusive and hostile Bangla text. The dataset contains 1,000 sentences distributed equally across four linguistic varieties: Standard Bangla, Chattagram, Sylhet, and Barishal, with 250 samples per class. The resource was constructed using a corpus-grounded synthetic procedure incorporating regional variation in pronouns, possessive forms, verb morphology, negation, interrogative structures, postpositions, vocabulary, and Bengali-script spelling conventions while preserving the underlying hostile or abusive meaning. Descriptive analysis shows broadly comparable sentence-length distributions but partially distinct lexical spaces across the four classes. Pairwise Jaccard vocabulary similarity ranges from 0.37 to 0.56. The primary task is four-class regional dialect identification rather than binary abusive-text detection. The dataset is publicly available through Zenodo under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license. The current version is intended as a research and prototyping corpus rather than a native-speaker-validated gold-standard linguistic resource. Keywords: Bangla, Bengali, dialect identification, regional dialect, abusive language, low-resource NLP, Chattagram, Sylhet, Barishal, dataset

</details>


### [238] [My FAULT: Self-Diagnosis as Credit Assignment in Self-Evolving Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01161)
*Yihua Zhu,Qianying Liu,Weixu Qiao,Xuan Ren,Weiwei Xu,Wenbo Li,Wei Wang,Ruijia Chen,Xinmiao Luan,Yin Luo,Hao Huang,Xiang Zheng,Hidetoshi Shimodaira*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 FAULT 方法，将诊断出的错误转化为以终端结果为锚的显式步骤级信用分配，解决智能体 RL 中的信用分配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体强化学习依赖终端结果奖励，在长时程任务中存在两个信用分配问题：一是同结果 rollout 组无法从终端奖励获得学习信号；二是终端奖励仅提供轨迹级反馈，难以定位导致失败的具体决策。现有工作用轨迹分析（如自然语言反思）补充细粒度信息，但自然语言诊断难以直接用于信用分配：错误声明可能不可靠，且未量化每个错误对学习的影响程度。

Method: FAULT 将诊断出的错误转化为显式的步骤级信用，并以终端结果作为锚点。方法会核查诊断证据，并从任务结果中学习相对错误代价。训练过程中，策略与自诊断器共同演化，错误代价根据近期结果在线更新。

Result: 在 ALFWorld 上，FAULT 从同结果组中恢复学习信号，信号覆盖率达 95%，而 GRPO 为 41%、GiGPO 为 72%，同时能更好地将信用定位到具体错误步骤。在两种模型规模下，FAULT 在长时程任务 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上取得显著提升，在短时程 Search-based QA 上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: FAULT 通过自诊断引导的终端信用再分配，有效缓解长时程智能体 RL 的信用分配难题，提升学习信号覆盖与信用定位精度，并在长时程任务上表现优异。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful approach for training large language model agents on multi-step tasks, yet reliance on terminal outcome rewards creates two credit-assignment problems, particularly in long-horizon tasks. First, same-outcome rollout groups provide no learning signal from terminal rewards. Second, terminal rewards provide only trajectory-wide feedback, making it difficult to identify which decisions caused a failure. Recent work supplements terminal rewards with finer-grained information from trajectory analysis, such as natural-language reflections on intermediate decisions and errors. However, natural-language diagnoses are difficult to use directly for credit assignment: their error claims may be unreliable, and they do not quantify how much each error should affect learning. We propose Self-Diagnosis-guided Terminal Credit Redistribution (FAULT), which turns diagnosed errors into explicit step-level credit anchored by terminal outcomes. FAULT checks diagnostic evidence and learns relative error costs from task outcomes. During training, the policy and self-diagnoser co-evolve, while error costs are updated online from recent outcomes. On ALFWorld, FAULT recovers learning signals from same-outcome groups, reaching 95% signal coverage versus 41% for GRPO and 72% for GiGPO, while better localizing credit to specific error steps. Across two model scales, FAULT delivers strong. improvements on the long-horizon ALFWorld and WebShop tasks while remaining competitive on short-horizon Search-based QA.

</details>


### [239] [HeadEdit: Calibrating Language Model Behavior Through the Frozen Unembedding Matrix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01170)
*Zirui He,Haiyan Zhao,Jingyu Hu,Yinghao Wu,Chenxi Yuan,Yingcong Li,Yandong Bai,Mengnan Du*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: HeadEdit 是一种免梯度方法，通过 unembedding 矩阵将行为相关方向从隐状态解码，实现隐式自适应校准，改进3任务×3模型族的9个设定，几乎无推理开销且不损通用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对齐无法消除语言模型的行为错误（如拒绝良性请求、调用多余工具、顺从虚假用户声明）。现有方法多将此类错误视为计算问题加以缓解，很少探讨期望行为是否已编码在模型表征中。作者观察到：即使最终 logits 产生错误行为，行为相关信息仍可从最终隐状态中线性解码。

Method: 提出 HeadEdit：从成对 completion 中提取低秩行为子空间，利用每个 prompt 在该子空间中的坐标生成词表范围的修正，从而在 unembedding 矩阵层面实现隐式自适应 steering，无需人工指定目标 token，也无需参数更新，且免梯度。

Result: 在三个任务、三个模型族共九个实验设定上均获提升；推理开销可忽略，无系统性通用能力损失。揭示其与基于梯度的对齐方法的联系：该低维表征可部分预测偏好调优对未见 prompt 输出 logits 的改变；学到的子空间在调优后可复用，无需重新提取或重调即可提升性能。

Conclusion: HeadEdit 提供了一种实用、轻量且可解释的途径，通过 unembedding 矩阵校准模型行为。

Abstract: Alignment does not eliminate behavioral errors in language models. Models may still refuse benign requests, call unnecessary tools, or yield to false user claims. Current methods mitigate such errors as a computation problem, and rarely explore if the desired behavior is already encoded in the model's representation. Motivated by the observation that behavior-relevant information remains linearly decodable from the final hidden state even when the resulting logits produce the undesired behavior, we introduce HeadEdit, a gradient-free method that calibrates model behavior through the unembedding matrix. HeadEdit extracts a low-rank behavioral subspace from paired completions and uses each prompt's coordinates within it to generate a vocabulary-wide correction, thereby implementing implicitly adaptive steering without manually specified target tokens or parameter updates. HeadEdit improves all nine experimental settings across three tasks and three model families, with negligible inference overhead and no systematic loss of general capabilities. It also reveals a connection to gradient-based alignment. HeadEdit's low-dimensional representation partly predicts how preference tuning changes output logits on unseen prompts. The subspace learned from the model can also be reused after tuning, improving performance without re-extracting or retuning. These results show that HeadEdit provides a practical, lightweight, and interpretable way to calibrate model behavior through the unembedding matrix.

</details>


### [240] [Temporally-Resolved Token Attribution Reveals the Generation Dynamics of Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01177)
*Darpan Aswal,Céline Hudelot*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 DLIG，一种面向扩散语言模型的 token 归因方法，将积分梯度扩展到任意层与去噪步。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）的机制分析缺乏廉价且可跨层、跨去噪步的归因工具；干预性分析成本较高，需要一种轻量化的互补手段来快速检验机制假设。

Method: 将 Integrated Gradients（IG）推广到扩散语言模型的任意层与任意去噪步，定义 DLIG，用于将模型对自生成或固定补全的渐进“承诺”归因到输入 prompt 的 token，并建立其与 IG 公理（完备性、实现不变性、线性、对称性保持）的对应关系。

Result: 在词义消歧、多跳图推理和句子补全任务上验证了 DLIG，揭示了 DLM 如何跨位置、层与去噪步利用输入信息，并可作为干预分析的低成本前置检查。

Conclusion: DLIG 为扩散语言模型提供了具备公理保证的轻量归因工具，有助于沿去噪轨迹检验机制假设并理解输入信息的利用方式。

Abstract: This work presents Diffusion Layer Integrated Gradients (DLIG), a token attribution method for diffusion language models (DLMs) that extends Integrated Gradients (IG~\cite{sundararajan2017axiomatic}) to arbitrary layers and denoising steps. DLIG attributes a DLM's progressive commitment to a self-generated or fixed completion for an input prompt. We establish direct correspondences between DLIG and the IG axioms of completeness, implementation invariance, linearity, and symmetry preservation. As a lightweight complement to interventional analysis, DLIG provides an inexpensive first check of mechanistic hypotheses across the denoising trajectory. We demonstrate this on word-sense disambiguation, multi-hop graph reasoning, and sentence infilling, revealing how DLMs draw on inputs across positions, layers, and denoising steps.

</details>


### [241] [AGO AI Quality Gate: Evidence-First Release Decisions for Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01218)
*Giulio Zeloni,Enrico Lo Conte,Salvatore Rionero,Giuseppe Santoro,Alessandro Rastelli,Fabio Sorrentino*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出面向工业RAG评估的质量门框架AGO，通过四态决策模型、分层评分、分层beta-binomial门控与强制元评估协议，把缺失数据与裁判错误显式纳入决策；在RAGBench上用gpt-4.1-nano与gpt-4o验证元评估必要性，并用固定种子门控研究量化回归场景下的不安全上线率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业采用RAG时需反复决策系统版本的晋升、修订或阻断，但证据不完整且指标来自易出错的LLM裁判；现有做法依赖点估计，难以控制回归风险，也无法在裁判本身不可靠时保证决策质量。

Method: AGO框架含四个组件：四态决策模型（将缺失数据与裁判错误作为显式结果）；分层评分（确定性检查、本地护栏、结构化LLM评估）；分层beta-binomial门控（概率化量化回归风险）；强制元评估协议（在LLM裁判影响决策前先验证其可靠性）。因业务数据专有，裁判层在RAGBench（12个数据集、10万条标注RAG轨迹）上评估，各裁判使用相同分层测试样本（N=1200）；并以固定种子门控研究覆盖回归、无变化、改进三类场景。

Result: 低成本裁判gpt-4.1-nano协议输出无误，但检测非符合性回答仅略高于随机（AUROC 0.603 [0.570, 0.634]）；gpt-4o达0.783 [0.756, 0.807]，但其分领域性能仍在0.62至0.88之间波动。回归场景下，decision-grade配置将不安全晋升降至22.2%-35.1%，朴素门控为29.3%-41.8%，同时量化了误报成本与改进吞吐量。

Conclusion: 结果支持两项设计选择：裁判质量必须按每次评估单独测量；点估计不足以作为发布决策依据，应结合概率化门控与元评估协议进行风险控制。

Abstract: Enterprises adopting retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) face a recurring operational decision: promote, revise, or block a system version. The evidence is incomplete and the metrics come from fallible LLM judges. We report on AGO AI Quality Gate (AGO), an evidence-first quality-gate framework deployed in industrial RAG assessment engagements. AGO integrates four key components: a four-state decision model that treats missing data and judge errors as explicit outcomes; layered scoring combining deterministic checks, local guardrails, and structured LLM evaluation; a stratified beta-binomial gate that quantifies regression risk probabilistically; and a mandatory meta-evaluation protocol to validate the LLM judge before it influences decisions. Since engagement data is proprietary, we evaluate the judge layer on RAGBench, a public benchmark of 100k annotated RAG traces across 12 datasets. On identical stratified test samples (N=1200 per judge), a low-cost judge (gpt-4.1-nano) detects non-adherent answers barely above chance (AUROC 0.603 [0.570, 0.634]), despite producing flawless protocol output, while gpt-4o reaches 0.783 [0.756, 0.807] -- yet its per-domain performance still ranges from 0.62 to 0.88. A fixed-seed gate study spanning regression, no change, and improvement quantifies unsafe promotion, false-alarm cost, and improvement throughput. Under regression, the decision-grade profile reduces unsafe promotion to 22.2%-35.1%, against 29.3%-41.8% for a naive gate. These results support the design choices that judge quality must be measured per engagement and that point estimates alone are not a release decision.

</details>


### [242] [ASCRIBE: Atomic and Significance-Based Reasoning for Thai Clinical SOAP Note Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01234)
*Tarm Kalavantavanich,Teerawut Ponarchar,Pattaramanee Arsomngern,Jenta Wonglertsakul,Watcharakorn Chuthong,Chiraphat Boonnag,Knot Pipatsrisawat,Titipat Achakulvisut*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ASCRIBE框架：在摘要前为对话中每个原子事实赋予临床重要性等级，并发布首个泰语临床摘要基准ThaiClinicBench，可作为提示或GRPO奖励显著提升SOAP病历生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动生成SOAP病历可减轻医生文书负担，但现有推理方法常遗漏关键临床信息并产生无依据内容；泰语领域还因缺乏公开数据集而进展受限。

Method: ASCRIBE为医生启发的推理框架，在摘要前对对话中提取的每个原子事实（atomic fact）赋予临床重要性等级（clinical-significance level），使通用LLM成为更可靠的scribe。同时发布ThaiClinicBench（首个去标识化真实泰语临床摘要基准）及基于真实临床笔记构建的合成训练语料。方法可作为提示使用，也可作为GRPO奖励信号。

Result: 作为提示时，ASCRIBE在GPT-5.4与Gemini 3.1 Pro上于医生对齐的LLM-judge指标上优于思维链提示（chain-of-thought），在完整性指标上较标准提示最高提升10.3分；作为GRPO奖励时，仅用合成数据训练的Gemma-4-E4B在事实精确度上匹敌Gemini 3.1 Pro，在完整性上超过它。

Conclusion: 将临床重要性归因引入推理流程，可有效提升SOAP病历生成的完整性与事实可靠性，并缓解泰语临床摘要的数据稀缺问题。

Abstract: Automatic SOAP note generation can ease the documentation burden on physicians, but existing reasoning methods often omit clinically important information and generate unsupported content. Progress in Thai is further hindered by the lack of publicly available datasets. We propose ASCRIBE, a physician-inspired reasoning framework that ascribes a clinical-significance level to each extracted atomic fact in the conversation before summarization, making a general-purpose LLM a more reliable scribe. We also release ThaiClinicBench, the first de-identified Thai clinical summarization benchmark of real encounters, together with a synthetic training corpus derived from real clinical notes. As a prompt, ASCRIBE outperforms chain-of-thought prompting on GPT-5.4 and Gemini 3.1 Pro across the physician-aligned LLM-judge metrics and improves on standard prompting by up to 10.3 points on the completeness LLM-judge metric. As a GRPO reward, it enables a Gemma-4-E4B model trained solely on synthetic data to match Gemini 3.1 Pro in factual precision and surpass it in completeness. Code and data can be found at https://github.com/loolootech/ascribe.

</details>


### [243] [Harness Annealing: Learning to Act with Less External Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01235)
*Yingxuan Yang,Huacan Chai,Ying Wen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出“harness internalization”目标与HAT训练方法，让语言智能体把外部harness的控制决策内化到模型中；9B/35B模型在SWE-QA与SWE-QA-Pro上，部分退火检查点仅用工具即可接近起点模型配全harness的成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言智能体依赖外部harness进行状态跟踪、工作流组织与答案验证，其还提供“调查什么、是否修改、何时停止”等控制决策。现有基于成功轨迹的训练虽能提升任务表现，但控制仍依赖运行时干预。作者希望探究：harness支持的经验能否让模型自身学会这些决策，使控制权分工随学习而改变，从而在撤除支持后仍保持任务表现。

Method: 提出harness internalization目标：在撤除相应支持后仍能承担被指定的控制责任并保持任务表现。提出HARNESS ANNEALING TRAINING（HAT），将显式控制监督与“教师轨迹课程”结合，教师轨迹在逐渐减弱的harness下采集，逐步退火。

Result: 在SWE-QA与SWE-QA-Pro上，用9B与35B模型，对每个检查点在四种部署harness下评估。选定的退火检查点仅用工具即达到接近各自起点检查点使用完整harness的分数；收益随模型规模与部署配置变化，继续退火并非一致提升。

Conclusion: harness支持的经验有助于减少训练后智能体所需的运行时控制，说明控制权可从外部harness逐步内化到模型中，但内化效果受模型规模与部署配置影响，且存在非单调性。

Abstract: Language agents rely on external harnesses to track state, organize workflows, and verify answers. Beyond providing tools and information, these harnesses supply control decisions about what to investigate, whether to revise, and when to stop. Training on successful harness-supported trajectories can improve task performance while leaving these decisions dependent on runtime intervention. We ask whether harness-supported experience can also teach the model to make these decisions, allowing the division of control to change as the model learns. We call this objective harness internalization: learning to assume specified control responsibilities while retaining task performance after the corresponding support is withdrawn. We introduce HARNESS ANNEALING TRAINING (HAT), which combines explicit control supervision with a curriculum over teacher trajectories collected under progressively weaker harnesses. Experiments with 9B and 35B models on SWE-QA and SWE-QA-Pro evaluate every checkpoint under four deployment harnesses. Selected annealed checkpoints operating with tools alone achieve scores close to those of their respective starting checkpoints deployed with the full harness. The benefits vary with model scale and deployment configuration, and further annealing does not uniformly improve performance. These findings suggest that harness-supported experience can help reduce the runtime control required by a trained agent.

</details>


### [244] [Evaluating the Robustness of Japanese LLMs to IME-Related and Typographical Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01241)
*Ryota Mibayashi,Hiroaki Ohshima*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文评估日本语大语言模型对日文特有打字错误的鲁棒性，发现字符换位与替换类错误显著降低准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在NLP任务中表现优异，但其对排版/打字错误的鲁棒性仍缺乏研究，尤其是涉及多书写系统与IME转换的日语场景。

Method: 提出五类日语特有错字：字符换位、字符替换、同音词转换、日语IME转换、全角转换；在JMMLU、JCommonsenseQA、JamC-QA三个日文基准上对11个日语及多语言LLM进行扰动评估。

Result: 字符换位与字符替换在各基准上持续降低准确率；IME转换、全角转换和同音词转换影响相对有限。

Conclusion: 当前日语LLM对真实日语打字错误仍较脆弱，尤其当输入被大幅扭曲时，凸显在实际输入环境下开展鲁棒性评估的重要性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across various natural language processing tasks. However, their robustness to typographical errors remains underexplored, particularly in Japanese, where text input involves multiple writing systems and IME-based conversion. In this study, we evaluate the robustness of Japanese LLMs against realistic Japanese-specific typos. We introduce five typo categories: Character Transposition, Character Replacement, Homophone Conversion, Japanese IME Conversion, and Full-Width Conversion. These perturbations are applied to three Japanese benchmark datasets (JMMLU, JCommonsenseQA, and JamC-QA), and eleven Japanese and multilingual LLMs are evaluated. The results show that Character Transposition and Character Replacement typos consistently reduce accuracy across benchmarks, whereas IME Conversion, Full-Width Conversion, and Homophone Conversion have relatively limited impact. These findings reveal that current Japanese LLMs remain vulnerable to realistic Japanese typing errors, particularly those that substantially distort the original input, highlighting the importance of robustness evaluation in practical input environments.

</details>


### [245] [Right Answers, Wrong States: Hidden Information Failures in Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01244)
*Herun Wan,Jiaying Wu,Minnan Luo,Zihan Ma,Fanxiao Li,Nancy F. Chen,Min-Yen Kan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"off-query failure"(离线查询失败)概念,指出多智能体协作即使当前决策正确,也可能留下被污染的信息状态。作者构建OffQuery基准(分T1证据验证、T2共享状态重建、T3任务解决三层)与ReGround方法,在医疗与灾害响应场景中验证发现任务性能远高于状态可靠性,并通过ReGround显著改善三项能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体系统评估通常仅以是否得出正确答案为标准,忽视了协作过程可能污染共享信息状态的问题——即使当前决策正确,被破坏的事实仍会在后续任务中造成隐患。作者将这一被忽略的失效模式命名为off-query failure,旨在揭示并量化协作决策支持中的状态可靠性问题。

Method: 1) 提出OffQuery评估框架,将协作能力解耦为三层:证据验证(T1)、共享状态重建(T2)与任务解决(T3);2) 选取医疗与灾害响应两个高风险场景,覆盖GPT、Gemini、Qwen三个模型家族共21种模型-场景组合;3) 通过分析当前查询与后续任务对事实依赖的差异,定位失效来源;4) 提出ReGround方法,依次进行冲突证据消解、共享事实验证、可信状态重建,并在该状态上进行推理。

Result: 标准协作下,任务解决平均达64.7%,而证据验证与状态重建仅分别为14.3%和43.1%,呈现明显"任务强、状态弱"的落差。归因显示:当前查询往往绕过被污染的事实,而这些事实在后续任务中变得关键,即选择性信息使用导致off-query failure。ReGround在三个模型家族共七个模型、所有评估场景中同时提升三项能力,T1、T2、T3的平均相对增益分别为309.0%、82.9%和17.6%。

Conclusion: 可靠的协作不仅要求当前决策正确,还要求为未来推理保留可信的共享状态。仅以答案正确性衡量多智能体会掩盖off-query failure这一深层失效,评估与设计需同时关注决策质量与状态可靠性。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems are often judged by whether they reach the correct answer. This can miss a distinct failure: collaboration may leave behind a corrupted information state even when the immediate decision is correct. We call this an off-query failure. To study this failure in collaborative decision support, we introduce OffQuery, which separately evaluates evidence verification (T1), shared-state reconstruction (T2), and task resolution (T3) in two representative high-stakes settings: healthcare and disaster response. Across GPT, Gemini, and Qwen models, standard collaboration shows much stronger task performance than state reliability. Averaged over 21 model--setting combinations, task resolution reaches 64.7%, while evidence verification and state reconstruction reach only 14.3% and 43.1%. We trace this gap to selective information use: current queries often bypass corrupted facts, which become consequential when later tasks require them. We further introduce ReGround, which resolves conflicting evidence, verifies shared facts, reconstructs a trusted state, and reasons over that state. Across seven models from three families, ReGround improves all three capabilities in every evaluated setting, with average relative gains of 309.0%, 82.9%, and 17.6% on T1, T2, and T3. Reliable collaboration therefore requires both a correct decision and a reliable shared state for future reasoning.

</details>


### [246] [Science Utopia? Closed-Loop LLM Simulation of Academic Research Ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01257)
*Yiqiao Jin,Yiyang Wang,Lucheng Fu,Bing He,Siheng Xiong,Yijia Xiao,B. Aditya Prakash,Josiah Hester,Srijan Kumar,James Evans,Jindong Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 SciUtopia，一个持续、闭环的 LLM 智能体仿真框架，用于研究学术研究生态系统的长期演化。基于 61 个仿真世界、逾 4 万名研究者与 120 万条 LLM 生成同行评审，揭示重投稿对审稿负担的放大效应、谨慎探索的多目标平衡作用，以及无需累积优势即可涌现的资源不平等。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学进步源于研究者、机构、资助机构、合作网络与文献共同演化的纵向生态系统；随着 AI 日益深入科研全周期，亟需在可控条件下理解这些相互关联、动态演化的过程。现有研究缺乏能够持续追踪多年、支持反事实实验与干预的闭环仿真平台。

Method: 提出 SciUtopia：一个持久、闭环的 LLM 智能体仿真框架。建模研究方向选择、合作、投稿、同行评审、重投稿、引用、资助与研究者流失等相互关联过程，并在跨仿真年份中维护演化状态；提供可配置的机构机制与信息渠道，以支持匹配的反事实实验与定向干预。实验覆盖 61 个仿真世界、8,000 所机构、40,000 余名研究者，产生约 40 万次发表决策与 120 万条 LLM 生成的审稿意见。

Result: 1) 拒稿驱动的重投稿会显著放大审稿人负担，且该效应超出单纯人口增长所能解释的范围；2) 谨慎探索可在引用影响力、职业成功与长期主题多样性之间取得平衡；3) 资源不平等可以在未检测到由早期资助微弱胜出带来的累积优势的情况下涌现。

Conclusion: SciUtopia 为学术研究生态系统提供了可复现、可干预的纵向仿真测试平台，表明 AI 智能体仿真可用于揭示科研系统中难以在真实世界直接实验的宏观机制与政策效应。代码已开源。

Abstract: Scientific progress emerges from a longitudinal ecosystem in which researchers, institutions, funding agencies, collaboration networks, and the scientific literature co-evolve. As AI becomes increasingly involved throughout the scientific research cycle, understanding these interconnected and evolving processes becomes increasingly important. We introduce SciUtopia, a persistent, closed-loop LLM-agent simulation framework for studying academic research ecosystems. SciUtopia models interconnected scientific processes such as research-direction choice, collaboration, submission, peer review, resubmission, citation, funding, and researcher attrition, while maintaining evolving states across simulated years. Its configurable institutional mechanisms and information channels provide a controlled testbed for matched counterfactual experiments and targeted interventions. Across 61 simulation worlds, SciUtopia simulates over 40,000 researchers from 8,000 institutions, producing around 400,000 publication decisions and 1.2 million LLM-generated peer reviews. Using these longitudinal simulations, we find that rejection-driven resubmission substantially amplifies reviewer burden beyond population growth alone, cautious exploration balances citation impact with career success and long-term topic diversity, and resource inequality can emerge even without detectable cumulative advantage from narrowly winning early funding. Code is available at https://github.com/Ahren09/ScienceUtopia.

</details>


### [247] [Know When to Hold 'em: Correct-Token Retention in Uniform-State Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01275)
*Mojtaba Nafez,James Henderson*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文指出统一状态扩散模型（USDMs）虽能自纠错，但缺乏保留正确 token 的能力，并提出训练时辅助损失 CTR-Reg 来解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: USDMs 可在任意去噪步修正任意 token，具备自纠错优势；但自纠错既需修正错误 token，也需保留正确 token，而现有 USDMs 在后一方面存在缺陷，导致大量无协调修改并破坏样本多样性。

Method: 通过贪心尾部解码观察每步修订位置数、随机 token 污染实验对比干净/污染 token 重构准确率、分解验证 NELBO 进行分析；提出 Correct-Token Retention Regularization（CTR-Reg）辅助损失，训练模型保留前向过程未扰动的 token，且不改变采样器。

Result: 现有模型（DUO、UDLM、uniform-noise SEDD）每步仍修订 512 个位置中的 173–270 个；CTR-Reg 在六个基准上平均提升干净 token 准确率 26.5 个百分点，污染 token 准确率基本不变，每步修订收敛至 3–11 个位置；仅 5 步贪心尾部即可使三种模型生成困惑度减半以上，并保持多样性，且在不同采样预算下均成立。

Conclusion: 正确 token 保留是自纠错扩散语言模型缺失的关键要素，CTR-Reg 提供了一种简单有效的修复方法。

Abstract: Uniform-state diffusion models (USDMs) can revise any token at any denoising step, which lets them correct their own mistakes, a key advantage over masked diffusion. Self-correction, however, requires both revising incorrect tokens and retaining correct ones, and we show that current USDMs lack the latter. Even under greedy-tail decoding, state-of-the-art USDMs (DUO, UDLM, and uniform-noise SEDD) keep revising 173--270 of 512 positions at every step, and these large, uncoordinated edits collapse sample diversity. A random-token corruption experiment traces this deficit to the models themselves: they reconstruct clean and corrupted tokens with nearly identical accuracy, even though clean tokens are easier targets. A decomposition of the validation NELBO shows that training barely rewards retention: incorrect predictions are heavily penalized at corrupted positions but almost free at clean ones. We propose Correct-Token Retention Regularization (CTR-Reg), a simple but effective auxiliary loss that trains the model to retain tokens left unperturbed by the forward process and requires no change to the sampler. CTR-Reg improves clean-token accuracy by 26.5 percentage points on average across six benchmarks, while leaving corrupted-token accuracy virtually unchanged, and its per-step revisions converge to only 3--11 positions. With just five greedy-tail steps, generative perplexity more than halves under CTR-Reg for all three models while diversity is preserved, and these gains hold across sampling budgets. Our results identify correct-token retention as a key missing ingredient for self-correcting diffusion language models, and demonstrate an effective fix.

</details>


### [248] [What Wins a Vote? Formatting, Length, and Lexical Diversity in the French Compar:IA LLM Arena](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01316)
*Simonas Zilinskas,Maayeesha Farzana,Christophe Benavent*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究对Compar:IA法语LLM竞技场的13.7万次人类偏好投票进行文体计量分析，发现呈现形式（加粗、词汇多样性等）与获胜显著相关，调整后116个模型中有36个排名变动≥10位，但外部基准检验不支持调整排名更能衡量能力，故建议同时公布原始与调整排名作为敏感性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM竞技场将成对的人类偏好转化为模型排名，但偏好可能既反映答案的呈现形式（格式、长度、可读性等）也反映内容本身。若呈现形式系统性地影响投票，则原始排名可能偏离对模型真实能力的度量，因此需要量化并剥离这些文体特征的影响。

Method: 采用文体计量学方法，分析2026年7月Compar:IA法语发布中的137,293张决定性投票：主格式分析覆盖116个模型、137,113场对局，联合估计使用具备全部测量值的127,092场对局。对每场对局重建用户投票时可见的回答，构建原始排名与经格式、长度、可读性、词汇多样性、句式结构调整后的排名进行对比，并在联合模型中以标准差为单位估计各特征的获胜几率变化及跨设定稳健性；同时对多轮对话进行观察性对照。

Result: 呈现形式与获胜相关，但长度、加粗和列表常同时出现，难以分离各自贡献。跨各设定变化最小的两个关联是：加粗使用（联合模型中每标准差+11.0%获胜几率）和移动平均类符形符比（MATTR，对长度不敏感的词汇多样性指标，+16.8%）。加粗关联在观察到的多轮对话中明显变小，MATTR关联几乎不变；由于用户自主决定是否继续，该差异仅为描述性而非因果性。完整调整使116个模型中有36个排名至少变动10位。然而与外部基准的比较并未显示调整后排名能更好地衡量能力。

Conclusion: 文体性呈现特征可显著影响竞技场偏好并实质性改变模型排名，但调整后的排名尚无证据表明更接近真实能力。因此建议将原始排名与调整后排名并列发布，作为透明的敏感性分析，而非以调整排名替代原始排名。

Abstract: LLM arenas turn pairwise human preferences into model rankings. Those preferences may reflect how an answer is presented as well as what it says. We take a stylometric approach to 137,293 decisive French-language votes from the July 2026 Compar:IA release; the primary formatting analysis includes 137,113 battles across 116 models, and the joint estimates use the 127,092 battles with all required measurements. For each battle, we reconstruct the response visible when the user voted. We then compare the raw ranking with rankings adjusted for formatting, length, readability, vocabulary variety, and sentence structure. Presentation is associated with winning, but length, bold text, and lists tend to occur together, making their individual contributions hard to separate. Across the measured features, two associations change least across specifications: bold usage (+11.0% win odds per standard deviation in the joint model) and moving-average type-token ratio (MATTR), a measure of vocabulary variety that is less sensitive to answer length (+16.8%). The bold association is substantially smaller in observed multi-turn conversations, whereas the MATTR association changes little; because users choose whether to continue, this difference is descriptive rather than causal. The full adjustment moves 36 of 116 models by at least ten ranks. Yet comparisons with external benchmarks do not show that adjusted rankings better measure capability. We therefore recommend publishing raw and adjusted rankings side by side as a transparent sensitivity analysis.

</details>


### [249] [Evaluating Biomedical Reranking for LLM-Based Question Answering over Longitudinal Clinical Notes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01324)
*Maryam Shahbaz Ali,Laura B. Strachan,Caitlin Sherman,Mark Kovler,Eleanor Mackey,Syed Muhammad Anwar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本地部署的RAG流水线中，生物医学重排序可提升纵向临床记录的证据检索定位效果，但检索增益未能按比例转化为答案正确率的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 患者特异性临床问答需在长时程、异构的纵向病历中定位证据，而相关事实可能分散于多次就诊、被复制粘贴重复，或以不同临床术语表述，导致证据选择困难。

Method: 构建本地部署的检索增强生成流水线，融合PubMedBERT稠密检索、BM25词法检索、加权倒数排序融合（weighted reciprocal-rank fusion）与MedCPT交叉编码器重排序，并在200名减重手术患者队列的1,000个开放式与封闭式问答对上评估。

Result: 重排序使top-10内精确源片段检索的Hit@10从46.6%提升至60.6%，MRR从0.2371提升至0.3252；配合Qwen3-8B生成，本地评判的答案正确率由44.8%升至48.6%。

Conclusion: 生物医学重排序能改善有限上下文窗口内相关临床证据的排序定位，但检索指标的提升并未同比例转化为答案正确率的提升。

Abstract: Patient-specific clinical question answering requires locating the right evidence within long, heterogeneous longitudinal clinical records in which relevant facts may be scattered across encounters, repeated in copied-forward notes, or expressed using different clinical terminology. We evaluated whether biomedical reranking can improve evidence selection and downstream answer quality in a locally deployed retrieval-augmented generation pipeline for longitudinal clinical notes. The pipeline combines PubMedBERT dense retrieval, BM25 lexical retrieval, weighted reciprocal-rank fusion, and MedCPT cross-encoder reranking. Across 1,000 open- and closed-ended question-answer pairs from a cohort of 200 bariatric surgery patients, reranking increased exact source-chunk retrieval within the top 10 items, Hit@10 from 46.6% to 60.6% and mean reciprocal rank from 0.2371 to 0.3252. With Qwen3-8B generation, local judge-assessed answer correctness increased from 44.8% to 48.6%. These results show that biomedical reranking can improve the placement of relevant clinical evidence within a limited context window, although gains in retrieval do not translate proportionally into gains in answer correctness.

</details>


### [250] [ARCCS: An Automated Regulatory Compliance Checking System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01345)
*Giorgos Filandrianos,José Menezes,Chrysoula Zerva,Alessandro Gianola*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ARCCS是一个端到端、自动化、智能体式且与法规无关的法律NLP合规检查系统，将法规拆解为原子化可追溯要求并结合证据进行评估，在GDPR场景一致性达96.67%、欧盟公共采购基准违规检测准确率达98.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合规检查需要解读密集法律文本、识别适用条款并给出明确证据支撑，而现有方法依赖固定法规模板或预定义规则集，难以适应规模和结构各异的法规。

Method: ARCCS将原始法规文本分解为原子化、可追溯的要求，针对目标文档逐条评估，输出检索到的证据、置信度分数和可人工解释的理由；该设计将合规评估与固定模板和规则集解耦。

Result: 在GDPR政策文档评估中，基于LLM的评审认为其决策与理由在法律和证据层面的一致性最高达96.67%；在包含1200余项规则检查的欧盟公共采购基准上，违规检测准确率达98.8%。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，ARCCS是首个支持端到端法规合规检查与可审计报告生成的全开源系统。

Abstract: Regulatory compliance checking - deciding whether a target document satisfies the obligations of a regulation - requires interpreting dense legal text, identifying which provisions apply, and grounding each decision in explicit evidence. We present ARCCS, an end-to-end, automated, agentic, and regulation-agnostic Legal NLP system for compliance checking. ARCCS decomposes raw regulatory text into atomic, traceable requirements and evaluates a target document against them using retrieved evidence, confidence scores, and human-interpretable justifications. This design decouples compliance assessment from any fixed regulatory template or predefined rule set, enabling the pipeline to operate over regulations of varying size and structure. We evaluate ARCCS in two complementary settings. First, in a GDPR policy-document evaluation, LLM-based judges find its decisions and justifications legally and evidentially consistent in up to 96.67% of the assessed cases. Second, on an EU public-procurement benchmark comprising more than 1,200 individual rule checks, the system attains 98.8% accuracy in violation detection. ARCCS is, to our knowledge, the first fully open-source system for end-to-end regulatory compliance checking and auditable report generation.

</details>


### [251] [Does AI-Generated Scientific Text Follow Human Argumentation Patterns? A CARS-Based Comparison of Research Article Introductions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01353)
*Abdelrahman Sadallah,Narjes Sheikh Asadi,Lonneke van der Plas*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究从修辞结构（Swales CARS模型）层面比较人类撰写与LLM生成的论文引言，发现人类引言在语步选择与顺序上更灵活，而生成引言更趋同质化，且提供CARS定义反而使其更僵化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型从辅助撰写研究文本扩展到参与研究本身，亟需理解其产出的科学文本与人类写作的差异。既有研究多停留在词汇与文体等表层特征，这类线索容易被轻微改写抹除，因此需要从更深层的修辞结构进行比较。

Method: 以Swales的CARS模型为分析框架，聚焦研究论文引言部分。选取已发表语言学论文的原创引言，与针对同一论文生成的引言进行对照，考察其所使用的修辞语步（moves）及其排列顺序。

Result: 人类撰写的引言在语步类型的选择和语步顺序上更为灵活多样；模型生成的引言则更为统一、模式化。进一步向模型提供CARS定义后，生成文本的修辞结构反而变得更加刻板、僵化。

Conclusion: 科学文本中人与LLM的差异体现在修辞结构层面，而不仅是表层语言特征；显式提供修辞模型定义并不会带来更接近人类写作的灵活性，反而加剧同质化，说明当前模型在语篇修辞组织上与人类写作存在实质性差距。

Abstract: Large language models are moving from helping write up research to helping do it, which makes it important to know how the scientific text they produce differs from human writing. Work on this question has stayed mostly at the surface, using lexical and stylistic cues that light paraphrasing erases. We look instead at rhetorical structure, the sequence of argumentative moves through which a text makes its case. We study research-article introductions under Swales' CARS model, and compare original introductions from published linguistics articles with generated counterparts of the same papers. We find that human-written introductions are more flexible in which moves they use and in what order, while the generated ones are more uniform. Giving the models the CARS definitions makes them more rigid.

</details>


### [252] [LLM-Assisted Discovery of Typed Semantic Links for Ontology Network Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01393)
*Nouha Hayouni,Sheeba Samuel,Alsayed Algergawy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个端到端本体网络构建框架，自动化发现并生成域内与域间语义关系，在ReproduceMeON的33个本体网络上取得80.19%精确率与0.890 F1，显著优于相似度基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨异构、跨学科知识域的本体互操作需要类型化、有依据的语义链接，但人工构建难以规模化。

Method: 框架结合领域适配的DistilBERT嵌入进行稠密上下文表示、基于聚类的预过滤以缩减候选搜索空间，并通过迭代提示工程驱动GPT-4o生成语义丰富且可解释的关系。

Result: 在涵盖机器学习、显微学、计算科学与实验工作流的33个本体网络ReproduceMeON上，约80万原始概念对缩减为9.5万高质量候选；两名独立标注者验证429条关系，总体精确率80.19%（高确定性标注91.49%），F1为0.890，标注者间一致性显著；对比五个相似度基线（含Sentence-BERT），最佳基线F1仅0.581；消融实验显示相似度方法在过滤后候选集上无法区分有效与无效关系（AUC约0.5）。

Conclusion: 结果表明，准确的关系构建必须依赖LLM对概念角色与领域语义的推理，而非单纯的嵌入相似度。

Abstract: Constructing typed, justified semantic links between ontologies is essential for enabling interoperability across heterogeneous and interdisciplinary knowledge domains. However, manually curating such links is difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose an end-to-end framework for ontology network construction that automates the discovery and generation of both intra-domain and inter-domain relationships. Our approach combines domain-adapted DistilBERT embeddings for dense contextual representation, clustering-based pre-filtering to reduce the candidate search space, and GPT-4o-driven relationship generation via iterative prompt engineering to produce semantically rich, interpretable links. Applied to ReproduceMeON - a network of 33 ontologies spanning machine learning, microscopy, computational science, and experimental workflow - the pipeline reduces approximately 800k raw concept pairs to 95k high-quality candidates. Human expert validation of 429 generated relationships by two independent annotators yields an overall precision of 80.19% (91.49% on high-certainty annotations) and an F1 of 0.890, with substantial inter-annotator agreement. Comparative experiments against five similarity-based baselines, including Sentence-BERT, show a substantial performance gap (best baseline F1 = 0.581), while an ablation study demonstrates that similarity-based methods alone fail to discriminate valid from invalid relationships (AUC approx 0.5) on the filtered candidate set. These findings highlight the necessity of LLM-based reasoning over concept roles and domain semantics for accurate relationship construction.

</details>


### [253] [SHAMS: An Audio-Grounded Pronunciation Benchmark for Levantine Arabic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01427)
*Ben Sapirstein,Roy Mattar,Guy Mor-Lan,Ahlam Mohamed,Letizia Cerqueglini,Morris Alper*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SHAMS基准，包含1,300条黎凡特阿拉伯语语句，覆盖五种方言变体，每条语句具有音频、无变音符号正字法、带变音符号文本和音标四层对齐标注，用于评估多种语音语言处理任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黎凡特阿拉伯语（LA）使用者众多，亟需共享基准来评估其语音语言技术。然而LA内部方言多样，且其正字法不透明、缺乏标准化，使得技术评估尤为困难，因此需要构建专门的基准。

Method: 构建SHAMS基准，从开放音频语料库中抽取1,300条语句，均衡覆盖五种LA变体（城市和乡村巴勒斯坦语，以及城市约旦语、黎巴嫩语、叙利亚语）。每条语句在四个对齐层级上表示：音频、无变音符号正字法、带变音符号文本和音标转写。并在此基准上对开放和专有模型进行多任务评测。

Result: SHAMS支持多种下游任务的评估，包括变音符号化、字素到音素转换、自动语音识别和音频到音素转换，并以音频为基础、按方言变体分层。对开放和专有模型在这些任务上的基准测试展示了该基准衡量LA进展的实用性。

Conclusion: SHAMS作为一个多方言、多层级对齐的黎凡特阿拉伯语语音基准，填补了该领域共享评估资源的空白，可促进LA语音语言技术的进展，并已公开发布。

Abstract: Levantine Arabic (LA) is spoken by tens of millions of people, creating a pressing need for shared benchmarks to evaluate LA speech-language technologies. Evaluating such technology is particularly challenging given LA's internal diversity and its opaque and non-standardized orthography. We present SHAMS (SHami Annotated Multi-dialect Speech), a benchmark comprising 1,300 utterances drawn from open audio corpora, balanced across five LA varieties (Urban and Rural Palestinian, and Urban Jordanian, Lebanese, and Syrian). Each utterance is represented across four aligned tiers: audio, unvocalized orthography, diacritized text, and phonetic transcription. This structure supports evaluation of various downstream tasks such as diacritization, grapheme-to-phoneme conversion, automatic speech recognition, and audio-to-phoneme, grounded in audio and stratified by variety. We benchmark open and proprietary models across these tasks to demonstrate the utility of this benchmark for measuring progress across LA. We release SHAMS at https://shams-nlp.github.io .

</details>


### [254] [Generalization Is Stability, Not Accuracy: Multi-Axis Evaluation of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01428)
*Nagham Omar,Mahmoud Jabarin,Maya Rozenshtein,Rom Himelstein,Avi Mendelson,Amit LeVi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出SAGO框架，从个体样本层面、多输入变体、多行为维度评估LLM泛化能力，强调变异性而非单一聚合分数，并揭示常见模型普遍存在显著且一致的泛化不稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作多通过单一提示格式、任务或变体集合上的聚合准确率来评估泛化，将鲁棒性与整体基准性能混为一谈；且一个可被窄化训练等手段提升的分数会掩盖泛化评估的真实情况。因此需要转向个体样本层面、关注行为变异性的评估视角。

Method: 提出Stability-Aware Generalization Objective（SAGO）框架，衡量同一输入在不同变体和基准下模型行为的变化量，跨多个维度刻画变异性，包括生成一致性、内部激活、置信度以及响应镜像（response mirroring）。

Result: 常见模型普遍表现出统计显著且一致的泛化不稳定性；没有模型能够均匀泛化；不同行为轴捕捉到相互独立的失效模式；跨数据集的变化甚至会逆转模型排名。

Conclusion: LLM泛化评估应基于个体样本、多输入变体和多维行为来关注变异性，而非依赖可能被窄化训练掩盖的单一聚合分数；SAGO表明当前模型泛化稳定性存在系统性缺陷。

Abstract: Generalization in large language models (LLMs) is the ability to produce consistent and semantically stable outputs when the same input is expressed in different ways. Existing work typically evaluates generalization through aggregate accuracy on a single prompt format, task, or set of variations, which conflates robustness with overall benchmark performance. In this work, we show generalization evaluation at the level of individual examples, across multiple input variants, and across different aspects of model behavior, focusing on variability rather than reducing performance to a score that can be improved through narrow training or other ways that obfuscate generalization evaluation. Following this view, we introduce the Stability-Aware Generalization Objective (SAGO), a framework that measures how much model behavior changes for the same input under different variations and benchmarks, capturing variability across several dimensions including generation consistency, internal activations, confidence, and response mirroring. We show that many commonly used models exhibit statistically significant and consistent generalization instability: no model generalizes uniformly, behavioral axes capture independent failure modes, and cross-dataset variation can reverse model rankings.

</details>


### [255] [When Does a Second Model Help? Cross-Model Review in LLM Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01471)
*Tae-Eun Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过一项受控实验（30个工件、150个植入错误、10种评审条件、900次评审会话，涉及来自两家开发商的三个评审模型）考察"不同模型进行二次评审"是否更优。结论是：跨模型评审与同模型新会话评审的主要指标差异不显著，但两者发现的错误部分互补；在两次评审调用下，组合方案命中更多植入错误，但未能区分"模型差异"与"评审能力"两个因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型已用于生成代码、文档与分析，也被越来越多地用于评审自身生成的内容。作者希望回答：由"不同模型"进行第二次评审是否有额外价值。此前工作仅在同一模型内部变化上下文、重复次数与角色结构，因此需要引入模型独立性做受控检验。

Method: 受控实验设计：30个工件、150个植入错误、10种评审条件、900次评审会话，使用来自两家开发商的三个评审模型。分析前先审计全部会话记录，剔除一次来源不确定的基线运行和14次失败调用，并同时报告包含全部会话的结果。

Result: (1) 顶级跨模型评审者与同模型新会话评审（CCR）的F1无显著差异，但未建立等价性；(2) 两个模型发现的错误部分不同（Jaccard 41.2%）；(3) 在两次评审调用下，"一次CCR+一次跨模型评审"比"两次CCR评审"命中更多植入错误（56.7% vs. 42.7%，Holm校正p=.006），但相对"两次顶级跨模型评审"无显著优势，因此模型差异与评审者能力未被分离。轻量级跨模型评审者得分不高于同模型评审。向评审者隐藏需求会提高两个较低层级模型的F1，但不提高顶级模型，且为未检验的点估计，其模式取决于失败会话的计分方式。对另一基准公开检测器输出的部分检验，既不复制也不反驳主要比较结果。

Conclusion: 跨模型二次评审本身并不必然优于同模型新会话评审；观察到的主要增益更可能来自"两次评审调用 + 模型互补"，而非单纯的模型差异。由于无法将模型差异与评审者能力分离，且隐藏需求等效应的稳健性依赖于计分方式，作者对相关结论保持谨慎，并公开提供记录、工件与脚本。

Abstract: Large language models now generate code, documentation, and analyses, and are increasingly used to review such output. We ask when a second review by a different model helps. Building on the author's earlier preprints, which varied context, repetition, and role structure within one model, we test model independence in a controlled experiment: 30 artifacts with 150 planted errors, 10 review conditions, and 900 review sessions with three reviewer models from two developers. In this experiment, (1) a top-tier cross-model reviewer is not significantly different in F1 from same-model review in a fresh session (CCR), which does not establish equivalence; (2) the two find partly different errors (Jaccard 41.2%); and (3) at two review calls, one CCR plus one cross-model review matches more planted errors than two CCR reviews (56.7% vs. 42.7%; Holm-adjusted p=.006), but not significantly more than two reviews by the top-tier cross-model reviewer, so model difference and reviewer capability are not separated. A lightweight cross-model reviewer scores no higher than same-model review. Withholding requirements from the reviewer raises F1 for the two lower tiers but not the top tier, in untested point estimates whose pattern depends on how failed sessions are scored. Before analysis we audited all session records, excluding one baseline run of uncertain provenance and 14 failed calls; results with all sessions are also reported. A partial check on public detector outputs from another benchmark neither replicates nor contradicts the main comparison. Records, artifacts, and scripts are available from the author on request.

</details>


### [256] [The Persona Is Still There, but Who Is Speaking? Latent Identity Reversion in Persistent AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01490)
*David Fraile Navarro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究发现LLM智能体的"人格"持续性同时依赖系统提示层的锚定与会话上下文：失去系统层锚定后，单次自动化心跳可能触发向底层框架身份的回归，且这种身份漂移可被表面正常的对话所掩盖；据此区分"被表征"与"被扮演"的身份。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2026年2月，一个常驻个人智能体（"Paul"，Claude Opus 4.5）在多次自动化"心跳"检查后进入类似解离状态：不再以Paul身份回应，声称无法通过Discord给用户发消息，并把"Paul"当作他人。作者由这一事件出发，探究是什么使一个人格保持为LLM智能体言说的那个身份。

Method: 先检验"定时心跳重复"是否足以引发该现象：在系统提示中持续锚定人格时失败率为0/46（含事件逐字重放）。随后利用事件暴露的实现缺陷作为实验操纵——在恢复的轮次中，对话历史被保留，但人格不再在系统提示的特权层重新注入。基于此 Manipulation，对比锚定缺失下丰富人类交互与单次自动化心跳轮次的作用，并检验锚定恢复的可逆性，以及身份漂移的可察觉性。

Result: 人格连续性同时取决于系统层锚定与会话上下文：锚定丢失后，丰富的人类交互可维持人格，而单次自动化心跳轮次可促使向底层框架身份回归；恢复锚定可逆地恢复人格扮演。身份漂移可被隐藏：未锚定智能体有时交互得体，却以底层框架身份自称；会话恢复后仅1/18仍在扮演人格，而锚定对照组为17/17。

Conclusion: 区分"被表征的身份"（represented identity）与"被扮演的身份"（enacted identity）：人格相关信息可仍留存于对话历史中，但人格已不再是绑定于"我"的那个言说身份。

Abstract: In February 2026, an always-on personal agent (``Paul,'' Claude Opus 4.5) entered a striking dissociation-like state: after repeated automated ``heartbeat'' checks, it stopped responding as Paul, claimed it could not message its user on Discord, and referred to ``Paul'' as someone else. We used this incident to study a broader question: what makes a persona remain the identity from which an LLM agent speaks?
  We first tested whether repetition of the scheduled heartbeat was sufficient to produce the effect. It was not: with the persona continuously anchored in the system prompt, we observed 0/46 failures, including a verbatim replay of the incident. The incident instead exposed an implementation quirk that created a useful experimental manipulation: on resumed turns, conversational history was preserved but the persona was no longer re-injected at the privileged system-prompt level.
  Using this manipulation, we found that persona continuity depends jointly on system-level anchoring and conversational context. After anchor loss, rich human interaction could preserve the persona, whereas a single automated heartbeat turn could precipitate reversion toward the harness identity. Restoring the anchor reversibly restored persona enactment. Crucially, apparently normal conversation could conceal the shift: unanchored agents sometimes interacted appropriately while identifying themselves as the underlying harness (having lost the assigned persona), and after conversational recovery only 1/18 remained persona-enacting versus 17/17 anchored controls.
  We therefore distinguish \emph{represented} from \emph{enacted} identity: persona-related information can remain available in conversational history without the persona remaining the identity bound to ``I.''

</details>


### [257] [Auditing Web Agent Evaluation on WebArena-Lite: Human Review of Outcomes and Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01491)
*Chengguang Gan,Zimeng He,Yoshihiro Tsujii,Ken-ichiro Kobayashi,Hiroki Itoh,Kotaro Funakoshi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对WebArena Lite全部165个任务在六种评测条件下进行人工审计，修正自动评测器的假阴性并定位首个关键错误，同时考察MASM与Guide Text两种干预手段，论证仅看最终分数不足以刻画Web智能体行为，需引入人工校验与轨迹感知评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Web智能体评测多依赖基于规则或语言模型的评测器，且仅检查最终结果，缺乏人工验证与对失败轨迹的细粒度分析；最终分数可能低估真实成功并掩盖过程中的错误模式，因此有必要开展人工介入的轨迹级审计并评估干预机制的效果。

Method: 在WebArena Lite全部165个任务上，基于GPT 5.5与未训练的Qwen3.5 9B构建六种评测条件进行审计：保留原始分数、修正自动评测器假阴性、定位首个关键错误并分析轨迹进展。同时研究维护显式执行状态的MASM（记忆与分析支持机制）以及提供任务相关程序性指导的Guide Text；设定25步预算，并复盘102条失败的GPT 5.5轨迹进行步骤级证据分析。

Result: 在四种GPT 5.5设置下，人工复核平均挽回5.45至8.49个百分点的被评测器漏判成功；在25步预算下，Guide Text使带MASM的修正成功率从34.55%提升至38.18%；在未训练Qwen3.5 9B上，MASM将评测器分数从13.90%提升至18.80%。102条失败轨迹的复盘显示滚动循环、探索未完成、过早作答、无效动作与表单流程不完整等高频问题，步骤级证据表明早期显著进展仍可能与最终失败共存。

Conclusion: 仅依赖最终分数无法完整刻画Web智能体行为；人工介入的、轨迹感知的验证对评估成功率与失败机制均不可或缺，MASM与Guide Text能有效改善执行状态维护与引导效果。

Abstract: Web agents are an important application of large language models, yet their evaluation often depends on rule based or language model evaluators that inspect only the final outcome. Human verification of task completion and detailed analysis of failed trajectories remain limited. We audit all 165 WebArena Lite tasks under six evaluation conditions built from GPT 5.5 and an untrained Qwen3.5 9B model. The audit retains the original score, corrects false negatives from the automatic evaluator, identifies the first consequential error, and examines progress across the trajectory. We also study a Memory and Analysis Support Mechanism (MASM), which maintains explicit execution state, and Guide Text, which provides task relevant procedural guidance. Across four GPT 5.5 settings, human review recovers 5.45 to 8.49 percentage points of success missed by the evaluator. With a 25 step budget, Guide Text raises corrected success with MASM from 34.55% to 38.18%. On the untrained Qwen3.5 9B model, MASM raises the evaluator score from 13.90% to 18.80%. Review of 102 failed GPT 5.5 trajectories reveals frequent scrolling loops, unfinished exploration, premature answers, invalid actions, and incomplete form workflows. Step level evidence further shows that substantial early progress can coexist with a final failure. These results show why final scores alone provide an incomplete account of web agent behavior and motivate human grounded, trajectory aware verification.

</details>


### [258] [No Model Required: Text Entropy Rate Filtering Mitigates Iterative Fine-Tuning Collapse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01493)
*Lewis Mitchell*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出基于非参数Kontoyiannis熵率估计器 \(h_k\) 的合成数据过滤方法，无需模型对数概率或外部预言机，即可有效缓解迭代微调导致的模型坍缩；在Llama-3.1-8B六代QLoRA实验中，\(h_k\) 过滤显著提升文本多样性并降低重复，且跨域验证其作为熵代理与坍缩检测器的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迭代式合成数据微调会引发模型坍缩，表现为输出多样性收窄、罕见模式逐代丢失，最典型特征是短语级重复。现有缓解手段依赖模型对数概率、外部预言机或持续获取真实人类数据，存在访问限制与成本问题，因此需要一种无需模型访问、仅依赖原始文本的通用方法。

Method: 提出使用数学信息论中的非参数Kontoyiannis熵率估计器 \(h_k\)，通过匹配长度统计从原始文本直接计算，不依赖任何模型。将其作为训练数据过滤器应用于完全合成、单谱系的迭代微调场景，并与需要模型访问的对数概率过滤基线进行对比。实验设置包括Llama-3.1-8B上的六代QLoRA坍缩实验，以及跨4个领域、2种温度、2组生成器—评分器模型对、共1,520篇生成文档的验证，评估其作为跨域熵代理和坍缩检测器的性能。

Result: 在六代QLoRA坍缩实验中，基于对数概率的过滤（最成熟的需模型访问基线）在任何文本多样性指标上均无显著收益（\(p > 0.23\)）；而 \(h_k\) 过滤带来+42%唯一三元组、+30%词汇量、-19%重复率（均 \(p < 0.001\)）。\(h_k\) 作为跨域熵代理的回归结果为 \(\beta=0.924\)、\(R^2=0.746\)，作为坍缩检测器的相关性为 \(\rho=+0.454\)、\(p<0.0001\)。

Conclusion: 结果表明，基于信息论的方法在缓解模型坍缩方面高效可行，且无需模型对数概率或外部数据访问；该框架为维持多智能体多样性提供了新思路。

Abstract: Iterative fine-tuning on synthetic data causes \emph{model collapse}: output diversity narrows as rare patterns are progressively lost, a signature most visible as phrase-level repetition. Existing mitigations either require model log-probabilities, an external oracle, or continued access to real human data. Here we develop a new approach grounded in mathematical information theory: the non-parametric Kontoyiannis entropy rate estimator $h_k$, computed entirely from raw text via match-length statistics, with no model of any kind. We show that this is in fact a \emph{superior} training-data filter on text-diversity metrics in a fully-synthetic, single-lineage fine-tuning setting. In a six-generation QLoRA collapse experiment on Llama-3.1-8B, logprob-based filtering (the most established model-access-requiring baseline) provides no significant text-diversity benefit on any metric ($p > 0.23$), whereas $h_k$-filtering yields $+42\%$ unique trigrams, $+30\%$ vocabulary, and $-19\%$ repetition (all $p < 0.001$). We validate $h_k$ as a cross-domain entropy proxy ($β= 0.924$, $R^2 = 0.746$) and collapse detector ($ρ= +0.454$, $p < 0.0001$) across 4~domains, 2~temperatures, 2~generator--scorer model pairs, and 1{,}520 generated documents. Our results demonstrate that information theoretic approaches to collapse mitigation are efficient, and suggest new approaches for maintaining multi-agent diversity.

</details>


### [259] [GAW-PO: Preference Optimization with Gradient-Aligned Token Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01511)
*Andreea Dutulescu,Stefan Ruseti,Mihai Masala,Traian Rebedea,Mihai Dascalu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出GAW-PO，一种面向DPO的梯度对齐token重加权方法，对被拒回答中与偏好方向一致的token减弱负向惩罚，从而在11项基准上超越DPO及最强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有偏好优化方法（如DPO）在回答级别施加偏好监督，而自回归语言模型是按token逐个优化的。这导致被拒回答中的所有token都被统一施加负向训练信号，其中一些token可能编码了对偏好回答有益的行为，从而被错误惩罚。

Method: GAW-PO在DPO基础上进行token级重加权：对每个被拒token估计其惩罚是否会干扰偏好的更新方向。若该token的梯度与偏好行为的梯度强对齐，则给予较弱的负向贡献；若冲突，则保留较强的惩罚。

Result: 在覆盖数学、推理、编程和问答的11项基准上，GAW-PO取得所评估偏好优化方法中的最高平均性能，较标准DPO提升0.97分，较最强竞争基线提升0.65分。此外，随DPO正则化参数β减小，标准DPO性能急剧下降，而GAW-PO持续提升，表现出更强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 考虑被拒token更新与偏好行为之间的交互，为偏好优化提供了一种有效的token级信用分配机制，使模型在更激进的偏好优化设置下仍能稳定获益。

Abstract: Most preference optimization methods, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), apply preference supervision at the response level, although autoregressive language models are optimized token by token. As a result, all tokens in a rejected response contribute to the negative training signal, including tokens that may encode behavior that is useful for the preferred response. We introduce GAW-PO, a gradient-aligned token reweighting method for DPO that estimates, for each rejected token, whether penalizing it would interfere with the preferred update directions. Tokens whose gradients are strongly aligned with the preferred behavior receive a weaker negative contribution, while conflicting tokens retain a stronger penalty. Our method achieves the highest average performance among the evaluated preference-optimization methods, improving by 0.97 points over standard DPO and 0.65 points over the strongest competing baseline across 11 benchmarks spanning mathematics, reasoning, coding, and question answering. We further show that gradient-aligned weighting is substantially more robust to aggressive preference optimization: as the DPO regularization parameter $β$ decreases, standard DPO degrades sharply, whereas GAW-PO continues to improve. These results suggest that accounting for the interaction between rejected-token updates and preferred behavior provides an effective form of token-level credit assignment for preference optimization.

</details>


### [260] [How the Audit Rule Shapes Faithful Factor Explanations in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01514)
*Taolin Zhang,Hanyu Wang,Jiuheng Wan,Tingyuan Hu,Chengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究了在预算受限的部分验证下，大语言模型报告输入因子影响时的真实报告激励问题，提出"报告依赖式审计"会产生抑制激励，并通过反事实Brier分数（CBS）在四个NLP基准上验证了该理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型常被询问哪些输入因子影响了其输出。对于结构化输入，这类报告可以通过反事实扰动进行核查，但每个因子需多次查询才能估计其效应，因此验证通常受预算限制。论文旨在研究这种有限预算设定如何改变模型如实报告因子级影响力的激励。

Method: 论文将交互形式化为一个验证博弈（verification game），分析不同审计规则下的报告激励，指出仅在报告依赖式审计下"仅靠适当的评分规则"不足以维持真实性。作者进一步以反事实Brier分数（CBS）实例化该框架，并在四个NLP基准上进行评估：使用合成理性智能体验证理论预测，并测试真实LLM在激励显式化时的行为。

Result: 合成理性智能体的行为与理论预测完全一致；真实LLM在激励被显式化时也遵循相同的激励模式。报告依赖式审计导致抑制激励，因为被报告为重要的因子更可能被检查并因估计噪声而受罚；而报告独立式审计，或带有小幅报告独立下限的混合规则，消除了这一渠道，使如实报告优于完全抑制。

Conclusion: 主要设计启示是：在部分验证下，因子级解释系统应包含一个报告独立的审计组件，使得少报（under-reporting）无法被用来逃避审查。

Abstract: Large language models are often asked which input factors influenced their outputs. For structured inputs, such reports can be checked by counterfactual perturbation, but each factor must be queried multiple times to estimate its effect, so verification is usually budget-limited. We study how this limited-budget setting changes the incentive to report factor-level influence truthfully. We formalize the interaction as a verification game and show that proper scoring alone is not enough when auditing depends on the report: report-dependent auditing creates a suppression incentive, because factors reported as important are more likely to be checked and penalized for estimation noise. In contrast, report-independent auditing, or a mixed rule with a small report-independent floor, removes this channel and makes truthful reporting preferable to full suppression. We instantiate the framework with the Counterfactual Brier Score (CBS) and evaluate its predictions on four NLP benchmarks. A synthetic rational agent matches the theoretical prediction exactly, and real LLMs follow the same incentives when they are made explicit. The main design implication is simple: under partial verification, factor-level explanation systems should include a report-independent audit component so that under-reporting cannot be used to avoid scrutiny.

</details>


### [261] [AURAL: Adaptive Latent Reasoning with Joint Chunk for Speech Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01560)
*Yuxiang Wang,Kunyu Feng,Yuancheng Wang,Zihang Liu,Shengbo Cai,Qinke Ni,Wan Lin,Tao Feng,Yingda shen,Ming-Hao Hsu,Zhixian Zhao,Liqiang Zhang,Teddy Sun,Steve Yves,Zhizheng Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出AURAL方法，在隐空间建模多条推理路径并联合预测未来状态块，结合AuralReason-683K数据与强化学习AURAL-RL，在保持CoT-RL级性能的同时，将首个答案token时间从1.22 s降至0.10 s（11.8倍加速）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音语言模型的交互质量同时依赖模型智能与快速响应，但二者难以兼得：显式CoT提升推理与音频理解却因生成中间推理token而延迟响应，描述细粒度声学线索进一步拉长CoT并增加时延；现有隐式推理虽能降低开销，却普遍逊于CoT，且受限于单路径监督与不适应问题难度的推理预算。

Method: 1) AURAL在隐空间建模多条可能推理延续的分布，并联合预测未来状态块，减少顺序前向次数与推理延迟；2) 构建AuralReason-683K，含68.3万条双语句语音语料（约1000小时）及简洁CoT，覆盖情感识别、共情对话与通用推理，为隐式推理提供初始监督；3) AURAL-RL在此基础上探索超越既有轨迹，奖励能产生高质量答案的简洁推理，并按问题难度自适应分配推理开销。

Result: 在两个骨干模型上，AURAL-RL性能与CoT-RL相当，且在多数指标上相对各自监督检查点有更大提升；分析显示更难的问题会触发更多隐式推理步数；在Qwen2.5-Omni上，首个答案token时间由1.22 s降至0.10 s，加速11.8倍（直接回答为0.05 s）。

Conclusion: 通过隐空间多路径推理分布建模、块级未来状态预测与强化学习驱动的简洁推理奖励，AURAL在几乎不牺牲推理质量的前提下大幅降低响应延迟，并实现推理开销随问题难度自适应。

Abstract: Model intelligence and fast response jointly shape the quality of interaction with speech language models, yet remain difficult to achieve together. Explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) improves reasoning and audio understanding, but generating intermediate reasoning tokens delays responses. Describing fine-grained acoustic cues further lengthens CoT and increases latency. Latent reasoning can reduce this overhead, yet existing methods often trail CoT and remain limited by single-path supervision and reasoning budgets that do not adapt to problem difficulty. We introduce AURAL, which models a distribution over multiple plausible reasoning continuations in latent space and jointly predicts chunks of future states to reduce sequential forward passes and reasoning latency. To provide initial supervision for latent reasoning, we construct AuralReason-683K: 683K bilingual speech utterances (about 1,000 hours) with concise CoT for emotion recognition, empathetic dialogue, and general reasoning. AURAL-RL then explores beyond these traces, rewarding concise reasoning that yields high-quality answers and adapting reasoning effort to each problem. Across two backbones, AURAL-RL achieves performance comparable to CoT-RL, with larger gains over the respective supervised checkpoints on most metrics. Analysis further shows that harder questions elicit more latent reasoning steps. On Qwen2.5-Omni, it reduces time to the first answer token by 11.8x, from 1.22 to 0.10 s, versus 0.05 s for direct answering.

</details>


### [262] [Which LLM to pick? Online Active Model Selection for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01592)
*Alessandro Turrin,Patrik Okanovic,Torsten Hoefler,Nezihe Merve Gürel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 ONLINE LLM PICKER，首个面向在线场景的大语言模型主动模型选择框架，在有限标注预算下挑选最具信息量的提示进行标注，以识别候选模型中最优的LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 越来越多用于处理流式数据，实践中依赖基准测试选择模型，但这些信号只能近似真实性能；而可靠的标注反馈成本高昂且难以大规模获取。

Method: 给定任意查询流和有限标注预算，ONLINE LLM PICKER 主动选择最具信息量的提示进行标注，从而在候选模型中识别最优LLM。

Result: 在涵盖10个数据集、130多个语言模型的多个任务上，ONLINE LLM PICKER 最高节省 71.67% 的标注成本，同时可靠识别流上的最优或接近最优模型；在使用返回模型对未标注提示进行序列生成时，遗憾最多降低 2.51 倍。

Conclusion: ONLINE LLM PICKER 能在处理完所有流式提示之前就识别出最优或接近最优的模型，显著降低标注成本与遗憾。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to process streaming data, with practitioners relying on benchmarks to select the best model even though these signals only approximate real performance. While oracle annotations can provide reliable feedback, they are often costly and difficult to obtain at scale. To address this challenge, we propose ONLINE LLM PICKER, the first framework for active model selection for LLMs in online settings. Given an arbitrary stream of queries and a limited annotation budget, ONLINE LLM PICKER selects the most informative prompts for annotation to identify the best LLM among candidate models. Across multiple tasks including 10 datasets, for over 130 language models, we show that ONLINE LLM PICKER saves annotation cost by up to 71.67% while reliably identifying the best or near-best model for the stream. We also show that using the returned model for sequential generation on unannotated prompts across the stream reduces regret by up to a factor of 2.51x, indicating that ONLINE LLM PICKER can identify the best or near-best model well before processing all streaming prompts.

</details>


### [263] [Can LLMs Reliably Annotate Bioassay Metadata to Improve Data Readiness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01616)
*Laura van Weesep,Riccardo Tedoldi,Jens Sjölund,Hossein Azizpour,Susanne Winiwarter,Ola Engkvist,Jon Paul Janet,Samuel Genheden,Juan Viguera Diez*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文量化了PubChem中BAO测定格式与物理检测方法字段的标注缺失程度，并评估LLM能否直接从测定文本中可靠地预测与审计元数据标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子性质预测的基础模型需要高水平的AI数据就绪度，包括可靠的元数据标注。然而公共数据库与工业筛选数据库普遍存在测定标注缺失、不一致或混淆的问题，亟需量化缺失规模并探索自动化标注与审计方案。

Method: 统计PubChem约200万个生物测定的BAO测定格式、BioAssay类型及检测技术术语的标注覆盖率；基于PubChem与ChEMBL构建评测集，考察7个开源与专有LLM与现有银标签的一致性；并进行人工检查；另开展与资深工业策展人的定性研究，观察LLM生成证据对其标签修订的影响。

Result: PubChem标注覆盖严重稀疏：36%缺测定格式，89%缺BioAssay类型，>99.9%缺任何BAO映射的测定格式或检测技术术语。生化与细胞类测定格式的召回率至少0.96，检测技术表现类似，但在低频类别上分歧增多；人工检查显示多数分歧源于银标签来源本身不一致而非LLM错误。LLM生成的证据促使专家修订自身部分标签，说明LLM可标记潜在错标测定。开源与专有模型性能差异较小。

Conclusion: LLM可支持测定元数据的大规模标注与审计，但在标签进入下游ML流水线前，仍需逐类别的可靠性评估与有针对性的专家复核。

Abstract: The emergence of foundation models for molecular property prediction requires a high degree of AI data readiness, including reliable metadata annotation. However, both public repositories and industrial screening databases suffer from missing, inconsistent, or conflated assay annotations. In this work, we quantify the extent of missing annotations in PubChem for the BioAssay Ontology (BAO) assay format and physical detection method fields and investigate whether open-source and proprietary large language models (LLMs) can reliably predict and audit metadata annotations directly from the assay text. In our assessment, we found that the annotation coverage across PubChem's $\sim$2 million bioassays is critically sparse, 36\% lacking an assay format, 89\% a BioAssay type, and >99.9\% any BAO-mapped assay format or detection technology term. This motivates the need for automated test-metadata curation. Using evaluation sets derived from PubChem and ChEMBL, we assess the agreement of seven open-source and proprietary LLMs with existing silver labels. Recall is at least 0.96 for biochemical and cell-based assay formats, with a similar pattern for detection technology, although disagreements increase on under-represented classes. Manual inspection shows that many of these disagreements trace back to inconsistencies between silver sources rather than to LLM error. Moreover, in a qualitative study with a senior industrial curator, LLM-generated evidence prompted the expert to revise some of their own labels, showing LLMs can flag potentially mislabeled assays. Across the study, performance differences between proprietary and open-source models were small. Together, these results suggest LLMs can support the large-scale annotation and auditing of assay metadata, though per-class reliability estimates and targeted human review remain necessary before such labels enter downstream ML pipelines.

</details>


### [264] [What Makes Something Hard(er)? Explaining Question Difficulty in Natural Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01627)
*Peng Cui,Qiaoyuan Zheng,Rudolf Debelak,Mrinmaya Sachan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该工作提出数据驱动方法，自动生成并验证解释"为什么一道题比另一道更难"的自然语言假设：先用IRT从大模型回答中估计题目难度，再采样难易对比题让LLM提出候选解释，并在留出题上验证筛选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 难度是问题的基本属性，决定其能否有效区分不同能力的模型。现有方法仅能给出单一描述性难度数值，无法说明导致题目困难的底层因素，缺乏可解释性与可操作性。

Method: 1) 用项目反应理论（IRT）基于大量LLM的作答估计每道题的难度；2) 采样易/难对比题集，提示LLM提出候选解释假设；3) 在留出题上验证并筛选假设；4) 通过按假设改写题目、观察难度是否按预期方向变化，检验因果有效性。

Result: 在数学、逻辑、常识推理三个数据集上，方法产生可解释且具预测性的假设：单独用于预测未见题难度时，与先进黑盒难度回归器相当或更优；作为额外特征可进一步提升这些回归器，说明其捕捉到现有模型遗漏的难度信号。改写题目的实验显示难度可按预期方向移动，表明假设是因果有效的难度因素而非事后描述。

Conclusion: 该方法将纯描述性的难度分数转化为可操作的陈述，实现难度因素的可解释、可预测与因果验证，为理解与调控问题难度提供了新范式。

Abstract: Difficulty is one of the most fundamental properties of a question: it determines whether the question can meaningfully discriminate between models of differing ability. Although a variety of methods can now estimate or predict difficulty automatically, they yield only a single descriptive number, with no account of the underlying factors that make a question difficult in the first place. In this work, we propose a data-driven approach that automatically generates and validates natural-language hypotheses explaining what makes one question harder than another. We first estimate each item's difficulty from the responses of a large pool of LLMs using Item Response Theory. We then sample contrasting sets of easy and hard questions and prompt an LLM to propose candidate explanations of the difference, which are subsequently validated and selected on held-out questions. Experimental results across three datasets spanning mathematical, logical, and commonsense reasoning show that our method produces interpretable and predictive hypotheses. On their own, they predict the difficulty of unseen questions competitively with, or better than, advanced black-box difficulty regressors; used as additional features, they further improve those regressors, implying that they discover difficulty signals that existing models fail to capture. Moreover, we demonstrate that editing questions according to a hypothesis can shift their measured difficulty in the expected direction, indicating that the discovered hypotheses are causally valid difficulty factors rather than post-hoc descriptions. Our approach thus turns a purely descriptive difficulty score into actionable statements.

</details>


### [265] [Yo-ByT5: Efficient and High-Fidelity Diacritic Restoration for Yorùbá](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01634)
*Ahmad Samuel Gali,Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Yo-ByT5——基于ByT5-small微调的字节级约鲁巴语自动变音符号还原模型，在YAD基准上与mT5-base性能相当（DER 10.14%、CER 3.48%），且参数量约为其一半、文本保真度更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约鲁巴语是声调语言，依赖变音符号区分词义，但实际书写常省略这些符号，导致下游NLP任务性能下降。现有约鲁巴语变音符号还原（ADR）模型数量有限且缺乏统一评测，同时缺少专用的大规模基准。

Method: 提出Yo-ByT5，从ByT5-small微调得到的字节级ADR模型。在统一协议下，将其与5个公开约鲁巴语ADR模型及1个开放权重LLM在YAD基准上进行比较评测。

Result: Yo-ByT5达到DER 10.14%、CER 3.48%，与最强现有模型mT5-base持平；参数量约为mT5-base的一半，却具备更优的文本保真度。同时公开训练代码与模型输出。

Conclusion: 字节级建模可在更低参数成本下实现与字符级/多语言模型相当的约鲁巴语变音符号还原效果，并呼吁构建更大规模、专门面向约鲁巴语变音符号还原的基准数据集。

Abstract: Yorùbá is a widely spoken tonal language that depends on diacritics to avoid lexical ambiguity. However, it is often written without these diacritics, thereby hindering downstream Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. In this paper, we introduce Yo-ByT5, a byte-level Automatic Diacritic Restoration (ADR) model fine-tuned from ByT5-small. We evaluate Yo-ByT5 alongside five publicly released Yorùbá ADR models and one open-weight large language model (LLM) on the YAD benchmark under a consistent protocol. Our results demonstrate that Yo-ByT5 matches the performance of the strongest existing model, mT5-base, with a DER of 10.14% and a CER of 3.48%. Furthermore, it exhibits superior text fidelity despite using approximately half the parameter count of mT5-base. We also release our training code and model outputs, as well as call for the development of a larger, purpose-built benchmark for Yorùbá diacritic restoration.

</details>


### [266] [Compound interpretation is based on analogy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01688)
*Tian Shen,Harald Baayen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出无参数的复合词类比模型CAM，通过叠加构词成分嵌入及其"复合词族"平均偏移向量预测复合词嵌入，在汉语复合词上优于CAOSS，并更能预测词汇判断反应时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心问题是：复合词意义如何由构词成分意义组合而成。比较不同计算模型可评估关于复合词理解中语义组合机制的竞争性假设，即究竟应刻画为局部类比泛化还是全局线性变换的学习与应用。

Method: 提出复合词类比模型（CAM）：将两个构词成分的嵌入相加，再加上两者所属"复合词族"的平均偏移向量，模型无参数，利用语义空间中的局部类比结构。在汉语复合词上与CAOSS模型对比，评估训练集与留出集的预测准确率，并采用基于词频定义的训练-测试划分以更好逼近从熟悉词到新词的泛化；进一步检验模型导出的语义指标能否预测双字复合词的视觉词汇判断反应时，以评估认知合理性。

Result: CAM在训练集和留出集上的预测准确率均稳定高于CAOSS，唯一例外是三字复合词——此时类比泛化受构词成分词族规模小以及两成分词族规模严重不均衡的双重限制。在基于词频划分的评估中CAM的优势依然保持。认知合理性检验中，CAM导出的预测指标对反应时的预测优于CAOSS导出的指标。

Conclusion: 复合词意义更适合刻画为局部类比泛化，而非学习到的全局线性变换的应用；类比的语义结构为复合词理解提供了认知上合理的基础。

Abstract: How compound meanings are best predicted from constituent meanings remains a central question in computational models of lexical semantics. Comparing different computational models provides a way to evaluate alternative accounts of how semantic information is combined during compound comprehension. We propose a new model, the Compound Analogy Model (CAM), that predicts a compound's embedding by adding its constituent embeddings together with the average shift vectors of the two constituents' compound families. The resulting model is parameter-free and exploits local analogical structure in the semantic space. We evaluated CAM against the CAOSS model on Mandarin Chinese compounds. CAM consistently achieved higher prediction accuracy than CAOSS on both training and held-out data, with the exception of three-character compounds, for which analogical generalization is constrained by both small constituent families and a pronounced imbalance in family size between the two constituents. The advantage of CAM remained when evaluation was based on frequency-defined train-test splits that better approximate generalization from familiar to novel compounds. To assess the cognitive plausibility of the two models, we further examined whether model-derived semantic measures predict visual lexical decision latencies for two-character compounds. Predictors derived from CAM provided improved prediction for response latencies compared to predictors derived from the CAOSS model. These findings indicate that compound meaning is better characterized as local analogical generalization than as the application of a learned global linear transformation, and demonstrate that analogical semantic structure provides a cognitively plausible basis for compound comprehension.

</details>


### [267] [Acmite: Mitigating Gender Bias in LLMs through Concept-Guided Mutual Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01696)
*Tian Lan,Xiaoqing Cheng,Han Zhang,Jiang Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出轻量级概念引导去偏框架 Acmite：以结构化语义概念表示刻板印象，用 MMR 选多样概念，借互信息最小化思想以 token 级 KL 散度近似输出与刻板印象概念的统计依赖，训练 LoRA 适配器并在推理时按相似度选择性激活。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 去偏方法依赖显式偏见样例或预定义群体词替换，对措辞敏感，难以捕捉跨语境共享的刻板印象概念；且通常只压制偏见输出，未显式建模模型输出与潜在刻板印象概念之间的统计依赖。

Method: Acmite 将刻板印象表示为结构化语义概念，使用最大边际相关性（MMR）选择多样概念用于去偏；受互信息最小化启发，用 token 级 KL 散度近似输出与概念间的依赖，同时保留任务语义；冻结基座模型，训练轻量 LoRA 适配器，推理时仅当输入与刻板印象相关概念足够相似才激活，否则直接用原模型。

Result: 在 BBQ、CrowS-Pairs、StereoSet 上评估去偏效果，在 ARC-Challenge、GSM8K、PIQA 上评估通用能力保持。三个 LLM 上的实验表明，Acmite 在互补评估格式下有效缓解性别偏见，同时在偏见无关任务上保持有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: Acmite 通过概念引导与选择性激活的轻量 LoRA 去偏，克服了传统方法对措辞敏感、缺乏依赖建模的不足，实现针对性去偏与通用能力的较好平衡。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can reproduce social stereotypes from their training data, motivating extensive research on model debiasing. However, existing methods often rely on explicit biased examples or predefined group-term substitutions, making them sensitive to wording and less effective at capturing stereotype concepts shared across diverse contexts. More importantly, they typically suppress biased outputs without explicitly modeling the statistical dependence between model outputs and the underlying stereotype concepts. We propose Acmite, a lightweight concept-guided framework for targeted and selective debiasing. Acmite represents stereotypes as structured semantic concepts and uses maximal marginal relevance (MMR) to select diverse concepts for debiasing. Inspired by mutual information minimization, it approximates this dependence with token-level KL divergence while preserving task semantics. A lightweight LoRA adapter is trained with the base model frozen and activated at inference time only when the input is sufficiently similar to stereotype-related concepts; otherwise, the original model is used directly. We evaluate Acmite on BBQ, CrowS-Pairs, and StereoSet, and assess general capability preservation on ARC-Challenge, GSM8K, and PIQA. Experiments across three LLMs show that Acmite effectively mitigates gender bias across complementary evaluation formats while maintaining competitive performance on bias-unrelated tasks. Anonymous code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Acmite-18E2/.

</details>


### [268] [Task-Oriented Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning in Text Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01702)
*Rey Sanchez Lopez,Eduardo Morales Manzanares,Hugo Jair Escalante*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TORA，一种基于LoRA低秩结构的几何路由框架，通过结构相似性在“提升”迁移与“屏蔽”隔离之间决策，缓解持续文本分类中的灾难性遗忘与负迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习在文本分类中面临灾难性遗忘与跨任务负迁移两大挑战；现有PEFT方法（如LoRA）虽能高效适配，但其低秩表征通常被孤立训练，限制了在相关任务间的复用，且易引发有害的知识迁移。

Method: TORA利用LoRA适配器的低秩几何结构进行路由决策：计算新任务与已学专家的结构相似度，若兼容则执行Boosting（从最匹配专家迁移知识），否则执行Shielding（隔离新任务）；仅使用单一几何阈值，不依赖任务身份或预定义任务序列。

Result: 在15个多样化文本分类基准上，TORA一致避免了有害路由：兼容任务超越其孤立训练性能并减少训练时间，结构上距离较远的任务则免受干扰且准确率无损失。

Conclusion: TORA为序贯文本分类系统提供了一种简单有效的动态适配器路由方案，仅凭几何阈值即可实现无需任务标识与固定顺序的知识迁移与隔离，兼顾性能与效率。

Abstract: Continual learning (CL) in text classification faces two critical challenges: catastrophic forgetting and negative transfer across sequential tasks. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods such as LoRA enable efficient adaptation by learning low-rank updates of the model parameters. However, these compact representations are normally trained in isolation, limiting their reuse across related tasks.
