We introduce Task-Oriented Rank Adaptation (TORA), a geometric routing framework that leverages the low-rank structure of LoRA adapters to decide whether to transfer knowledge from the most compatible expert (Boosting) or isolate the new task (Shielding) based on structural similarity. Evaluated across 15 diverse text classification benchmarks, TORA consistently avoids harmful routing decisions: compatible tasks exceed their isolated performance while reducing training time, and structurally distant tasks are protected from interference with no loss in accuracy. With a single geometric threshold and no reliance on task identities or predefined sequences, TORA provides a simple and effective approach for dynamic adapter routing in sequential text classification systems.

</details>


### [269] [A Matryoshka Hierarchical RAG for Efficient Multi-Hop Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01767)
*Gianluca Bonifazi,Christopher Buratti,Michele Marchetti,Federica Parlapiano,Giulia Quaglieri,Davide Traini,Domenico Ursino,Luca Virgili*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MatRAG 将 RAG 与 Matryoshka 表示学习结合，通过层次化 DAG 聚类结构对齐 MRL 嵌套维度，在降低索引与查询成本的同时提升多跳 QA 的检索质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多跳问答的 RAG 系统需在检索质量与计算成本间权衡。现有成本来自两方面：索引阶段使用昂贵的知识图谱（KG）或大语言模型（LLM）生成摘要；查询阶段通过迭代式 LLM 驱动的检索。目标是降低这两类成本并保持检索质量。

Method: 提出 MatRAG 层次化框架：将 RAG 与 Matryoshka 表示学习（MRL）结合，把聚类结构的语义层次与 MRL 的嵌套结构对齐。具体做法是将文档语料组织成粒度由细到粗的有向无环图（DAG）聚类结构，每一层用更低的 Matryoshka 维度索引。系统采用自顶向下的迭代式 DAG 遍历，并配以实体驱动机制来控制跳数预算（hop budget）与候选重排序。

Result: 在三个标准多跳 QA 基准上，与七种代表性基线对比，MatRAG 在检索质量上优于最强竞争者；同时通过避免 KG 构建与 LLM 摘要降低索引成本，并通过维度感知的相似度计算降低查询时成本。

Conclusion: MatRAG 通过将层次化聚类结构与 Matryoshka 嵌套维度对齐，实现了检索质量与计算成本的协同优化，为多跳 QA 提供了一种低成本、高质量的检索增强方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for multi-hop Question Answering (QA) must balance retrieval quality with computational cost. This cost is incurred during indexing time, through the use of expensive Knowledge Graphs (KGs) or Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate summaries, or during querying, through iterative LLM-driven retrieval. To reduce it while maintaining retrieval quality, we present MatRAG, a hierarchical framework that combines RAG systems with Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL). MatRAG addresses both kinds of cost by aligning the semantic hierarchy of a clustering structure with the nested structure of MRL. Specifically, it organizes the corpus of documents into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of clusters with progressively coarser granularity. Each level is indexed by a lower Matryoshka dimension. MatRAG pairs an iterative, top-down traversal of the DAG with an entity-driven mechanism that controls the hop budget and re-ranks candidates. We evaluated MatRAG on three standard multi-hop QA benchmarks against seven representative baselines. MatRAG outperforms its strongest competitors in terms of retrieval quality; furthermore, it reduces indexing costs by avoiding KG construction and LLM-based summarization, and lowers query-time costs through dimension-aware similarity.

</details>


### [270] [The Asymptotics of Language Model Alignment with Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01828)
*Haricharan Balasundaram,V. Arvind Rameshwar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将KL约束RL与best-of-n两种对齐方法输出分布渐近接近的结论，从i.i.d. token序列推广到马尔可夫序列，并对有限长度（尤其m=1）给出KL散度为零的完整刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Yang等人的渐近接近性结论依赖token序列i.i.d.假设，而实际LM输出序列往往具有记忆性（非独立），因此该假设不具代表性；同时有限长序列下两方法分布KL散度何时为零的问题此前未被完整解答。

Method: 将m长度token序列由i.i.d.假设推广为马尔可夫链建模，在此基础上重新推导KL约束RL与best-of-n两种对齐方法所产生分布之间的渐近接近性；并对有限长度序列（特别是m=1）分析两方法分布的KL散度，给出其为零时LM分布与奖励函数的完整刻画。

Result: 在马尔可夫token序列下证明了两种对齐方法输出分布的渐近接近性；对有限长度序列，尤其是m=1情形，完整刻画了使两对齐方法分布KL散度为零的LM分布与奖励函数类。

Conclusion: 研究将LM对齐中KL约束RL与best-of-n的分布接近性理论从i.i.d.推广到更贴近实际的马尔可夫设定，并回答了有限长度下KL散度为零的刻画问题。

Abstract: Language model (LM) alignment broadly aims to perturb a given LM $Q$ into an aligned LM $q$ such that i) the outputs produced by $q$ and $Q$ are 'close' in probability, ii) $q$ has a higher expected reward than $Q$. Two common techniques for LM alignment are: KL-constrained RL, which requires knowledge of the LM distribution and is computationally expensive, and the best-of-$n$ algorithm, which requires only sampling from the LM. The work of Yang et al. established asymptotic closeness between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods for an $m$--length i.i.d. token sequence output by the LM, in the limit as $m$ increases to infinity. However, the i.i.d. assumption is not representative of practical LMs, whose output sequences often have memory. In this paper, we extend the asymptotic closeness result to the case when the $m$--length token sequence outputted by the LM is Markovian. Further, for finite-length output sequences -- particularly, when $m=1$ -- we provide a complete characterization of LM distributions and reward functions for which the KL-divergence between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods is zero -- a question first posed in Yang et al.

</details>


### [271] [Cross-Lingual Alignment for Decoder-Only Models using MoE Routers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01921)
*Lucas Bandarkar,Clark Peng,Ahmed Haj Ahmed,Aditi Khandelwal,Nanyun Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出用MoE路由器的输出作为跨语言对齐目标，替代隐藏状态上的辅助对齐损失，在四个开源MoE上进行受控持续预训练，发现该路由损失既能对齐底层隐藏表示，又能提升多语言性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨语言对比学习是多语言编码器训练的核心，但由于多语言分词差异，仅解码器LLM难以直接对齐表示；然而越来越多研究表明，即使对LLM而言，更高的跨语言表示对齐也能带来更好的跨语言迁移，因此需要在现代LLM架构约束下重新设计跨语言对比学习。

Method: 不采用在隐藏状态上施加辅助对齐损失的做法，而是以混合专家（MoE）路由器输出作为对齐目标；相比隐藏状态，路由器输出更适合对大量token进行池化，从而在序列级别实现更可靠的跨语言比较；在四个开源MoE上进行受控持续预训练实验。

Result: 引入该路由损失不仅能对齐不同语言的底层隐藏表示，而且显著改善了在多样化评测套件上的多语言表现，验证了跨语言MoE路由器对齐的潜力。

Conclusion: 跨语言MoE路由器对齐为受架构限制的现代LLM提供了一种有效的跨语言对比学习新范式，可同时实现表示对齐与多语言性能提升。

Abstract: Cross-lingual contrastive learning has been a core component of multilingual encoder training, but the ability to explicitly align representations is not possible in decoder-only LLMs because of varying multilingual tokenization. However, a growing amount of research suggests that even in LLMs, higher cross-lingual representational alignment leads to improved cross-lingual transfer. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to reimagine cross-lingual contrastive learning given the architectural constraints of modern LLMs. Rather than applying an auxiliary alignment loss on hidden states, we propose using the outputs of the mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers as the target for alignment. Router outputs lend themselves better to pooling over many tokens, enabling more reliable cross-lingual comparisons at the sequence-level. Controlled continual pre-training experiments on four open-source MoEs show that incorporating this routing loss also aligns the underlying hidden representations across languages. Most importantly, this loss improves multilingual performance on our diverse evaluation suite, demonstrating the potential of cross-lingual MoE router alignment.

</details>


### [272] [A rubric landscape for evaluating clinical reasoning in large language models: what exists, what is missing, and what needs to be combined](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01938)
*Zhangshu Joshua Jiang,Zina Ibrahim,James T. Teo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这是一篇结构化叙事综述，主张"考试式准确率"不能证明LLM具备临床推理能力，并提出六个评估维度与一套工具组合的设计思路，明确了现有维度覆盖情况、缺口及未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床LLM评测多以考试式准确率为主，无法判定模型能否在跨时间、跨来源的临床记录中良好推理；而医学教育评估工具、临床LLM基准与通用长文本生成评估三条文献脉络彼此割裂，缺少统一的评估框架。

Method: 结构化叙事综述，整合三类文献：医学教育评估工具、2023年以来的临床LLM基准、通用领域长文本生成评估方法。按六个维度进行梳理：问题表征、时间综合、鉴别与管理推理、反事实推理、校准的不确定性、推理忠实性。纳入预印本并加以标注。

Result: 没有任何单一工具覆盖全部六个维度。问题表征与鉴别/管理推理覆盖较好，但信度随工具与场景而异；TIMER-Eval针对时间综合，ER-Reason评估序贯诊断信念更新；不确定性与反事实评估正在出现，但对纵向自由文本推理的适用性有限；事实完整性在通用领域已有较好理论，临床侧已有重要遗漏的早期证据；忠实性最薄弱，仅识别出一项基于多选题的临床因果消融研究。

Conclusion: 建议通过二元评分项、完整性与正确性分开计分、病例特异重要性加权与不可补偿的安全上限、时间顺序一致性检查、以及机会校正的信度报告来组合现有工具。校准不确定性、反事实推理与纵向自由文本记录上的忠实性仍需进一步设计研究。本文提供的是设计依据，而非已验证的评估工具。

Abstract: Exam-style accuracy does not establish whether large language models (LLMs) reason well over clinical records. We define clinical reasoning as integrating and updating evidence across time and sources to form, revise and justify a patient's problem representation and a defensible plan.
  This structured narrative review maps three literatures: medical education assessment instruments, clinical LLM benchmarks published from 2023 onwards, and general-domain methods for evaluating long-form generation. We examine six dimensions: problem representation, temporal synthesis, differential and management reasoning, counterfactual reasoning, calibrated uncertainty, and reasoning faithfulness. Preprints are included and flagged.
  No single instrument covers all six dimensions. Problem representation and differential or management reasoning are reasonably covered, although reliability varies by instrument and setting. TIMER-Eval targets temporal synthesis, and ER-Reason assesses sequential diagnostic belief updating. Dedicated uncertainty and counterfactual evaluations are emerging, but their applicability to longitudinal free-text reasoning remains limited. Factual completeness is well theorised in general-domain evaluation, with early clinical evidence of important omissions. Faithfulness remains the weakest dimension, with one identified clinical causal-ablation study on multiple-choice questions.
  Existing tools should be combined through binary rubric items, separate completeness and correctness scores, case-specific importance weighting with non-compensable safety caps, temporal order-consistency checks, and chance-corrected reliability reporting. Further design work is needed for calibrated uncertainty, counterfactual reasoning and faithfulness over longitudinal free-text records. This review provides a design rationale, not a validated instrument.

</details>


### [273] [Universal Byte-Level Encoding: UTF-8/UTF-16 Routing to Reduce Cross-Script Token-Budget Disparities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01984)
*Hyunsik Kim,Youngmoon Jung*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出UBE（Universal Byte-Level Encoding），一种双字母表分词器：1-2字节UTF-8字符走UTF-8路径，3-4字节UTF-8字符走UTF-16路径，从而降低3字节BMP字符的"编码下限"，在不提高英文切片成本的前提下缩小跨语言token差异，同时保持标准BPE合并规则与精确解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于UTF-8的字节级BPE（BBPE）分词器虽覆盖全部Unicode文本，但在无可用合并规则时的最坏情形下，非英语文字需用多个字节派生符号表示一个多字节字符，形成较高的"编码下限"（encoding floor）。这导致token数增加、单请求成本上升、可用上下文缩短。更换全局文本编码可缓解该差距，但会让混合文本中本已高效的英文片段变贵。

Method: 提出UBE双字母表分词器：将1-2字节UTF-8字符保留在UTF-8路径，把3-4字节UTF-8字符路由至UTF-16。仅改变呈现给BPE的字节表示，合并规则仍为标准规则，并保持精确解码。UBE可与替代边界策略及基于形态学的表示组合使用。

Result: 在Unicode 17审计中，UBE对所有Unicode标量值及官方规范化、字素断字、emoji测试套件中的全部输入实现精确往返。内生评估中，UBE降低了以英语归一化的token数比值的离散度，缩小跨语言token预算差异。多语言语言模型实验中，UBE的LM质量与BBPE相当；在多语言主设置中，UBE对高溢价文字降低token数最多，并略微降低英文token数，从而在固定token预算下提供更多可用上下文，并在内容匹配基准上加快提示处理。

Conclusion: UBE通过双字母表路径设计有效降低了多字节字符的编码下限，在不牺牲英文效率与LM质量的前提下改善了跨语言token预算均衡，提升上下文可用性与处理速度，是对标准BBPE的兼容性改进。

Abstract: Byte-level byte-pair encoding (BBPE) tokenizers are attractive for multilingual large language models (LLMs) because they cover all Unicode text. In UTF-8-based BBPE, however, many scripts start from a higher fallback cost than English: when no learned merges can be applied, a multibyte character requires multiple byte-derived symbols. We call this worst-case pre-merge cost the encoding floor. A higher floor can increase token counts and per-request cost and shrink usable context. Changing the text encoding can reduce this gap, but a single global encoding can make already-efficient English spans more expensive in mixed-script text. We propose Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE), a dual-alphabet tokenizer that keeps 1-2-byte UTF-8 characters on the UTF-8 path while routing 3-4-byte UTF-8 characters through UTF-16. This lowers the encoding floor for 3-byte Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP) characters in scripts with high token premiums (token counts relative to English) without raising it for already-efficient spans in mixed-script text. UBE changes only the byte representation presented to byte-pair encoding (BPE); the merge rule remains standard, and exact decoding is preserved. UBE also composes with alternative boundary policies and morphology-based representations. In a Unicode 17 audit, UBE exactly round-trips all Unicode scalar values and all inputs in the official normalization, grapheme-break, and emoji test suites. Across intrinsic evaluations, UBE lowers dispersion in English-normalized token-count ratios, reducing cross-lingual token-budget disparity. In multilingual language model (LM) experiments, UBE matches BBPE's LM quality. In the main multilingual settings, UBE reduces token counts most for high-premium scripts and slightly lowers English token counts, yielding more usable context under fixed token budgets and faster prompt processing in content-matched benchmarks.

</details>


### [274] [Mem++: Non-Destructive Memory for Long-Term Organizational LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02002)
*Ahmad Yehia,Aly O. Abdelkareem,Islam Ahmed,Hesham Omran,Khaled Alashmouny,Christian Claudel,Abduallah Mohamed*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Mem++，一种非破坏性记忆框架，将记忆构建从写入时蒸馏转变为读取时选择，在OrgMemBench等基准上取得领先表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在组织工作中跨文档、跨月记录决策，修订后的决策以新文档形式出现而非编辑，回答问题时需知道某时间点生效的版本。而现有记忆系统在写入时压缩记录（蒸馏为事实、笔记或图边），提前固化了可回答的内容，限制了时间敏感的问答能力。

Method: Mem++ 采用非破坏性存储策略：完整保存每份文档及其日期与作者，写入时不调用任何生成模型；读取时仅检索日期不晚于问题所涉时间的文档，并融合词汇与语义两路排序；保留旧版本而非覆盖，将版本选择权交给回答模型。

Result: 在组织类基准 OrgMemBench 上，Mem++ 较最强记忆系统基线在两个回答模型上提升 8.0–13.1 分；使用 gpt-4.1-mini 时取得最佳总分，比 RAG 高 2.6 分。在 LoCoMo 上取得最佳 LLM-judge 平均分，在 LongMemEval-S 上排名第二，仅次于其自身实体图变体。

Conclusion: 写入时蒸馏会过早限制系统可回答范围，Mem++ 通过读取时选择与无损保留历史版本来解决时间敏感的版本化问答，在多个基准上验证了有效性。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents now take part in organizational work, where many authors record decisions across documents over months. Because a revised decision arrives as a new document rather than an edit, answering a question requires knowing which version held at a given time. However, most memory systems compress the record at write time. By distilling each document into facts, notes or graph edges, these methods fix what can be answered before any question is asked. To address this, we propose Mem++, a non-destructive memory framework shifting from write-time distillation to read-time selection. Mem++ stores every document whole with its date and author, and it calls no generative model at write time. At read time, it retrieves only documents dated up to the time a question asks about and fuses lexical and semantic rankings. Unlike systems that overwrite older versions, Mem++ keeps them and leaves the choice to the answering model. Evaluations on the organizational benchmark OrgMemBench demonstrate that Mem++ surpasses the strongest memory system baseline by 8.0 to 13.1 points across two answering models. With gpt-4.1-mini, it also achieves the best overall score, 2.6 points above RAG. In addition, Mem++ achieves the best average LLM-judge score on LoCoMo and ranks second on LongMemEval-S, behind only its entity-graph variant. Code for benchmark evaluation is available at https://github.com/AIDAChip-Inc/mem-plus-plus.

</details>


### [275] [Controllable Multi-label Video Safety Detection via Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02019)
*Guangyu Yang,Jingbiao Mei,Mingsheng Sun,Jinghong Chen,Yingtong Bu,Pengda Qin,Da Chen,Bill Byrne*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ATPO强化学习框架，用于多标签视频安全检测，通过自适应Tversky奖励实现可控的精确率-召回率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频社交媒体的普及使用户暴露于有害内容的风险增加，现有有害视频检测系统存在两大局限：一是将安全检测简化为二分类问题，忽略了不安全视频固有的多标签特性；二是依赖静态训练目标，无法支持可控的精确率-召回率权衡，而不同审核流程和不安全类别所需的操作点各异。

Method: 提出自适应Tversky策略优化（ATPO），一个面向多标签视频安全检测（Multi-VSD）的强化学习框架。核心是自适应Tversky奖励（ATR），在训练过程中动态调整假阳性与假阴性惩罚，从而实现可控的精确率-召回率权衡。

Result: 在SafeWatch-Bench和XD-Violence上实验表明，ATPO显著提升多标签性能，在SafeWatch-Bench-Real上Jaccard Index从40.66提升至75.44；此外ATR能够可靠地引导精确率-召回率操作点，支持具有异构策略需求的部署场景。

Conclusion: ATPO有效解决了多标签视频安全检测中的多标签建模与操作点可控性问题，为不同审核策略下的实际部署提供了灵活且可靠的解决方案，代码与检查点已开源。

Abstract: The rapid growth of video-based social media has increased users' exposure to harmful content, creating a need for reliable automated video safety detection. Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show strong video understanding capabilities, existing harmful video detection systems face two key limitations: they typically reduce safety detection to binary classification, overlooking the inherently multi-label nature of unsafe videos, and they rely on static training objectives that do not support controllable precision-recall trade-offs, though the desired operating point may vary across moderation pipelines and unsafe categories. To address these gaps, we propose Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization (ATPO), a reinforcement learning framework for Multi-label Video Safety Detection (Multi-VSD). ATPO introduces the Adaptive Tversky Reward (ATR), which dynamically adjusts false-positive and false-negative penalties during training to enable controllable precision-recall trade-offs. Experiments on SafeWatch-Bench and XD-Violence show that ATPO substantially improves multi-label performance, increasing the Jaccard Index from 40.66 to 75.44 on SafeWatch-Bench-Real. Moreover, ATR enables reliable steering of the precision-recall operating point, supporting deployment scenarios with heterogeneous policy requirements. Code and checkpoints are provided at https://bruceyg.github.io/ATPO-project-page/ .

</details>


### [276] [Old Ideas, Novel Problems: The Instability of LLM-Based Novelty Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02022)
*Noy Sternlicht,Simra Shahid,Peter Jansen,Daniel S. Weld,Pao Siangliulue,Tom Hope*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了自动化构思系统中新颖性评判（novelty judge）的设计选择，发现小提示改动即可造成评判结果的巨大波动，现有评判方法不可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化构思系统常以LLM评判其产出想法的新颖性，但这类评判器多为临时搭建，且验证多基于人类论文而非其实际要打分的人造想法，因此需探究其真实表现。

Method: 自动构建评估集：从OpenReview挖掘审稿人明确肯定或质疑论文原创性的段落，仅保留在其研究领域极端位置上意见一致的投稿，并与普通LLM生成器产出的想法配对；随后对六个评判器进行受控实验，考察提示设计、检索、推理预算等变量。

Result: 微小的提示设计差异影响巨大：仅告知"审稿人认为其中一个想法新颖、另一个不新颖"，即可改变其对过半相同想法对的判定，成对准确率波动超50个百分点，甚至低于随机；同一改动对某评判器有利而对另一评判器有害；检索与更大推理预算帮助甚微；两个专门构建的新颖性评估器表现不及最简单的提示式基线。

Conclusion: 该结果对已报告的自动化构思系统新颖性增益提出质疑，呼吁建立更鲁棒的新颖性评估方法。

Abstract: Automated ideation systems are often evaluated on the novelty of the ideas they produce, and that judgment is increasingly delegated to large language models. Such judges are typically built ad hoc and validated, if at all, on human-authored papers rather than on the generated ideas they are meant to score. So, how do novelty judges perform?
  Not well. We present a systematic controlled study of novelty evaluation design choices. We first build an evaluation set automatically, mining OpenReview for passages where reviewers explicitly affirm or dispute a paper's originality and keeping only submissions with unanimous agreement at the extremes of their research area; we pair these with ideas from a vanilla LLM generator. Across six judges, we find that small prompt design choices have large consequences; e.g., simply telling the judge that reviewers found one idea novel and the other not can change its verdict on more than half of the identical idea pairs it is shown, shifting pairwise accuracy by over 50 points and occasionally pushing it below chance. The same change helps one judge and hurts another. Retrieval and larger reasoning budgets help little, and two purpose-built novelty evaluators are outperformed by our cheapest prompted baseline. These results raise questions about reported novelty gains of automated ideation systems, and call for robust novelty evaluation methods.

</details>


### [277] [Typological Alignment of Stack-Based Language Models on Mildly Context-Sensitive Artificial Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02040)
*Nadine El-Naggar,Tatsuki Kuribayashi,Ted Briscoe*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文在语言模型学习偏差与语言类型共性的关系研究上，从数据和模型两方面扩展分析，聚焦交叉序列依赖与基于栈的语言模型（SLM），发现SLM难以习得交叉序列依赖，但有限工作记忆的SLM泛化更优，为某些词序配置的类型共性提供归纳偏差依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言中某些属性（如SOV词序）远比其它属性普遍，这种类型学共性常被归因于学习偏差。近期用语言模型进行的计算模拟推动了该理论的检验。作者希望在两方面拓展现有分析：(i) 交叉序列依赖——已证实句法复杂度的上限；(ii) 基于栈的语言模型——可能促进层级模式的学习。

Method: 在多种人工语言上评估基于栈的语言模型（SLM）对交叉序列依赖的泛化能力，并对比具有有限工作记忆的SLM与不受限SLM的表现差异。

Result: SLM在交叉序列依赖上泛化困难，难以习得该类结构；然而工作记忆受限的SLM泛化更好。

Conclusion: 有限工作记忆可作为一种归纳偏差的可能基础，从而解释某些词序配置为何具有类型学共性，也为语言模型学习偏差与语言类型共性的关联提供了模型侧的新证据。

Abstract: Some properties of languages, e.g., subject-object-verb (SOV) word order, are more prevalent than others among the thousands of attested natural languages (NLs). Such typological commonality is often attributed to learning biases. Computational simulations, recently with language models (LMs), have facilitated the exploration of this theory. In this paper, we extend existing analyses of the relationship between LMs' learning biases and typological commonality on both data and model sides, focusing on: (i) cross-serial dependencies, the upper limit of attested syntactic complexity, and (ii) stack-based LMs (SLMs), potentially facilitating learning of hierarchical patterns. We first evaluate generalization of SLMs on cross-serial dependencies across diverse artificial languages and confirm that they struggle with such constructions. However, SLMs with limited working memory generalize better suggesting a possible basis for such inductive bias and thus the typological commonality of some word order configurations.

</details>


### [278] [LLM2Jev: LLMs Are Already Jev-Style Decision Models -- When and How to Fine-Tune Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02076)
*Yinheng Li,Justin Wagle*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LLM2Jev框架，从LLM下一token概率中直接提取校准决策，无需生成自由文本。发现现代LLM本身即为有效决策模型，微调仅对弱模型和特定任务有针对性收益，KL锚定可防止对话生成能力退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Jev式决策模型输出预定义选项上的分类概率分布，可直接被软件系统使用，但需专门训练。作者试图探究通用LLM是否已开箱具备该能力，以及何时真正需要微调，以减少额外训练成本并避免生成式输出带来的不可控性。

Method: LLM2Jev采用保持架构不变的框架，通过括号式数字标识符的下一token概率直接提取校准决策。提供两种方案：(1)免训练推理配方；(2)微调目标，使用树因子化的listwise损失优化候选选择，并以KL散度惩罚将辅助预测锚定到基座模型。在Qwen3.5-4B与Qwen3-0.6B上评测。

Result: 免训练时，4B模型可媲美同基座的社区Jev式模型，优于letter-logit读出，支持任意选项数量，并原生处理图像多模态决策。微调带来针对性收益：显著提升弱模型及多选项意图路由等任务，但对强基座收益递减。KL锚定有效防止对话文本生成的行为退化，LoRA在强模型上表现最佳。

Conclusion: 通用LLM已内在地具备Jev式决策能力，免训练即可达到可用水平，微调并非普遍必要。KL锚定是避免能力退化的关键，LoRA为强模型优选方案。该工作为决策模型的训练必要性提供了经验性判据。

Abstract: Jev-style decision models return categorical probability distributions over predefined options without generating free-form text, enabling software systems to act on their outputs directly. In this work, we investigate the extent to which general-purpose LLMs already possess this capability out of the box, and when fine-tuning is actually necessary. We present LLM2Jev, an architecture-preserving framework that extracts calibrated decisions directly from next-token probabilities over bracketed numeric identifiers. LLM2Jev provides both a training-free inference recipe and a fine-tuning objective that optimizes candidate selection via a tree-factorized listwise loss while anchoring auxiliary predictions to the base model using KL divergence penalties. Evaluating on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3-0.6B, we find that modern LLMs are inherently effective decision models: without training, the 4B model matches community Jev-style models built on the same backbone, outperforms letter-logit readouts, supports arbitrary option counts, and natively handles multimodal decisions over images. Fine-tuning provides targeted rather than universal benefits -- substantially improving weaker models and specific tasks (such as many-option intent routing), but offering diminishing returns for strong backbones. Crucially, our KL anchors prevent behavioral degradation in conversational text generation, with LoRA delivering the strongest performance on capable models.

</details>


### [279] [Scalable, Transferable Meta-network for Data Selection Requires a Different Loss (and Why the Obvious Choice is Problematic)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02092)
*Zilin Du,Bowen Yang,Boyang Albert Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出TESS，一种基于逐点价值匹配（PVM）目标的可扩展数据选择框架，用于大语言模型训练数据筛选，在跨数据集、从子集到全量语料、从小模型到大模型等场景下展现出强迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模异质语料下，数据选择对LLM训练至关重要。现有基于元学习（MTS）的方法虽优于启发式打分，但在细粒度估值与对未见数据的迁移性之间存在权衡。用选择网络替代逐样本权重是自然思路，但直接将其嵌入现有MTS目标会导致权重抑制和对易学特征的持续依赖，从而训练不稳定、泛化差。

Method: 提出Transferable Example Scoring and Selection（TESS），一个可扩展的数据选择框架，构建于逐点价值匹配目标（Pointwise Value Matching, PVM）之上，以缓解权重抑制和易学特征依赖问题。

Result: 在LLM安全性和定向指令微调任务上的实验表明，TESS在跨数据集、从子集到全量语料、以及从小模型到大模型等维度均具有强迁移能力。

Conclusion: TESS通过PVM目标有效解决了选择网络嵌入MTS时的优化不稳定与泛化差问题，实现了可扩展且强迁移的数据选择。

Abstract: Data selection is critical for training large language models on massive and heterogeneous corpora. Meta-learning for Training-data Selection offers a principled alternative to heuristic scoring by learning data weights from a target validation objective, but existing methods face a trade-off between fine-grained valuation and transferability to unseen data. A natural solution is to replace per-sample weights with a selection network. However, we find that directly incorporating such a network into existing MTS objectives leads to unstable optimization and poor generalization, caused by weight suppression and persistent reliance on easy-to-learn features. To address these issues, we propose Transferable Example Scoring and Selection (TESS), a scalable data-selection framework built on a Pointwise Value Matching objective (PVM). Experiments on LLM safety and targeted instruction tuning demonstrate strong transfer across datasets, from subsets to full corpora, and from smaller to larger models.

</details>


### [280] [Argo-Bench: Evaluating Data Agents on Enterprise-Scale Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02122)
*Gabriel Tomitsuka,Arman Raayatsanati,Emma Xing,Duke Gand,Joseph J Ma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Argo-Bench评测框架，包含210个数据科学与分析任务，模拟纽约市外卖平台真实规模数据环境，要求智能体在仓库中导航并执行操作，14个模型中最强模型仅34.8%任务达95分以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有text-to-SQL基准仅评估查询生成，且答案键常有错误；真实企业仓库过于敏感难以公开，导致基准多基于单表单事件的公开数据集，无法反映真实企业数据科学与分析工作流的复杂性。

Method: 构建Argo-Bench，基于公开数据、行业文献与监管文件模拟纽约市外卖平台，含8100万订单（2024年）、真实经济与欺诈模式；导出为模仿Oracle E-Business Suite的ERP仓库，含235张表、75亿行。仿真真值状态对智能体隐藏，须先导航仓库重建事实再行动。智能体执行如封禁欺诈账户、分配激励预算、补发工资等操作，评分依据仿真中的后果；每任务配有可执行参考解。

Result: 14个前沿与开源模型中，最强模型仅在34.8%的任务上得分≥95，平均59.5分。

Conclusion: Argo-Bench超越text-to-SQL，推动智能体在真实数据环境中理解、导航并行动的能力发展。

Abstract: Real-world enterprise data science and analytics workflows require reasoning across dozens of tables, performing statistical analyses, and acting on the results. Established text-to-SQL benchmarks evaluate query generation alone, and audits have found their answer keys frequently wrong. Because real enterprise warehouses are too sensitive to release, these benchmarks are built on public datasets where a business event fits in a single table. We introduce Argo-Bench, an evaluation framework comprising 210 data science and analytics tasks. Drawing on public data, peer-reviewed industry literature, and regulatory filings, we simulate a food delivery platform in New York City at true scale, with 81 million orders in 2024, grounded economics, fraud patterns, and marketplace incentives. We export this world to an ERP warehouse of 235 tables and 7.5 billion rows, modeled on the Oracle E-Business Suite schema. The simulator's ground-truth state is withheld from the warehouse the agent sees, so tasks require reconstructing facts by navigating the warehouse before acting on them. Argo-Bench goes beyond text-to-SQL: the agent files actions such as banning fraudulent accounts, allocating courier incentive budgets, or issuing back pay, and the grader scores each by its consequences in the simulator. Every task has an executable reference solution that demonstrates solvability using only the warehouse. The strongest of 14 frontier and open-weight models scores 95 or higher on only 34.8% of tasks and averages 59.5 points. We hope Argo-Bench drives progress toward agents that understand, navigate, and act within real data environments.

</details>


### [281] [Keyword Harnesses Fail Open: A Cheap Diagnostic Ladder for Tool-Use Claims in Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02142)
*Juan S. Santillana*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文记录了一对同架构西班牙语安全模型（600M 与 1B）在工具调用评测中的假阳性现象：宽松的关键词匹配指标几乎无法区分两者（B4: 0.660 vs. 0.650），但逐字复现训练样例可彻底区分（600M 为 6/6 有效调用，1B 为 0/6）。作者提出一套严格的低成本诊断阶梯，将 1B 的失败定位为 web-heavy 训练阶段抹除了 <|tool_call|> 先验，并用约 3.3 GPU 小时的目标 SFT 修复（有效发出率 0.100→0.959）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关键词匹配类基准可能给实际并不会工具调用的小模型"虚假加分"。作者在一对共享解码器、分词器与特殊 token 的同架构西班牙语安全模型上观察到该假阳性：两者在宽松工具使用指标上得分几乎相同，但真实能力差异巨大，因此需要一套廉价、严格的诊断方法来识别并定位此类失效。

Method: 1) 对比对象：661.6M 模型（约 65% 代码/技术文本，无专用 SFT）与 1,109M 模型（web-heavy 多阶段课程 + 6B token 工具 SFT）。2) 诊断阶梯：逐字复现训练样例的检查、首 token 探针（测量 <|tool_call|> 先验概率）、嵌入漂移检查。3) 修复：目标 SFT 配方（多样化语料、5 倍学习率、2,202 步、约 3.3 GPU 小时），并用因子分析检验各配置。

Result: 逐字复现：600M 在 6/6 样例上生成带泛化参数的有效工具调用，1B 在所有 checkpoint 上为 0/6。首 token 探针将 1B 失败定位到缺失先验（<|tool_call|> 概率 10^-4–10^-5），该先验被 web-heavy 训练阶段抹除。修复后 1B 在全部 269 条语料行上有效发出率从 0.100 升至 0.959（600M: 0.926）；在 238 条未见 prompt 上修复后 1B 通过率 0.536，优于 600M 的 0.428（p=0.004）。嵌入漂移检查显示修复未改动触发 token 的 tied embedding（bf16 表 97.7% 保持逐位一致），说明变化发生在周边网络。两者均存在过度触发，对负向 prompt 很少不调用（600M 0.09，修复后 1B 0.17）。因子分析确认所有修复配置都能安装该格式，但多样化语料的抑制收益受种子敏感性影响，仍属假设。

Conclusion: 宽松的关键词匹配指标会掩盖小模型真实工具调用能力的缺失，应被严格诊断所取代。该诊断阶梯仅需数分钟 CPU 时间，可有效门控小模型的工具使用声明；1B 的失效源于训练阶段抹除的先验，可通过极低成本的目标 SFT 修复，且改动位于周边网络而非触发 token 嵌入。

Abstract: Keyword-matching benchmarks can credit small models for tool use they never perform. We document such a false positive in a matched-architecture pair of Spanish security language models and propose a ladder of strict, cheap diagnostics. A 661.6M parameter model (approx. 65% code/technical text; no dedicated SFT) and a 1,109M model (web-heavy multi-phase curriculum; 6B-token tool-SFT) share decoder, tokenizer, and special tokens, scoring almost identically on lenient tool-use metrics (B4: 0.660 vs. 0.650).
  Verbatim-reproduction checks on training examples separate them completely: the 600M emits valid tool calls with generalized arguments on 6/6 examples; the 1B does so on 0/6 across checkpoints. A first-token probe localizes the 1B's failure to a missing prior (prob. $10^{-4}$--$10^{-5}$ on <|tool_call|>), which was erased by its web-heavy training phase. A targeted SFT recipe (diverse corpus, 5x higher learning rate, 2,202 steps, ~3.3 GPU-hours) repairs the 1B using three orders of magnitude fewer tokens than the failed phase. On all 269 corpus rows, valid emission rises from 0.100 to 0.959 (600M: 0.926). On 238 unseen prompts, the repaired 1B passes 0.536 vs. the 600M's 0.428 ($p = 0.004$). Embedding-drift checks show the repair did not move the trigger token's tied embedding (97.7% of the bf16 table remains bit-identical), meaning changes live in the surrounding network.
  Both models over-trigger, rarely answering negative prompts without a call (0.09 for 600M, 0.17 for repaired 1B). Factorial analyses confirm all repair configurations install the format, though suppression benefits from a diverse corpus remain a hypothesis due to seed sensitivity. This cheap diagnostic ladder costs minutes of CPU time and should gate tool-use claims on small models.

</details>


### [282] [From Knowledge Access to Source Learning: Developing Source-Specific Competence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02150)
*Lucheng Fu,Kejing Xia,Yiyang Wang,Yiqiao Jin,Jinjin He,Xiyuan Yang,Haoxin Liu,Ye Yu,Haibo Jin,Yijia Xiao,Wenke Lee,B. Aditya Prakash,Haohan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"源学习"（source learning）问题，通过构建可持久化的"源模型"（persistent source model）让LLM智能体对同一权威外部源逐步积累可复用的理解，并提出SourceLearn方法，结合自导向与任务导向两种学习机制来构建和迭代优化源模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法分别优化源内容的访问与组织方式（如RAG），以及保留历史交互中可复用知识的智能体记忆系统，但对同一外部源的反复使用仍被视为"重复访问"，而非逐步深化对该源理解的机会。作者希望将重复访问转化为源特定能力的持续积累。

Method: 以"源模型"表征对权威源的可复用理解（知识如何被组织、解读与应用），并提出SourceLearn，包含两种互补机制：（1）自导向源学习（Self-Directed Source Learning）：识别尚未充分理解的内容并自适应地重访源；（2）任务导向源学习（Task-Guided Source Learning）：利用下游任务经验发现局部表征缺口与知识组织的重复需求。两者中学习信号决定"应重新审视什么"，而持久化更新则从权威源重建，以保证准确性。

Result: 在5个基准与3个LLM后端共15个设置中，SourceLearn在13个设置上取得最佳性能；相比Hybrid RAG最高提升22.6个点，并在整体上显著优于静态源表征与基于经验的记忆基线。

Conclusion: 对持久权威源的重复使用应被视为逐步提升源理解的机会，而非简单的重复访问；通过自导向与任务导向信号驱动的源模型构建与持续更新，可显著提升知识密集型任务序列上的智能体表现，且更新以权威源为依据可维持可靠性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent external sources to solve sequences of knowledge-intensive tasks. Existing methods improve how source content is accessed and organized, while agent-memory systems preserve reusable knowledge from prior interactions, but repeated use of the same source is still largely treated as repeated access rather than an opportunity to progressively improve understanding of that source. We study source learning: developing reusable source-specific competence over a persistent authoritative source. We represent this competence with a persistent source model that captures reusable understanding of the source, including how its knowledge is structured, interpreted, and applied. To construct and progressively refine such models, we propose SourceLearn, which combines two complementary learning mechanisms. Self-Directed Source Learning identifies what remains incompletely understood and adaptively revisits the source, while Task-Guided Source Learning uses downstream experience to reveal local representational gaps and recurring needs in how source knowledge should be organized. In both cases, learning signals determine what should be reconsidered, while persistent updates are reconstructed from the authoritative source. Across five benchmarks and three LLM backends, SourceLearn achieves the best performance in 13 of 15 settings, with gains of up to 22.6 points over Hybrid RAG and substantial overall improvements over static source representations and experience-based memory baselines.

</details>


### [283] [AutoCompact: Learning When to Compact Context in Long-Horizon Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02163)
*Xuan Zhang,Longtao Zheng,Cunxiao Du,Bo An,Xin Dong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 AutoCompact，让编码 agent 将"上下文压缩"决策纳入策略学习：通过 judge 修正压缩决策生成训练轨迹，经 SFT 与 RL 联合优化编码和压缩能力，在 SWE-bench Verified 与 SWE-PolyBench Verified 上分别绝对提升 9.2% 和 5.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仓库级软件工程任务需要长时间的代码检查、搜索、编辑与测试轨迹，早期探索信息会逐渐过时。因此上下文管理不只是防止溢出，agent 还需决定何时压缩、保留哪些工作状态、以及如何从压缩后的状态继续。现有方法缺乏对这种压缩决策能力的显式训练。

Method: 1) 让基础 agent 在编码任务上运行，用 judge 审查其压缩决策、摘要及压缩后的动作；2) 将有缺陷的输出替换为修正版本后再在环境中执行，使每条轨迹从被修正的决策继续；3) 用这些轨迹做监督微调（SFT）；4) 再以任务成功奖励通过强化学习联合优化编码与压缩行为。

Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-PolyBench Verified 上，AutoCompact 相比基础模型 pass rate 绝对提升分别为 9.2% 和 5.0%；在评估的各推理预算下提升均保持，包括 256K 上下文窗口（从不溢出）以及 16K 窗口（溢出时触发回退压缩）。

Conclusion: 将上下文压缩作为可学习的策略组成部分，并采用 judge 修正 + SFT + RL 的训练流程，能有效提升编码 agent 的仓库级任务成功率，且在不同上下文预算设置下具有稳健性。

Abstract: Coding agents solve repository-level software engineering tasks through long trajectories of code inspection, search, editing, and testing. As a task progresses, earlier exploration becomes stale, so managing context is more than avoiding overflow: an agent must decide when to compact, what working state to preserve, and how to continue from it. We introduce AutoCompact, which trains a coding agent to make these decisions as part of its policy. To collect training data, we run the base agent on coding tasks and use a judge to review its compaction decisions, summaries, and actions after compaction. Flawed outputs are replaced with corrected ones before being executed in the environment, so each trajectory continues from the corrected decisions. We use these trajectories for supervised fine-tuning, then jointly optimize coding and compaction through reinforcement learning with task-success rewards. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-PolyBench Verified show that AutoCompact improves pass rates over the base model by an absolute 9.2\% and 5.0\%, respectively. The improvements hold across all evaluated inference budgets, with a 256K context window that never overflows and with a 16K window whose overflow triggers fallback compaction.

</details>


### [284] [Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02193)
*Hui Ren,Zihan Li,Chang Liu,Huidong Liu,Alexander Schwing*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出分层连续扩散语言模型（HC-DLM），将离散token生成与连续隐变量轨迹耦合在单一去噪过程中，训练目标由token似然的变分下界导出，在Sudoku、Countdown和LM1B上均优于同规模离散与连续扩散基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散语言模型并行解码时各token独立从边缘分布采样，破坏了同一批解码token间的统计依赖；连续扩散语言模型虽通过共享连续状态去噪来规避该问题，但其去噪器仅看到该状态，直到最终解码前都无法与合法token配置绑定。因此需要一种能同时保留并行统计依赖与token有效性的方法。

Method: HC-DLM将离散token生成与连续隐变量轨迹耦合于单一、有原则的去噪过程，其训练目标源自token似然的变分下界。与将连续上下文附接到自包含离散链的近期方法不同，HC-DLM令隐变量成为唯一持久的生成状态：每一步都从隐变量读出token，并将token回馈作为下一次隐变量更新的支架（scaffold）。

Result: 在结构化推理（Sudoku）、数学规划（Countdown）和语言建模（LM1B）上，在相同模型规模下，HC-DLM在Sudoku与Countdown的谜题准确率、以及LM1B的生成困惑度上均优于离散与连续扩散基线。项目页面：https://hc-dlm.github.io/。

Conclusion: HC-DLM通过以连续隐变量为唯一持久生成状态、并让token读出与回馈形成闭环，统一了离散与连续扩散的优势，在结构化推理与语言建模任务上取得一致改进。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion language models offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive generation for tasks demanding bidirectional reasoning and global constraint satisfaction. Yet they share a structural bottleneck: when decoding in parallel, each token is sampled independently from its marginal, severing the statistical dependencies among the tokens decoded together. Continuous diffusion language models avoid this by denoising a shared continuous state, but their denoiser sees only that state, so nothing ties it to a valid token configuration until it is finally decoded. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (HC-DLM), which couple discrete token generation with a continuous latent trajectory in a single, principled denoising process, whose training objective is derived from a variational bound on the token likelihood. In contrast to recent methods that attach continuous context to a self-contained discrete chain, HC-DLM makes the latent the only persistent generative state: tokens are read out from it at every step and feed back as a scaffold for the next latent update. On structured reasoning (Sudoku), mathematical planning (Countdown) and language modeling (LM1B), HC-DLM improves over discrete and continuous diffusion baselines at matched model size, in puzzle accuracy on Sudoku and Countdown and in generative perplexity on LM1B. Project page: https://hc-dlm.github.io/.

</details>


### [285] [KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02206)
*Pengfei Li,Naufal Suryanto,Sicheng Zhang,Muzammal Naseer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出KaliBench基准，用于评测大模型将自然语言转换为Kali Linux网络安全工具命令行的能力，包含8504个查询-命令对，覆盖1642个工具；结果显示开源模型准确率均低于42%，但基于该基准的可验证奖励可显著提升8B模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评测多聚焦知识问答或端到端智能体任务，未直接衡量大模型为真实网络安全工具生成可执行命令的能力。而网络安全操作依赖严格的命令行界面，细微的语法错误、标志-取值绑定错误或参数顺序错误都会导致执行失败，这一评测空白亟需填补。

Method: 构建KaliBench，通过基于文档的流水线、确定性规范化与别名感知评测生成数据；采用多阶段验证流程，结合LLM校验、沙箱终端执行与人在回路精炼，保证语义正确性与可执行性；并基于细粒度确定性信号设计免运行时验证奖励，用于监督微调与强化学习。

Result: 数据集含8504个查询-命令对，覆盖1642个工具、23个能力维度与5个安全阶段。在三种评测模式、24种通用及安全导向开源模型配置下，无限制场景中无开源模型精确命令准确率超过42%。经监督微调与可验证奖励强化学习后，8B模型性能可媲美685B MoE模型。

Conclusion: KaliBench填补了自然语言到网络安全CLI翻译评测的空白，提供了细粒度、可复现、可执行的评测手段；实验表明无工具提示时精确CLI生成仍具挑战，而该基准衍生的可验证奖励能有效提升模型能力。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. However, existing evaluations focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks, and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to generate executable commands for real-world cybersecurity tools. This gap is critical because cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag--value bindings, or argument misordering can invalidate execution. We introduce KaliBench, a fine-grained benchmark and dataset for natural-language--to--CLI translation on Kali Linux, comprising 8,504 query--command pairs spanning 1,642 tools across 23 capability dimensions and 5 security phases. KaliBench is constructed via a manuscript-grounded pipeline with deterministic canonicalization and alias-aware evaluation, enabling precise and reproducible assessment of tool selection and argument construction. To ensure both semantic correctness and practical executability, we develop a multi-stage verification pipeline that combines LLM-based validation, sandboxed terminal execution, and human-in-the-loop refinement. Building on these fine-grained, deterministic signals, KaliBench further enables runtime-free verifiable rewards for training. Across three evaluation modes and 24 configurations of general-purpose and security-focused open-weight models, no open-weight model exceeds 42% exact-command accuracy in the unrestricted setting, highlighting the difficulty of accurate CLI-based cybersecurity tool use without explicit tool hints. We further show that supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards derived from KaliBench significantly improve an 8B model and achieve performance comparable to a 685B MoE model.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [286] [Reverse Item Response Theory for Sparsity-Robust Ranking in Fragmented Cancer Drug-Response Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00002)
*Jung Min Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出“反向IRT”框架，将癌症类型视为具耐药能力的潜变量“被试”、药物视为具规避难度的“项目”，并在GDSC2数据上验证其在缺失情境下恢复潜秩的稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物反应数据高度碎片化且存在系统性缺失，简单平均难以在部分观测下稳定刻画癌症类型的体外耐药程度与药物的广谱活性，需要一种能在共享潜尺度上同时估计二者的稳健方法。

Method: 将Item Response Theory反向套用于药物基因组学：癌症类型对应潜“被试”（耐药能力），药物对应“项目”（规避难度）。基于GDSC2的242,036条药物敏感性测量，在共享潜尺度上估计癌症类型层面的体外耐药性与药物层面的广谱活性；设计四种缺失机制进行验证，并与简单平均比较；采用留出预测、Bootstrap置信区间及跨平台PRISM复制进行评估。

Result: 在MCAR、癌症偏置与药物偏置稀疏下，60%缺失时反向IRT的潜秩恢复优于简单平均（Delta-rho = +0.089至+0.095）；留出预测中IRT在五种方法中取得最佳Brier分数；Bootstrap显示28种癌症类型中19种有稳定的耐药/敏感分类；PRISM跨平台复制的方向一致率为82%，但秩相关较弱（rho = 0.25）。

Conclusion: 该工作的贡献在于碎片化评估条件下的方法学稳健性，而非提供普适的临床耐药排行榜；跨平台弱秩相关亦表明结论不宜外推为通用临床排序。

Abstract: We introduce reverse Item Response Theory (IRT) to pharmacogenomic drug-response analysis by treating cancer types as latent "subjects" with resistance ability and drugs as "items" with evasion difficulty. Applied to 242,036 drug sensitivity measurements from the Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC2) database, the model estimates cancer-type-level in-vitro resistance and drug-level broad activity on a shared latent scale. Validation across four missingness regimes demonstrates that reverse IRT better recovers the full-data latent ranking than simple averaging, with advantages of Delta-rho = +0.089 to +0.095 at 60% missingness under MCAR, cancer-biased, and drug-biased sparsity. Held-out prediction confirms IRT achieves the best Brier score among five evaluated methods. Bootstrap confidence intervals show 19 of 28 cancer types have stable resistant/sensitive classifications. Cross-platform PRISM replication shows 82% directional agreement but weak rank-order correlation (rho = 0.25), indicating the contribution is methodological robustness under fragmented evaluation, not a universal clinical resistance leaderboard.

</details>


### [287] [How Far is Adam from Natural Gradient Descent?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00004)
*Vihaan Paka-Hegde*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将Adam完整更新规则（含动量）解释为受对角截断、经验标签替换与时间滞后约束的对角经验Fisher近似，并用尺度不变的γ(Δθ)度量其与真实自然梯度下降的几何偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam是深度学习中的标准优化器，但其与自然梯度下降（NGD）之间的几何关系仍存在未解决的问题，需要量化Adam在多大程度上真正贴近自然梯度路径。

Method: 把Adam的完整更新（含动量）视为对角经验Fisher近似，并引入对角截断、经验标签替换和时间滞后三种结构性失配；采用尺度不变的γ(Δθ)度量，在四类损失景观（良态线性回归、病态线性回归、逻辑回归、非凸小型神经网络）上测量Adam相对真实NGD的几何偏差，并对比改进经验Fisher（iEF）与标准经验Fisher（EF）的轨迹稳定性。

Result: Adam的几何轨迹依赖具体情境：良态场景下偏差较低，但在病态条件下显著上升，在神经网络中错配度约达10^3。较高的几何漂移与初期优化较慢相关，但不损害最终目标最小化，Adam始终能收敛到较低损失；iEF比标准EF路径更稳定，后者常出现震荡或发散。

Conclusion: Adam的实用优化能力可能源于结构近似误差与动量平滑之间的平衡，而非对自然梯度路径的紧密跟踪。

Abstract: Adam is the standard optimizer in deep learning, yet its geometric relationship to natural gradient descent (NGD) contains unresolved questions. We study Adam's full update rule, including momentum, as a diagonal empirical Fisher approximation subject to diagonal truncation, empirical label substitution, and temporal lag. Using the scale-invariant $γ(Δθ)$ metric, we measure Adam's geometric deviation from true NGD across four loss landscapes: well-conditioned linear regression, ill-conditioned linear regression, logistic regression, and a non-convex small neural network. Adam's geometric trajectory is context-dependent. Deviation remains low in well-conditioned settings but rises significantly under ill-conditioning, reaching misalignments of $\approx 10^3$ in the neural network. Higher geometric drift correlates with slower initial optimization but does not degrade final objective minimization; Adam consistently reaches low loss. Furthermore, the improved empirical Fisher (iEF) tracks more stable paths than the standard empirical Fisher (EF), which frequently oscillates or diverges. Our results suggest Adam's practical optimization power may stem from a balance of structural approximation errors and momentum smoothing rather than close tracking of the natural gradient path.

</details>


### [288] [FourierQK: Filter Shape, Admissibility and the Leakage-Coverage Law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00009)
*Athanasios Zeris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过受控消融实验，检验频域注意力（FourierQK）中五种滤波器属性假设，发现带通振荡结构（抑制DC/Nyquist）、中尺度带宽（σ≈2 bins，约70 token）最优，可解释其相对点积注意力的增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 频率坍缩注意力以可学习的带通内积替代Q/K点积并取得显著提升，但何种滤波器形状最优及其原因尚不明确，需要系统检验滤波器属性对性能的贡献。

Method: 在字符级语言建模任务（TinyShakespeare，6层GPT）上进行受控消融，围绕DC抑制、Nyquist抑制、带宽、中心频率、多尺度覆盖五个假设，比较BASE-DOT、可容许滤波器（零均值Mexican Hat DOG m=2）与非可容许高斯，并分析双边FFT泄漏与因果时域Morlet（K=128 taps，T=256上下文）。

Result: (1) DC与Nyquist分量有害（val≈2.0，等价于相位随机化）；(2) 最优单尺度带宽σ≈2 bins、中心位于段落尺度（约70 token），相对BASE-DOT增益Δ=+1.15 nats；(3) 可容许滤波器（零均值Mexican Hat DOG m=2）在同尺度下优于高斯并提供部分双边FFT泄漏防护；(4) 双边FFT泄漏随频谱覆盖单调增加，窄带（gap>+4）干净、宽带（gap<+2）泄漏；(5) 因果时域Morlet在字符尺度无法超越BASE-DOT，K=128 taps仅覆盖50%的T=256上下文。

Conclusion: FourierQK适用于双向注意力（encoder式，如BERT），训练与推理均可获得全序列上下文；自回归生成需因果谱变体（如MorletQK，decoder式，如GPT）。

Abstract: Frequency-collapse attention [Zeris, 2026e] achieves large gains over standard dot-product attention by replacing the Q/K dot product with a bandpass-filtered inner product at a learned frequency. A natural follow-up question is: which filter shape works best, and why? We test five hypotheses about filter properties -- DC suppression, Nyquist suppression, bandwidth, centre frequency, and multi-scale coverage -- using a controlled ablation on character-level language modelling (TinyShakespeare, 6-layer GPT). Our main findings are: (1) DC and Nyquist components are actively harmful (val ~= 2.0, equivalent to phase randomisation), confirming that oscillatory bandpass structure is essential, not just any low-dimensional spectral summary; (2) the optimal single-scale bandwidth is sigma ~= 2 bins centred at paragraph scale (~70 tokens), giving a clean gain of Delta = +1.15 nats over BASE-DOT; (3) admissible filters (zero-mean, Mexican Hat DOG m = 2) outperform non-admissible Gaussians at the same scale and provide partial protection against bilateral FFT leakage; (4) bilateral FFT leakage scales monotonically with spectral coverage -- narrowband filters (gap > +4) are clean, wideband filters (gap < +2) are leaky; and (5) causal time-domain Morlet at character scale cannot beat BASE-DOT (K=128 taps covers 50% of T=256 context), motivating word-level experiments in the companion MorletQK paper [Zeris, 2026f]. Together, findings (1)-(5) characterise FourierQK as effective in bidirectional attention settings (encoder-style, e.g. BERT), where full-sequence context is available at both training and inference time; autoregressive generation requires a causal spectral variant such as MorletQK [Zeris, 2026f] (decoder-style, e.g. GPT). Code available at: https://github.com/AthanasiosZeris/energy-gated-attention

</details>


### [289] [Integrating Fairness and Explainability in a Multiple Instance Reinforcement Learning System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00035)
*Bente Hinkenhuis,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出一个结合RL-MIL、对抗去偏与偏好条件超网络的多目标框架，用于学生学业风险预测，但发现超网络扩展出现模式坍塌，偏好权重无法有效调控公平性—性能权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从教育交互数据预测学生表现，既要求模型准确，又要求具备足够的透明性以支持有意义的干预；同时人口统计信息的引入会带来预测不公平的风险。因此需要一种能同时兼顾准确性、可解释性与公平性的建模框架。

Method: 采用多目标框架：以强化学习驱动的多示例学习（RL-MIL）为核心，将每个学生表示为一袋弱标注交互，由RL智能体选择信息量高的示例供下游分类；引入对抗去偏处理人口统计信息带来的不公平；并评估两种超网络变体，检验用户定义的偏好标量能否连续控制预测性能与Equalized Odds之间的权衡。

Result: 基础RL-MIL模型取得了较强的分类性能，但两种超网络扩展均出现模式坍塌：改变偏好权重几乎无法使模型沿预期的公平性—性能前沿系统性移动。该失败与目标主导、条件机制中梯度传播微弱以及动态生成参数之间的相互作用有关。

Conclusion: 公平性目标可以被纳入可解释的RL-MIL流程，但仅靠偏好条件并不能保证多目标行为可控。稳健的公平RL-MIL需要显式的梯度平衡机制、目标分离设计以及稳定性分析。

Abstract: Predicting student performance from educational interaction data requires models that are both accurate and sufficiently transparent to support meaningful intervention, while demographic information introduces an additional risk of unfair predictions. This study investigates a multi-objective framework that combines reinforcement learning-based multiple instance learning (RL-MIL), adversarial debiasing, and preference-conditioned hypernetworks for student-at-risk prediction. MIL represents each student as a bag of weakly labeled interactions, while an RL agent selects informative instances for downstream classification. Two hypernetwork variants are evaluated to determine whether a user-defined preference scalar can continuously control the trade-off between predictive performance and Equalized Odds. The underlying RL-MIL baseline achieves strong classification performance, but both hypernetwork extensions exhibit mode collapse: changing the preference weight produces little systematic movement along the intended fairness-performance frontier. The failure is associated with objective dominance, weak gradient propagation through the conditioning mechanism, and interactions between dynamically generated parameters. The results show that fairness objectives can be incorporated into an interpretable RL-MIL pipeline, but preference conditioning alone does not guarantee controllable multi-objective behavior. Robust fair RL-MIL therefore requires explicit mechanisms for gradient balancing, objective separation, and stability analysis.

</details>


### [290] [Fast Polynomial Transcendentals for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00049)
*Robert Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究用短多项式程序替代LLM中SFU激活函数（sigmoid、tanh、SiLU）以加速计算，并在GB200上验证了端到端训练吞吐提升与训练损失基本无损。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU代际间矩阵、特殊功能单元（SFU）与内存管线的扩展速率不一致，导致内核瓶颈随硬件演进发生迁移（如FlashAttention-4在NVIDIA Blackwell上暴露的失衡问题）。作者希望检验是否可用短多项式程序加速LLM中其他SFU操作。

Method: 先在隔离的FP16扫描中对比原生PyTorch与打包FMA程序（覆盖L2驻留与HBM驻留工作集）；随后在四个GB200集成任务（dense SiLU、tanh-softcapped attention、sigmoid attention、routed-expert SwiGLU）中用degree-3/4的BF16多项式替换原生sigmoid、tanh、SiLU。方法结合解析对称性、目标格式舍入与消费内核内的打包算术。

Result: 隔离路径在L2中提升1.19–2.19x，在HBM中提升1.00–1.70x。dense-SiLU、tanh-softcapped-attention、routed-expert替换分别使完整训练步吞吐提升2.7%、2.9%、8.0%；sigmoid-attention替换使完整attention前向提升7.4%、完整GPU步提升0.3%。在约1000亿token的常见训练视界下，四个任务的最终平滑训练损失差异（多项式减原生）介于−0.107至+0.079之间。

Conclusion: 短BF16多项式程序可有效替代LLM中多个SFU激活函数，在保持训练损失基本不变的前提下获得可观的吞吐收益，说明针对SFU瓶颈的算法-硬件协同优化具有实用价值。

Abstract: Graphics processing unit (GPU) generations scale matrix, special-function, and memory pipelines at different rates, so kernel bottlenecks move as hardware evolves. FlashAttention-4 exposed this imbalance inside attention on NVIDIA Blackwell. We test whether short polynomial programs can accelerate other special-function-unit (SFU) operations in large language models (LLMs). We first compare native PyTorch evaluation with packed fused multiply--add (FMA) programs in an isolated IEEE binary16 (FP16) sweep spanning L2-resident and high-bandwidth-memory (HBM)-resident working sets. We then replace native sigmoid, tanh, and sigmoid linear unit (SiLU) with degree-3 or degree-4 bfloat16 (BF16) programs in four GB200 integration tasks: dense SiLU, tanh-softcapped attention, sigmoid attention, and routed-expert Swish-gated linear unit (SwiGLU). The programs combine analytical symmetry, target-format rounding, and packed arithmetic inside consuming kernels. The isolated paths improve by 1.19--2.19x in L2 and 1.00--1.70x in HBM. The dense-SiLU, tanh-softcapped-attention, and routed-expert substitutions improve complete training-step throughput by 2.7\%, 2.9\%, and 8.0\%, respectively. The sigmoid-attention substitution improves complete-attention forward by 7.4\% and the complete GPU step by 0.3\%. Same-checkpoint open-weight ablations and one paired pre-training comparison per task extend the evaluation to model behavior. At common horizons near 100 billion tokens, the final smoothed training-loss differences (polynomial minus native) range from $-0.107$ to $+0.079$ across the four tasks.

</details>


### [291] [SW-KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Stieltjes-Wigert q-Orthogonal Polynomials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00050)
*Amirhosein Azarpour,Seyyed Moein Kazemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SW-KAN，用Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式在半无限域上构建KAN，通过tanh指数映射解决域不匹配，实现更优的精度-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始KAN基于B样条计算开销大；现有多项式KAN变体存在无界实数输入与正交多项式基有界/半无限支撑之间的域不匹配问题，该问题尚未被充分研究。

Method: 采用定义在半无限域(0, +∞)的Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式；引入平滑的exponential-of-tanh映射稳定桥接域差距并保持良态梯度；利用数值稳定的三项递推在O(N)复杂度内求值，无需特殊函数调用。

Result: 在图像分类与连续函数逼近实验中，SW-KAN取得更优的精度-效率权衡；在降低特征维度、训练数据有限的资源受限条件下仍保持稳健性能，优于现有多项式KAN基线，且能以极少参数逼近复杂多元函数。

Conclusion: SW-KAN凭借对数正态权重结构与可学习q参数带来的独特归纳偏置，成为资源受限场景下高效函数逼近与分类的有力替代方案。

Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a paradigmatic shift in deep learning by replacing fixed node activations with learnable univariate functions on edges, offering enhanced interpretability and parameter efficiency. While recent polynomial-based KAN variants have addressed the computational overhead of original B-spline implementations, they introduce a fundamental yet underexplored challenge: the domain mismatch between unbounded real-valued inputs and the bounded or semi-infinite support of orthogonal polynomial bases. To address this limitation, we propose the Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (SW-KAN), a novel architecture that employs Stieltjes-Wigert q-orthogonal polynomials defined on the semi-infinite domain (0, infinity). We introduce a smooth exponential-of-tanh mapping that stably bridges the domain gap while preserving well-conditioned gradients, and leverage a numerically stable three-term recurrence that evaluates polynomial expansions in O(N) operations without special-function calls. Through comprehensive experiments spanning image classification and continuous function approximation, we demonstrate that SW-KAN achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across diverse tasks. The log-normal weight structure and learnable q-parameter of Stieltjes-Wigert polynomials provide a distinct inductive bias that enables robust performance under resource-constrained conditions, including reduced feature dimensionality and limited training data. The proposed architecture not only outperforms established polynomial KAN baselines on standard benchmarks but also exhibits strong representational capacity for approximating complex multivariate functions with remarkably few parameters, making it a compelling alternative for efficient function approximation and classification in resource-constrained settings.

</details>


### [292] [Format-Aware Fusion for Fast FP4 Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00053)
*Robert Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出“格式感知融合”（format-aware fusion）方法，将每个量化生产端与其scale domain和消费端布局协同设计，支持native mxfp8、global nvfp8和CTA-local nvfp8三种方案。在Llama-3系列8B模型160B token预训练中，最快自定义路径达到37.9K tokens/s/GPU，超越bf16（18.8K）和Transformer Engine nvfp8（27.6K）；其中mxfp8配合行梯度随机舍入和固定符号32值Hadamard权重梯度预处理达到37.2K tokens/s/GPU（86.3% bf16模型FLOP利用率），训练损失终点仅高于bf16 2.11%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FP4 Tensor Core可加速矩阵乘法，但scale计算、操作数打包、布局构建以及反向传播状态的保存会抵消其收益。因此需要从量化生产者、scale域到消费者布局的整体协同设计，而非仅关注矩阵乘法本身。

Method: 提出format-aware fusion，将每个量化生产者与其scale domain及消费端布局协同设计，覆盖native mxfp8、global nvfp8和CTA-local nvfp8三种格式。在Llama-3系列8B预训练（160B tokens，bf16输出投影与编译交叉熵）上评估，并采用行梯度随机舍入与固定符号32值Hadamard权重梯度预处理。

Result: 同加速器匹配测试中，bf16和Transformer Engine nvfp8分别为18.8K和27.6K tokens/s/GPU，最快自定义路径达37.9K。mxfp8配合随机舍入与Hadamard预处理达37.2K tokens/s/GPU（86.3% bf16模型FLOP利用率），训练损失终点高于bf16仅2.11%。TE配方含四个最终bf16块时损失高0.87%，速度为27.1K tokens/s/GPU。下游任务排名与训练损失排名不一致。

Conclusion: FP4训练的实际效果取决于scale contract、操作数和执行路径三者的联合设计，而非单一格式选择；格式感知融合可显著提升吞吐并保持可接受的损失差距，且训练损失不能完全预测下游性能。

Abstract: Four-bit floating-point (FP4) Tensor Cores accelerate matrix multiplication, but scale computation, operand packing, layout construction, and saved backward state can erase the gain. We present \emph{format-aware fusion}, which co-designs each quantization producer with its scale domain and consumer layout for native \mxfp{}, global \nvfp{}, and cooperative-thread-array-local \nvfp{}. We evaluate Llama-3-family 8B pretraining through 160 billion tokens using bfloat16 output projections and compiled cross entropy. In matched same-accelerator probes, bfloat16 and Transformer Engine \nvfp{} reach 18.8K and 27.6K tokens/s/GPU, while our fastest custom route reaches 37.9K. \mxfp{} with row-gradient stochastic rounding and fixed-sign 32-value Hadamard weight-gradient preconditioning reaches 37.2K tokens/s/GPU (86.3\% bfloat16 model FLOP utilization) and ends 2.11\% above the raw bfloat16 training-loss endpoint. A Transformer Engine recipe with four final bfloat16 blocks ends 0.87\% above bfloat16 at 27.1K tokens/s/GPU. Downstream rankings differ from training-loss rankings, showing that FP4 outcomes depend jointly on scale contract, operand, and execution path.

</details>


### [293] ["very likely" Means "uncertain"? How LLMs Diverge from Humans in Linguistic Uncertainty Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00083)
*Jinhao Duan,Zicheng Liu,Zijie Liu,Kaidi Xu,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM与人类在言语不确定性表达上的差异，并提出一种基于优化的算法，从LLM输出中学习不确定性标记的最优映射，从而实现人类与LLM置信语义的直接比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类通过"可能""很可能"等言语标记表达不确定性，而现有LLM不确定性量化（UQ）多依赖代价高昂的似然或一致性信号；从认知视角看，准确的言语不确定性反映元认知监控，是"知道自己不知道"的知识边界表征，但LLM在此方面与人类的偏离尚不清楚，言语标记能否可靠量化LLM不确定性也有待验证。

Method: 构建来源于心理学与决策科学文献的人类不确定性标记语料库，并以此为基准测试LLM；随后提出一种基于优化的算法（METHODNAME），直接从LLM输出中学习不确定性标记上的最优不确定性分布，通过拟合标记—不确定性映射来最大化解释经验正确性，而非通过重复采样估计不确定性。

Result: 观察到LLM对言语不确定性所编码的数值水平与人类存在显著差异；METHODNAME实现了标记层级上人类与LLM置信语义的直接比较，能够解耦二者的错配并揭示言语表达中的系统性置信差异。

Conclusion: 言语不确定性标记可作为量化LLM不确定性的有效信号；METHODNAME提供了一种无需重复采样、可在标记层级比较人类与LLM置信语义的方法，揭示了二者之间的系统性置信差距。

Abstract: Humans express uncertainty verbally via markers (e.g., "possible," "likely"), yet most LLM uncertainty quantification (UQ) relies on costing likelihood- or consistency-based signals. From a cognitive perspective, accurate verbal uncertainty reflects metacognitive monitoring, representing knowledge boundaries ("knowing that you don't know") to support regulation and information seeking. In this paper, we investigate how LLMs diverge from humans in verbal uncertainty quantification and whether verbal markers can reliably quantify LLM uncertainty. We curate a corpus of human uncertainty markers from psychology and decision-science literature and benchmark LLMs against it. We observe that LLMs encode verbal uncertainty with numerical levels that differ substantially from those of humans. We then introduce METHODNAME, a novel optimization-based algorithm that learns an optimal uncertainty profile over uncertainty markers directly from LLM outputs. By fitting a marker-uncertainty mapping to best explain empirical correctness, METHODNAME discovers how much probability mass each verbal marker should convey, rather than estimating uncertainty via repeated sampling. METHODNAME enables a direct, marker-level comparison of confidence semantics between humans and LLMs, disentangling mismatch and revealing systematic confidence disparities in verbal expressions.

</details>


### [294] [Nous: Learning and Certifying Memory Decisions Before Source Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00094)
*Pranav Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文区分信念记忆中的"学习、校准与修订认证"三个问题，证明在隐马尔可夫族上，学习并认证有用决策所需样本量可比重建源可靠性少一个平方量级（O(l^-2) vs Theta(l^-4)），并在未知报告信道下给出有限样本证书与MiniGrid实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信念型智能体记忆需要可靠判定当前状态，但其证据可能含噪、被复制或已过时。已有工作通常假设必须先校准（重建）各来源可靠性才能改进决策，本文质疑这一前提，探究决策学习与认证是否可绕过源校准。

Method: 将问题拆分为学习、校准与修订认证三部分：在一个四模型隐马尔可夫族上给出学习未知贝叶斯决策、认证其相对信息性 incumbent 的改进、以及固定精度源估计的样本复杂度；推广到更广模型类以保留决策率与源下界；在未知"身份+背景"报告信道下刻画策略改进的锐利可识别区间，并基于可观测见证区域构造有限样本证书；扩展至有界历史依赖误设与条件复制；采用分训见证（split-trained witnesses）适配任意历史空间。

Result: 学习需 Theta(l^-2) 条记录，认证改进需 O(l^-2) 条同观测律新样本，而固定精度源估计需 Theta(l^-4)；即学习与认证可比源校准少用平方级样本。实验上，将策略界收据与 Nous Dimensions 结合，在 45,000 条留出的可变状态历史与三个外部 MiniGrid 记忆环境（引入含噪报告接口）的 9,000 个 episode 中测试：新证书接受 9/9（相对常数 incumbent）与 4/9（相对 last-write-wins）的改进，而旧证书在 MiniGrid 中为零；强基线推理方法仍具竞争力或更优。

Conclusion: 本文给出的是关于"何时可以在不恢复源可靠性的前提下学习并辩护记忆决策"的统计学解释，而非一个普适更优的记忆算法。

Abstract: Belief-based agent memory needs reliable decisions about current state, yet its evidence may be noisy, copied, or stale. Must a memory calibrate its sources before it can improve its decisions? We separate learning, calibration, and revision certification. On one four-model hidden Markov family, learning an unknown Bayes decision requires Theta(l^-2) records and certifying its improvement over an informative incumbent takes O(l^-2) fresh records from the same observation law, while fixed-precision source estimation requires Theta(l^-4) as persistence l vanishes. Thus learning and certifying useful decisions can require quadratically fewer records than source calibration. A broader model class retains the decision rate and source lower bound. Under an unknown identity-plus-background report channel, we characterize the sharp identified interval for policy improvement and derive a finite-sample certificate using observable witness regions, without pure-class anchors. A robustness extension tolerates bounded history-dependent misspecification and conditional copying; split-trained witnesses apply to arbitrary history spaces with explicit power conditions. We integrate policy-bound receipts with Nous Dimensions and test 45,000 held-out mutable-state histories and 9,000 episodes in three external MiniGrid memory environments with an introduced noisy-report interface. The new certificate accepts 9/9 improvements over a constant incumbent and 4/9 over last-write-wins, versus none for the earlier certificate in MiniGrid. Strong established inference baselines remain competitive or better. The result is a statistical account of when memory decisions can be learned and justified without recovering source reliability, not a universally superior memory algorithm.

</details>


### [295] [One Mastery Threshold Does Not Fit All Knowledge Tracing Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00095)
*Xianghui Meng,Yujing Zhang,Jionghao Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究检验六个知识追踪模型在四个公开数据集上的12个掌握阈值(0.50–0.99)，发现阈值的等效性依赖于底层KT模型：BKT对阈值不敏感，神经模型随阈值升高显著更严格；最优阈值随模型与教学情境变化，且严格阈值并不能可靠缩小成绩差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掌握阈值通常被视为可直接比较的数值参数，但当底层知识追踪(KT)模型不同时，同一阈值会导向非常不同的教学决策。研究动机在于检验阈值与KT模型、教学优先级之间的可迁移性，并揭示仅依赖单一阈值可能带来的进阶公平与练习负担问题。

Method: 在四个公开教育数据集上，对六个KT模型评估从0.50到0.99的12个阈值，采用四项指标：进阶后表现、进阶覆盖率、练习负担、不同先前表现群体的差异；并在30个预设教学情境下识别兼顾表现、额外练习与进阶的阈值。

Result: BKT对阈值变化相对不敏感，而神经模型随阈值提高变得更为严格，部分原因在于输出语义不同：BKT估计潜在掌握概率，神经模型估计下一次作答正确的概率，故同一截断值不代表相同掌握水平。最佳平衡阈值随模型与情境大幅变化；半数情境中神经模型与BKT所选阈值相差超过0.10，但当更重视减少额外练习、让更多学生进阶时差距缩小。更严格的阈值并未可靠缩小成绩差距，反而可能过度限制进阶，先前表现较强学生的进阶频率最高可达较弱学生的3.26倍。

Conclusion: 掌握阈值并非跨模型可比的通用常量，应随KT模型或教学优先级变化重新校准，并以其对表现、练习、进阶与机会获取的综合影响进行评价。

Abstract: Tutoring systems use mastery thresholds to decide when students can stop practicing and advance, but the same numerical threshold can lead to very different decisions when the underlying knowledge tracing (KT) model changes. We examine six KT models across four public educational datasets and evaluate 12 thresholds from 0.50 to 0.99 using post-advancement performance, advancement coverage, practice burden, and disparities across prior-performance groups. We also identify thresholds that balance performance, extra practice, and advancement under 30 predefined instructional settings. Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) is relatively insensitive to threshold changes, while neural models become much more selective as thresholds increase. This partly reflects different model outputs: BKT estimates latent mastery probability, whereas neural models estimate the probability of a correct next response, so the same cutoff does not represent the same level of mastery. The best-balanced threshold varied substantially across models and settings. In half of the tested settings, neural models and BKT differed by more than 0.10 in their selected thresholds, although this gap became smaller when greater priority was placed on reducing extra practice and allowing more students to advance. Stricter thresholds also did not reliably reduce performance gaps and could disproportionately restrict advancement, with stronger-prior students advancing up to 3.26 times as often as weaker-prior students. These results show that mastery thresholds should be recalibrated when the KT model or instructional priorities change and evaluated by their effects on performance, practice, advancement, and access.

</details>


### [296] [Uncertainty-Aware Learning from Multi-Expert Interval Targets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00102)
*Samira Alkaee Taleghan,Younghyun Koo,Andrew P. Barrett,Farnoush Banaei-Kashani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出保留个体专家区间标签的方法，将标签内不精确性与专家间分歧分解建模，并通过"分解匹配"验证预测不确定性成分对应关系，在海冰浓度任务上MAE降低31%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将多专家标签的两种不确定性来源（标签内不精确性、专家间变异）分开处理：多专家方法坍缩为共识标签，区间目标方法仅输出单点预测，预测不确定性方法很少用观察到的专家分歧来验证其不确定性估计。

Method: 1) 将异构标签词表统一到公共概率标签空间，分离编码差异与专家判断；2) 保留个体标签区间，用Beta混合分布建模，以proper Cramér distance为目标训练；3) 将预测不确定性分解为within-component、between-component和model uncertainty，并评估其是否分别对应标签内不确定性、标签间不确定性和模型误差；4) 引入decomposition matching，将预测成分对齐到预期标签侧来源。

Result: 在海冰浓度数据集上，相比硬标签MAE降低31%，并优于聚合、区间分布和区间回归等基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过保留个体专家区间并显式分离两类标签不确定性，配合分解匹配机制，可提升预测精度并使预测不确定性成分与真实标签侧不确定性来源对应。

Abstract: Many machine learning (ML) applications rely on expert labels, and qualified experts may provide different but plausible interpretations of the same observation. Such variation across expert labels may reflect genuine disagreement or ambiguity rather than annotation error. When individual experts additionally report intervals rather than exact values, the supervision contains two distinct sources of label uncertainty: within-label imprecision and between-expert variation. Existing methods treat these forms separately: multi-expert approaches collapse labels to a consensus, interval-target methods often yield a single prediction, and predictive-uncertainty methods rarely validate their uncertainty estimates against observed expert disagreement. To address this problem, we propose an approach that preserves individual expert intervals, separates within-label imprecision from between-expert variation, and validates the corresponding predictive uncertainty components. First, heterogeneous label vocabularies are harmonized into a common probabilistic label space, separating encoding differences from expert judgement. Second, individual label intervals are retained and modeled with a mixture of Beta distributions trained using a proper Cramér-distance objective, preserving distinct expert-reported labels. Third, we decompose predictive uncertainty into within-component, between-component, and model uncertainty, and evaluate whether these components correspond to within-label uncertainty, between-label uncertainty, and model error, respectively. Because this correspondence is not guaranteed, we introduce decomposition matching, which aligns the predictive components to their intended label-side sources. On sea-ice concentration the model reduces MAE by 31\% over hard labels and outperforms aggregation, interval-distribution, and interval-regression baselines.

</details>


### [297] [The Hidden Costs of 99% Accuracy: A Trustworthiness Audit of the Telco Customer Churn Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00118)
*Soumyadeep Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文审计IBM Telco客户流失基准的四大可信度缺陷：预拆分SMOTE导致F1虚高13.1个百分点（约36%合成点为测试集近邻插值）；TotalCharges与tenure×MonthlyCharges近似共线（R2=0.999）却仍被TreeSHAP高排，误导可解释性；校准审计中isotonic回归最优、温度缩放对加权树集成失效；成本最优阈值比F1最优阈值低5-10倍，每千客户节省约7.7万美元。跨域复现显示F1可泛化、F2仅在电信域泛化，并提出四要素报告清单。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IBM Telco流失基准上普遍报告95%以上、甚至99.01%的测试准确率，但此类以准确率和F1为中心的汇报掩盖了若干可信度问题，作者希望系统审计并揭示被忽视的缺陷。

Method: 针对四个问题分别设计审计：(1)对比预拆分SMOTE与类权重流水线，跨10个分类器、15个随机种子做Wilcoxon检验，并直接量化合成点与测试集的近邻插值比例；(2)分析TotalCharges与tenure×MonthlyCharges的共线性（R2）及其对TreeSHAP排序的干扰，提出R2>0.95的建模前诊断；(3)以15个种子做校准审计，比较isotonic回归与温度缩放；(4)在50美元挽留成本与24个月CLV假设下比较成本最优阈值与F1最优阈值；并在Iranian Telecom Churn（同域）与Bank Customer Churn（跨域）上复现F1、F2。

Result: (1)预拆分SMOTE使流失类F1虚高13.1个百分点（各分类器Wilcoxon p<10^-4），而类权重流水线无此膨胀，约36%合成训练点为测试集实例的近邻插值；(2)TotalCharges去除后准确率变化<0.2个百分点，但TreeSHAP仍将其排为第九，严重误导解释，R2>0.95诊断可识别；(3)isotonic回归为最强默认方法，温度缩放在概率分布双峰的加权树集成上失败；(4)成本最优阈值比F1最优阈值低约5-10倍，每千客户节省约77,000美元。

Conclusion: 论文将发现整合为四要素报告清单——流水线披露、冗余诊断、校准审计、成本敏感阈值，并发布可复现实现，以提升流失预测研究的可信度与实用性。

Abstract: Customer churn prediction on the IBM Telco Customer Churn benchmark (n = 7,043) routinely reports test accuracies above 95%, with the most cited published study reporting 99.01%. We audit this benchmark for four trustworthiness failures invisible to the accuracy- and F1-centred reporting that dominates the literature. First, pre-split SMOTE inflates churn-class F1 by 13.1 percentage points across ten classifiers and fifteen seeds (Wilcoxon p < 10^-4 per classifier); the same leaky pipeline ordering paired with class weighting yields no inflation, isolating the effect to SMOTE's geometric construction. We measure the mechanism directly: approximately 36% of synthetic training points are nearest-neighbour interpolations of test-set instances. Second, the TotalCharges field is approximately determined by tenure multiplied by MonthlyCharges (R2 = 0.999); removing it changes accuracy by less than 0.2 percentage points, yet TreeSHAP ranks it ninth in mean absolute attribution - a pattern that materially corrupts SHAP-based interpretation. We propose an R2 > 0.95 pre-modelling diagnostic. Third, in a 15-seed calibration audit, isotonic regression is the strongest default; temperature scaling fails on class-weighted tree ensembles whose predicted-probability distribution is bimodal. Fourth, the cost-optimal decision threshold (under a 50 USD retention offer and 24-month CLV proxy) is approximately 5-10 times lower than the F1-optimal threshold, saving approximately 77,000 USD per 1,000 customers. We replicate F1 and F2 on Iranian Telecom Churn (within domain) and Bank Customer Churn (across domain): F1 generalises; F2 generalises only within telecom. We synthesise these findings into a four-component reporting checklist - pipeline disclosure, redundancy diagnostic, calibration audit, and cost-sensitive thresholds - and release a reproducible implementation.

</details>


### [298] [Generalized Biomedicine Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00120)
*Luyao Tang,Yingkai Yang,Hanqi Chen,Jiewei Zheng,Chaoqi Chen,Cheng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出广义生物医学发现（GBD）任务与统一基准，覆盖长尾、异常与层级分类学发现；并提出认知启发的SCAN方法，通过预测抑制、惊奇诱发显著性与互补适应，在保留已知临床知识的同时提升新概念发现能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实临床医学图像存在开放世界偏移：长尾罕见病、被正常解剖结构主导的细微病灶、以及层级分类体系。然而多数开放世界范式假设标签空间是平坦且类别均衡的，无法满足这些生物医学需求。

Method: 核心洞见是主导性的已知模式构成一个视觉流形，从而掩盖了细微的新颖性。受专家诊断过程启发，提出SCAN（Surprise-evoked Complementary AccommodatioN），采用认知启发的感知递进流程：先用预测抑制过滤预期中的常态，再通过惊奇诱发显著性突出意外偏差，最后以互补适应将这些偏移整合进全局表示。

Result: 大量实验表明，SCAN在提升新概念发现的同时总体上能保留既有临床知识，并可嵌入现有架构，更好地权衡医学影像中的已知—未知取舍。

Conclusion: 该工作将开放世界医学图像分析统一为GBD问题并给出基准，SCAN作为一种即插即用的认知启发模块，为医学影像中的新概念发现与已知知识保持提供了有效方案。

Abstract: In real-world clinical practice, medical images face open-world shifts: (i) long-tailed rare diseases, (ii) subtle lesions dominated by normal anatomy, and (iii) hierarchical taxonomies. Yet most open-world paradigms assume flat, balanced label spaces, leaving these biomedical demands unresolved. We introduce Generalized Biomedicine Discovery (GBD) and a unified benchmark spanning long-tail, anomaly, and taxonomy-aware discovery. Our key insight is that dominant known patterns form a visual manifold that masks subtle novelty. Inspired by expert diagnosis, we propose SCAN (Surprise-evoked Complementary AccommodatioN), which follows a cognition-inspired perceptual progression: it applies predictive suppression to filter expected norms, triggers surprise-evoked salience to highlight unexpected deviations, and performs complementary accommodation to integrate these shifts into global representations. Extensive experiments show that SCAN improves novel concept discovery while generally preserving established clinical knowledge, and it plugs into existing architectures to better navigate the known-unknown trade-off in medical imaging. Code is available at https://github.com/lytang63/generalized-biomedicine-discovery.

</details>


### [299] [Classification Based on Association Rules Algorithm for Breast Cancer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00174)
*Ali Alsalama,Ahmed Kubba,Ghaith Jamjoum,Zaher Al Aghbari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于加权分类思想的关联规则数据挖掘方法，用于乳腺癌分类，包含规则生成、规则剪枝与规则预测三个核心算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乳腺癌是全球女性死亡的重要原因，发病率居各类癌症前列，早期检测需求迫切。关联规则挖掘能产生医学专业人员易于理解的结果，因此成为研究者青睐的分类方法。

Method: 采用基于加权分类的关联规则挖掘技术，实现三个核心算法：规则生成（识别频繁项集并生成关联规则）、规则剪枝（依据特定准则剔除规则，并按其对训练数据的影响力划分为主要与次要规则组）、规则预测（将剪枝后的规则应用于测试数据分类）。

Result: 在若干测试样本上验证了最终预测算法，展示了该方法的可行性与性能。

Conclusion: 该关联规则加权分类方法在乳腺癌分类任务中具备可行性，可为早期检测提供可解释的分类支持。

Abstract: Breast cancer is a significant contributor to female mortality across the world, displaying one of the highest oc currence rates among the various cancer types. In response to the need for early breast cancer detection, researchers have increasingly turned to association rule-based classification as a favored method. Association Rule mining is a data mining approach which offers the benefit of yielding results that are readily understandable for medical professionals. This paper introduces a novel association rule-based data mining technique for breast cancer classification based on a weighted classification approach. This implementation employs three core algorithms: Rule Generation, Rule Pruning, and Rule Prediction. Rule Generation identifies frequent itemsets and creates association rules. Rule Pruning eliminates rules using specific criteria and separates them into major and minor groups based on their influence on training data. Rule Prediction applies the pruned rules to classify test data. The final prediction algorithm was tested on several testing samples to show the feasibility and performance of the approach.

</details>


### [300] [Four Ways to Grow a Classifier and Why One of Them Cannot Learn](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00180)
*Cagri Temel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在统一协议下评估四种构造式分类器的“生长”决策，诊断出最自然的软决策树加深方式因梯度恒为零而完全无效，并给出简单随机扰动修复；其余三种决策各有取舍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构造式分类器在训练中不断添加结构（树的层级、隐藏单元、叶节点分裂），但这些生长决策究竟带来什么收益缺乏统一衡量。作者希望在同一固定协议下精确评估每种决策的收益，尤其是找出并修复其中“毫无收益”的一种。

Method: 对四种生长决策在树结构与构造式模型中采用统一实验协议。核心诊断针对软决策树最自然的加深方式：将每个叶节点变为门，两个子节点继承父节点类别分布（函数不变）。理论证明新门梯度恒为零，门为1/2时两子节点梯度相同。对比Net2Net的噪声打破对称、分裂最速下降用二阶信息逃离鞍点，此处一阶信息不是弱而是完全缺失。修复方法为对子节点施加小幅随机扰动。其余三种决策：用残差拟合新隐藏单元、分裂期望误差最大的叶、节点获得更强表达能力前要求统计显著性。

Result: 加深构造在三种子五折交叉验证下，相对同深度从头训练：Iris损失19.6、Wine损失19.1、Digits损失55.6个百分点。随机扰动修复有效且扰动大小几乎无关。残差拟合新隐藏单元：每个数据集上都得到更小网络，但并未更准确，在Digits上显著损失精度。最大期望误差叶分裂：获得稀疏性，用3.7次分裂达0.885，而完整深度六树需63次分裂，但在更难问题上损失4.3点。统计显著性要求：无收益，树更大且更不准确。

Conclusion: 四种生长决策中，最自然的软树加深方式一无所获（梯度缺失），需用随机扰动修复，并给出实用规则：添加参数后断言其梯度非零。残差拟合买来更小网络（非更准），误差最大叶分裂买来稀疏性（有精度代价），显著性检验毫无收益。所有数值均由测量脚本插入。

Abstract: Constructive classifiers add structure while they train: a level to a tree, a unit to a hidden layer, a split at a leaf. This paper asks what each of four such growth decisions actually buys, measured under one fixed protocol in tree-structured and constructive models, and gives an exact diagnosis and a fix for the one that buys nothing.
  The diagnosis concerns the most natural way to deepen a soft decision tree: turn every leaf into a gate whose two children inherit the parent's class distribution, so that the function is unchanged. I prove that this leaves the gradient of every new gate identically zero and, with the gate at 1/2, gives the two children identical gradients, so the added level can never learn. Unlike the symmetry that Net2Net breaks with noise or the saddle point that splitting steepest descent escapes with second-order information, first-order information here is not weak but absent. Over three seeds of five-fold cross-validation the construction loses 19.6 accuracy points on Iris, 19.1 on Wine and 55.6 on Digits against the same depth trained from scratch. The fix is a small random perturbation of the children, whose size barely matters. The practical rule is one line in a test: after adding parameters, assert that their gradient is nonzero.
  The other three decisions each buy one thing. Fitting a new hidden unit to the residual error before installing it buys a smaller network on every dataset, though not a more accurate one, and on Digits it costs accuracy significantly. Splitting the leaf with the largest expected error buys sparsity, reaching 0.885 with 3.7 splits where a complete depth-six tree uses 63, but loses 4.3 points on a harder problem. Requiring statistical significance before a node receives a more expressive split buys nothing: the tree gets larger and less accurate.
  Every number in the paper is inserted from the measurement script.

</details>


### [301] [Uncertainty-Aware RL-Controlled Adaptive 3D Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00188)
*Alpay Ozkan,Tunc Ozan Aydin,Marc Pollefeys,Jelena Trisovic,Daniel Barath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于语义熵、几何曲率和纹理丰富度的自适应体素细分框架，并用强化学习在内存预算约束下学习细分策略，实现显式内存-精度权衡，优于MAP-ADAPT和固定分辨率基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 体素化体积建图是三维重建的基础，但固定分辨率网格本质低效：均匀区域浪费内存、复杂区域丢失细节。现有自适应方法（如MAP-ADAPT）依赖几何与用户定义的语义类别列表，需专家调参、难以泛化到未见物体，且缺乏显式内存控制机制。

Method: 以语义熵（捕捉标签不确定性）、几何曲率和纹理丰富度作为场景复杂度线索进行体素细分，实现不依赖语义分类体系的有原则的分辨率分配；进一步引入强化学习智能体，在用户指定的目标内存预算下学习体素细分策略，以单一直观控制参数替代手工阈值，生成多分辨率TSDF。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，相比MAP-ADAPT与固定分辨率基线，多分辨率TSDF取得更高的几何精度、更好的语义一致性以及更优的内存-精度权衡。

Conclusion: 该框架通过语义熵等多线索驱动细分并以强化学习实现用户可控的内存预算，为自适应体积建图提供了无需分类体系、泛化性更强且内存可控的方案，代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Voxel-based volumetric mapping is fundamental to 3D reconstruction, yet fixed-resolution grids remain inherently inefficient - wasting memory in uniform regions and losing detail in complex ones. Existing adaptive methods, such as MAP-ADAPT, partially address this by varying resolution based on geometry and user-defined semantic class lists, but these heuristics require expert tuning, lack generalization to unseen objects, and provide no explicit mechanism to control memory usage. We propose an adaptive framework that refines voxels based on semantic entropy, which captures label uncertainty, together with geometric curvature and texture richness as scene complexity cues, yielding principled resolution allocation without reliance on semantic taxonomies.
