LOOM stabilizes recurrence by scaling residual updates to bound variance growth and re-injecting the input embedding at every loop, and diversifies it through per-loop routers that engage different experts and a Looping Residual that carries earlier outputs forward. Experiments across 100M-1.7B models show stable scaling to 9-12 loops. Under near-iso-FLOP, the 700M model performs best at 5 loops, reducing perplexity from 18.36 to 16.54 and improving average zero-shot accuracy from 38.84% to 39.53% over the non-looped baseline. Without FLOP matching, the 1.7B model trained on 60B tokens peaks at 9 loops, reducing perplexity from 9.62 to 7.77 and improving average zero-shot accuracy from 42.4% to 47.7%. Code is available https://github.com/hed-ucas/LOOM.

</details>


### [436] [Latent JEPA: Abstract Future Prediction for Latent Reasoning in Chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01947)
*Xinjian Zhao,Yaoyao Xu,Xuemin Chen,Xiaozhuang Song,Tianshu Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Latent JEPA框架，将自回归学习与联合嵌入预测结合，用连续潜在思维预测未来解的信息性方面，在化学推理任务上取得提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化学直觉能在解法细节完全展开前提供对可能结果的初步判断。受此启发，作者希望研究连续潜在思维如何被训练来预测未来解的信息性方面，而无需将每个中间步骤都言语化。

Method: 提出Latent JEPA框架，将自回归学习与一个或多个未来视图的联合嵌入预测相结合；针对化学推理设计文本与分子预测目标，把潜在思维与后续推理及分子结果联系起来。

Result: 在ChemCoTBench上分子优化任务取得提升，并在若干编辑和反应指标上有所改善；表征分析显示未来预测使潜在思维对分子结果更具信息性，并增强其与化学结构的对应关系。

Conclusion: 抽象的未来预测可作为连接连续潜在推理与科学结果的学习原则。

Abstract: Large language models offer a promising foundation for chemical reasoning, bringing together chemical knowledge and multistep problem solving. Chemical intuition can provide an initial sense of plausible outcomes before the details of a solution are fully worked out. Inspired by how such expectations complement explicit analysis, we study how continuous latent thoughts can be trained to anticipate informative aspects of future solutions without verbalizing every intermediate step. We introduce Latent JEPA, a framework that combines autoregressive learning with joint-embedding prediction of one or more future views. For chemical reasoning, we develop textual and molecular prediction objectives that connect latent thoughts to both subsequent reasoning and molecular outcomes. Experiments on ChemCoTBench show gains in molecular optimization and on several editing and reaction metrics. Representation analyses show that future prediction makes latent thoughts more informative about molecular outcomes and strengthens their correspondence with chemical structure. These findings support abstract future prediction as a learning principle for connecting continuous latent reasoning with scientific outcomes.

</details>


### [437] [Detect, Explain, Interpret: An End-to-End Benchmark for Time Series Anomaly Detection, Explainability and Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01168)
*Roberto Stanzione,Jules Barbe,Magali Parrino,Jérémie Fourmann,Paul Boniol*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SHAD——一个由215条真实云存储系统多变量高维时间序列组成、带丰富语义标注的异常检测基准，并系统评测了检测、可解释性与可理解性三类基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测方法大多与领域语境脱节，忽视可解释性与可理解性；原因是当前基准主要关注检测精度，较少评估空间可解释性，且没有基准提供足够丰富的语义标注来生成人类可理解的异常解释。

Method: 构建SHAD基准，包含来自Scality真实分布式云存储系统的215条多变量高维时间序列，配有丰富上下文信息，覆盖三类不同严重程度的异常；并建立覆盖TSAD全流程的基线评测框架：检测阶段评测多种现有异常检测器，可解释性阶段评估各维度对异常分数贡献是否能给出准确异常归因，可理解性阶段考察冻结LLM基线在异常定位与解释上的有效性。

Result: 提供了带完整标注的真实世界高维时间序列数据集，并在检测、可解释性和可理解性三个维度上给出了系统性基线评测结果，为后续研究奠定基础。

Conclusion: SHAD通过丰富语义标注弥补了现有基准在可解释性与可理解性评估上的不足，为面向真实场景的TSAD全流程研究提供了统一评测平台。

Abstract: Time Series Anomaly Detection has received increasing attention, driven by the growing availability of complex time series data. This surge has led to the development of numerous detection methods, as well as a variety of benchmarks aimed at thoroughly evaluating their performance. However, most existing detectors remain largely agnostic to domain context, overlooking explainability and interpretability. One of the main reasons for this gap is that current benchmarks primarily focus on detection accuracy, and only few of them evaluate spatial explainability. Moreover, no benchmark currently provides sufficiently rich semantic annotations to support the generation of human-understandable interpretations of anomalies. To address these limitations, we introduce SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection benchmark), a fully annotated benchmark composed of 215 multivariate, high-dimensional time series collected from real-world distributed cloud storage systems operated by Scality. The proposed dataset includes rich contextual information, covering three families of anomalies with varying degrees of severity. As further contribution, we provide a foundation for future work by evaluating baseline methods for Detection, Explainability, and Interpretability, covering all stages of a TSAD pipeline. For Detection, we benchmark a wide range of existing anomaly detectors, testing their effectiveness on the proposed real-world dataset. Then, we consider explainability by evaluating whether measuring the contribution of each dimension in the generated anomaly score can provide accurate anomaly attributions. Finally, for interpretability, we investigate the effectiveness of frozen LLM baselines in localizing and interpreting anomalies.

</details>


### [438] [Learning Rate Transfer for Hybrid Transformer-SSM Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01172)
*Jimin Seo,Gyubok Lee,Yeonsik Jo,Kiwoong Yoo,Yeongoon Kim,Minhae Oh,Jin Woo Koo,Suhwan Kim,Nakyung Lee,Minsik Seol,Idris Nechnech,Jaehyeon Kim,Giho Lee,Jungwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer与SSM混合架构的学习率缩放问题，发现在实际实现中仅用原始μP处方即可实现近乎零的学习率迁移差距，并将其归因于全局更新-权重不变性与AdamW局部逐分量平衡两个条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SSM在无限宽度、状态尺寸增长、零阶保持离散化下的理论缩放规则，与业界实际使用固定状态尺寸的简化ZOH Mamba实现之间存在明显差距。此外，SSM操作不在μP的Tensor Programs可表示条件内，且所测参数化都未通过μP的坐标检验诊断，因此需要厘清混合架构中学习率缩放的实际行为。

Method: 在宽度256–2048、深度4–32、直至十亿参数规模的混合架构上，仅使用原始μP处方进行学习率迁移实验；测试多种参数化并执行标准坐标检验诊断；通过跨深度、序列长度、批次大小及Transformer-to-SSM比例的变化验证宽度不变性。

Result: 混合架构在宽度256–2048、深度4–32直至十亿参数规模下实现近乎零的学习率迁移差距；最优学习率在宽度上保持8倍范围内不变，且该不变性跨深度、序列长度、批次大小和Transformer-to-SSM比例成立，并迁移到生产级混合模型Nemotron-H。

Conclusion: 混合架构的学习率迁移可由两条件分解解释：μP的初始化与学习率缩放提供全局更新-权重不变性，AdamW的逐参数归一化提供局部逐分量平衡。研究填补了理论缩放规则与实际混合实现之间的差距，并鼓励进一步研究以弥合这一鸿沟。

Abstract: We study learning rate (LR) scaling for hybrid architectures combining Transformer and State-Space Model (SSM) blocks, a class adopted by several recent production language models. In particular, we focus on the gap between the theoretical scaling rules derived for SSMs under zero-order-hold (ZOH) discretization at infinite width with growing state size, and the field-standard practical implementations using simplified-ZOH Mamba at fixed state size. Surprisingly, in this practical regime hybrid architectures achieve a near-zero LR transfer gap across widths 256-2048 and depths 4-32 up to billion-parameter scale using only the original $μ$P prescription, even though SSM operations fall outside its Tensor Programs representability conditions and every parameterization we test fails the standard coordinate-check diagnostic of $μ$P correctness. We attribute this to a two-condition decomposition of LR transfer in hybrid architectures: a global update-to-weight invariance, enforced by $μ$P's initialization and LR scaling; and a local per-component balance, provided by AdamW's per-parameter normalization. Our observations show that the optimal LR is invariant to width up to 8$\times$, that this width invariance holds across depth, sequence length, batch size, and Transformer-to-SSM ratio, and that it transfers to Nemotron-H, a production hybrid outside our custom architecture set. We hope these findings fill the gap between theoretical scaling rules and practical hybrid implementations, and stimulate further research toward bridging it.

</details>


### [439] [CAGE-NAS: Certified Functional Descent for Efficient Model Growth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01173)
*Santiago Florido Gomez,Stéphane Rivaud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CAGE-NAS 通过函数空间中的可容许性判据决定神经网络表示是否继续增长：当表示能够支持经认证的函数梯度下降步时保持架构不变，否则执行保函数扩展并重新评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 渐进式增长的神经网络需要判断当前表示对于优化是否仍然充分，以及何时应当扩展。现有做法缺乏对"何时增长"这一决策的原则性刻画。

Method: 将增长决策形式化到函数空间，对函数梯度的近似施加可容许性判据。只要表示能实现经认证的函数梯度下降步，架构固定；判据失败时施加保函数扩展并再次评估。作为主要实例，研究切空间诱导的表示族，并使用函数梯度的正则化投影。

Result: 在具有精确认证的受控设置下，CAGE-NAS 生成的架构在同参数预算内所有可容许方案中，其留出集 RMSE 位于性能第 99.8 百分位以上，且增长轨迹中无需枚举这些方案。

Conclusion: 以函数梯度可容许性为核心的判据为网络增长提供了原则性决策依据，并在受控条件下展现出显著优越的性能定位。

Abstract: The progressive growth of neural networks requires deciding when the current representation remains sufficient for optimization and when it should be expanded. CAGE-NAS formulates this decision in function space through an admissibility criterion on approximations of the functional gradient. As long as a representation enables a certified Functional Gradient Descent step, the architecture remains fixed; when the criterion fails, a function-preserving expansion is applied and the resulting representation is evaluated again. As the main instance, we study the family induced by the tangent space, using a regularized projection of the functional gradient. In a controlled setting with exact certification, CAGE-NAS produces architectures positioned above the 99.8th performance percentile by held-out RMSE among all admissible alternatives within the same parameter budget, without enumerating them during the growth trajectory.

</details>


### [440] [CARM: Cancellation-Aware Response Masking for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02039)
*Yafei Zhang,Songshuo Lu,Sicong Liao,Zhi Chen,Yaohua Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CARM（Cancellation-Aware Response Masking），通过先取token对数比绝对值再平均的序列级掩码，防止正负概率漂移相互抵消，从而更可靠地控制LLM强化学习中的off-policy问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM后训练中强化学习广泛应用，但策略更新及rollout与训练引擎的差异会导致采样响应off-policy。常用的序列级掩码基于长度归一化的几何平均token概率比，其带符号的对数比会在不同位置相互抵消，掩盖双向策略漂移，导致掩码判断失真。

Method: 提出Cancellation-Aware Response Masking（CARM），在平均前对每个token的对数比取绝对值，避免相反方向概率变化抵消；并从理论上证明被接受的响应满足采样token比率落在规定区间外的比例与其边界外平均对数距离的联合界。

Result: 在数学推理与代码生成任务上，CARM在AIME 2024/2025/2026与BeyondAIME上的平均mean@16较几何平均掩码最高提升3.13个百分点；在四个代码基准上的平均pass@1较最强基线提升2.88个百分点。

Conclusion: 实验支持CARM是一种有理论支撑且有效的响应级off-policy控制方法，适用于LLM强化学习后训练。

Abstract: Recent years have witnessed the rapid adoption of reinforcement learning (RL) in large language model (LLM) post-training, with substantial gains in mathematical reasoning and code generation. In practical systems, however, policy updates and differences between rollout and training engines can make sampled responses off-policy. Sequence-level masking addresses this mismatch by deciding whether an entire response should contribute to optimization. A common masking rule uses the length-normalized geometric mean of sampled token probability ratios. Its signed log-ratios can cancel across positions, concealing substantial bidirectional policy drift. We propose \emph{Cancellation-Aware Response Masking} (CARM), a sequence-level mask that takes the absolute value of each token log-ratio before averaging, preventing opposing probability changes from canceling. We prove that accepted responses satisfy a joint bound on the fraction of sampled-token ratios outside a prescribed band and their mean log-distance beyond its boundaries. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that CARM improves mean@16 averaged over AIME 2024/2025/2026 and BeyondAIME by up to $3.13$ percentage points over geometric-mean masking, and increases average pass@1 across four code benchmarks by $2.88$ points over the strongest evaluated baseline. These findings support CARM as a theoretically grounded and effective method for response-level off-policy control in LLM reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [441] [Rethinking the Information Bottleneck: Structured Decomposition under Label-Induced Partitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01175)
*Jingyao Zhang,Yuxuan Li,Lu Han,Ali Anaissi,Nguyen H. Tran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对标准信息瓶颈（IB）以单一标量I(Z;X)统一约束表示、无法区分任务相关结构与干扰性条件内变异的缺陷，提出基于标签诱导划分的结构化视角，构建双瓶颈（dual-bottleneck）正则化：用标准KL项控制全局信息容量，用条件KL项约束条件内信息。条件KL可精确分解为条件内信息项与先验失配项，配合单纯形结构条件先验可实现可控的潜在几何，并易于嵌入现有流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准IB正则化仅通过单个标量I(Z;X)约束表示，隐含地将所有信息视为同质，导致标签相关结构与条件内残余变异（如医学影像中的采集条件、背景因素、个体外观差异）被耦合在一起，无法独立调控其分配，使冗余/干扰信息滞留于表示中。该问题在数据受限场景尤为突出，模型易过拟合此类变异而损害泛化。现有正则化方法虽能稳定训练、控制容量或塑造表示几何，但均未显式分离类干扰变异与任务支撑结构。

Method: 作者从基于标签诱导划分（label-induced partition）的结构化视角重新审视IB，将条件级结构与条件内信息赋予不同角色，提出双瓶颈公式：一个标准KL项控制全局信息容量，另一个条件KL项针对条件内信息。理论上证明条件KL可精确分解为条件内信息项与先验失配（prior-mismatch）项，从而解释其与设计目标的对齐性。采用单纯形结构（simplex-structured）的条件先验，使潜空间几何可控，并可无缝集成到现有流程中。

Result: 在分类与分割任务上进行实验，在低数据分类场景取得最明显增益，并在密集预测基准上获得一致性提升。

Conclusion: 通过引入条件KL构成的双瓶颈正则化，该方法在理论上实现了条件内信息的显式分离与可控潜在几何，在实践中尤其改善数据受限下的分类泛化，并对密集预测任务带来稳定增益，为IB正则化提供了结构化、可插拔的改进方案。

Abstract: Standard information bottleneck (IB) regularization constrains representations via a single scalar I(Z;X), implicitlytreating all information as homogeneous. However, a single global compression control couples label-relevant structurewith residual within-condition variation, rather than regulating their allocation independently, allowing nuisanceinformation to persist in learned representations. For example, in medical imaging applications, residual variation oftenstems from acquisition conditions, background factors, or subject-specific appearance. This issue becomes particularlypronounced in data-limited settings, where models tend to overfit such variation, hindering generalization. While existingregularization methods can stabilize training, control capacity, or shape representation geometry, they do not explicitlyseparate nuisance-like variation from task-supporting structure. To address this limitation, we revisit IB from a structuredperspective based on a label-induced partition, where condition-level structure and within-condition information playdistinct roles. This leads to a dual-bottleneck formulation: a standard KL term controls global information capacity, while aconditional KL term targets within-condition information. We show that the conditional KL admits an exact decompositioninto a within-condition information term and a prior-mismatch term, explaining its alignment with the design objective.With a simplex-structured conditional prior, the method provides controllable latent geometry and integrates seamlesslyinto existing pipelines. Experiments on classification and segmentation show the clearest gains in low-data classificationand consistent improvements across dense prediction benchmarks.

</details>


### [442] [Fully Online Decentralized Learning in Stochastic Games with Unknown Independent Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01181)
*S. Rasoul Etesami*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对具有独立受控链与未知转移核的随机博弈，提出一种完全在线、去中心化、非协调的镜像下降算法，在占用测度对偶空间中逼近平稳纳什均衡，并获得 $O(T^{-1/2})$ 的固定比较器遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有随机博弈学习算法通常需要联合状态空间覆盖、同步回合或中心化协调，且复杂度随玩家数与联合状态/动作空间规模指数增长；本文希望在仅观测局部状态与实现收益、转移核未知的条件下实现可扩展的在线学习。

Method: 算法为完全在线、去中心化且非协调的镜像下降方法，在占用测度的对偶空间中运行；每个原始时间步仅使用单个转移/收益样本，仅依赖局部信息，无需联合状态空间覆盖，也无需同步回合。

Result: 在均匀遍历性与有限覆盖假设下，高概率给出时间平均固定比较器遗憾以典型 $O(T^{-1/2})$ 速率衰减（忽略对数因子与多项式依赖）。复杂度取决于各局部状态空间的覆盖时间，而非乘积状态空间，避免了对玩家数及联合状态、动作空间规模的指数依赖。该有限时间遗憾界进一步导出近似粗相关均衡保证。在额外全局变分稳定性条件下，同一算法在最后迭代渐近收敛到平稳 $\epsilon$-纳什均衡。

Conclusion: 本文为未知独立链随机博弈提供了完全在线且可扩展的学习框架；算法可视为一种利用玩家受控转移链独立性与局部结构的马尔可夫博弈原始-对偶框架。

Abstract: We consider stochastic games with independent controlled chains and unknown transition kernels, where players observe only their local states and realized payoffs. We develop a fully online, decentralized, and uncoordinated mirror-descent algorithm that operates in the dual space of occupancy measures for approximating stationary Nash equilibrium (NE) policies. The algorithm uses a single transition/reward sample at every primitive time step, relies only on local information, and requires neither coverage of the joint state space nor synchronized episodes. Under uniform-ergodicity and finite-coverage assumptions, we show that, with high probability, the time-averaged fixed-comparator regret decays at the canonical $O(T^{-1/2})$ rate, up to logarithmic factors and polynomial dependence on the game parameters. In particular, the complexity depends on the cover times of the individual local state spaces rather than the product state space, avoiding exponential dependence on the number of players and the sizes of the joint state and action spaces. The resulting finite-time regret bound further yields an approximate coarse-correlated-equilibrium guarantee, which is natural for arbitrary reward functions since computing a stationary $ε$-NE is PPAD-hard in this setting. Under an additional global variational-stability condition, we show that the same fully online algorithm converges asymptotically in the last iterate to a stationary $ε$-NE. Our results provide a fully online and scalable learning framework for stochastic games with unknown independent chains. The algorithm can also be viewed as a primal-dual framework for Markov games that exploits the independence and local structure of the players' controlled transition chains.

</details>


### [443] [Counterfactual Generation via Flow Matching: Coupling-Sensitive End-to-End Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01193)
*Yunrui Guan,Krishnakumar Balasubramanian,Shiva Prasad Kasiviswanathan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于流匹配的反事实生成方法，通过样本分割双稳健训练目标与学习式源-目标耦合，结合带分数修正的随机采样器，实现了有限步生成，并给出耦合敏感的KL误差界与端到端有限样本保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反事实生成需在事实分配机制下采集的观测数据中，采样假设干预或决策下的结果。现有方法在有限离散步数下的生成误差控制、以及从数据估计结果模型与耦合时的有限样本理论保证方面仍不充分，尤其缺乏对耦合结构敏感的误差刻画。

Method: 1) 流匹配框架：结合样本分割的双稳健训练目标，并学习观测源结果与来自拟合条件结果模型的目标结果之间的耦合；2) 采样：基于高斯平滑插值的分数修正随机采样器，支持有限步生成；3) 理论：建立常步Euler离散化的耦合敏感KL界，误差由所选耦合下源-目标位移的矩控制，对环境的维度近似线性依赖；4) 在条件结果模型与源-目标耦合均从数据估计时，给出学习速度场与分数场的有限样本非参数保证。

Result: 理论上，耦合敏感KL界表明误差受耦合下源-目标位移矩控制而非速度场全局一致正则性，且对维度近似线性；有限样本界将近似误差、耦合替换误差、冗余参数估计误差、泛化误差与蒙特卡洛误差分离，结合采样器分析得到反事实生成的端到端保证。实验上，合成与半合成图像基准支持耦合依赖理论，并显示在有限离散预算下随机采样器可优于对应的确定性ODE采样器。

Conclusion: 该工作将流匹配、双稳健估计与学习式耦合统一于反事实生成，提供了耦合敏感的离散化误差理论与端到端有限样本保证，并在实验中验证了耦合依赖性与随机采样器在有限步预算下的优势。

Abstract: Counterfactual generation seeks to sample outcomes under a hypothetical intervention or decision using observational data collected under the factual assignment mechanism. We develop a flow-matching approach that combines a sample-split, doubly robust training objective with a learned coupling between observed source outcomes and target outcomes drawn from a fitted conditional outcome model. To enable finite-step generation, we leverage a score-corrected stochastic sampler based on a Gaussian-smoothed interpolation. Our main theoretical contribution is a coupling-sensitive KL bound for constant-step Euler discretization: the error is controlled by moments of the source--target displacement under the chosen coupling, rather than by global uniform regularity of the velocity field, and has near-linear dependence on the ambient dimension. We also establish finite-sample non-parametric guarantees for the learned velocity and score fields when both the conditional outcome model and the source-target coupling are estimated from data. These bounds separate approximation, coupling-replacement, nuisance-estimation, generalization, and Monte Carlo errors and, combined with the sampler analysis, yield an end-to-end guarantee for counterfactual generation. Experiments on synthetic and semi-synthetic image benchmarks support the coupling-dependent theory and show that, at finite discretization budgets, the stochastic sampler can outperform the corresponding deterministic ODE sampler.

</details>


### [444] [Finetuning with Sampling: SFT Learns Better Than You Think](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02140)
*Aayush Karan,Sitan Chen,Yilun Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种MCMC采样算法，将离策略轨迹逐步转化为更接近在策略的分布，从而让SFT在获得新能力时既能泛化又能减少遗忘，媲美主流后训练方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练主要依赖SFT与RL：通常认为RL泛化强、遗忘少，但只能靠模型自身反复采样寻找成功轨迹；SFT可学习离策略专家数据，却泛化弱且易灾难性遗忘。本文希望同时利用在策略学习的优势与离策略数据中的特权信息。

Method: 不修改学习目标，而是调整数据分布以适配学习器。引入马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样算法，在给定参考模型的条件下，逐步把离策略轨迹变换为更接近在策略的轨迹，再用于微调（SFT）。

Result: 在科学技能获取、数学推理与开放式专业知识等任务上，该采样算法使SFT能够与主流后训练技术相抗衡，且往往比强在策略基线泛化更好、遗忘更少；微调后模型展现出较强的分布性能，并能超越对基座模型分布的简单锐化。

Conclusion: 该工作将采样视为一种模型原生的算子，用于塑造数据的可学习性，可作为后训练流程中通用基础原语，具有更广泛的适用性。

Abstract: Introducing new capabilities to frontier models has long been the goal of posttraining, which predominantly employs supervised finetuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) to this end. Conventional wisdom dictates that RL enables strong generalization on new tasks without losing existing capabilities, while SFT is prone to weak generalization and catastrophic forgetting. At the same time, SFT can learn from off-policy expert data, whereas RL must rely on a model's ability to find successful trajectories with repeated sampling. In our work, we seek to leverage the strength of on-policy learning while utilizing the privileged information contained in off-policy data. However, rather than modifying the learning objective to accommodate this data, we instead tailor the data distribution to better suit the learner. We introduce a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling algorithm that progressively transforms off-policy traces to be more on-policy given a reference model for finetuning. Across tasks like scientific skill acquisition, mathematical reasoning, and open-ended expertise, our sampling algorithm enables SFT to rival prevailing posttraining techniques, often generalizing better and forgetting less than strong on-policy baselines. In addition, the resulting finetuned models exhibit strong distributional performance and are capable of learning beyond sharpening the base model distribution. At a higher level, our approach presents sampling as a model-native operator that shapes data for learnability, offering broader utility as a general-purpose primitive throughout the posttraining stack.

</details>


### [445] [Low-Budget Active Learning through Entropic Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01199)
*Rim Hajal,Mathieu Besançon,Jérôme Malick*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于熵最优传输（Sinkhorn散度）的coreset选择准则，用于低预算主动学习，兼具无维样本复杂度保证、高效梯度计算与可证明解质量，在图像与医学数据上优于现有启发式方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在标注需昂贵专家介入的场景（如医学应用）中，只能选择极少量样本（coreset）进行标注训练，因此需要高效且质量有保证的低预算主动学习方法。

Method: 利用预训练自监督模型提取的特征表示数据，在特征空间中直接进行coreset选择；采用熵最优传输中的Sinkhorn散度作为选择准则，从而获得无维样本复杂度结果并支持高效梯度计算；使用基于梯度的算法快速求解候选解，再以基于交换的局部搜索进行改进，并提供解质量保证。

Result: 在图像基准和医学数据集上的实验表明，该方法在低预算设定下优于当前最先进的启发式方法。

Conclusion: Sinkhorn散度准则结合梯度优化与交换局部搜索，为低预算主动学习提供了高效、可证明且实验表现优越的coreset选择方案。

Abstract: We consider low-budget active learning, which consists of selecting a limited number of points, the coreset, such that a model can be trained to high accuracy on the selection only. This problem is particularly relevant in contexts where labeling requires costly expert intervention, as in medical applications. We leverage features extracted from a pretrained self-supervised model to represent the data, and perform coreset selection directly in this feature space. In this paper, we use entropic optimal transport, specifically the Sinkhorn divergence, as the coreset selection criterion, which first allows us to get dimension-free sample complexity results, and second admits computationally efficient gradient evaluations. This opens the way to using gradient-based algorithms to rapidly compute solution candidates, further improved by a swap-based local search, with guarantees on the solution quality. Experiments on image benchmarks and medical datasets show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art heuristics in low-budget settings.

</details>


### [446] [Every Ablation Is a Dose: Counterweights and the Semblance of Self-Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02173)
*Areeb Ahmad,Pratinav Seth,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自修复现象存在单一机制：消融前已存在的增益。作者证明细粒度单元的反事实因果修复响应服从仿射定律 E_r(λ)=own_r+γ_rλ，斜率γ_r是由固定权重决定、与是否消融无关的稳定系数，其符号决定该单元是抵消还是强化被移除信号；"自修复"实为反权重（counterweight）在对比信号于核心涌现时的常规操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型中被消融的组件常被其他组件补偿（自修复），此现象被反复观察但机制不明。此前最系统的研究结论认为自修复是噪声性的、不太可能有单一解释。作者则主张存在唯一解释。

Method: 将任何对因果重要组件的干预视为坐标轴λ上的一点（反事实对比的有符号强度），指出传统消融方法只是该轴上未校准的点；提出并检验细粒度单元r的因果修复响应满足仿射定律 E_r(λ)=own_r+γ_rλ，其中γ_r为固定系数，并尝试从固定权重预测γ_r的量级。实验在四类模型（Gemma、Qwen、LLaMA、Mistral）的事实判定任务及GPT-2 Small的IOI电路上进行，覆盖MLP神经元、OV神经元与奇异方向等组件。

Result: 在四类模型的事实判定任务中，81个下游方向里有68个（含MLP神经元、OV神经元、奇异方向）遵循该仿射定律；且γ_r的量级可由固定权重预先预测。在GPT-2 Small的IOI电路上，干预可触及的10个注意力头中有7个遵循该定律，且这7个全部为反权重。

Conclusion: 自修复并非噪声性、多因的现象，而是由消融前已存在的固定增益（斜率γ_r）决定的单一机制；所谓自修复，本质上是反权重在对比信号于核心涌现时执行其常规操作。

Abstract: Ablate a component of a language model, and other components often appear to adjust and compensate. This phenomenon, termed self-repair, has been observed repeatedly, but its mechanism remains unclear. The most systematic study to date concluded that self-repair is noisy and unlikely to have a single explanation. We argue that it has one: a gain already present before any ablation. Any intervention on a causally important component can be viewed as a point on a coordinate axis $λ$, the signed strength of a counterfactual contrast. Hence, conventional ablation methods are uncalibrated points on this axis. We show that the causal repair response for a fine-grained unit $r$ is governed by an affine law, $E_r(λ)=\mathrm{own}_r+γ_rλ$. The slope $γ_r$ is a fixed coefficient that consistently influences the model, with or without ablation, and its sign determines whether the unit counteracts or reinforces the removed signal. On a factual-verdict task across four models from distinct families (Gemma, Qwen, LLaMA, and Mistral), we identify components including MLP neurons, OV neurons, and singular directions that follow this affine law, 68 of 81 downstream directions in all. Moreover, we can anticipate the magnitude of $γ_r$ from the fixed weights. On the IOI circuit of GPT-2 Small, seven of the ten heads the intervention can reach follow the law, and all seven are counterweights. From this perspective, what may appear as self-repair is a counterweight performing its usual operation when the contrastive signal emerges at the core.

</details>


### [447] [Autoregressive Drillhole Modelling Under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01204)
*Yihao Ding,Daniel Yitian Su,Yiran Zhang,Christopher M. Gonzalez,Wei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 DrillBench——一个包含 49,671 个西澳钻孔的下一层位预测与自回归地层生成基准，覆盖从局部预测到跨地质省迁移的分级迁移谱，并给出一种结合大规模预训练与邻域岩性空间检索的通用方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归建模在语言与序列任务中成效显著，而钻孔随钻进由浅至深逐层揭示岩性，天然契合自回归预测范式的设定。然而现有钻孔建模多集中于空间插值与重建或掩码建模，严格意义上的自回归预测尚未被充分探索。

Method: 构建 DrillBench 基准，涵盖下一层位预测与自回归地层生成任务，并设计从局部预测、空间偏移到跨地质省迁移的分级迁移谱。对经典模型、地统计模型与神经模型进行系统评测，进而提出一种与骨干网络无关的建模方案：在大规模历史钻孔上预训练，并引入邻域岩性的空间检索。

Result: 评测揭示出明确的"迁移边界"：空间与地球化学条件在局部带来显著增益，但在更强偏移下急剧退化；而岩性序列自回归模型迁移更为稳健。检索在风化覆盖层中最为有效，此时局部空间连续性仍具信息量；预训练则在基岩及更大范围地质偏移下贡献更大。二者结合可在保持局部性能的同时改善空间与跨省迁移泛化，在最远距离划分上提升尤为明显。

Conclusion: 钻孔场景为自回归预测提供了天然试验场，且空间条件与序列自回归能力在不同地质条件下呈互补性。通过预训练与空间检索的组合可在迁移边界之外维持稳健性能，为跨区域地层预测提供可行路径。基准与代码已开源。

Abstract: Autoregressive modelling has achieved remarkable success in language and sequence tasks by learning to predict future states from previous observation. Mineral-exploration drillholes provide a natural but largely unexplored setting for this paradigm: as drilling proceeds, lithology is revealed sequentially from shallow to deep, making prediction of deeper strata inherently autoregressive. Existing drillhole modelling, however, is dominated by spatial interpolation and reconstruction, or largely rely on masked modelling, leaving strictly autoregressive prediction largely underexplored. We introduce DrillBench, a benchmark of 49,671 Western Australian drillholes for next-layer prediction and autoregressive stratigraphic generation across a graded transfer spectrum, from local prediction through spatial shift to cross geological province transfer. Benchmarking classical, geostatistical, and neural models reveals a clear \emph{transfer boundary}: spatial and geochemical conditioning provides large local gains but deteriorates sharply under stronger shift, whereas lithology-sequence autoregressive models transfer more robustly. Guided by this finding, we develop a backbone-agnostic recipe combining large-scale pretraining on historical drillholes with spatial retrieval of neighbouring lithology. Retrieval is most effective in weathered cover, when local spatial continuity remains informative, whereas pretraining contributes more strongly in bedrock and under broader geological shift. Together, they retain strong local performance while improving generalisation under spatial and cross-province shift, most markedly on the most distant splits. The benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/yihaoding/drillbench.

</details>


### [448] [Have an LLM Write Your Anomaly Detector: Autonomous Discovery of Compact, Interpretable Detectors for Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01223)
*David Berghaus*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 利用大语言模型自主搜索程序，发现两个紧凑的谱特征+协方差距离检测器，在TSB-AD上领先且无需训练网络或GPU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列异常检测需在预测精度、计算效率与可解释性之间权衡，现有方法（经典、深度、基础模型）往往难以同时兼顾，因此探索一种能自动发现高效且透明检测器的新范式。

Method: 将LLM用作检测器的作者而非检测器本身：构建自主研究循环，在无泄漏目标下反复编辑同一段简短NumPy程序，保留得分最优的检测器。该循环发现两个紧凑检测器（分别面向单变量与多变量序列），通过局部频谱特征描述短窗口，并用协方差感知距离与训练区分布进行比较。

Result: 在TSB-AD基准上，所发现的检测器在多项指标上领先，超越最强经典、深度及基础模型基线（含Time-RCD）；无需训练网络、不使用GPU，且多变量检测器比所有性能相近的基线更快。

Conclusion: LLM驱动的程序搜索是获得准确、高效且透明检测器的可行路径。

Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection trades off predictive accuracy, computational efficiency, and interpretability. We use a large language model not as the detector but as the author of one: an autonomous research loop in which the model repeatedly edits a single short NumPy program under a leakage-free objective, keeping the best-scoring detector it finds. The loop discovers two compact detectors, one for univariate and one for multivariate series, that describe short windows by their local spectral features and compare them with the training-region distribution through a covariance-aware distance. On the TSB-AD benchmark these detectors lead the field across metrics, ahead of the strongest classical, deep, and foundation-model baselines including Time-RCD, yet they train no network and use no GPU, and the multivariate detector is faster than every similarly performing baseline. LLM-driven program search is thus a practical route to accurate, efficient, and transparent detectors.

</details>


### [449] [Supervise What Decides Success: Criterion-Aligned Auxiliary Losses for Latent World-Model Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01224)
*Takumi Hara,Kanata Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种辅助损失，将成功判定所依赖的物理量作为回归目标加入训练，使潜在世界模型的隐状态保留这些量，从而提升规划成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在世界模型通过隐空间距离评估候选动作序列，但任务成败由物理量（成功判定量）决定。作者考察的四个潜在世界模型中，末端执行器位置在隐状态中的编码误差都超过成功判定所允许的阈值，导致隐状态无法区分成功与失败候选，因此需要让隐状态显式保留成功判定量。

Method: 在训练时于编码器与预测器输出上附加线性头，回归成功判定量（如末端执行器位置），并将回归误差加入训练损失；现有模型仅将这些量作为输入，而该方法将其作为训练目标。训练结束后移除线性头，测试时的模型结构、代价与输入均保持不变。

Result: 仅加入该损失，在 PushT 与 cube 任务上成功率分别绝对提升 3.5% 与 3.4%，两项提升均具有统计显著性。

Conclusion: 成功判定标准实际上规定了世界模型隐状态必须保留哪些信息，因此可将其直接用作训练目标，以极低代价（不改变测试时模型）提升规划成功率。

Abstract: Latent world models plan by scoring candidate action sequences with distances in latent space. However, task success is judged by physical quantities, which we call the success-criterion quantities. In all four latent world models we examine, the end-effector position is encoded in the latent state with an error larger than the success criterion allows. Such a latent state cannot separate successful candidates from failing ones. We propose an auxiliary loss that uses success-criterion quantities as training targets, whereas existing latent world models take them only as inputs. During training, a linear head on the encoder and predictor outputs regresses the success-criterion quantities, and the regression error is added to the training loss. The head is discarded after training, so the model, its cost, and its inputs at test time are unchanged. This loss alone improves the success rate on PushT and cube by 3.5% and 3.4% (absolute), respectively, and both improvements are statistically significant. A success criterion thus specifies what a world model must retain in its latent state, and we show that it can serve directly as a training target.

</details>


### [450] [Mixture-Trained Merging for Unified Multi-Objective Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01238)
*SeongHyeon Kim,Chaeyun Jang,Seungyoo Lee,Jiyeon Ham,Yunju Bak,Boseop Kim,Juho Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Mixture-Trained Merging (MTM)，通过让每个分支在"目标偏置数据混合"上训练而非单一目标，使各分支在权重空间几何上彼此兼容，从而解决多能力统一模型中权重合并导致的能力退化与 think/non-think 模式坍缩问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一语言模型需在同一组参数内融合数学、代码、指令遵循与可控思考等多种异构能力。顺序后训练会把所有目标纠缠在单一优化轨迹上，使结果高度依赖训练顺序、数据配比、调度与停止准则；而权重空间合并虽是模块化替代方案，但对单目标专家直接做朴素合并往往失败：领域能力急剧退化，或 think/non-think 模式坍缩为单一主导行为。作者将这两类失败归因于权重空间几何不相容——单目标专家漂移到参数空间的远端区域，其插值落在任何共享低损失盆地之外。

Method: 提出 Mixture-Trained Merging (MTM)：1) 每个分支不用单一目标训练，而是在含跨目标交互的"目标偏置数据混合"上训练，使其在合并时天然兼容；2) 用合并后模型的评测作为低成本信号来选择各分支的混合配比，避免昂贵的数据配比消融实验；3) 迭代式流程——每一轮用全局选出的合并系数提升基座模型，并在保持其他目标的约束下，用领域偏好系数精化各分支混合；4) 为突破单纯形网格搜索的规模限制，采用基于 qNEHVI 的多目标贝叶斯优化进行系数搜索。

Result: 在代码、数学、指令遵循以及 think/non-think 控制等任务上，MTM 优于朴素合并，并且在单目标合并发生模式坍缩的场景中仍能保持 think 与 non-think 的行为可分离性。

Conclusion: 有效的统一模型要求其分支在训练阶段就被设计为"可合并的"，而非事后对单目标专家做简单权重插值；通过多目标混合训练与基于合并评测的系数选择，可模块化地获得兼具多能力与行为可控性的统一模型。

Abstract: Unified language models are increasingly expected to combine heterogeneous capabilities, such as mathematics, code, instruction following, and controllable thinking behavior, within a single set of parameters. A common solution is sequential post-training on multiple objectives, but this entangles all objectives along one optimization trajectory and makes the final model highly sensitive to training order, data ratios, schedules, and stopping criteria. Weight-space merging offers a modular alternative, but naive merging of single-objective experts often fails: domain capabilities degrade sharply, or think/non-think modes collapse into one dominant behavior. We attribute both failures to incompatible weight-space geometry: experts trained on single objectives drift to distant regions of parameter space, placing their interpolations outside any shared low-loss basin. We propose Mixture-Trained Merging (MTM), which trains each branch on an objective-biased data mixture rather than a single objective, exposing it to cross-objective interactions and making branches compatible at merge time. MTM uses merged-model evaluations as a low-cost signal for selecting branch mixtures, avoiding expensive data-mixture ablations. The procedure is iterative: each round promotes the base model using globally selected merge coefficients and refines each branch mixture using domain-preferred coefficients under constraints that preserve other objectives. To scale beyond simplex grid search, MTM uses qNEHVI-based multi-objective Bayesian optimization. Across code, mathematics, instruction following, and think/non-think control, MTM outperforms naive merging and preserves behavioral separation where single-objective merging collapses, suggesting that effective unified models require branches trained to be mergeable.

</details>


### [451] [Context-Aware Error Mitigation Orchestration for Hybrid Quantum Reinforcement Learning on NISQ Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01253)
*Bisma Majid,Shabir Ahmed Sofi,Mir Mohammad Yousuf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出APGEM——一种在量子强化学习训练循环中自适应选择误差缓解策略的上下文感知编排层，在CVRP任务上优于静态缓解方法，达到约94%的oracle效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子强化学习（QRL）结合参数化量子电路，是组合优化的有前景方法，但在NISQ设备上，退相干、门不完美与测量误差会降低策略质量并削弱学习可靠性。现有误差缓解技术通常以固定校正方式应用，无法适应变化的噪声条件与训练状态的演化。

Method: APGEM作为混合量子-经典训练循环中的上下文感知编排层，依据策略级指标（量子态保真度、策略熵、累积奖励、近似比）对ZNE、PEC、CDR与REM进行评估与动态选择，并将所选策略直接集成进强化学习循环。在CVRP（容量约束车辆路径问题）上，于多种NISQ噪声模型与噪声水平下进行评估，并开展消融研究。

Result: APGEM持续优于传统静态缓解方法，达到约94%的oracle策略效用；随噪声增大仍保持更高的量子态保真度，并在整个训练过程中产生更稳定的学习行为。消融研究显示，该框架学到了能适应不同噪声环境与电路执行条件的上下文感知缓解策略。

Conclusion: 将自适应误差缓解集成到学习过程本身，可显著提升QRL在NISQ硬件上的鲁棒性与可靠性。

Abstract: Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL) integrates reinforcement learning with parameterized quantum circuits and is a promising approach to combinatorial optimization. On Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices, however, decoherence, gate imperfections, and measurement errors reduce policy quality and make learning less reliable. Existing error mitigation techniques are generally applied as fixed corrections that do not adapt to changing noise conditions or to the evolving state of training. This work presents Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation (APGEM) as a context-aware orchestration layer of the hybrid quantum-classical training loop that dynamically selects the most suitable mitigation strategy during QRL training. APGEM evaluates Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE), Probabilistic Error Cancellation (PEC), Clifford Data Regression (CDR), and Readout Error Mitigation (REM) using policy-level indicators, including quantum-state fidelity, policy entropy, cumulative reward, and approximation ratio, and integrates the selected strategy directly into the reinforcement learning loop. The framework is evaluated on the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), a representative NP-hard problem in urban logistics, under a range of NISQ noise models and noise levels. APGEM consistently outperforms conventional static mitigation methods, reaches approximately 94% of the utility of an oracle strategy, maintains higher quantum-state fidelity as noise increases, and produces more stable learning behaviour throughout training. Ablation studies show that the framework learns context-aware mitigation policies that adapt to different noise environments and circuit execution conditions. These findings demonstrate that integrating adaptive error mitigation into the learning process substantially improves the robustness and reliability of QRL on NISQ hardware.

</details>


### [452] [IQS-BO: In-Context Query Selection for Bayesian Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01269)
*Luca Geminiani,Nadja Klein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: IQS-BO 是一种基于 PFN 的贝叶斯优化方法，通过合成先验上的监督学习直接学习查询决策，单次前向传播预测每个候选点成为最优解的概率，从而以极低计算成本实现完全上下文内 BO 或仅摊销决策步骤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 BO 需在每步重拟合代理模型并最大化采集函数，成本高昂。PFNs4BO 仅摊销代理但仍需数值最大化采集函数，FIBO 完全上下文但决策规则固定且无代理，基于强化学习的可学习采集函数又依赖已解任务标签。作者希望用监督学习方式学习查询决策，摆脱这些限制。

Method: 提出 IQS-BO：一个 PFN，在单次前向传播中预测每个候选点在整个候选集上取得最大目标值的概率，并证明其目标函数的最小化子即为该事件的后验概率。该模型可无代理预训练用于完全上下文 BO，也可将固定概率代理的预测作为额外输入，仅摊销决策步骤。此外提出一种混合先验，将 GP 样本与具有扭曲输入、孤立窄最优点或平台结构的函数结合用于预训练。

Result: 与基于采集函数的方法相比，IQS-BO 以显著更低的成本提出查询点，并在合成和真实基准上匹配或超越使用高斯过程的标准 BO 及现有上下文内方法。基于混合先验的预训练可进一步提升优化性能。

Conclusion: IQS-BO 通过监督学习实现上下文内查询决策，兼顾低计算成本与优越性能，且提出的混合先验能弥补平稳核难以建模的函数结构，为高效贝叶斯优化提供了新思路。

Abstract: Bayesian Optimisation (BO) is a powerful framework for the optimisation of expensive black-box functions, but typically requires refitting a surrogate and maximising an acquisition function at every evaluation step. In-context approaches based on Prior-data Fitted Networks (PFNs) amortise part of this cost by pre-training transformers on functions drawn from synthetic priors. PFNs4BO amortises the surrogate but still relies on a numerically maximised acquisition function, while FIBO performs BO fully in-context by sampling optimiser locations from a learned density, which fixes the decision rule and admits no surrogate. Learned acquisition functions score a finite candidate set with a trained network, but, lacking a label for the query, learn the score by reinforcement learning on previously solved tasks. We propose IQS-BO, a PFN that learns the query decision by supervised learning on synthetic priors. In a single forward pass, IQS-BO predicts the probability that each candidate maximises the objective over the set, and we show that the minimiser of its objective is the posterior probability of this event. The model can be pre-trained without a surrogate for fully in-context BO, or take the predictions of a fixed probabilistic surrogate as additional input, amortising only the decision step. Our method proposes queries at a fraction of the cost of acquisition-based methods, while either matching or outperforming standard BO with Gaussian processes (GPs) and available in-context methods on synthetic and real-world benchmarks. Finally, we propose a mixture prior for pre-training PFNs which combines samples from GPs with functions exhibiting warped inputs, isolated narrow optima, or plateaus that are poorly modeled by stationary kernels common in GP surrogates. We show that pre-training on this prior can lead to improved optimisation performance.

</details>


### [453] [Not All Is Lost: Repairing Lossy User Preference States of Personalization Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01270)
*Parthiv Chatterjee,Dhiraj Golhar,Ummesalma Diwan,Sourish Dasgupta,Manjunath Joshi,Tanmoy Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究个性化编码器压缩交互历史后存在的"可恢复性缺口"，提出REPAIR方法，在不重编码历史、冻结编码器与任务头的前提下校正偏好状态，在推荐与个性化生成任务上均取得提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化编码器将不断演化的交互历史压缩为偏好状态，任务头仅依赖该状态进行排序或文本生成。然而冻结编码器在各时间步的缓存表示中仍保留有用证据，仅靠压缩后的状态会丢失这些信息，即存在"可恢复性缺口"（recoverability gap）。论文旨在区分偏好证据的"可获得性"与其"下游使用"。

Method: 提出REPAIR：在学习到的紧凑坐标空间中，将缓存表示与当前偏好状态进行比较，在长历史、近期交互和局部爆发三种时间尺度上解析纠正性证据；随后选择哪些时间步的哪些模式参与贡献，并将其聚合纠正量加到任务头之前的偏好状态上。采用"编码器宿主修复"方式复用已有前向计算中的表示，无需重新编码历史，且编码器与任务头均保持冻结。

Result: 在MovieLens、PENS、MIND与Amazon Reviews 2023数据集上，仅训练REPAIR即可在12个代表性推荐宿主上提升MRR与nDCG@10；相比之下，仅微调任务头的增益更小，例如Mamba4Rec在MovieLens上MRR提升3.96个点，而仅微调任务头仅提升0.19。排序与时间诊断结果表明纠正结构是紧凑且依赖于宿主的。在个性化生成中，IMPerSumm在两个加权PerSEval变体上最多提升25.23%。

Conclusion: 结果支持"压缩后状态校正"这一范式，并区分了偏好证据的可获得性与下游实际使用之间的差异。REPAIR以轻量、宿主相关的纠正机制有效弥补压缩造成的信息损失，为个性化推荐与生成提供了一种高效的后处理式改进方案。

Abstract: Personalization encoders compress evolving interaction histories into preference states used to rank items or condition text generation. A task head operating only on this state can miss useful evidence that remains in the frozen encoder's cached representations for individual timesteps. We study this recoverability gap and propose REPAIR, which compares cached representations with the current preference state in a compact learned coordinate space. It resolves corrective evidence over extended history, recent interactions, and localized bursts. It then selects which patterns at which timesteps contribute and adds their aggregate correction to the state before the task head. Encoder-host repair reuses representations from the existing forward computation without re-encoding the history. Across MovieLens, PENS, MIND, and Amazon Reviews 2023, training only REPAIR improves MRR and nDCG@10 for all twelve representative recommendation hosts while both encoder and task head remain frozen. Head-only finetuning of the same hosts yields smaller gains. For example, Mamba4Rec on MovieLens gains 3.96 MRR points, compared with 0.19 from head-only finetuning. Rank and temporal diagnostics support a compact, host-dependent corrective structure. In personalized generation, IMPerSumm improves the two reported weighted PerSEval variants, which assess responsiveness to user preference, by up to 25.23%. These results support post-compression state correction and distinguish the availability of preference evidence from its downstream use.

</details>


### [454] [Model validation in machine learning: A scenario-based guide from hold-out splits to nested group cross-validation in biomedical and applied research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01284)
*Mehmet Baygin,Sengul Dogan,Turker Tuncer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该教程系统梳理了模型验证方法（留出法、k折交叉验证、嵌套交叉验证、分组验证等），通过8个受控场景对比“有缺陷设计”与“防泄漏设计”，证明没有普适最优的验证方法，独立单元必须匹配部署目标，且所有依赖数据的操作都必须排除用于性能估计的观测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无效的数据划分会产生乐观且稳定的性能估计，导致模型验证结果失真。作者希望澄清各类验证方案的适用条件，并将通用机器学习原则与EEG片段、配对眼OCT图像、重复临床测量、多中心数据等具体场景联系起来，以指导正确验证。

Method: 综述留出验证、训练/验证/测试设计、重复随机子采样、k折与重复分层交叉验证、留一法与留p法、分组感知验证及嵌套分组交叉验证。构建8个受控场景比较有缺陷与防泄漏设计，其中7个使用锁定的混淆矩阵与可审计指标，1个使用可复现的重复研究模拟，涵盖全局特征选择、归一化泄漏、依赖记录、中心混合、重复使用测试集和估计器不稳定等问题，并考察偏差、方差、指标聚合、不确定性与计算成本。

Result: 结果显示不存在普遍最优的验证方法。独立单元必须与预期部署目标一致；所有依赖数据的操作（如特征选择、归一化）都必须排除用于性能估计的观测，否则会产生泄漏与乐观偏差。

Conclusion: 验证设计的核心在于独立单元的选取必须匹配部署目标，并严格隔离性能估计所用的观测以防数据泄漏。作者提供了数据规模矩阵、决策树和报告清单，以及可复现的MATLAB模板与scikit-learn对应实现，用于指导实践。

Abstract: Model validation estimates the performance of a complete learning procedure on new data. However, an invalid split can produce an optimistic and stable result. This tutorial reviews hold-out validation, train/validation/test designs, repeated random subsampling, k-fold and repeated stratified cross-validation, leave-one-out and leave-p-out schemes, group-aware validation, and nested group cross-validation. General machine-learning principles are linked to EEG epochs, paired-eye OCT images, repeated clinical measurements, and multicenter data. Eight controlled scenarios compare flawed and leakage-safe designs: seven use locked confusion matrices with auditable metrics, and one uses a reproducible repeated-study simulation. The scenarios cover global feature selection, normalization leakage, dependent records, center mixing, repeated test-set use, and estimator instability. Bias, variance, metric aggregation, uncertainty, and computational cost are also examined. A data-size matrix, a decision tree, and reporting checklists are provided. Reproducible MATLAB templates and scikit-learn counterparts are included. The results show that no validation method is universally best. The independent unit must match the intended deployment target. Every data-dependent operation must also exclude the observations used for performance estimation.

</details>


### [455] [EP-Flow: Disordered Crystal Structure Prediction without Site-Level Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01315)
*Qiuliang Liu,Liming Wu,Qi Li,Zhonglong Peng,Chang Chen,Xiaolong Chen,Wenbing Huang,Shifeng Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出无序晶体结构预测任务及占据分布矩阵（ODM）表示，并设计熵多胞形流（EP-Flow）框架统一生成有序、固溶、空位与间隙占据，在COD与MPDS衍生的基准上达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式模型在有序晶体结构预测上进展迅速，但许多功能材料本质上是无序的，其性质由取代混溶、空位或间隙物种控制。现有晶体生成器要么假设确定性的位点占据，要么依赖位点级无序标注，而在仅给定化学式的场景下这类标注通常不可得。因此需要一种仅以化学式为输入、能统一刻画多种无序类型的晶体结构预测方法。

Method: 论文将无序晶体结构预测形式化为占据分布矩阵（ODM），一种连续的"位点×物种"表示，可统一有序晶体、固溶体、空位无序和间隙占据。合法ODM需满足位点级占据、质量守恒与非负性等耦合约束，使每个样本落在依赖化学式的运输多胞形上。为此提出熵多胞形流（EP-Flow），一种边缘约束的流匹配框架：将异质多胞形规范化到共享的双中心化空间，学习保边缘的流，并通过Sinkhorn逆映射恢复可行占据。模型联合生成占据、分数坐标与晶格参数。

Result: EP-Flow在由COD和MPDS衍生的化学式条件下的无序CSP基准上取得最优性能，显著优于经适配的有序晶体生成器。分析表明，EP-Flow能够恢复稀疏且具化学意义的局部无序模式，而非仅匹配全局成分统计。

Conclusion: 通过ODM表示与EP-Flow框架，论文将无序晶体结构预测统一纳入受约束的生成建模问题，在仅依赖化学式的条件下实现多种无序类型的联合生成，并展现出对真实局部无序结构的刻画能力。

Abstract: Generative models have made rapid progress in ordered crystal structure prediction, yet many functional materials are intrinsically disordered, with substitutional mixing, vacancies, or interstitial species controlling their properties. Existing crystal generators either assume deterministic site occupations or require site-level disorder annotations, which are often unavailable when the chemical formula is the primary input. We formulate disordered crystal structure prediction through an Occupancy Distribution Matrix (ODM), a continuous site-by-species representation that unifies ordered crystals, solid solutions, vacancy disorder, and interstitial occupancy. A valid ODM must satisfy coupled site-wise occupancy, mass-conservation, and non-negativity constraints, placing each sample on a formula-dependent transportation polytope. We propose Entropic Polytope Flow (EP-Flow), a marginal-constrained flow matching framework that canonicalizes heterogeneous polytopes into a shared double-centered space, learns a marginal-preserving flow, and recovers feasible occupancies through a Sinkhorn inverse map. By jointly generating occupancies, fractional coordinates, and lattice parameters, EP-Flow achieves state-of-the-art performance on formula-conditioned disordered CSP benchmarks derived from COD and MPDS, substantially outperforming adapted ordered-crystal generators. Analyses further show that EP-Flow recovers sparse and chemically meaningful local disorder patterns rather than merely matching global composition statistics.

</details>


### [456] [Prediction-powered Neural Architecture Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01317)
*Pascal Janetzky,Yuxin Wang,Michael Klar,Stefan Feuerriegel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PPNAS提出一种基于预测驱动推断（PPI）的NAS方法，融合少量真实性能标签与大量零成本代理（ZCP）信息，通过序数成对排序监督并结合PPI去偏，在有限评估预算下实现端到端预测器NAS的SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NAS中评估候选架构存在固有权衡：真实性能标签因训练评估代价高而稀缺，ZCP虽可大规模廉价计算但噪声较大，如何有效结合这两类监督信号尚不明确。

Method: 提出PPNAS：利用PPI框架融合（1）少量带观测性能标签的架构与（2）大量带ZCP信息的架构；借助ZCP提供的序数信息构造额外的成对排序监督，同时用PPI校正ZCP排序与真实性能排序之间的系统性偏差。

Result: 在端到端基于预测器的NAS中，PPNAS在有限评估预算下取得state-of-the-art性能。

Conclusion: PPNAS是首个面向标签高效NAS的预测驱动方法，验证了融合稀缺真实标签与大规模ZCP监督的有效性。

Abstract: Evaluating candidate architectures in neural architecture search (NAS) faces an inherent trade-off: on the one hand, reliable performance labels are limited because training and evaluating architectures is costly; on the other hand, zero-cost proxies (ZCPs) are cheap to compute at large scale but can be noisy. Yet, how to effectively combine these two sources of supervision remains unclear. In this paper, we propose PPNAS, a novel prediction-powered inference (PPI) approach for NAS. PPNAS fuses (1) a small set of architectures with observed performance labels and (2) a large set of architectures with ZCP information. To combine these two sources of supervision, PPNAS exploits the ordinal information provided by ZCPs to construct additional pairwise ranking supervision, while PPI debiases systematic discrepancies between ZCP-based and true performance rankings. We evaluate PPNAS in end-to-end predictor-based NAS, where it achieves state-of-the-art under limited evaluation budgets. To the best of our knowledge, PPNAS is the first prediction-powered approach for label-efficient NAS.

</details>


### [457] [Feature Selective Model Collapse in Diffusion Models: Total Replacement versus Fixed-Budget Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01318)
*Hanna Malet,Gabriel Turinici*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在有限预算的扩散模型迭代训练流程中，真实数据占比随代数衰减但不被移除时，模型崩溃是部分的而非完全的：脆弱特征在几代内丢失，鲁棒特征可在近乎无界的时间范围内保留。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前研究对模型崩溃的结论看似矛盾：用合成数据完全替换真实数据会导致崩溃，而将真实数据与合成数据累积并存则可避免崩溃。作者希望澄清这一分歧，并刻画介于两者之间、更贴近实际有限预算流水线的中间机制。

Method: 提出"固定预算"协议：保留所有历史数据集与真实数据，但每代新模型仅从不断增大的数据池中抽取固定大小的样本训练，因此真实数据比例自然衰减而数据从未被删除。在2D螺旋数据集及MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10图像基准上，与文献中的"替换"协议进行对比实验；并建立多代参数动力学的线性响应模型，通过随机递归进行分析。

Result: 替换协议使数据集迅速退化，与已有文献一致；固定预算协议只造成部分退化，保留了部分特征。线性响应模型分析确认两种协议存在本质差异：两种协议下都有一些特征脆弱、在几代内丢失，而在固定预算协议下另一些特征鲁棒，可在实际无界的代数范围内被保留。

Conclusion: 模型崩溃的严重程度取决于数据协议：完全替换导致快速崩溃，而仅让真实数据比例衰减的固定预算协议下崩溃是部分的，其特征丢失可预测地分为脆弱与鲁棒两类，为设计与评估迭代训练流水线提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Model collapse arises when generative models are trained on synthetic data produced by earlier models. The phenomenon has attracted considerable attention because of its societal and technical implications. However, previous studies have reached seemingly contradictory conclusions: replacing real data with synthetic data causes collapse (Shumailov et al.), yet accumulating real data alongside synthetic data can prevent it. For diffusion models, we study an intermediate regime typical of finite-budget pipelines: all past datasets and the real data are kept, but each new model is trained on a fixed-size sample from this growing pool, so the real fraction vanishes without any data being removed. Experiments on a 2D spiral dataset as well as the image benchmarks (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10) show that replacement protocol degrades dataset rapidly as in the literature, whereas the fixed budget degrades only partially, sparing some features. A linear-response model of the multi-generational parameter dynamics, analyzed by stochastic recursion, confirms that the two protocols differ: some features will be fragile and lost within a few generations for both protocols, while some will be robust and preserved over practically unbounded horizons under the fixed budget protocol.

</details>


### [458] [Clifford Sheaf Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01322)
*Kotaro Kamiya,Joel Nicholls*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Clifford Sheaf Neural Network（CSNN），一种面向几何图的等变层论神经网络。它放弃代数同态约束，采用K-term sandwich作为限制映射，从而获得半正定、无需versor约束且能混合grade的层Laplacian。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在代数值stalk的层中，标准限制映射应为代数同态；加入等变约束后，自然选择变为versor共轭。但versor共轭表达力弱，因此需要一种既保持理论性质又更具表达力的限制映射。

Method: 在每个cellular sheaf的stalk上放置Clifford代数，沿边传输multivector特征。放弃代数同态约束，引入K-term sandwich作为限制映射，由此构造的sheaf Laplacian按构造半正定，无需versor约束，且可混合不同grade。

Result: 从三个轴刻画限制映射族：耦合哪些grade、能达到endomorphism空间的程度、条件数表现。K-term sandwich覆盖endomorphism空间的一半；在Cl(3,0,0)中对应与中心pseudoscalar对易的映射。项数控制表达力。CSNN是reversion成员，属一阶模型，也是该族的grade-mixing角点。

Conclusion: CSNN为图级等变回归提供了一种新的sheaf构造，在保持半正定性与等变性的同时增强了表达力。

Abstract: We introduce the Clifford Sheaf Neural Network (CSNN), an equivariant sheaf neural network for geometric graphs that places a Clifford algebra on each stalk of a cellular sheaf and transports multivector features along edges. The canonical choice of restriction map for sheaves with algebra-valued stalks is algebra homomorphism. Adding the constraint of equivariance, the naive choice becomes versor conjugation. However, versor conjugation is expressively weak, so we drop algebra homomorphism and arrive at the K-term sandwich. The resulting sheaf Laplacian is positive semidefinite by construction, needs no versor constraint, and still mixes grades. Our main contribution characterizes the resulting family of restriction maps along three axes: which grades a map couples, how much of the endomorphism space it reaches, and how well it is conditioned. The K-term sandwich spans half of the endomorphism space, and in Cl(3, 0, 0) it corresponds to the maps that commute with the central pseudoscalar. The number of terms controls expressivity. CSNN is the reversion member, a first-order model by construction and the grade-mixing corner of this family, developed as a sheaf construction for graph-level equivariant regression.

</details>


### [459] [Robust Non-Clairvoyant Scheduling with Classification Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01343)
*Anthony Dugois,Vincent Fagnon,Giorgio Lucarelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究非预知（non-clairvoyant）单机调度中最小化完工时间之和的问题，借助分类模型的混淆矩阵构建鲁棒优化框架，将不确定性刻画为各类内排列的集合，并设计了在三类鲁棒准则下同时最优的非自适应策略，同时探讨了自适应与随机算法的优势条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非预知单机调度中作业处理时间未知，该问题不存在常数竞争比的在线算法，传统方法难以克服这一理论下界。作者受鲁棒优化与学习增强算法的启发，希望利用分类模型提供的结构信息（混淆矩阵）来突破这一限制，并避免经典鲁棒指标（如Min-Max与Min-Max Regret）带来的计算困难。

Method: 假设作业被划分为若干类别，并可获取分类器的混淆矩阵，其元素(k,ℓ)表示被预测为类k但实际属于类ℓ的作业数量。据此将不确定性刻画为每个预测类内部的一组排列，而非离散数值情景集合。在此框架下考虑三类鲁棒准则：最坏情况指标（Min-Max、Min-Max Regret）以及所有情景上的期望目标。首先提出对所有三类准则均不敏感（oblivious）的最优非自适应策略，进而研究自适应与随机算法。

Result: 提出了一个在Min-Max、Min-Max Regret及期望目标三类鲁棒准则下同时最优的非自适应策略；并进一步分析了自适应与随机算法，证明当混淆矩阵具备特定结构性质时，它们能够优于最优非自适应策略。

Conclusion: 利用分类器混淆矩阵的结构信息可在非预知调度中有效刻画不确定性并绕开经典鲁棒指标的计算难题，所提出的非自适应策略在三类鲁棒准则下达到最优，而自适应与随机算法在特定矩阵结构下可带来进一步改进。

Abstract: We study the classical single-machine scheduling problem of minimizing the sum of completion times of jobs in a non-clairvoyant setting, where the processing time of each job remains unknown until its completion. This is a hard problem for which no constant competitive algorithm is possible. Inspired by robust optimization and learning-augmented algorithms, we introduce a novel robustness framework that leverages structural information provided by a classification model to overcome this limitation. Specifically, we assume that jobs are partitioned into classes and we have access to the confusion matrix of the classifier, whose entry $(k,\ell)$ indicates the number of jobs predicted to belong to class~$k$ but that actually belong to class~$\ell$. In this manner, we are able to characterize uncertainty as a set of permutations within each predicted class, rather than as a collection of discrete numerical scenarios, avoiding the computational difficulty of classical robust metrics, such as Min-Max and Min-Max Regret. In addition to these worst-case metrics, we also consider the expected objective over all scenarios. We first propose an optimal non-adaptive strategy that is oblivious with respect to all three robust criteria. We then investigate adaptive and randomized algorithms, showing that they can outperform the optimal non-adaptive strategy when the matrix exhibits particular structural properties.

</details>


### [460] [Discrete Wasserstein Flows for One-Step Generative Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01355)
*Alessandro Micheli,Andrea Zerio,Samir Bhatt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向有限状态空间的一步生成建模框架。基于离散Wasserstein几何定义目标相对KL梯度流，通过Markov跳跃实现粒子级概率流，并将传输更新摊销为隐变量条件生成器，使推理阶段保持一步生成。在可精确计算分布与传输动力学的受控设定下验证了KL耗散、粒子动力学与概率流的一致性及数值缩放，并表明有限容量神经生成器能追踪精确传输目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将连续域上的"漂移"生成建模思想扩展到有限（离散）状态空间，以支持结构化离散数据的一步生成建模，同时降低推理阶段对迭代动力学的依赖。

Method: 利用离散Wasserstein几何，在可逆Markov核的转移上定义目标相对KL梯度流；通过Markov跳跃在粒子层面实现该概率流；将由此产生的传输更新摊销到隐变量条件生成器中——迭代动力学仅用于训练，推理为一步生成。

Result: 在可精确计算基础分布与传输动力学的受控设定下，验证了KL耗散、粒子动力学与概率流之间的一致性，以及理论预测的数值缩放；进一步证明有限容量神经生成器能够追踪这些精确传输目标，同时保持一步生成。

Conclusion: 结果验证了该基本构造的有效性，为将离散漂移方法扩展到结构化离散数据提供了基础。

Abstract: We introduce a new framework for one-step generative modelling on finite state spaces. To extend drifting beyond continuous domains, we use discrete Wasserstein geometry to define a target-relative KL gradient flow over the transitions of a reversible Markov kernel. We realize this probability flow at the particle level through Markov jumps and amortize the resulting transport updates into a latent-conditioned generator, so that the iterative dynamics are required only during training while inference remains one-step. In a controlled setting where the underlying distributions and transport dynamics can be computed exactly, we verify KL dissipation, consistency between the particle dynamics and the probability flow, and the predicted numerical scaling. We further show that a finite-capacity neural generator can track these exact transport targets while retaining one-step generation. These results validate the basic construction and provide a foundation for scaling Discrete Drifting to structured discrete data.

</details>


### [461] [Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks for Systems with Multiple Asymptotically Stable Equilibria](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01356)
*Simon Heilig,Jens Püttschneider,Mohammad Itani,Asja Fischer,Timm Faulwasser*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出以单一输入凸网络生成的Bregman散度乘积参数化Hamiltonian，使port-Hamiltonian神经网络可表示多吸引子（如双势井）系统，并证明其Lyapunov稳定性等性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稳定port-Hamiltonian神经网络以Hamiltonian作为全局Lyapunov函数，仅含单一全局极小值，因此只能表示单吸引子动力系统，无法刻画双势井等简单多吸引子系统，需突破该限制。

Method: 将Hamiltonian参数化为由一个输入凸网络生成的Bregman散度的乘积形式，构建可表达多吸引子的port-Hamiltonian神经网络。

Result: 证明模型局部Lyapunov稳定；稳定平衡点共存必然导致额外非渐近稳定平衡点存在；所有平衡点位于有界区域；在双曲性假设下几乎处处稳定。在三个系统上恢复能量面特征并将收敛速度提升1.8×–8.5×。

Conclusion: 通过Bregman散度乘积的参数化，克服了单吸引子限制，在保证稳定性的同时实现多吸引子建模与更快收敛。

Abstract: Stable port-Hamiltonian neural networks certify asymptotic stability by construction. Yet, their Hamiltonian is a global Lyapunov function with a single global minimum, so they can represent only dynamic systems with {one} attractor. We demonstrate that this excludes even simple systems with energy landscapes forming a double well, and we overcome the restriction by parametrising the Hamiltonian as a {product} of Bregman divergences generated by one input-convex network. We prove that the resulting model is locally Lyapunov stable, that the coexistence of stable equilibria forces additional non-asymptotically-stable equilibria to exist, that all equilibria lie in a bounded region, and under a hyperbolicity assumption that almost-everywhere stability holds. On three systems our approach is able to recover the energy surface characteristics and improve the convergence speed by 1.8$\times$-8.5$\times$.

</details>


### [462] [From Redundancy to Minimality: Fixed-Point-Guided Hierarchical Reduction of Learned Piecewise-Linear Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01369)
*Hiroto Tamura,Gouhei Tanaka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出定点引导的分层约简方法，将较冗余的AL-RNN逐步线性化至最小动力学表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接从时间序列理解非线性动力系统，不仅需重现轨迹，还需找到保留其本质动力学结构的简单表示。AL-RNN用少量ReLU单元显式控制非线性容量，其激活模式构成符号化转迁图，但直接用极少ReLU单元训练以实现最小动力学表示并不可靠。

Method: 先用较多ReLU单元训练AL-RNN，再以定点（FP）引导的分层约简过程逐步线性化选定ReLU单元，合并相邻线性区域与图节点，同时保留含有定点的不同符号。约简树给出逐步简化的候选层次，每个约简候选由父代参数初始化并在父代动力学引导下重训练。并证明重现Q个不同定点至少需要Q个含FP符号，从而在达到该界时提供符号级最小性证书。

Result: 在3-scroll Chua系统上，直接以理论最小值3个ReLU单元训练仅在20%随机种子中实现高保真最小表示；本文“学习-约简-重训练”策略在相同最终非线性容量下将种子宏成功率提升至约71%。

Conclusion: 冗余非线性容量可作为发现和实现最小动力学表示的支架；先学习再系统约简比直接训练最小模型更可靠。

Abstract: Understanding a nonlinear dynamical system from time series requires not only reproducing its trajectories, but also identifying a simple representation that preserves its essential dynamical structure. Almost-linear recurrent neural networks (AL-RNNs) are piecewise-linear RNNs in which only a subset of units use ReLU nonlinearities, so that nonlinear capacity is explicitly controlled by the number of ReLU units. Their activation patterns define linear regions, represented as symbols, whose observed transitions form a symbolic transition graph. However, directly training AL-RNNs with few ReLU units to realize minimal dynamical representations can be unreliable. We ask whether an AL-RNN with more ReLU units can instead be trained first and systematically reduced to a minimal dynamical representation. We introduce a fixed-point-guided hierarchical reduction procedure that progressively linearizes selected ReLU units, merging neighboring linear regions and graph nodes while preserving distinct symbols containing fixed points (FPs). The resulting reduction tree defines a hierarchy of progressively simpler candidates. Each reduced candidate is initialized from the parent parameters and retrained under guidance from the parent dynamics. We also prove that reproducing $Q$ distinct fixed points requires at least $Q$ FP-containing symbols, providing a certificate of symbol-level minimality when this bound is attained. On the 3-scroll Chua system, direct training with the theoretical minimum of three ReLU units achieves high-fidelity minimal realizations in only 20% of seeds, whereas our learn-reduce-retrain strategy increases the seed-macro success rate to approximately 71% at the same final nonlinear capacity. These results show that redundant nonlinear capacity can serve as a scaffold for discovering and realizing minimal dynamical representations.

</details>


### [463] [Learning Commute-Time-Preserving World Models for Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01373)
*Michael Hauri,Peter Buttaroni,Fabian A. Mikulasch,Friedemann Zenke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CTWM世界模型，用潜在位移预测器加对数行列式正则项，恢复具有正确特征值缩放的拉普拉斯表示，在连续目标达成任务上以半数参数匹配或超越LeWM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型通过选择最能缩短到目标状态距离的动作序列在潜在空间规划，因此理想潜在表示的度量应反映环境中的通勤时间（commute time）。图拉普拉斯的谱嵌入空间可提供此类表示，但需满足特定的特征值相关缩放；然而在大型连续环境中显式构造图拉普拉斯不可行。自监督学习有望在大规模下学习保持通勤时间的嵌入，但现有方法通常鼓励各向同性表示以防表示坍缩，反而破坏了正确的特征值缩放，导致通勤时间表示不准确。

Method: CTWM（Commute-Time-Preserving World Models）结合两部分：潜在位移预测器（latent displacement predictor）与对数行列式正则项（log-determinant regularizer）以防止表示坍缩。理论上证明，在可逆确定性动力学下且处于预测器不动点时，该方法可恢复正确缩放的拉普拉斯表示。

Result: 在数值模拟中，CTWM在多个复杂、连续的目标达成基准上达到或超过任务无关基线LeWM，且参数量仅为后者的一半。

Conclusion: 通过位移预测与对数行列式正则化的组合替代各向同性约束，可在无需显式构造图拉普拉斯的情况下学到保持通勤时间的潜在表示，为大规模连续环境中的规划提供更精确的度量结构，并具有参数效率优势。

Abstract: World models allow agents to plan in latent space by choosing a sequence of actions that most reduces the distance to a given goal state. Thus, planning can benefit from latent representations whose distances mirror commute-times in the environment. The spectral embedding space of the graph Laplacian provides such a representation, if it obeys a specific eigenvalue-dependent scaling. Unfortunately, instantiating the graph Laplacian is intractable in large, continuous environments. Self-supervised learning offers a natural route to such commute-time-preserving embeddings at scale. However, here we show that existing methods, which commonly encourage isotropic representations to prevent representational collapse, tend to degrade the "correct" eigenvalue-dependent scaling, leading to an inaccurate representation of commute times. To address this problem, we introduce Commute-Time-Preserving World Models (CTWMs), combining a latent displacement predictor and a log-determinant regularizer that prevents collapse, which provably recover the correctly scaled Laplacian representation under reversible deterministic dynamics and at the predictor's fixed point. In numerical simulations, CTWM matches or outperforms LeWM, a task-agnostic baseline, on several complex, continuous goal-reaching benchmarks, while using half the parameters.

</details>


### [464] [Action-On-Item Preference Flow: A Shared Event Schema for Predictive and Generative Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01375)
*Parthiv Chatterjee,Kashish Kanjaria,Vashisth Purani,Sourish Dasgupta,Tanmoy Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究能否用用户的电影、新闻、对话等异构历史训练一个可复用的“历史更新机制”，并提出动作-条目模式、多时间尺度状态假设(MTSH)及PerTIDE模型。理论给出重标记不变性、状态有界性与池化训练界，实验在PENS、PENS-to-MovieLens、MIND上验证跨源迁移与生成/预测双消费者复用的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户在不同领域(电影、新闻、对话)的交互在原生动作与输出上存在差异，但每次交互都提供了可更新用户记忆的证据。作者希望探究这些异构历史能否共同训练一个可复用的更新机制，以实现跨源知识迁移并同时服务预测与生成任务。

Method: 提出动作-条目(action-on-item)模式：将映射后的交互角色与内容嵌入配对，使共享更新参数可操作于分离的用户状态。理论上建立原生重标记不变性、条目嵌入扰动下的状态变化有界性，以及显式兼容条件下的池化训练界。提出多时间尺度状态假设(MTSH)刻画证据如何进入、保持与被消费，并用PerTIDE实现，包含动作门控、三条状态空间轨迹、融合与命令条件读出。

Result: 在PENS上，同一历史编码器同时支持下一新闻预测与个性化标题生成。在受控的PENS-to-MovieLens实验中，冻结的源训练核心在拟合相同目标消费者后，比结构相同的随机核心高出15.23 MRR点。在MIND上，PerTIDE相比同输入的三分支状态空间对照保持4.12点MRR优势。动作、读出与轨迹干预实验识别出对这些增益的互补贡献。

Conclusion: 理论与实验共同支持：可在兼容来源间学习历史更新机制，并通过预测型与生成型消费者进行复用。

Abstract: A user's movie, news, and dialogue histories differ in their native actions and outputs, yet each interaction supplies evidence that can update user memory. We study whether these histories can train one reusable update mechanism. An action-on-item schema pairs a mapped interaction role with a content embedding, allowing shared update parameters to operate on separate user states. We establish invariance to native relabeling, bounded state changes under item-embedding perturbations, and a pooled-training bound under explicit compatibility conditions. The Multi-Timescale State Hypothesis (MTSH) specifies how this evidence enters, persists, and is consumed; PerTIDE implements it with action gating, three state-space traces, fusion, and command-conditioned readout. On PENS, the same history encoder supports both next-news prediction and personalized headline generation. In a controlled PENS-to-MovieLens experiment, a frozen source-trained core exceeds an identically structured random core by 15.23 MRR points after fitting the same target consumer. On MIND, PerTIDE retains a 4.12-point MRR advantage over a same-input three-branch state-space control. Action, readout, and trace interventions identify complementary contributions to these gains. Together, the theory and experiments support learning history updates across compatible sources and reusing them through predictive and generative consumers.

</details>


### [465] [Minimax Optimal Regret for Causal Logistic Bandits with Counterfactual Fairness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01377)
*Junhyuk Huh,Seoungbin Bae,Dabeen Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带反事实公平约束的因果逻辑斯蒂赌博机，在仅观测事实奖励、反事实可行性方向不可识别的设定下，证明覆盖条件必要性，刻画目标相关信息尺度 V⋆，并给出上下界匹配的算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反事实公平的因果赌博机中，学习者只能观测事实奖励，而决定反事实可行性的方向无法从反馈中识别，因此公平约束的可行性估计困难。已有分析要么省略覆盖条件，要么施加过强条件，且未给出匹配的下界。

Method: 在事实与反事实特征映射共享未知逻辑斯蒂奖励参数的因果结构下，先证明覆盖条件的必要性；随后在跨动作汇集的事实协方差的较弱满秩条件下，定义目标专属信息尺度 V⋆；基于 V⋆ 构造探索-利用算法，并进一步给出无需已知 V⋆ 的自适应算法。

Result: 无覆盖型限制时，事实不可区分但最优公平动作不同的环境导致 Ω(T) 联合损失下界。在最弱满秩条件下构造最坏情形族，任意策略的联合损失下界为 Ω([V⋆ min{log K, d}]^{1/3} T^{2/3})。两种算法达到 max{R_T, V_T} = Õ([V⋆ min{log K, d}]^{1/3} T^{2/3} + κd/σ_0^2)，上下界在 T、V⋆、min{log K, d} 的主阶依赖上匹配（至对数因子）。

Conclusion: 覆盖条件是反事实公平因果赌博机可实现次线性联合损失的必备前提；所提出的 V⋆ 信息尺度准确刻画了从事实反馈估计奖励与反事实效应的难度，且算法上界与下界在主导项上匹配，给出近乎最优的 T^{2/3} 速率。

Abstract: We study causal logistic bandits with counterfactual fairness constraints. The causal structure is given through known factual and counterfactual feature maps that share an unknown logistic reward parameter, but the learner observes only factual rewards. Consequently, the directions determining counterfactual feasibility need not be identifiable from the available feedback. The closest prior analyses either omit a coverage condition or impose a comparatively strong one, and do not establish matching lower bounds. We first show that some coverage condition is necessary: without a coverage-type restriction, factually indistinguishable environments with different optimal fair actions force $Ω(T)$ expected joint loss. Under a weaker full-rank condition on the factual covariance pooled across actions, we identify a target-specific information scale $V_\star$ that measures the difficulty of estimating rewards and counterfactual effects from factual feedback. We construct worst-case families satisfying this condition on which every policy incurs expected joint loss $Ω\left(\left[V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}\right]^{1/3}T^{2/3}\right)$. We also give an explore--then--exploit procedure tuned using $V_\star$ and an adaptive algorithm that does not require its value. Both algorithms achieve $\max\{R_T,V_T\}=\widetilde{O}\left(\left[V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}\right]^{1/3}T^{2/3}+κd/σ_0^2\right)$, where $R_T$ is regret relative to the best fair action and $V_T$ denotes the cumulative stage-wise positive violations. Thus the upper and lower bounds match in their leading dependence on $T$, $V_\star$, and $\min\{\log K,d\}$, up to logarithmic factors.

</details>


### [466] [Robust Evidential Learning Through Latent Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01384)
*Charmaine Barker,Daniel Bethell,Simos Gerasimou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CLEAR是一种轻量级、任务无关的后处理方法，利用校准数据刻画潜空间几何，通过在潜空间生成扰动视图并度量冲突，选择性降低证据强度，从而提升证据深度学习的不确定性鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 证据深度学习（Evidential Deep Learning）虽能在单次前向传播中高效给出不确定性估计，但仍会对分布外或对抗性输入赋予过高的证据强度，产生"自信但不可靠"的预测，这对高风险场景下的部署构成威胁。

Method: CLEAR在推理阶段于潜空间直接生成扰动视图，并度量其相对于预测组校准几何的冲突程度：高潜冲突表明证据缺乏表示支持，据此选择性削弱证据强度，同时保留潜一致输入的证据。该方法无需重训练，也不改变基础预测。

Result: 在ImageNet→CUB任务上，CLEAR将OOD与对抗AUROC分别提升+8.29与+5.01，且比竞争性后处理方法快17.4倍，同时在分类、回归与目标检测基准上保持预测性能。

Conclusion: CLEAR提供了一种高效、任务无关的后处理方案，在不重训练、不改变基础预测的前提下显著提升证据深度学习的鲁棒性，适用于高风险场景下的可靠不确定性量化。

Abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for deploying deep learning models in high-stakes settings, where out-of-distribution and adversarial inputs can induce confident but unreliable predictions. Evidential Deep Learning provides efficient uncertainty estimates in a single forward pass, but can still assign high evidential strength to inputs that are poorly supported by the learned representation, such as adversarial inputs. We introduce CLEAR, a lightweight, task-agnostic post-hoc method that improves evidential robustness without retraining or altering the base prediction. Using held-out calibration data, CLEAR characterises the group-conditioned geometry of the model's latent space. At inference, it efficiently generates perturbation views directly in the latent space and measures their conflict relative to the calibrated geometry of the predicted group. High latent conflict indicates unsupported evidence, which CLEAR uses to selectively reduce evidential strength while retaining evidence for latent-consistent inputs. On ImageNet$\rightarrow$CUB, CLEAR improves OOD and adversarial AUROC by $+8.29$ and $+5.01$ while running 17.4$\times$ faster than competing post-hoc methods while preserving predictive performance across classification, regression, and object detection benchmarks.

</details>


### [467] [AF-Muon: An AdamW-Free Muon Optimizer for Tied-Embedding Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01395)
*Arash Lagzian,Paniz Halvachi,Junming Zhang,Zhouhan Lin,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AF-Muon：一种无需AdamW的Muon扩展，用支持感知的有限容量线性最小化预言机更新绑定词表，用RMS归一化更新一维参数，仅用一阶动量，节省约20%优化器状态内存，在九种设定上优于Hybrid Muon与Sign。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon通过谱范数最速下降更新矩阵参数，但实际模型含不符合稠密矩阵几何的参数块。典型如绑定词表（tied vocabulary table），其接收稀疏输入查找与稠密输出分类器等多源异构梯度。参考方案将其交给辅助AdamW，这会引入二阶动量状态并按通用张量更新别名表，破坏了Muon的统一性与内存效率。

Method: AF-Muon保持隐藏权重矩阵使用Muon矩阵更新；对绑定词表采用支持感知的有限容量线性最小化预言机（support-aware finite-cap linear minimization oracle）；对一维辅助参数使用RMS归一化更新。全程只用单一一阶动量缓冲，不保留二阶动量状态。

Result: 相比Hybrid Muon节省约20%优化器状态内存。在九种绑定词表设定（124M–1B参数解码器语言模型、全共享T5式编码器-解码器、ImageGPT式图像token、蛋白质及稀疏MoE变体，覆盖文本、图像、蛋白质序列）上，平均验证损失与困惑度均优于Hybrid Muon和SCION式Sign端点。长程运行与超参敏感性研究证实增益稳健；相同动量诊断归因于有限容量保留了更多行内幅值，同时约束了行RMS的坐标集中度。相比匹配训练约1%步时开销。

Conclusion: 绑定词表构成一种独特的优化器几何结构；AF-Muon为跨模型、模态与架构的稳健AdamW-free Muon变体。

Abstract: Muon improves large-scale training by applying a spectral-norm steepest-descent update to matrix parameters, but practical models also contain parameter blocks that do not fit dense-matrix geometry. One important case is the tied vocabulary table, which appears in language models and other token generators and can receive multiple structurally different gradient sources, from sparse input lookups to dense output-classifier updates. In the reference recipe these blocks are handed to an auxiliary AdamW optimizer, which restores second-moment state and updates the aliased table as a generic tensor. We propose AF-Muon, an AdamW-free extension of Muon that keeps the Muon matrix update for hidden weight matrices while using a support-aware finite-cap linear minimization oracle for tied vocabulary tables and an RMS-normalized update for one-dimensional auxiliary parameters. AF-Muon therefore trains every parameter class with a single first-moment buffer and no second-moment state, saving around 20% optimizer-state memory relative to Hybrid Muon in our benchmark. Across nine tied-token settings - decoder-only language models from 124M to 1B parameters, a fully shared T5-style encoder-decoder, and ImageGPT-style image-token, protein, and sparse-MoE variants, spanning text, image, and protein-sequence data - AF-Muon improves mean validation loss and perplexity over both Hybrid Muon and a SCION-style Sign endpoint. Long-horizon runs and hyperparameter sensitivity studies confirm the gain is robust, and identical-momentum diagnostics attribute it to the finite cap, which preserves more within-row magnitude than Sign while bounding the coordinate concentration of row-RMS. These results identify tied vocabulary tables as a distinct optimizer geometry and yield a robust AdamW-free Muon variant across models, modalities, and architectures, with about 1% step-time overhead in matched training.

</details>


### [468] [Reusing Past Samples in Proximal Policy Optimization: When and How Does It Help?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01399)
*Alessandro Montenegro,Riccardo Venturelli,Marco Mussi,Matteo Papini,Alberto Maria Metelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在多重重要性加权框架下实例化了两种PPO样本复用变体（wPPO-U和wPPO-BH），仅复用近期迭代窗口内的样本，并推导了策略改进下界，用于系统研究数据复用在连续控制任务中对PPO样本效率与最终性能的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略方法（如PPO）样本效率低，数据仅用几次即被丢弃；离线策略方法虽通过经验回放提升样本效率，却带来训练不稳定或调参负担。现有混合策略（PPO+数据复用）虽有改进，但缺乏关于"复用何时有帮助、在何种场景、帮助多大"的系统研究。

Method: 在多重重要性加权框架下实例化两种PPO变体，仅复用近期若干迭代窗口内的样本，以隔离数据复用效应。两种变体分别为使用原始重要性权重的wPPO-U，和使用平衡启发式校正权重的wPPO-BH，并保留PPO核心机制。针对二者推导策略改进下界，为各自的损失函数提供理论支撑。

Result: 在连续控制任务上开展了实证研究，考察数据复用对PPO样本效率或最终性能提升的条件与程度。（摘要未给出具体数值结果。）

Conclusion: 该工作为PPO的样本复用提供了理论下界与受控实验框架，系统揭示了数据复用在何时及如何改善PPO的样本效率与性能。

Abstract: Among on-policy deep reinforcement learning methods, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) has become the de facto standard, due to its consistently strong empirical performance across diverse application domains. However, on-policy methods are inherently sample inefficient: fresh data collected under the current policy is used for just a few updates before being discarded. Off-policy methods avoid this inefficiency via experience replay, achieving notable sample efficiency gains, but at the cost of training instabilities or extensive tuning. This motivated the rise of hybrid strategies that augment PPO with off-policy data reuse. Existing sample-reuse variants of PPO demonstrated improved sample efficiency over vanilla PPO, yet a systematic study of when reuse helps, in which scenarios, and to what extent remains missing. In this work, we study the effectiveness of sample reuse in PPO by instantiating two variants within a multiple importance weighting framework. Both retain the core PPO mechanics, reusing only samples from a window of recent iterations, thereby isolating the effect of data reuse from other factors. The variants, termed wPPO-U and wPPO-BH, employ vanilla importance weights or balance-heuristic-corrected ones, respectively. For both, we derive policy improvement lower bounds providing theoretical grounding for their respective losses. We use them to empirically study when and how data reuse improves sample efficiency or final performance of PPO across continuous control tasks.

</details>


### [469] [Why Does Train-Validation Separation Emerge? Update-Pressure Density Dynamics in Pretrained Backbones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01425)
*Yuchen Li,Mingyu Du,Zongqi Fan,Ken-Tye Yong,Nguyen H. Tran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"动态结构"解释训练-验证分离：适应过程中继续拟合会把更新需求从广泛可复用的支撑转向更窄、留出迁移更弱的支撑，表现为梯度分配异质性上升及训练探针与留出表现差距扩大；模拟、NLP与视觉实验一致支持该账户。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练-验证分离（训练表现与有限留出验证表现之差）随预训练模型适应而演变，现有研究对其形成机制缺乏结构性解释；本文试图刻画该差距在适应过程中如何发展，并给出可观测、无需验证样本进入读出的结构性指标。

Method: 提出动态结构账户与条件局部模型，将更新需求从"广泛可复用支撑"向"窄支撑（弱留出迁移）"的偏移，与梯度分配异质性增加、训练-验证分离联系起来。使用固定训练探针使结构演化可观测，且验证样本不进入读出；留出性能另用于评估其与差距的关系。实验包括：ResMLP构造层级（例私有特征目标占比从0.3→0.5→0.7，四层共享特征相对混合保持1:2:3:4）；分别对训练与验证样本计算的掩码输入损失；NLP上RoBERTa、DeBERTa、Qwen在6个数据集各10轮共90次运行，检验训练探针加权的类内与总体离散度读出；以及40轮ResNet-18在三个视觉数据集上的验证。

Result: ResMLP中例私有特征占比升高使最终平均准确率差距由0.185升至0.331再升至0.527（每条件5次运行）；训练与验证掩码输入损失揭示对应迁移不对称。NLP 90次运行中，训练探针加权的类内与总体离散度读出在全部90次运行中与准确率差距呈正的原始及平滑水平相关；约一个epoch间隔配对的原始变化分别在86/90与87/90次运行中保持正关联。ResNet-18视觉研究在三个数据集上对两个读出均进行了检验。

Conclusion: 模拟、NLP与视觉三类证据共同支持该动态结构账户；真实模型证据在指定监测器下检验了其可观测预测，说明训练-验证分离可由梯度分配异质性与探针离散度结构动态刻画。

Abstract: Train-validation separation is the evolving difference between performance on observed training examples and a finite held-out validation set. We propose a dynamic structural account of how this gap develops during adaptation of pretrained models: continued fitting can shift update demand from broadly reusable support toward narrower support with weaker held-out transfer. A conditional local model links this shift to increasing heterogeneity in gradient allocation and train-validation separation. Fixed training probes make this structural evolution observable without validation examples entering the readouts; held-out performance is used separately to evaluate its relation to the gap. In a constructed hierarchy implemented with a residual multilayer perceptron (ResMLP), increasing the target share of example-private features from $p=.3$ to $.5$ to $.7$, while preserving the relative mixture $1{:}2{:}3{:}4$ among the four shared feature levels, increases the final mean accuracy gap from $.185$ to $.331$ to $.527$ across five runs per condition. Masked-input losses measured separately on training and validation examples expose the corresponding transfer asymmetry.
