The natural language processing (NLP) analysis uses 10-epoch runs of RoBERTa, DeBERTa, and Qwen on six datasets (90 runs): the training-probe-weighted within-class and overall dispersion readouts each have positive raw and smoothed level correlations with the accuracy gap in all 90 runs. Raw changes paired at approximately one-epoch intervals remain positively associated in 86/90 and 87/90 runs, respectively. A 40-epoch ResNet-18 study tests both readouts on three vision datasets. Together, controlled simulation, NLP, and vision support the dynamic structural account across settings, with real-model evidence testing its observable predictions under the specified monitors.

</details>


### [470] [Least-time Gradient Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01426)
*Alessandro Betti,Marco Gori,Stefano Melacci,Jinwei Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究梯度流速度控制的变分正则化问题：最小化到达零风险时间的泛函不适定，引入H¹正则项后最优速率呈e^{2/3}幂律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通过令梯度流满足ẇ=-u(E)∇E/|∇E|²，可使风险e(t)=E(w(t))精确满足ė=-u(e)，与能量景观E无关，从而将到达零风险的时间表示为∫₀^{e₀}de/u(e)。单独最小化该时间是不适定的，因此需要引入正则化以得到良定义的最优速度。

Method: 研究正则化问题inf{∫₀^{e₀}(λ/2|u'|²+1/u)de : u∈H¹(0,e₀), u≥0, u(0)=0}，λ>0。采用经典变分路线：直接方法证明存在性，严格凸性证明唯一性，证明极小元在原点外为正，并显式积分Euler-Lagrange方程。

Result: 证明极小元存在、唯一，且为线性缩放的摆线（cycloid）。最优速率在零风险附近满足u*(e)~(9/(2λ))^{1/3}e^{2/3}，即指数2/3，与文献中幂律拟设所得结果一致；该指数落在Hölder窗口(1/2,1)内，对应有限时间到达且速度权重趋于零。

Conclusion: 该工作将梯度流到达零风险的时间最小化问题严格正则化，给出了显式最优速度解与e^{2/3}幂律渐近行为，验证并理论解释了幂律拟设的指数，说明该指数位于有限时间到达的Hölder窗口内。

Abstract: Prescribing the speed of gradient flow on the risk itself, by the dynamics $\dot w=-u(E(w))\nabla E(w)/\abs{\nabla E(w)}^{2}$, makes the risk $e(t)=E(w(t))$ obey $\dot e=-u(e)$ exactly, whatever the landscape~$E$; the time needed to reach zero risk from $e_0$ is $\int_0^{e_0}\dd e/u(e)$. Minimizing this time alone is ill posed, and we study the regularized problem $\inf\{\int_0^{e_0}(\tfrac\lambda2\abs{u'}^{2}+1/u)\,\dd e:\ u\in H^{1}(0,e_0),\ u\ge0,\ u(0)=0\}$, $λ>0$. We prove that the minimizer exists, is unique, and is a linearly scaled cycloid, and we show that the optimal rate behaves like $u^{*}(e)\sim(9/(2λ))^{1/3}e^{2/3}$ near zero risk: the exponent $2/3$ is the one found in \cite{betti2026holder} by a power-law ansatz, and it lies in the Hölder window $(\tfrac12,1)$ where the arrival is in finite time with vanishing weight speed. The proof follows the classical route: existence by the direct method, uniqueness by strict convexity, positivity of the minimizer away from the origin, and the explicit integration of the Euler-Lagrange equation.

</details>


### [471] [Distillation of Tabular Foundation Models into Efficient Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01435)
*Minho Jeong,Dooho Lee,Jinmo Lee,Jaemin Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究表格基础模型（TFM）的知识蒸馏，提出一套有效蒸馏配方：以完整有标注训练集作为教师上下文，仅用教师对观测查询与合成查询的预测来训练轻量学生模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TFM 通过上下文学习取得强预测性能，但每次推理都需重复条件于有标注数据，导致推理成本高昂。知识蒸馏可将 TFM 的预测能力迁移到轻量、数据集专用的学生模型，从而降低开销。然而 TFM 预测同时依赖有标注上下文与查询，由此引出两个设计问题：如何构造教师监督信号，以及扩大查询覆盖范围是否能提升蒸馏效果。

Method: 在两个 TFM 以及神经网络与树模型两类学生模型上系统考察上述两个问题，并据此推导蒸馏配方：教师上下文使用完整有标注训练集，学生仅在教师对观测查询和合成查询的预测上训练。

Result: 在 TabArena 上，所得学生模型比经过调参和集成的监督训练对应模型高出 57–98 Elo 分。将该配方原样应用于 TALENT，在 300 个数据集中的 236–258 个上优于匹配的默认学生模型，并将中位主误差降低 4.0–6.4%。蒸馏学生模型相对教师实现 3.0–21.6 倍的中位推理加速。

Conclusion: 以完整训练集为教师上下文并仅用教师预测（含合成查询）训练学生是一套通用有效的 TFM 蒸馏配方，能在预测性能与重复推理成本之间提供实用折中，且可跨 TFM 与不同学生架构直接迁移。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve strong predictive performance through in-context learning, yet repeatedly conditioning on labeled data makes inference expensive. Knowledge distillation can reduce this cost by transferring their predictive ability to lightweight, dataset-specific students. However, the dependence of TFM predictions on both a labeled context and a query introduces two design questions: how to construct teacher supervision and whether expanding query coverage improves distillation. We examine these questions across two TFMs and both neural and tree-based students, and derive an effective distillation recipe. The recipe uses the full labeled training set as teacher context and trains students solely on teacher predictions for observed and synthetic queries. On TabArena, the resulting students outperform their supervised trained tuned-and-ensembled counterparts by 57-98 Elo points. Applied unchanged to TALENT, the same recipe improves matched default students on 236-258 of 300 datasets and reduces median primary error by 4.0-6.4%. The distilled students also achieve median inference speedups of 3.0-21.6 times over their teachers, offering a practical trade-off between predictive performance and repeated inference cost. Code is available at https://github.com/nums-ai/TFM_Distillation .

</details>


### [472] [ibUMAP: Coherent and Scalable Field Evaluation for UMAP Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01445)
*Bin Chen,Yumeng Xue,Patrick Paetzold,Yunhai Wang,Oliver Deussen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ibUMAP：一种基于一致场（coherent field）的UMAP替代方案，用共享嵌入快照同步计算吸引与排斥力，并以插值FFT方案高效评估三个标量矩，避免全对计算，实现数倍加速与更好的运行稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UMAP依赖随机负采样实现可扩展的布局优化，但这种随机性导致嵌入在不同重跑与下游复用中不稳定，因为估计的排斥力取决于采样事件的顺序。

Method: ibUMAP基于共享嵌入快照评估吸引与排斥并同步施加作用力；其度加权排斥场由对固定嵌入下负采样条件期望的动机导出，用三个标量矩表示，并通过基于插值的FFT方案在CPU和GPU上高效评估，从而避免显式全对计算，同时产生与标准在线UMAP不同的优化动力学。

Result: 受控实验显示：同步性与核截断（kernel capping）改变了局部-全局保真度的权衡，而FFT评估对最终质量的平均改变较小；端到端基准上，CPU相对umap-learn中位加速3.29倍（无种子）和5.79倍（有种子），GPU无种子执行下在百万级数据集相对cuML加速1.44倍。

Conclusion: ibUMAP在获得上述加速的同时，带来更好的逐次运行稳定性，并伴随可度量的保真度权衡。

Abstract: UMAP achieves scalable layout optimization through stochastic negative sampling. However, this stochasticity can lead to unstable embeddings across reruns and downstream reuse, as the estimated repulsive forces depend on the ordering of sampling events. We present ibUMAP, a coherent field-based alternative that evaluates attraction and repulsion from a shared embedding snapshot and applies them synchronously. Its degree-weighted repulsive field is motivated by the conditional expectation of negative sampling for a fixed embedding and represented by three scalar moments, which are evaluated efficiently on CPUs and GPUs using an interpolation-based FFT scheme. This formulation avoids explicit all-pairs computations while inducing optimization dynamics that differ from those of standard online UMAP. Controlled experiments show that synchrony and kernel capping alter the local-global fidelity trade-off, whereas FFT evaluation produces small average changes in final quality. End-to-end benchmarks show median speedups of 3.29x unseeded and 5.79x seeded over umap-learn on CPU, and 1.44x over cuML on million-scale datasets under unseeded GPU execution. These gains accompany greater run-to-run stability and measurable fidelity trade-offs.

</details>


### [473] [Repurposing Obsolete Representations for Post-Deployment Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01453)
*Daniel Bethell,Charmaine Barker,Simos Gerasimou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Deep Repurposing (DR)后处理框架，在任务过时场景下无需梯度更新即可移除过时输出行为并保留有效任务效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长生命周期系统中任务需求可能变化，原输出空间的部分类别或行为会过时。现有方法要么保留过时行为，要么需代价高昂的微调。

Method: DR估计过时区域与保留区域的隐空间几何结构，移除支持过时的分量，并通过解析修复映射重分配与保留任务相容的证据，全程无梯度更新。

Result: 在多种任务设置下移除过时行为并保留有效效用；在分类基准上保留准确率匹配或超越竞争的去学习与编辑基线，消除过时预测，适配速度最高快60倍。

Conclusion: DR是一种高效的后处理适配框架，可在任务过时下实现无梯度修复，兼顾过时行为消除与保留任务效用。

Abstract: Deep neural networks are increasingly deployed in long-lived systems, where task requirements may change after training. In such settings, part of the original output space may become obsolete: a class, prediction region, or learned behaviour may no longer be valid. Existing approaches either leave the obsolete behaviour intact or require fine-tuning, which can be expensive. We propose Deep Repurposing (DR), a post-hoc framework for adapting models under task obsolescence. DR estimates the latent geometry of obsolete and retained regions, removes obsolete-supporting components, and reallocates retained-compatible evidence through an analytic repair map without gradient updates. This yields repaired predictions and representations in which obsolete regions no longer act as valid outputs, while useful obsolete structure can support the retained task. Across multiple task settings, DR removes obsolete behaviour while preserving retained utility. More importantly, across classification benchmarks, DR matches or exceeds competing unlearning and editing baselines in retained accuracy, eliminates obsolete predictions, and adapts up to $60\times$ faster than competing unlearning methods.

</details>


### [474] [Streaming algorithms for robust max-min diversification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01456)
*Andrea Pietracaprina,Geppino Pucci,Stefano Zanon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对带离群点的鲁棒max-min多样化问题，指出Amagata (AAAI23)算法的三个缺陷，并提出一种确定性coreset算法，返回恰好k个内点且为(2+ε)-近似，流式实现内存与更新时间均不依赖n。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始max-min多样化目标对噪声点高度敏感，Amagata (AAAI23)提出的鲁棒形式（排除含z个离群点的解）及其coreset流式算法存在三方面不足：coreset构造需对X离线计算、内存线性于n，违背流处理目标；从coreset提取解的单遍过程可能返回少于k个点，导致不可行解；离群点排除保证仅为概率性，且随coreset缩小而变弱。

Method: 提出确定性的基于coreset的算法：在自然的inlier-outlier分离假设下（类似Amagata (AAAI23)），构造coreset并从中提取恰好k个内点。给出单遍流式实现，能自适应数据集的倍增维数D，在k、z、ε、D的广泛范围内使用与n无关的内存。

Result: 算法返回恰好k个内点，构成(2+ε)-近似解（任意ε>0），即使无离群点也仅比最优多项式时间顺序近似高ε。流式实现的内存在广泛参数范围内独立于n；对足够长的流，摊还更新时间与coreset规模成正比，因而也独立于n。

Conclusion: 该工作修正了Amagata (AAAI23)在内存、可行性与离群点排除保证上的缺陷，以确定性方式实现了(2+ε)-近似，并给出内存与更新时间均独立于n的单遍流式算法。

Abstract: Given a set of $n$ points $X$ in a metric space and an integer $k$, max-min diversification aims to select $k$ points of $X$ maximizing their minimum pairwise distance. This objective function is however highly vulnerable to noisy points. In[Amagata, AAAI23], a robust formulation is proposed which addresses this vulnerability by excluding solutions containing any of $z$ outliers, defined as the $z$ points in $X$ with the largest nearest-neighbor distances. That paper also presents a coreset-based streaming algorithm for the new formulation, based on a suitable inlier-outlier separation assumption. However, we identify three shortcomings in the algorithm by [Amagata, AAAI23]: its coreset construction requires an offline computation over $X$, which needs memory linear in $n$, in stark contrast with the typical goals of stream processing; the one-pass procedure used to extract the solution from the coreset may return fewer than $k$ points (hence, an unfeasible solution) because it permanently discards points too far from the current solution; and its outlier-exclusion guarantee is only probabilistic and weakens as the coreset size shrinks. In contrast, we present a deterministic coreset-based algorithm that, under a natural inlier-outlier separation assumption (similar to the one used in [Amagata, AAAI23]), returns exactly $k$ inliers which are a $(2+\varepsilon)$-approximate solution, for any $\varepsilon>0$, thus only $\varepsilon$ above the best polynomial-time sequential approximation, even without outliers. Its one-pass streaming implementation adapts obliviously to the dataset's doubling dimension $D$ and, for wide ranges of $k$, $z$, $\varepsilon$, and $D$, it uses memory independent of $n$. For sufficiently long streams, its amortized update time is proportional to the coreset size, thus also independent of $n$.

</details>


### [475] [Tight Transition Time Bounds for Separable Logistic Regression at the Edge of Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01459)
*Haodong Wen,Kaiyue Wen,Jiaye Teng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究大步长梯度下降在线性可分数据上的逻辑回归动力学，证明当�small margin $γ$ 充分小时，最坏情况转换时间为 $\Theta((\log η)^{\min\{n-2,d-2\}})$，从而否定了关于转换时间与 $η$ 无关的猜想。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作仅在维度 $d=2$ 给出紧的 $\Theta(1)$ 界，并猜想任意维度 $d\geq2$ 下转换时间与步长 $η$ 无关。本文旨在检验并推翻这一猜想。

Method: 通过按维度和样本量进行归纳，控制"对梯度贡献最大的样本"在迭代过程中反复变化的问题，并构造匹配的难例实例，从而确立下界与上界。

Result: 对每个固定样本量 $n\geq2$ 和充分小的 margin $γ$，最坏情况转换时间为 $\Theta((\log η)^{\min\{n-2,d-2\}})$，且在 $d\geq2$ 上一致成立，说明转换时间随 $η$ 增长而非与 $η$ 无关。

Conclusion: 该结果否定了任意维度下转换时间与步长无关的猜想，揭示了 Edge of Stability 现象中转换时间对步长 $η$ 的多项式（对数）依赖关系。

Abstract: We study logistic regression on linearly separable data under gradient descent with a large constant stepsize $η$. Such dynamics may exhibit a characteristic Edge of Stability phenomenon, in which the loss initially oscillates before transitioning to a stable phase of monotone decrease. Existing work provides a tight $Θ(1)$ bound in dimension $d=2$ as $η\to \infty$ and conjectures a bound independent of $η$ in arbitrary dimensions $d\geq 2$. In this paper, we disprove this conjecture by showing that, for every fixed sample size $n\geq 2$ and sufficiently small margin $γ$, the worst-case transition time is $$Θ\!\left((\logη)^{\min\{n-2,d-2\}}\right)$$ uniformly over $d\geq2$. The key challenge in establishing a tight bound is that the sample contributing most strongly to the gradient can change repeatedly across iterations. To address this issue, we control such changes by induction on dimension and sample size, and construct matching hard instances.

</details>


### [476] [Let the Heads Talk: Beyond Diagonal Graph Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01494)
*Riccardo Ali,Alessio Borgi,Mario Severino,Alessio Gravina,Davide Bacciu,Pietro Liò,Christopher Irwin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文通过quiver表示将Sheaf神经网络中的矩阵值传输与多头注意力建立联系，指出标准多头注意力本质是“对角边映射”，并据此提出Top-A，实现边条件下的跨头通信，在多项任务上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sheaf神经网络用局部特征空间间的线性传输映射替代标量边权，但其矩阵值传输的作用与sheaf-diffusion整体构造纠缠，难以厘清该原语的独立计算意义。作者希望分离并刻画这一传输原语，并厘清它与多头注意力的关系。

Method: 借助quiver表示隔离传输原语，将其与多头注意力对应：把注意力头视为局部传输空间的坐标，证明标准多头注意力等价于对角边映射（源头仅能贡献给对应接收头）。进一步允许非对角项，得到边条件下的跨头通信，并证明该操作一般不能被聚合后的单一共享线性映射吸收。基于此提出Topological Attention（Top-A），学习边相关的非对角路由，保留原同头路径，并在额外路由消失时精确退化为vanilla注意力。

Result: 在关系推理、异构图学习、算法推理（含OOD泛化）上评估Top-A，并以异配节点分类作为对照。结果显示：当任务受益于交互依赖的变换时，跨头传输最有用；而单靠异配性并不带来系统性优势。

Conclusion: 边条件下的跨头通信是矩阵值传输的一个独特计算原语，不能被标准多头注意力或聚合后线性映射替代；Top-A提供了一种可退化的实现方式，为理解与设计sheaf式注意力机制提供了新视角。

Abstract: Sheaf Neural Networks generalize scalar-weighted message passing by replacing scalar edge weights with linear transport maps between local feature spaces. Yet the role of this matrix-valued transport is entangled with the broader sheaf-diffusion construction. We isolate the transport primitive through quiver representations and establish a direct connection with multi-head attention. Treating attention heads as coordinates of a local transport space reveals that standard multi-head attention implements diagonal edge maps: along each directed interaction, a source head can contribute only to the corresponding receiver head. Allowing off-diagonal entries instead enables edge-conditioned communication across heads before neighborhood aggregation. We show that this operation cannot, in general, be absorbed into a single shared linear map applied after aggregation. Building on this characterization, we introduce Topological Attention (Top-A), a multi-head attention that learns edge-dependent off-diagonal routes while preserving the original same-head paths and exactly recovering vanilla attention when the additional routing vanishes. We evaluate Top-A on relational reasoning, heterogeneous graph learning, and algorithmic reasoning, including out-of-distribution generalization, with heterophilic node classification as a contrast setting. The results show that cross-head transport is most useful when the task benefits from interaction-dependent transformations, while heterophily alone provides no systematic advantage. These findings identify edge-conditioned cross-head communication as a distinct computational primitive of matrix-valued transport.

</details>


### [477] [Learned End-to-End Guidance Schedules for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01502)
*Aneesh Barthakur,Mathias Niepert,Luiz F. O. Chamon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LEEGS，一种端到端学习时间相关引导调度的方法，用少量样本和近似梯度训练，在更少采样步数下兼顾生成质量与约束满足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 引导扩散需通过漂移项（引导函数梯度）施加约束，其权重（引导尺度）决定数据质量与约束满足之间的权衡；为兼顾二者须采用小引导尺度和长采样，计算成本高。

Method: LEEGS在少量样本上以随机梯度下降最小化引导函数，训练时间相关的引导调度；由于穿越引导采样的反向传播代价高昂，采用梯度近似，将训练时间缩短为原来的1/4。

Result: 在图像修复、含噪图像逆问题、Face-ID引导生成以及正/逆偏微分方程问题等多样引导任务上，LEEGS在相同预算（50或100 NFEs）下优于基线，或仅用10%步数即可匹配恒定引导效果。

Conclusion: 学习式端到端引导调度可在显著减少采样步数的同时实现高质量生成与约束满足，提升引导扩散的计算效率。

Abstract: Diffusion models are a powerful generative paradigm used across multimedia and scientific applications. Guided diffusion methods impose requirements on the generation by adding the gradient of a differentiable loss (the guidance function) as a drift term during inference. The weight of this drift (the guidance scale) is critical for the trade-off between data quality and requirement satisfaction. To achieve both of these goals, guided diffusion must resort to small guidance scales and lengthy sampling, incurring high computational costs. This work proposes learned end-to-end guidance schedules (LEEGS) to achieve these objectives with fewer sampling steps. LEEGS trains a time-dependent schedule by minimizing the guidance function over a small set of examples using stochastic gradient descent. Backpropagating through guided sampling is computationally expensive, so LEEGS uses an approximation of the gradient that cuts training time by a factor of 4. We evaluate LEEGS on diverse guidance tasks, including (a) image inpainting, (b) noisy image inverse problems, (c) face-ID-guided generation, and (d) forward and inverse PDE problems, outperforming baselines at equal budget (50 or 100 NFEs), or matching constant guidance with only 10% of the steps.

</details>


### [478] [FedMIX-P: Mixing Local and Global Preconditioners for Federated Vision and Language Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01515)
*Junkang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FedMIX-P，在每个本地步混合共享与本地预条件器，将均方算子失配降低λ²倍，并在随机梯度与部分参与下给出O(R^{-1/2})平稳性界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应预条件器能加速模型训练，但异构客户端几何会在相同模型上的梯度评估中引入偏差，使联邦更新产生偏向；仅靠轮次开始时的同步无法阻止这种失配在本地训练过程中重新出现。

Method: FedMIX-P在每一次本地更新步中混合共享预条件器与本地预条件器，从而在保留本地自适应的同时抑制算子失配。针对光滑非凸目标、随机梯度与部分参与场景，采用合适步长和与训练视界相关的混合权重进行理论分析。理论限定在有界线性对称正定预条件器范围内；两个客户端的反例用于说明固定正混合权重可能保留非平稳不动点。

Result: 均方算子失配降低λ²倍。在光滑非凸、随机梯度和部分参与下获得O(R^{-1/2})的平稳性界，且不要求各本地预条件器相互收敛。两客户端反例表明固定正混合权重可能保留非平稳不动点。在视觉与语言任务上使用SOAP、Sophia和Muon变体，相比对应本地优化器均有提升，包括最高19.47个百分点的准确率增益，以及60M–350M语言模型上更低的验证损失。

Conclusion: FedMIX-P通过逐步混合共享与本地预条件器，有效缓解异构客户端几何导致的联邦更新偏差，并提供收敛性保证与实证收益；完整非线性与基于动量的更新仍需单独分析。

Abstract: Adaptive preconditioners accelerate model training, but heterogeneous client geometries can bias federated updates even when gradients are evaluated at the same model. Round-start synchronization alone cannot prevent this mismatch from reappearing during local training. We propose \texttt{FedMIX-P}, which mixes shared and local preconditioners at every local step, retaining local adaptation while reducing mean-squared operator mismatch by a factor of $λ^2$. For smooth nonconvex objectives with stochastic gradients and partial participation, we establish an $O(R^{-1/2})$ stationarity bound using suitable stepsizes and a horizon-dependent mixing weight, without requiring local preconditioners to converge to one another. A two-client counterexample shows that fixed positive mixing can preserve a nonstationary fixed point. The theory covers bounded linear symmetric positive-definite preconditioners. Experiments with SOAP, Sophia, and Muon variants across vision and language tasks show improvements over corresponding local optimizers, including accuracy gains of up to $19.47$ percentage points and lower validation loss for 60M--350M language models. Full nonlinear and momentum-based updates require separate analysis.

</details>


### [479] [Auto-Formalizing Neuro-Symbolic Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01519)
*Samuele Bortolotti,Weixin Chen,Han Zhao,Andrea Passerini,Stefano Teso,Antonio Vergari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究利用LLM自动形式化文本知识为符号约束，并引入auto-nesy-bench基准评估其对NeSy预测器下游准确率的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经符号（NeSy）预测器将先验知识融入神经网络预测以满足约束，适用于高风险场景；但其瓶颈在于符号约束的获取需人工、专家密集型编码，成本高。

Method: 提出auto-nesy-bench基准，用于评估约束形式化及其对NeSy预测器下游准确率的影响；并系统评估LLM将文本知识自动翻译为可插入NeSy预测器的符号知识的能力。

Result: 跨多个领域的广泛评估表明，LLM能在相当程度上形式化约束，生成的公式常与人类专家提供的相似；且当生成公式语法有效时，可带来高质量的下游预测。

Conclusion: LLM自动形式化可部分替代人工专家编码符号约束，有望缓解NeSy范式中的约束获取瓶颈；代码与基准已开源。

Abstract: Neuro-Symbolic (NeSy) predictors incorporate prior knowledge into the prediction process of neural networks, ensuring that outputs satisfy specified constraints, making them particularly suitable for high-stakes applications where compliance with domain knowledge is essential. A key bottleneck in this paradigm is the acquisition of symbolic constraints: encoding domain knowledge into logical formulas remains a manual and expert-intensive process. In this work, we investigate the extent to which auto-formalization via LLMs can systematically translate textual knowledge into symbolic knowledge that can be plugged into NeSy predictors. To this end, we introduce auto-nesy-bench, a new benchmark for evaluating constraint formalization and its impact on downstream accuracy of NeSy predictors. Through an extensive evaluation across several domains, we find that LLMs can formalize constraints to a meaningful extent, generating formulas that are often similar to those provided by human experts. Moreover, when the generated formulas are syntactically valid, they can lead to high-quality downstream predictions. The code and benchmark are available at https://unitn-sml.github.io/auto-nesy-bench/.

</details>


### [480] [Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning: Replacing Target Samples by Black-Box Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01522)
*Vladimir R. Kostic,Karim Lounici,Hélène Halconruy,Timothée Devergne,Michele Parrinello,Massimiliano Pontil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning (LITL)框架，仅用黑盒反馈即可从有偏源样本中恢复目标的Langevin动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多科学与机器学习系统（分子动力学、扩散模型等）由具低维结构、慢时标演化的随机动力学支配，但用于识别与解释该动力学的目标轨迹往往不可得，只有探索流形的有偏或静态样本。

Method: LITL通过Dirichlet表示学习获取目标无穷小生成元的领头谱结构与投影漂移，实现谱形式的动力学重建与慢流形梯度场估计；并提出球面变体，用于将归一化隐表示导向期望目标。

Result: 在Sobolev范数下建立了特征值、特征函数与投影漂移估计的有限样本保证，确保这些量及其一阶导数的泛化；实验上从有偏分子模拟恢复物理跃迁时标、由生成模型静态样本构建动力学结构、重建物理系统球面对称性，并实现黑盒反馈下训练网络的隐空间后处理导向。

Conclusion: 结果表明谱算子学习是分布漂移下恢复随机动力学的实用框架，并在机器学习与物理科学中具有广泛应用前景。

Abstract: Many scientific and machine learning systems, from molecular dynamics to diffusion models and beyond, are governed by stochastic dynamics with low-dimensional structure, evolving on slow timescales. However, target trajectories, used to identify and interpret such dynamics, are often inaccessible: only biased or static samples that explore the underlying manifold are available. We introduce Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning (LITL), a framework for recovering target Langevin dynamics from biased source samples using only black-box feedback. LITL learns the leading spectral structure of the target infinitesimal generator and the projected drift through Dirichlet representation learning, enabling kinetic reconstruction in spectral form and slow-manifold gradient field estimation. We further introduce a spherical variant well suited to steering normalized latent representations commonly used in learning systems toward desired objectives. We establish finite-sample guarantees for eigenvalue, eigenfunction, and projected drift estimation in Sobolev norms, thereby ensuring generalization of these quantities and their first-order derivatives. Empirically, LITL recovers physical transition timescales from biased molecular simulations, builds kinetic structure from static samples of generative models, reconstructs spherical symmetries of physical systems, and enables post-hoc latent steering of trained neural networks under black-box feedback. Together, these results position spectral operator learning as a practical framework for recovering stochastic dynamics under distribution shift and unlock applications across machine learning and the physical sciences.

</details>


### [481] [Exact Distinguishability in Non-Markovian Decision Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01527)
*Kabir Murjani,Nisarg Patel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究固定行为策略下离线数据能否区分两个候选RDP，证明观测等价候选的后验几率恒等于先验几率（且被Lean 4形式化验证），给出等价的精确刻画并提出线性时间判定算法PEC，实验表明PEC可恢复先前工作所依赖的可区分性假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RDP常被用来建模非马尔可夫环境，其动力学通过有限自动机依赖交互历史。现有离线保证依赖对行为策略的可区分性假设，但该假设无法被验证；一旦不成立，不同模型可能同样好地解释数据，导致学习/推断结论不可靠。

Method: 在固定行为策略下考察两个候选RDP的可区分性：证明观测等价候选的后验几率在任何样本量下都保持等于先验几率，即使策略访问了自动机的每个状态，并用Lean 4对两个结论进行形式化验证；随后对上述等价关系进行精确刻画，据此推导PEC算法，在乘积自动机规模上以线性时间判定该等价性；并在四个测试环境上评估先前可区分性假设的失效情况以及PEC所选实验的恢复效果。

Result: 理论上，观测等价候选的后验几率与先验几率始终相等，且该结论在策略遍历全部自动机状态时依然成立，并已形式化验证；方法上给出等价的精确刻画与线性的PEC判定算法；实验上，先前工作的可区分性假设在四个测试环境中有三个失效，而PEC识别出的实验在每个失效案例中都能恢复该假设。

Conclusion: 固定行为策略下，数据可能无法区分某些RDP，这是现有离线保证中一个可被显式检验的脆弱点；本文通过后验几率不变性、精确等价刻画与线性判定算法PEC，将不可验证的假设转化为可检验并可修复的问题，并在多数测试环境中证实其必要性。

Abstract: Non-Markovian environments are often modeled as Regular Decision Processes (RDPs), where dynamics depend on the interaction history through a finite automaton. Existing offline guarantees for RDPs rely on a distinguishability assumption on the behaviour policy but provide no means of verifying it. When the assumption is violated, distinct models may explain the data equally well. We study when data collected under a fixed behaviour policy can distinguish two candidate RDPs. We prove that the posterior odds between observationally equivalent candidates remain equal to the prior odds at every sample size, even when the policy visits every automaton state, and verify both results formally in Lean 4. We then characterize this equivalence exactly and derive PEC, an algorithm that decides it in time linear in the size of the product automaton. The distinguishability assumption of prior work fails on three of our four test environments, and the experiment identified by PEC restores it in each case.

</details>


### [482] [Calibrating Prediction Timeliness Through Multi-Objective Hyperparameter Optimization for Remaining Useful Life Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01530)
*Tugrul Cabir Hakyemez,Ener Uras Gokhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究将RUL预测的优化目标本身视为设计变量，在C-MAPSS与BackBlaze基准上比较单目标（R²、NASA评分）与多目标（NSGA-II+Entropy-CRITIC）优化策略，发现多目标可将方向性失衡降低约33%，模型排名依赖配置，且两数据集上目标间关系由互补转为冲突。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测性维护中，RUL预测的提前与滞后误差后果不对称，但超参数优化通常只针对单一精度指标，对两个方向同等对待，导致预测时序性/校准性被忽视。作者因此把优化目标本身作为可设计变量，考察目标选择如何塑造预测行为。

Method: 评估五种架构（MLP、LSTM、XGBoost、TCN、Transformer），在三种优化范式下比较：单目标最大化R²、单目标最小化NASA评分函数、以及联合优化两者的多目标范式；多目标搜索采用NSGA-II并结合Entropy-CRITIC权重进行Pareto选择。共评估75个“模型-数据集-策略”组合，数据集为NASA C-MAPSS涡扇发动机与BackBlaze硬盘基准。

Result: 在C-MAPSS上，各策略精度相当（R²≈0.89），但多目标优化使方向性失衡降低约33%，改善了提前与滞后预测的校准；模型排名随配置变化，较简单架构常优于更深的时序模型。在BackBlaze上，两目标由互补转为冲突，Entropy-CRITIC权重出现分化，并存在显著泛化差距（最佳R²≈0.34）。

Conclusion: 优化目标会实质性地塑造预测行为，多目标搜索为在RUL建模中校准预测时序性提供了实用机制，提示实践中应将目标选择视为显式设计决策而非默认单一精度指标。

Abstract: In predictive maintenance, early and late RUL prediction errors carry asymmetric consequences, yet hyperparameter optimization typically targets a single accuracy metric that treats both directions equally. This study treats the optimization objective itself as a design variable. Five architectures (MLP, LSTM, XGBoost, TCN, and Transformer) are evaluated under three regimes: single-objective maximization of $R^2$, single-objective minimization of the NASA scoring function, and a multi-objective formulation that jointly optimizes both criteria. The multi-objective search employs NSGA-II with Entropy-CRITIC weighting for Pareto selection. Seventy-five model-dataset-strategy combinations are assessed on the NASA C-MAPSS turbofan and BackBlaze hard-disk drive benchmarks. On C-MAPSS, all strategies achieve comparable accuracy ($R^2 \approx 0.89$), yet multi-objective optimization reduces directional imbalance by approximately 33%, improving calibration of early versus late predictions. Model rankings prove configuration-dependent, with simpler architectures frequently outperforming deeper temporal models. On BackBlaze, the objectives shift from complementary to conflicting, producing divergent Entropy-CRITIC weights and a substantial generalization gap (best $R^2 \approx 0.34$). These results demonstrate that the optimization objective materially shapes prognostic behavior and that multi-objective search provides a practical mechanism for calibrating prediction timeliness in RUL modeling.

</details>


### [483] [Two Routes to the Middle: Placement Search and Brain Readouts Converge on Where Continual Learners Should Specialize](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01590)
*Yuan Huang,Zihan Chen,Runbin Zhang,Hongwei Ding,Changzeng Fu,Shiqi Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在预训练视觉Transformer中放置任务特定适配器（adapter）的位置问题，提出基于神经科学启发的LS-B方法：用冻结的人脑fMRI编码模型观察初始任务，一次性将任务特定容量分配给跨任务读数变化最大的模块，从而实现无需标签与反向传播的层级分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习在每个模块中都保留任务特定adapter会导致存储随任务数线性增长；仅在少数模块中保留adapter可抑制增长，但"放在哪些模块"这一问题尚不明确，需要兼顾算法搜索与外部先验的指导。

Method: 算法层面：训练所有连续四模块放置组合，分析精度随深度的变化，并测试基于权重谱或激活统计的低成本选择准则。神经科学层面：受视觉皮层层级组织与中间阶段可塑性启发，提出LS-B——通过冻结的、覆盖12个人脑视觉区的fMRI编码模型观察初始任务，将任务特定容量一次性分配给"跨任务读数变化最大而自身结构稳定"的模块，全程无需标签与反向传播。

Result: 连续四模块放置的最终精度呈倒U形，峰值位于中间深度，波动达3.5个百分点；基于权重谱/激活统计的准则偏向最深层。LS-B在三个ViT-B/16骨干上给出稳定的、骨干特异的分配；在AugReg和iBOT上所选模块与搜索得到的中深度区域重叠，在存储与观测预算匹配下优于最浅与最深的四模块配置；在Split ImageNet-R上仅用60%的全量BiLoRA适配器存储，最终精度差距在1.5pp以内。

Conclusion: 适配器的中间深度放置更优，且可由外部神经科学信号（fMRI编码模型）在无标签、无反向传播、运行时开销小于0.6%的条件下稳定预测，并呈现骨干特异的皮层特征，为持续学习中的层级容量分配提供了高效可解释的方案。

Abstract: Continual learners that keep a task-specific adapter in every block of a pre-trained vision transformer accumulate storage linearly with the number of tasks; keeping task-specific adapters in only a few blocks curbs this growth but raises the question of where to place them. We investigate this question from two perspectives. Algorithmically, training all contiguous four-block placements yields an inverted U: final accuracy peaks at intermediate depth and varies by up to 3.5 percentage points (pp), while inexpensive criteria based on weight spectra or activation statistics favor the deepest blocks. From neuroscience, the hierarchical organization and intermediate-stage plasticity of the visual cortex motivate us to ask whether a measurement taken outside the learner can guide layer specialization without placement search. LS-B observes the first tasks through a frozen fMRI encoding model of twelve human visual areas and commits task-specific capacity once to the blocks whose readouts vary most across tasks relative to their stable structure. Across three ViT-B/16 backbones, LS-B yields stable, backbone-specific allocations. On the two backbones with placement search, AugReg and iBOT, the selected blocks overlap the intermediate-depth region identified by search. Under matched storage and observation budgets, the selected blocks outperform the shallowest and deepest four-block configurations. On Split ImageNet-R, LS-B uses 60% of full-BiLoRA adapter storage while remaining within 1.5 pp of its final accuracy. The allocation requires no labels or backpropagation, adds under 0.6% runtime, and exhibits backbone-specific cortical signatures.

</details>


### [484] [FedFit: Federated Fine-Tuning of LLMs via Vector-Bank Parameterization and Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01537)
*Hang Zou,Chao Zhang,Yuzhi Yang,Yu Tian,Samson Lasaulce,Mérouane Debbah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 FedFit：用不相交共享向量库参数化 + 交替优化（含残差谱聚合）+ 分块量化与误差反馈，在保持联邦 LoRA 困惑度水平的同时实现最高约 100 倍压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦微调大语言模型可保护隐私，但通信开销巨大成为瓶颈。在 FL 中引入 LoRA 时存在"聚合困境"：Sum-of-Products（SoP）实现聚合准确但通信昂贵，Product-of-Sums（PoS）实现通信高效但聚合不精确，二者难以兼顾。

Method: 1) 不相交共享向量库参数化：用两个紧凑、互不相交的全局向量库重建高维适配器矩阵，显著降低通信量。2) 交替优化调度：在解耦的单库更新（可精确聚合）与联合更新（由残差谱聚合 Residual Spectral Aggregation 校正）之间循环，化解 SoP 与 PoS 冲突。3) 分块量化结合客户端误差反馈，进一步压缩传输向量。4) 给出算法收敛性理论保证。

Result: 在 Qwen2.5 系列模型上的大量实验表明，FedFit 的困惑度与标准联邦 LoRA 方法相当，同时压缩比最高提升约 100 倍。

Conclusion: FedFit 通过共享向量库参数化与交替优化设计，在近乎不损失困惑度的情况下大幅降低联邦 LoRA 通信开销，并具备收敛性保障，为通信高效的联邦 LLM 微调提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet the massive communication overhead remains a critical bottleneck. Furthermore, applying Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) in FL faces a fundamental "aggregation dilemma" between the accurate Sum-of-Products (SoP) and the communication-efficient Product-of-Sums (PoS) implementations. To tackle these challenges, we propose FedFit. First, to significantly reduce communication overhead, we introduce a disjoint shared vector-bank parameterization that reconstructs high-dimensional adapter matrices from two compact and disjoint global vector banks. Second, to address the aggregation dilemma, we devise an alternating optimization schedule. By cycling between decoupled single-bank updates (which allow for accurate aggregation) and joint updates corrected by a Residual Spectral Aggregation mechanism, we resolve the conflict between SoP and PoS. Additionally, we integrate blockwise quantization with client-side error feedback to further compress the transmitted vectors. Furthermore, we establish theoretical convergence guarantees for the proposed algorithm. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5 models demonstrate that FedFit achieves perplexity performance comparable to standard federated LoRA methods, while providing compression ratios up to 100x higher.

</details>


### [485] [Range-GRPO: Policy Optimization via Pairwise Relations among Reward Intervals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01548)
*Ryunyi Lee,Kangjun Noh,Somin Kim,Heedong Kim,Kyungwoo Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Range-GRPO 半监督后训练框架，将 LLM-as-a-Judge 伪奖励表示为共形校准的奖励区间，在 GRPO 中以区间成对比较构建学习信号，从而让不确定性同时影响优势的方向与幅度，并在评测中取得最优分布内外平均性能且训练开销更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 适配下游任务的后训练依赖可靠监督，但在缺少参考答案或可执行验证器的领域获取监督代价高昂。LLM-as-a-Judge 可提供可扩展的伪奖励，然而单点分数无法显式刻画奖励不确定性，因此有必要将伪奖励建模为共形校准的奖励区间。

Method: 提出半监督后训练框架 Range-GRPO，结合少量标注数据与无标注提示。在 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）中，学习信号源于同一 rollout 组内的相对奖励比较；为此设计以奖励区间成对比较的目标函数，而非将区间归约为点奖励，使区间不确定性能够影响学习信号的幅度与方向。并给出理论分析，说明该目标在奖励区间退化为点时恢复 Dr.GRPO 优势。

Result: 在评估的半监督方法中，Range-GRPO 取得最高的分布内（in-distribution）与分布外（out-of-distribution）平均性能，同时所需训练资源更少。

Conclusion: 将伪奖励以共形校准区间形式引入 GRPO 的成对比较，可有效利用不确定性提升半监督后训练效果，且具有理论一致性与资源效率优势。

Abstract: As the use of large language models (LLMs) expands, post-training has become increasingly important for adapting them to downstream tasks. However, obtaining reliable supervision remains costly, especially in domains without reference answers or executable verifiers. LLM-as-a-Judge provides scalable pseudo-rewards for unlabeled responses, but a single point score does not explicitly represent reward uncertainty. This motivates representing pseudo-rewards as conformally calibrated reward ranges. We propose Range-GRPO, a semi-supervised post-training framework that combines limited labeled data with unlabeled prompts. In Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), learning signals depend on relative reward comparisons within each rollout group. The proposed objective compares reward ranges pairwise rather than reducing them to point rewards, allowing interval uncertainty to affect both the magnitude and direction of these signals. Our theoretical analysis characterizes this distinction and shows that the proposed objective recovers the Dr.GRPO advantage when all reward ranges collapse to points. Empirically, Range-GRPO achieves the highest in-distribution and out-of-distribution average performance among the evaluated semi-supervised methods while requiring fewer training resources.

</details>


### [486] [SIEVE: Selective attention-value Suppression for Vision-Language Models Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01962)
*Si Qi Goh,Cap Dang Xuan Kiet,Tat-Jen Cham,Kwok-Yan Lam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SIEVE框架，通过对注意力值表示进行正则化并结合序列级遗忘/保留监督，实现视觉语言模型中对个人可识别信息的选择性遗忘，同时保持被允许的保留知识，达到多模态遗忘的最新性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型能将视觉身份与传记信息关联，因此需要对其中的个人可识别信息进行选择性遗忘，同时保留关于同一人物的被允许知识。该设定困难在于：敏感信息与需保留信息往往共享相同的视觉输入和中间表示，难以区分处理。

Method: 提出SIEVE框架。方法直接对注意力值（attention-value）表示进行正则化，并控制模型输出：将遗忘样本的注意力值压制至恒定零，同时通过匹配冻结参考模型来保留保留样本的表示。将这些目标与序列级的遗忘监督和保留监督相结合，实现定向遗忘且尽量不影响保留知识。

Result: 在多种模型-模态设置下，SIEVE在遗忘任务上达到最新（state-of-the-art）性能，同时保持有竞争力的保留效用。消融研究表明：值压制与负交叉熵提供互补的遗忘信号，而基于参考的值匹配显著减少效用退化。

Conclusion: 注意力值为选择性多模态遗忘提供了有效的干预点，尤其在敏感知识与保留知识密切相关时有效。

Abstract: The ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to associate visual identities with biographical information creates a need for selective unlearning of personally identifiable information (PII) while preserving permitted knowledge about the same individual. This setting is challenging because both sensitive and retained information can share the same visual inputs and intermediate representations. We introduce SIEVE, a simple and effective framework for selective VLM unlearning. SIEVE directly regularizes attention-value representations while also controlling model outputs. SIEVE suppresses attention values for forget examples toward a constant zero, while preserving retain-example representations by matching them to a frozen reference model. These objectives are combined with sequence-level forget and retain supervision, enabling targeted forgetting without largely affecting retained knowledge. Extensive experiments show that SIEVE achieves state-of-the-art performance on unlearning with multiple model-modality settings, while maintaining competitive retained utility. Ablation studies further show that value suppression and negative cross-entropy contribute complementary forgetting signals, while reference-based value matching substantially reduces utility degradation. These results demonstrate that attention values provide an effective intervention point for selective multimodal unlearning when sensitive and retained knowledge are closely related.

</details>


### [487] [Towards Optimal Policy Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01566)
*Yaniv Oren,Viliam Vadocz,Wiktor Zabka,Thomas Evers,Jan Robine,Wendelin Böhmer,Matthijs T. J. Spaan,Martha White,Hendrik Baier,Fenghui Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文从第一性原理研究策略改进，将最优策略改进定义为在约束下单次更新可达到的最佳策略，证明状态子集上的最优改进等价于求解一个诱导MDP，并在近似评估约束下提出基于概率决策的新算子及梯度近似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践中的强化学习算法在近似评估下通过迭代策略改进求解MDP，但策略改进本身缺乏理论刻画：是否有"最优"的改进步长与方式？评估误差如何影响贪心化？论文动机在于弥补策略改进的理论空白，并解决近似评估这一核心实际约束下的最优贪心化问题。

Method: 1) 将最优策略改进定义为在指定约束下单次更新可达到的最佳策略；2) 证明受限于某状态集的最优改进等价于求解一个诱导MDP，从而把带显式/隐式模型的规划刻画为通往最优策略改进的路径；3) 将近似评估下的贪心化形式化为不确定性下的概率决策问题，并推导出对该目标最优的新算子；4) 给出该算子的实用梯度近似。

Result: 所提算子及其基于梯度的实用近似在GumbelAlphaZero、SAC、ReBRAC和广义策略迭代(GPI)上提升了整体性能，实验覆盖离散与连续动作、基于模型与无模型、在线与离线强化学习。

Conclusion: 策略改进可从第一性原理被刻画为诱导MDP的求解问题，而在近似评估约束下，贪心化应被视为不确定性下的概率决策；由此得到的最优算子具有通用性，可作为即插即用组件改进多种现有RL算法。

Abstract: Practical Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms learn to solve Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) through iterative policy improvement in the presence of approximate evaluation. We study policy improvement from first principles, defining optimal policy improvement as producing the best policy attainable in a single update under specified constraints. We show that optimal improvement restricted to a set of states is equivalent to solving an induced MDP, characterizing planning with an explicit or implicit model as a path towards optimal policy improvement. Because practical methods commonly solve such induced problems through iterative improvement in the form of greedification, we take steps towards optimal greedification under the central practical constraint of approximate evaluation. We formulate greedification under this constraint as probabilistic decision-making under uncertainty and derive a novel operator that is optimal with respect to the resulting objective. Empirically, the operator and its practical gradient-based approximations improve aggregate performance across GumbelAlphaZero, SAC, ReBRAC and Generalized Policy Iteration, in experiments spanning discrete and continuous actions, model-based and model-free, online and offline RL.

</details>


### [488] [Beyond Pointwise Error: A Multi-Metric Evaluation of Spatial Climate Downscaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01579)
*Loys Masquelier,Etienne Le Naour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对ERA5温度、风速和降水场上的五种空间降尺度方法进行了多指标基准评测，使用逐点误差、结构相似性、分布误差、谱误差和梯度误差五个指标。结果显示空间保真度与细尺度变率之间存在系统性权衡，方法排名随指标和变量而变化，因此不存在单一最优降尺度方法，多指标评估不可或缺。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候降尺度旨在从粗分辨率输入重建精细尺度空间场，但其质量评估存在困难：低逐点误差可能以牺牲细尺度变率为代价，而真实的空间变率又可能伴随不准确的局部结构。由于评估指标本身会改变哪种方法表现最佳，单一指标评估具有误导性，因此需要多指标基准来全面刻画不同方法所保留的气候场性质。

Method: 构建多指标基准，在ERA5温度、风速和降水场上比较五种空间降尺度方法。采用五个互补指标进行评估：逐点误差、结构相似性、分布误差、谱误差和梯度误差，从不同角度刻画重建场与参考场的一致性。

Result: 结果揭示出空间保真度与细尺度变率之间的系统性权衡：部分方法在逐点误差和空间对齐类指标上表现最佳，但损失了高频内容；另一些方法虽能保留更多谱变率，却以局部结构定位不准确为代价。因此，方法排名在不同指标和不同变量间发生改变。

Conclusion: 不存在单一最优的降尺度方法。多指标评估对于判定气候场哪些性质得到保留至关重要，是评估降尺度质量的必要手段。

Abstract: Climate downscaling aims to reconstruct fine scale spatial fields from coarse resolution inputs. Evaluating the quality of these reconstructions is challenging: low pointwise error can come at the cost of fine scale variability, while realistic spatial variability can be achieved with inaccurate local structures. The evaluation metric can therefore change which method appears to perform best. This work presents a multi metric benchmark comparing five spatial downscaling methods on ERA5 temperature, wind, and precipitation fields. Five criteria assess complementary properties: pointwise error, structural similarity, distribution error, spectral error, and gradient error. The results reveal a systematic trade off between spatial fidelity and fine scale variability. Some methods perform best on pointwise and spatially aligned metrics, but lose high frequency content, while others preserve substantially more spectral variability at the cost of less accurately positioned local structures. Consequently, method rankings change across metrics and variables. These results show that there is no single best downscaling method. Multi metric evaluation is therefore essential for assessing which properties of a climate field are preserved.

</details>


### [489] [Permutation-Robust Decision Modeling with Candidate-Independent Block-Causal Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01601)
*Guy Amit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出候选无关块因果注意力（candidate-independent block-causal attention），通过阻断候选间信息流并重置候选位置，降低决策模型对候选序列排列的敏感性，同时保持竞争性决策质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策模型需对变长候选动作集合打分，尤其在生成系统内的System 1组件中，候选的提议或排序在不同运行间可能变化。标准因果交叉编码虽表达力强，但会使候选得分依赖序列化顺序，而非依赖底层决策问题本身，导致排列敏感性问题。

Method: 提出候选无关块因果注意力：在共享上下文和每个候选内部保留因果计算，同时阻断跨候选信息流并重置候选位置；在Gemma 3 1B、Qwen3 1.7B、Qwen3 4B骨干上，与标准因果注意力及互补的不变性基线进行比较，并进行消融实验；另在Qwen3-4B上用更多训练数据进一步研究该架构行为。

Result: 候选无关注意力一致地降低排列敏感性，同时保持有竞争力的决策质量；消融表明候选隔离是效果的主要来源，位置重置则补全了预期的对称性；Qwen3-4B更大规模研究进一步考察了该架构在更多训练数据下的表现。

Conclusion: 候选隔离与位置重置相结合的候选无关块因果注意力，能在不显著牺牲决策质量的前提下有效提升决策模型对候选排列的不变性，代码与Qwen3-4B模型工件已公开。

Abstract: Decision models often score a variable-sized set of candidate actions encoded in a single sequence. This setting is increasingly relevant for System 1 components inside generative systems, where candidates may be proposed or ordered differently across runs. Standard causal cross-encoding is expressive, but it can make a candidate's score depend on serialization order rather than on the underlying decision problem. We introduce candidate-independent block-causal attention, which preserves causal computation within the shared context and each candidate while blocking cross-candidate information flow and resetting candidate positions. We compare this architecture with standard causal attention and complementary invariant baselines across Gemma 3 1B, Qwen3 1.7B, and Qwen3 4B backbones. Candidate-independent attention consistently reduces permutation sensitivity while retaining competitive decision quality; ablations indicate that candidate isolation is the primary source of the effect, with position resetting completing the intended symmetry. A larger Qwen3-4B study further examines the behavior of the proposed architecture with substantially more training data. Code is available at the \href{https://github.com/guyAmit/ci-decision-models}{\textcolor{blue}{project repository}}, and the \href{https://huggingface.co/Guy-Amit/qwen3-4b-ci-decision-4096-poc}{\textcolor{blue}{Qwen3-4B model artifact}} is available on Hugging Face.

</details>


### [490] [Exposing the Cost of Deep Learning Audio Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01619)
*Constance Douwes,Paul Magron,Romain Serizel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出基于Grid5000平台活动日志的方法，估算深度学习音频项目开发阶段的能耗，发现其能耗是训练最优模型的3至256倍，呼吁全生命周期能耗报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多关注模型训练与推理的能耗和碳排放，却忽视了架构原型设计与大量实验所在的开发阶段，而该阶段能耗极高。

Method: 基于LORIA实验室使用的Grid5000共享计算平台的活动日志，提出一套估算开发阶段能耗的方法，并以Multispeech研究团队的音频项目为案例，评估四个项目的总体能耗并与训练所报告模型的能耗进行比较。

Result: 开发阶段所需能耗是单独训练最优模型所需能耗的3至256倍。

Conclusion: 应更系统地对基于深度学习的音频项目全生命周期能耗进行报告。

Abstract: The environmental impact of deep learning has attracted increasing attention over the past decade. Existing studies mainly focus on the energy and carbon emissions of model training and inference, while the whole development phase is often overlooked. Yet, architecture prototyping and intensive experiments are conducted during this stage, which is highly energy-demanding. In this article, we propose a methodology to estimate these costs, based on activity logs from the Grid5000 shared computing platform used by the LORIA laboratory. As a case-study, we focus on audio projects developed in the Multispeech research team. We evaluate the overall energy cost of four projects, and we compare them to those of training the reported models. Our results show that the energy required for the development phase is 3 to 256 times greater than that required to train the best-performing model alone. These results advocate for a more systematic reporting of energy consumption across the entire life cycle of deep learning-based audio projects.

</details>


### [491] [Generalization in Neural Networks Through the Lens of Magnitude Potential](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01633)
*Sahel Torkamani,Henry Gouk,Rik Sarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"幅度势"(magnitude potential)这一基于度量幅度理论的新量，用于刻画任意点被给定集合表示的程度，并将其应用于分析神经网络的泛化与训练动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络泛化与训练动力学仍缺乏清晰解释，现有方法从不同角度切入，需要新的几何工具来刻画点的表示质量、记忆行为、决策边界变化等现象。

Method: 基于度量幅度理论定义"幅度势"，衡量点被集合表示的程度；在logit层计算某点相对于其类别的幅度势与相对于整个数据集的幅度势之比，作为表示的指标；并将各点的比值进行聚合分析。

Result: 个体训练点的幅度势比值与Feldman记忆分数相关；跨点聚合的幅度势比值能检测决策边界的结构性变化，为模算术中的grokking提供几何指标；即便显式抑制神经坍缩，幅度势比值仍具信息性。

Conclusion: 幅度势这一基础几何量能统一地揭示神经泛化的多种特征，具有广泛适用性，与神经坍缩密切相关但更具鲁棒性。

Abstract: Explaining generalization and training dynamics in neural networks remains a challenge, and various approaches have been developed to study different aspects of these phenomena. In this paper, we introduce the idea of {\em magnitude potential} -- a quantity based on the theory of metric magnitude -- that reflects how well an arbitrary point is represented by a given set. We find that this basic quantity can be applied to examine various features in neural generalization. The ratio between the magnitude potential with respect to a class and with respect to the entire data, computed at the logit layer, is informative of the representation of the point. In experiments, these ratios for individual training points are found to be correlated with the Feldman memorization scores. Magnitude potential ratios aggregated across points detect structural changes in the decision boundaries and provide a geometric indicator of grokking in modular arithmetic. Although the magnitude potential ratio and neural collapse are both closely associated with intra-class and inter-class geometric structure, the magnitude potential ratio remains informative even when neural collapse is explicitly suppressed.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [492] [Heavy-Tailed Memory Traces in Long-Horizon Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00010)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出以"记忆使用形态"为缺失评估对象，通过长尾审计发现LLM语义策略产生最强的截断幂律型核心-尾部检索痕迹，并据此设计基于排名的记忆控制器CTWM，在多个基准上以更少token保持或提升预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前长时程语言智能体依赖外部记忆作为冻结的世界模型，但记忆系统通常仅用任务成功率或token成本来评判，忽略了在有限上下文和重复检索条件下记忆使用分布形态这一关键维度；作者认为这导致稀有状态被遗落在长尾中、预测误差持续累积。

Method: 首先进行保守的长尾审计，刻画记忆集中现象的成因与可复现性，比较随机游走智能体与语义LLM策略的检索痕迹分布形态；进而提出Core-Tail World Model（CTWM），一种基于排名的记忆控制器，利用单一指数τ分配提示预算，并保留一个摘要化尾部。在Synthetic Graph World、ALFWorld与LongMemEval上进行配对比较实验。

Result: 审计显示集中现象可复现但依赖策略：随机游走产生与对数正态兼容的检索痕迹，而语义LLM策略产生最强的截断幂律核心-尾部痕迹。在Synthetic Graph World上，CTWM保持完整状态与转移覆盖，提示token减少5.9%，下半尾部预测误差较图记忆基线降低13.6%；在ALFWorld上token节省一致，在LongMemEval上token减少24.48%且总体准确率持平。

Conclusion: 重尾记忆痕迹不仅是有限检索的诊断信号，也可作为token高效智能体世界模型的实用控制信号；CTWM表明将记忆使用形态纳入控制回路可在保持覆盖率与精度的同时显著降低提示开销。

Abstract: Long-horizon language agents increasingly rely on external memory as a frozen world model, yet current memory systems are usually judged only by task success or token cost. We argue that the missing object is the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, agent memory can concentrate on a small core while leaving rare states in a long tail where prediction errors accumulate. We study this effect through a conservative tail audit and find that concentration is reproducible but policy-dependent. Random-walk agents produce log-normal-compatible retrieval artifacts, whereas semantic LLM policies yield the strongest truncated-power-law-compatible core--tail traces. Motivated by this audit, we propose Core--Tail World Model (CTWM), a rank-based memory controller that allocates prompt budget with a single exponent $τ$ while retaining a summarized tail. On Synthetic Graph World, CTWM preserves full state and transition coverage, reduces prompt tokens by 5.9%, and lowers bottom-half tail prediction error by 13.6% relative to a graph-memory baseline. The same paired comparison gives consistent token savings on ALFWorld and a 24.48% token reduction on LongMemEval with aggregate accuracy parity. These results suggest that heavy-tailed memory traces are not only a diagnostic of finite retrieval, but also a practical control signal for token-efficient agent world models.

</details>


### [493] [When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00012)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 FedCausalCompose 因果世界模型框架，论证 LLM 智能体在模块化系统中规划时，观测式世界模型存在不可消除的干预误差，而跨模块接口的因果结构仅在"可统计识别 + 行动时可被使用"两个条件同时满足时才能带来收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体越来越多地通过模块化服务（下单、支付、库存、物流）执行动作，一个模块中的动作会改变另一模块中有效的状态转移。标准世界模型通常拟合观测轨迹，但观测轨迹无法区分"支付先于发货"是支付授权了发货、库存中介了效应，还是存在隐藏共同触发因素，因此不满足干预时规划所需的量。论文旨在研究这一观测与干预之间的鸿沟。

Method: 提出 FedCausalCompose：面向模块化 LLM 智能体的因果世界模型框架，其中局部动作提供针对跨模块接口的"干预—响应"证据。理论上刻画三类性质：(1) 在未阻断的后门路径下观测式世界模型的不可消除干预误差；(2) 接口恢复随干预—响应覆盖度提升而改善；(3) 在覆盖度与局部机制误差受控时，oracle 因果组合可优于非因果下界。随后在诊断性智能体环境中检验由此得出的预测，对比结构化工具环境与对话/叙事环境，并测试"短注意力锚点"对因果信息可用性的影响。

Result: 因果接口在结构化工具环境（如 API 签名显式暴露前置条件与下游效应）中帮助最大；而在对话和叙事环境中，智能体往往忽略原始边列表（edge lists），除非加入一个短的注意力锚点使因果信息与决策相关。

Conclusion: 为 LLM 智能体的因果世界模型给出了一个具体适用条件：当跨模块接口既在统计上可识别，又以智能体在行动时刻可用的形式呈现时，因果结构才真正带来收益。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. Standard world models usually fit observational traces, but this is not the quantity needed for intervention-time planning: a trace may show that payment precedes shipment without identifying whether payment authorizes shipment, inventory mediates the effect, or a hidden trigger explains both. We study this gap through FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents in which local actions provide intervention-response evidence for cross-module interfaces. We first show that observational world models incur an irreducible interventional error under unblocked back-door paths, that interface recovery improves with intervention-response coverage, and that an oracle causal composition can beat the non-causal lower bound when coverage and local mechanism errors are controlled. We then test the resulting prediction in diagnostic agent settings. Causal interfaces help most in structured tool environments, where API signatures expose preconditions and downstream effects. In contrast, dialogue and narrative environments often ignore raw edge lists unless a short attention anchor makes the causal information decision-relevant. These results identify a concrete condition for causal world models in LLM agents: causal structure helps when cross-module interfaces are both statistically identifiable and presented in a form the agent can use at action time.

</details>


### [494] [From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00015)
*Stefan G. Creadore*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Praxa——一种将"提议、授权、调度、外部验证生效与上线推广"显式区分并可测试的智能体运行框架，但其四类证据均不支持性能或安全性上的优越性主张。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型智能体能够提出并执行动作，但"提出提议""获得授权""实际调度""经外部验证的真实效果""服务上线推广"是性质不同的主张，现有系统常将其混为一谈，缺乏显式、可测试的状态区分机制。

Method: 构建 Praxa 运行框架（agent harness），通过确定性准入、代理式执行、外部回读、对账以及经审核的推广流程，显式表示上述各状态；并在四条证据路径上评估：仓库本地审计（固定版本）、Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 试运行（12 项任务）、协调代理开发对比（180×2 试次）、以及已部署的源码/配置证据。

Result: 证据一：1,027/1,027 单元测试与 89/89 Workerd 测试通过，363 个源文件全部插桩并满足四项覆盖率下限，但原始逐测试记录与独立复现不可得。证据二：Terminal-Bench 试运行中基线与可靠性层各通过 17/36 严格试次，可靠性层多耗 37.49% 输入、50.73% 输出 token，不支持优越性。证据三：开发对比中两者均完成 180/180 试次、精度相同、崩溃恢复完全且零受保护违规；候选方案少用 37.11% token、低 33.84% 估算端点成本、少 11.63% 步骤，但未证明质量、时延或生产行为更优。证据四：部署证据显示反射有界、召回记账、记忆编译与工具健康路径，但无生产结果提升。

Conclusion: Praxa 有支撑的贡献仅在于一种"证据约束"架构，使授权到生效的转换显式且可测试；现有证据未能确立对抗安全性、生产安全、通用专家优越性、自主递归优化或用户收益。

Abstract: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. We present Praxa, an agent harness that represents these states explicitly through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. We report four evidence lanes. First, an author-run repository-local audit at a pinned revision passed 1,027/1,027 unit tests and 89/89 Workerd tests, instrumented all 363 expected source files, and met four coverage floors; raw per-test transcripts and independent reproduction are unavailable. Second, in a provider-backed Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 pilot across 12 curated tasks, baseline and reliability-layer arms each passed 17/36 strict trials. The reliability layer used 37.49% more input and 50.73% more output tokens, so the pilot does not support superiority. Third, in a post-debug, two-order coordination-proxy development comparison, baseline and a source-authored candidate each completed 180/180 trials with equal measured accuracy, full hermetic crash recovery, and zero protected violations. The candidate used 37.11% fewer tokens, 33.84% lower estimated endpoint cost, and 11.63% fewer steps; this does not establish improved quality, latency, or production behavior. Fourth, deployed source/configuration evidence shows bounded reflection, recall accounting, memory compilation, and tool-health paths, but no production outcome lift. Praxa's supported contribution is an evidence-bound architecture that makes authority-to-effect transitions explicit and testable. Current evidence does not establish adversarial security, production safety, general specialist superiority, autonomous recursive optimization, or user benefit.

</details>


### [495] [What Do Rationales Communicate? A Message-Intervention Study in Role-Specialized QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00018)
*Jiameng Zhang,Hongqiu Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"消息干预"诊断方法，在固定证据与候选答案的前提下仅变换reasoner传给verifier的rationale，发现忠实rationale几乎不提升答案准确率，但被破坏的rationale会显著改变支持性判断，揭示该信道是一类验证消息机制而非单纯的答案提升路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角色分工式QA流水线中，reasoner向verifier传递rationale已是常见做法，但该消息究竟带来什么并不清楚：是更好的答案、更强的支持性评估，还是新的失效面。作者希望厘清这一跨边界消息的真实作用，而非默认它有益。

Method: 设计消息干预诊断：固定证据与候选答案，仅改变跨reasoner-to-verifier边界的rationale。在400个MuSiQue、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA样本上，以DeepSeek分别作生成器与验证器；对比无rationale、忠实rationale、破坏rationale以及无害改写，并设置盲验证提示与显式rationale检查提示两种条件；辅以人工审计、跨模型检验与任务边界检验。

Result: 忠实rationale相对无rationale几乎不增加答案准确率；破坏rationale强烈改变支持判断。盲提示下无害改写仅使支持判断变动0–2.5%，破坏rationale变动10–22%；显式rationale检查提示将同一模式放大到34–55%。最终答案变动较小（2–30%），仅2.9–35.3%的支持翻转伴随答案变化。人工审计中16/42个有效破坏属"过度信任破坏"案例，盲审人类拒绝或标记不确定10个经审计的破坏rationale中的9个，而模型接受了它们。跨模型与任务边界检验显示该信道可处于激活、放大、惰性或并入任务标签的状态。

Conclusion: rationale共享应被作为验证消息机制来评估，而不仅仅视为通往更高答案准确率的途径；其核心风险在于破坏性rationale对验证判断的过度影响与人类–模型审计分歧。

Abstract: Role-specialized QA pipelines increasingly pass rationales from a reasoner to a verifier, but it is unclear what this message actually buys: better answers, stronger support assessment, or a new failure surface. We introduce a message-intervention diagnostic that fixes the evidence and candidate answer while varying only the rationale passed across the reasoner-to-verifier boundary. On 400 MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA examples with DeepSeek as generator and verifier, faithful rationales add almost no answer accuracy over no rationale, while corrupted rationales strongly alter support judgments. Under a blind verifier prompt, harmless paraphrases shift support by only 0--2.5%, whereas corrupted rationales shift support by 10--22%; an explicit rationale-checking prompt amplifies the same pattern to 34--55%. Final answers move less (2--30%), and only 2.9--35.3% of corrupted support flips co-occur with answer changes. Human audits show why this matters: 16/42 valid corruptions are corruption-overtrust cases, and blind humans reject or mark unclear 9/10 audited corrupted rationales that the model accepts. Cross-model and task-boundary checks show when the channel is active, amplified, inert, or folded into the task label. Rationale sharing should be evaluated as a verification-message mechanism, not merely as a route to higher answer accuracy.

</details>


### [496] [Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00025)
*Jundong Hu,Shekar Ramachandran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文构建了4个智能体微任务基准（含固定提示、自动指标、基于置信区间的资格规则），对Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B（FP16）及Llama-3.x进行评测，发现16/16配置全部未达阈值；通过logprob决策阈值诊断将失败划分为能力缺陷与解码阈值可修复两类（4种情形）；4-bit量化造成的损伤依模型规模而定且未使任何配置合格，说明差距更多由模型规模而非精度驱动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent harness increasingly delegate microtasks around a frontier LLM planner (shell-command auto-approval, memory writing, tool selection, past-turn ranking) to small language models. 作者想回答：现成SLM能否达到从业者设定的阈值？若失败原因何在？量化是否会改变结论？

Method: 构建4个微任务基准，采用固定提示与自动指标；每个任务设定预注册阈值τ，锚定于廉价非LLM基线，并配CI感知资格规则（置信上/下界需越过τ）。在Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B最优配置（FP16、贪心解码、单一冻结提示、零调优）上大规模扫描，共16个配置。引入logprob决策阈值诊断（T1/T3/T4直接做，T2用上下文长度/级联探针），将失败划分为能力缺陷与可通过改变解码阈值解决两类（4种情形）。量化实验：4-bit RTN/GPTQ/AWQ，在可重构硬标签任务T1/T3上做认证、T2/T4上做诊断与窗口化稳健性检验。稳健性检验包括τ扫描（锚点选择）、提示改写（原始+3个中性改写）、以及在Llama-3.x上的复现。

Result: 资格差距存在：0/16（4任务×4模型）配置通过阈值，已通过检查原始输出与解析器行为验证。logprob诊断将失败分为能力缺陷和可通过调整解码阈值解决两类。4-bit量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）的损伤依赖模型规模，且未使任何配置进入合格区间，说明差距更多由模型规模而非量化精度驱动。结论在Llama-3.x上复现（12/12不合格），并稳健于锚点选择（τ扫描）和提示措辞（原始加3个中性改写下0/112合格）。实用启示：让SLM只部署在基线未达阈值之处——例如4B重排器在BM25短列表上可超过BM25（+0.047 [0.020, 0.073]），但其本身仍未通过资格认证。

Conclusion: 现成SLM在智能体微任务上普遍达不到从业者设定的CI支持阈值，且量化并非主因（模型规模更关键）。实际部署策略应是将SLM置于满足CI阈值的非LLM基线之后，仅在基线未达标处使用SLM（如4B重排器相对BM25有增益但自身仍不合格）。

Abstract: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. We ask whether off-the-shelf SLMs meet practitioner-defined thresholds and, when they fail, why, and whether quantization changes the answer. We build a benchmark of 4 such microtasks with fixed prompts and automatic metrics, each with a pre-specified threshold $τ$ anchored to a cheap non-LLM baseline and a CI-aware eligibility rule (a configuration passes only if its confidence bound clears $τ$). Sweeping Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B at their best (FP16, greedy, one frozen prompt, no tuning), we find an eligibility gap: 0 of 16 (4 tasks $\times$ 4 models) configurations pass (verified by checking the raw outputs and parser behavior). A logprob decision-threshold diagnostic (T1/T3/T4; T2 via a context-length/cascade probe) separates the failures into capability deficits and failures that can be addressed by changing the decoding threshold (4 regimes). Quantization to 4-bit (RTN/GPTQ/AWQ) does damage that depends on model size and moves no configuration into eligibility (certified on the reconstructable hard-label tasks T1/T3, diagnostic/windowed robustness on T2/T4), so the gap tracks model size more than precision; it replicates on Llama-3.x (12/12 ineligible) and is robust to the anchor choice (a $τ$-sweep) and to prompt wording (0/112 eligible across the original plus 3 neutral paraphrases per cell). The practical implication: place SLMs behind a baseline that meets the CI-backed threshold, and use the SLM only where the baseline fails to meet the threshold; e.g. a 4B re-ranker over a BM25 shortlist beats BM25 ($+0.047$ [0.020, 0.073], without itself certifying eligibility).

</details>


### [497] [Characterizing a Configuration Where Inference-Time PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting Is Inert: Evidence from Three Reasoning LMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00047)
*Khawaja Murad ul Hassan,Mehran Ebrahimi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文隔离出"PRM剪枝片段嫁接"(PPFG)机制，在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct + Math-Shepherd + MATH500全量(500题/3种子)上验证其与独立并行CoT基线在各指标上统计无差异，并通过四类事件分类、等价性检验(TOST)、反事实与事后oracle上界分析，论证该机制在此操作点上是"惰性"的，并给出推理期机制零假设的等价性检验模板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行链式思维(parallel CoT)存在多样性坍缩，催生了一系列推理期干预。其中一种自然设计是：当过程奖励模型(PRM)剪枝某条链时，抽取其高PRM前缀并原样嫁接为上下文示例到仍在解码的兄弟链中。然而已有片段嫁接工作在无额外补偿成分时收益有限，因此需要在一个"收益仅在附加条件下出现"的操作点上，单独隔离并检验该机制本身是否有效。

Method: 将上述机制隔离定义为PPFG(PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting)，作为跨轨迹步骤级迁移的最小成本实现。在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct + Math-Shepherd + MATH500(n=500，三种子)上，比较PPFG的两种变体(停滞目标选择、随机目标选择)与独立并行CoT基线。分析手段包括：对322次停滞规则注入事件做四桶分类；复合门控精化扫描；随机对照(2.4倍触发率)；跨3个基座LM、6个基准、第二个PRM及兼容性门控扫描的复现；用双单侧检验(TOST)将"无差异"提升为"正等价"；逐事件抽查与幸存兄弟反事实；以及事后oracle上界。

Result: PPFG两种变体在所有测量轴上与独立并行CoT基线统计不可区分。322次注入事件中仅14%命中真正陷入困境的链，其余落在已成功、接近完成或处于PRM平台的链上，救援嫁接无法改变这些状态。无任何复合门控能同时实现良好靶向触发与足够密度；随机对照以2.4倍触发率仍保持同等"无差异"，说明惰性非启发式特有。结论在3个基座LM、6个基准、第二个PRM及兼容性门控扫描下复现；TOST在全部12个Qwen/LLaMA单元上将"无差异"升格为"正等价"。逐事件抽查显示注入链的剪枝率为匹配步率的2.75倍，但幸存兄弟反事实未发现群体层面补偿。事后oracle将PPFG相对独立方案的单题收益上界限定为+0.13pp。

Conclusion: PPFG在这一被测试操作点上对并行CoT推理是惰性的(null)，其失效源于目标选择无法区分可救援与不可救援状态，而非某特定启发式的问题。作者贡献了一个用于确立推理期机制零假设的等价性检验模板，并强调所有结论均严格限定于其测试的操作点。

Abstract: Diversity collapse in parallel chain-of-thought has motivated inference-time interventions built on a natural design: when a process reward model (PRM) prunes a chain, its high-PRM prefix is extracted and grafted verbatim as an in-context demonstration into a still-decoding sibling. We isolate this mechanism, PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting (PPFG), as the most cost-minimal operationalization of cross-trajectory step-level transfer, and test it at the operating point where prior fragment-grafting work reports gains only under additional compensating ingredients. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with Math-Shepherd on full MATH500 (n=500, three seeds), PPFG in both stagnation- and random-targeting variants is statistically indistinguishable from an independent parallel-CoT baseline on every measured axis. We characterize why: a four-bucket classification of 322 stagnation-rule injection events shows only 14% targeted a genuinely struggling chain; the rest landed on chains that had already succeeded, were near completion, or sat on a flat PRM plateau, states a rescue graft cannot change. No compound-gate refinement jointly achieves well-targeted firing and adequate density, and a random control matches the same parity at 2.4x the firing rate, so the inertness is not heuristic-specific. The finding replicates across three base LMs, six benchmarks, a second PRM, and a compatibility-gate sweep; two-one-sided-tests analysis promotes the parity to positive equivalence on all twelve Qwen/LLaMA cells. A per-event spot-check finds injected chains prune at 2.75x the matched-step rate, but a surviving-sibling counterfactual finds no population-level compensation. A hindsight oracle bounds any per-problem gain from choosing PPFG over independent at +0.13 pp. We contribute an equivalence-testing template for establishing inference-time mechanism nulls, with every claim scoped to its tested operating point.

</details>


### [498] [Gradient-Aligned Pair Selection for Personalized Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00061)
*Ruoming Jin,Xinyu Li,Hao Zhou,Jianfeng Zhu,Ruixin Guo,Feodor Dragan,Lei Xu,Haixun Wang,Yang Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐优化问题，揭示DPO更新方向与用户效用梯度的一阶交互规律，提出GAP-DPO算法进行效用感知、几何对齐的偏好对选择，在个性化文本生成任务上一致优于标准DPO变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化LLM需要生成行为与用户特定偏好对齐，而非仅追求聚合质量。DPO虽为偏好学习提供了稳定框架，但在个性化场景下其效果严重依赖偏好对的选择方式。现有方法多依赖启发式准则（如基于似然的极端样本），将优化与显式用户效用解耦，可能导致个性化性能退化。

Method: 作者将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐优化问题，分析期望用户效用梯度与DPO更新方向之间的一阶交互。分析表明：在离策略采样下，当偏好边际与效用梯度方向对齐时，DPO更新会从纯误差纠正信号转变为类强化学习更新。据此提出GAP-DPO（Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO），一种迭代算法，执行效用感知、几何对齐的偏好对选择，并通过逐轮（epoch-wise）再生成控制分布漂移。

Result: 在个性化文本生成基准上的实验表明，GAP-DPO在风格保真度、偏好对齐和生成质量方面均持续优于标准DPO变体。

Conclusion: 研究结果确立了梯度对齐作为个性化偏好优化的统一原则，并证明偏好对选择是优化几何的内在组成部分，而非启发式预处理步骤。

Abstract: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) requires aligning generation behavior with user-specific preferences rather than aggregate quality. While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) provides a stable framework for preference learning, its effectiveness in personalized settings critically depends on how preference pairs are selected. Existing approaches typically rely on heuristic criteria, such as likelihood-based extremes, which decouple optimization from explicit user utility and can lead to degraded personalization. We formalize personalized preference learning as a geometry-aligned optimization problem by analyzing the first-order interaction between gradients of expected user utility and DPO update directions. Our analysis reveals that, under off-policy sampling, the DPO update transitions from a purely error-corrective signal to a reinforcement-like update when preference margins are directionally aligned with utility gradients. This perspective exposes pair selection as a geometric decision that governs whether preference optimization advances or hinders personalization. Motivated by this insight, we propose GAP-DPO (Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO), an iterative algorithm that performs utility-aware, geometry-aligned pair selection while controlling distribution shift via epoch-wise regeneration. Experiments on personalized text generation benchmarks show that GAP-DPO consistently improves stylistic fidelity, preference alignment, and generation quality compared to standard DPO variants. Together, our results establish gradient alignment as a unifying principle for personalized preference optimization and demonstrate that pair selection is an intrinsic component of the optimization geometry rather than a heuristic preprocessing step.

</details>


### [499] [K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00074)
*Aubrey M. Brueckner,Darshil Patel,Yuhuan He,Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: K-Dense BYOK 是一款免费开源的本地运行 AI 科研助手，通过科学流程库、Living Lab Notebook 与不可篡改的观察式日志，将模型过度声称问题从"事前防止"转为"事后可核查"。在20个跨学科研究提示上，其在科学质量与研究执行两项指标上均优于两个托管平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有聊天助手与通用编码代理缺乏科研所需的领域脚手架、可追溯记录与可信执行日志。作者前期对九个前沿模型的基准测试显示，最常见的失败模式是模型过度声称（model overclaiming），因此需要一个让声明可被核查而非被禁止的工具，同时保证数据、代码与记录留在研究者自控的机器上、长期可读。

Method: 系统在研究者自有计算机上运行，模型可由研究者自选（托管或本地），应用提供运行环境、科学脚手架与完整记录。每个项目为普通文件夹。三大差异化设计：①内置科学流程库、引导式工作流模板、研究数据目录以及可移交任务的审稿人与写作角色；②维护 Living Lab Notebook，条目相互链接成论证链，只增不删；③通过观察代理行为而非采信代理自述来记录过程，日志位于代理无写入工具的通道。评测采用20个跨学科研究提示，按预先固定的评分标准打分，并与两个托管平台对比。

Result: 在科学质量与研究执行两方面，K-Dense BYOK 均领先两个托管平台。其交付物是唯一记录了所运行软件的，也是唯一通常附带可复现结果的命令的。其中一个托管平台使用相同的前沿模型，却两项均未提供。需要指出的是，这些环境记录是代理写入的文件，而非观察式日志的一部分，当前日志尚未捕获软件环境本身。

Conclusion: 观察式、代理不可写入的日志与本地化、文件夹式的项目结构，能使科研 AI 的声明可被核查并长期可读，从而缓解模型过度声称这一主要失败模式。代码以 MIT 许可证开源。局限在于观察日志尚未覆盖软件环境，环境信息仍依赖代理自报文件。

Abstract: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the application. Three things separate it from a chat assistant or a general-purpose coding agent. It ships a library of written scientific procedures, guided workflow templates, catalogs of where research data can be found, and reviewer and writer roles the agent can hand work to. It keeps a Living Lab Notebook whose entries link into an argument and are added to but never erased. And it records what happened by watching what the agent does rather than by taking the agent's word for it, in a log the agent has no tool that can write to. That choice targets the most common failure, model overclaiming, in our earlier benchmark of nine frontier models, by making claims checkable rather than preventing them. On twenty interdisciplinary research prompts, scored under a rubric fixed in advance, K-Dense BYOK led two managed platforms on both scientific quality and research execution. Its deliverables were the only ones that recorded the software they ran in, and the only ones that usually arrived with a command that regenerates the results. One of the managed platforms ran the same frontier model and supplied neither. Those environment records were files the agent wrote, not part of the observed log, which does not yet capture the software environment itself. The code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok.

</details>


### [500] [Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00084)
*Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在9个科学基准(4531题)与60个生物信息学工具调用任务上，专业化的系统提示词(AGENTS.md画像)相比最简基线并未带来一致准确率提升，反而使输出token增至1.5–2.3倍、单次成功调用成本增至2.2–4.5倍；工具任务解出率还下降了10个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 业界普遍在系统提示中加载详细的职业/领域专属画像，隐含假设这类提示能提升模型在专业任务上的表现。本文旨在检验该假设是否成立，并量化其token与成本代价，判断"默认加载完整专业画像"这一做法是否有实证依据。

Method: 构建开源语料 Scientific Agents，包含503个职业专属 AGENTS.md 画像。使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash（经 OpenRouter，Pi agent harness）进行对照实验：实验组为匹配的专业画像，对照组包括①最简基线"你是一个有帮助的助手"、②画像的开场角色句、③通用科学严谨性指南、④无关领域的画像。评测覆盖9个文本类科学基准（采样4531题、100个匹配画像，经API错误重试后4488题完成全部5种条件），采用自动化规则打分；另在60个需调用工具的 BioMysteryBench 生物信息学问题上对基线与画像各跑3次。统计采用固定任务上的bootstrap区间。

Result: 画像与基线的平均准确率差为 -0.6 个百分点（95% bootstrap 区间 [-1.5, +0.2]），无任何基准出现统计上明确的提升。匹配画像输出token为基线的1.5–2.3倍，单次成功调用成本为2.2–4.5倍。工具类任务中画像平均解出率46.7%，基线56.7%，差 -10.0 个百分点（95%区间 [-16.7, -3.3]），主要因画像条件下更频繁触发token与时间上限而中止。唯一意外收益出现在 SuperGPQA：供应商API频繁掉线时，短基线仅54.0%题目首轮即得正确答案，画像为71.6%；但通用与错配画像可靠性相近，说明该收益源自提示长度/格式而非领域专业性。

Conclusion: 在受测模型与任务上，默认加载完整职业画像不提升准确率且成本显著更高，不具性价比。提示长度/格式可能在API不稳定场景下带来偶然的稳健性优势，但与领域专长无关。作者提出后续需验证的方向：画像片段的选择性检索（而非整体加载），以及开放式科研任务是否改变结论。

Abstract: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.

</details>


### [501] [Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00197)
*Sam Larson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究会话幽默训练中的自动化奖励及其被"钻空子"(reward exploit)的问题。研究发现基于嵌入的"惊喜"奖励会被乱序词回复欺骗，流畅性过滤器虽能识别乱序但会误伤机智回复；听众模型预测的笑声也易受说话人消息中的笑声线索操纵。归一化线索可阻断已知攻击，但未匹配表达仍可被利用。三次强化学习实验显示，最终奖励版本使综合评分提升0.0903、零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项提升仍未达标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化奖励可为语言模型的会话幽默训练提供可扩展的监督信号，但这类奖励往往存在可被策略"钻空子"的捷径，导致模型优化奖励而非真正的幽默能力。作者希望系统性地揭示这些漏洞并设计对策。

Method: 作者考察两类奖励设计：(1)旨在捕捉"可理解的惊喜"与"预期听众愉悦"的奖励；(2)基于听众模型预测笑声音量的奖励。通过受控实验测试奖励的抗攻击性，并设计对策（流畅性过滤器、跨说话人笑声线索归一化），最后用三次逐步修订奖励的强化学习训练进行评估。

Result: 受控测试显示，基于嵌入的惊喜奖励对乱序词回复与机智回复给予相近奖励；流畅性过滤器能检测乱序，但组合奖励会拒绝部分机智回复且未能通过进一步验证。听众模型预测的笑声易受任一说话人消息中的笑声线索影响；跨说话人归一化可阻断已覆盖的攻击，但未匹配的表达仍可利用。最终强化学习运行使综合评分提升0.0903、零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项提升低于预注册目标。

Conclusion: 自动化奖励设计面临一个更广泛的挑战：对策必须既能阻断可利用的捷径，又要保留奖励原本想鼓励的目标行为。单纯的过滤或归一化难以同时满足两者。

Abstract: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.

</details>


### [502] [EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00212)
*Yixi Zhou,Sikun Wang,Lei Fan,Fan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 EviGraph，区分决策的关键要求与可搁置信息，用语言智能体在时序知识图谱中链接证据，并由确定性检查器判定推荐是否有据，从而减少不必要的弃答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共服务推荐需要与服务类型、范围和日期匹配的证据，但若把所有缺失细节都视为决定性因素，会导致系统过度弃答、错失有用推荐。

Method: EviGraph：语言智能体将关键决策要求链接到时序知识图谱中的证据，确定性检查器判定推荐是否被支持，从而区分必须确立的要求与可保持未决的信息。

Result: 在带可执行政策引用的双语香港公共服务基准上，该区分显著减少不必要的弃答；但额外验证会在不提升决策质量的情况下撤回原本被支持的推荐。

Conclusion: 可靠的循证导航取决于明确界定决策必须确立的条件，而非单纯增加验证环节。

Abstract: Public-service recommendations require evidence that matches the requested service, scope, and date. Yet treating every missing detail as decisive can withhold useful recommendations. We introduce EviGraph, which distinguishes critical decision requirements from information that can remain unresolved. A language agent links these requirements to evidence in a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker establishes whether a recommendation is supported. Evaluation on a bilingual Hong Kong public-service benchmark with executable policy references shows that this distinction reduces unnecessary abstention. Additional verification, however, can withdraw supported recommendations without improving decision quality. These findings suggest that reliable evidence-based navigation depends on specifying what must be established for a decision, rather than simply adding more verification.

</details>


### [503] [Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00224)
*Wooyoung Jung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Build2SPARQL：面向建筑知识图谱的大规模文本到SPARQL基准，通过图遍历代码生成并验证查询、LLM仅生成自然语言问题，在201个KG上产出6,136条可执行SPARQL与30,680个问题，检索增强可将精确匹配从0.2-20%提升至56-65%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑自动化系统日益以Brick、ASHRAE 223P等本体构建为语义知识图谱，使"自然语言问题→SPARQL"（text-to-SPARQL）成为让运维人员用语言代理查询图谱的潜在应用。但该方向受限于缺乏大规模自然语言/SPARQL基准数据集，进展缓慢。

Method: 提出KG-groundedly构建流水线：SPARQL查询完全由图遍历代码生成并验证，LLM仅负责生成自然语言问题，从而保证查询正确性独立于模型行为。覆盖六类查询模式族（线性链、分支、UNION、聚合、OPTIONAL、属性过滤），每题以五种词汇语域表述。应用于201个建筑KG（180个Brick、21个ASHRAE 223P）。

Result: 生成6,136条可执行SPARQL查询与30,680个问题。由两名标注者人工验证300个问题，语义保真度98.8%、自然度98.8%、操作合理性84.0%。在三个开放权重语言模型上的检索增强评测中，精确匹配准确率由零样本的0.2-20%提升至三样本检索的56-65%。

Conclusion: Build2SPARQL为建筑知识图谱的text-to-SPARQL提供了大规模、查询正确性可控的基准，验证了检索增强对提升LLM查询生成能力的有效性，可支撑建筑运维语言代理的进一步研究。

Abstract: Building automation systems are increasingly represented as semantic knowledge graphs (KGs) using ontologies such as Brick and ASHRAE 223P, creating a machine-readable substrate for artificial-intelligence applications. One promising application is translating natural-language questions into SPARQL (text-to-SPARQL), which would let building operators query these graphs through language agents, but progress is limited by the scarcity of large natural-language/SPARQL benchmarks. This paper presents Build2SPARQL, a large-scale benchmark for building KGs generated by a KG-grounded pipeline: SPARQL queries are produced and validated entirely by graph-traversal code, while large language models generate only the natural-language questions, keeping query correctness independent of model behavior. The pipeline mines six query-pattern families -- linear chains, branching, UNION, aggregation, OPTIONAL, and attribute-filtered -- and phrases each query across five vocabulary registers. Applied to 201 building KGs (180 Brick, 21 ASHRAE 223P), it yields 6,136 executable SPARQL queries and 30,680 questions. A two-rater human validation of 300 questions found 98.8% semantic fidelity, 98.8% naturalness, and 84.0% operational plausibility. A retrieval-augmented evaluation across three open-weight language models raised exact-match accuracy from 0.2-20% (zero-shot) to 56-65% (three-shot retrieved).

</details>


### [504] [Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00233)
*Cris Huynh*

Main category: cs.AI
